(48) iko yaṇaci |6|1|77|
iko yaṇaci | ṭhika' iti ṣaṣṭhī | ataḥ ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyoge'ti
paribhāṣayā sthāna iti labhyate | sthānaṃ prasaṅga ityuktam | varṇānāṃ
varṇāntarādhikaraṇatvā'sambhavāt, acīti satisaptamī | ṭhtasminniti
nirdiṣṭe pūrvasye'ti paribhāṣāyā varṇāntarāvyavahitoccārite'ci

saṃhitāyāmityadhikṛtam | tataścārdhamātrādhikakālavyavadhānā'bhāvo

sūtrākṣarānusāriprācīnamatānasāreṇa | ṭhsaṃhitāyā'miti sūtrabhāṣye
tu sāmīpikātmakaupaśleṣikādhikaraṇe acīti saptamīṃ
tasminnityanenāśritya saṃhitādhikāraḥ pratyākhyātaḥ | itthaṃ hi tatra
bhāṣyam - ṭhayaṃ yogaḥ śakyo'vaktum | katham?| adhikaraṇaṃ nāma
triprakāraṃ vyāpakamaupaśleṣikaṃ vaiṣayikamiti | śabdasya tu śabdena
ko'nyo'bhisaṃbandho bhavitumarhatyanyadata upaśleṣāt | iko yaṇaci
acyupaśliṣṭasyeti | tatrāntareṇa saṃhitāgrahaṇaṃ saṃhitāyāmeva
bhaviṣyatī'ti | upausamīpe śleṣaḥusaṃbandhaḥ-upaśleṣaḥ,
tatkṛtamadhikaraṇamauvaśleṣikaṃ sāmīpikamiti yāvat | evaṃ
cā'csamīpavartina ika iti phalati | sāmīpyaṃ ca kālato varṇataśca
vyavadhānā'bhāvaḥ | evaṃ cā'saṃhitāyāmuktasāmīpyā'bhāvādeva
yaṇabhāvasiddheḥ saṃhitādhikāro na kartavya iti bhāṣyārthaḥ | evaṃ ca
tusyanyāyātasminniti nirdiṣṭe
pūrvasyetyatrāpyaupaśleṣikādhikaraṇe saptamī |
tataścā'cītyādisaptamyantārthe'kārādāvuccārite sāmīpyasambandhena
vidyamānasya pūrvasya kāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ | phalati |
natvavyavahitoccārite ityavyavahitatvaviśeṣaṇamuccārite deyam,
sāmīpikādhikaraṇasaptamyaiva tallābhāt | sāmīpyasya ca tatra kālato
varṇataśca vyavadhānā'bhāvātmakatvāt | evaṃ ca tatra nairantaryārthaṃ
nirgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam | idaṃ ca ṭhsnukramo'riti sūtre, ṭhtatra ca
dīyate' iti sūtre ca kaiyaṭe sapaṣṭam | adhikaraṇatraividhyaṃ tu
kārakādhikāre ṭhādhāro'dhikaraṇa'mityatra spaṣṭīkariṣyate | sudhī
iti | dhyai cintāyāmiti dhātordhyāyateḥ samprasāraṇaṃ ceti kvipi
yakārasya samprasāraṇe ikāre pūrvarūpe halaśceti dīrghe ca dhīśabdaḥ |
suṣṭhua dhyāyantīti sudhiyaḥ | suuśobhanā dhīryeṣāmiti vā sudhiyaḥ |
sudhībhi rūpāsya iti vigrahaḥ | ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahula'miti
samāsaḥ | ṭhsupo dhātuprātipadikayo'riti bhiso luk | ṭhsudhī
upāsya iti sthite īkārasya yakāra ityanvayaḥ | pratyāha#areṣu
tadvācyavācyeṣu lakṣaṇā nājjhalāviti sūtre prapañcitā | tatsphoraṇāya
īkāra udāhṛtaḥ | nanu īkārasya varalāḥ kuto na syuḥ,
yaṇtvā'viśeṣāṃdityata āha-sthānata āntaryāditi |

iko yaṇaci | dadhyatra | madhvatra | naitadasti |

| saṃkhyātānudeśenāpyetatsiddha'mityuktam | yathāsaṃkhyasūtreṇetyarthaḥ
| nanviha yaṇśabdena niranunāsikā yavalā rephaśceti catvāro

ikÂtvayaṇtvādinā'nugatīkṛtānāṃ samatvāt | nanu ṛlavarṇābhyāṃ

lādeśasya ca prasaṅga iti na yathāsaṃkhyasūtreṇa nirvāha iti cet,
śrṛṇu-ṛtvāvaccchinnasya repho bhavati, lṛtvāvaccchinnasya lakāro
bhavatīti yathāsaṃkhyasūtrāllabhyate | ṛtvajātiśca na lṛvarṇeṣu |
lṛtvajātiśca na ṛvarṇeṣu | ṛlṛvarṇayoḥ sāvarṇyavidhibalātu
ṛtvam lṛkāre, lṛtvamṛkāre ca āropyate kāryārtham | evaṃ ca
vāstavamṛtvaṃ lṛtvaṃ ca ādāyātra yathāsaṃkhyapravṛtirnirbādhetyāstāṃ
tāvat |

(50) sthānivadādeśo'nalvidhau |1|1|56|

nanu sudh y ityatra īkārasthānikasya yakārasya
sthānivadbhāvenāctvādcparakatvātkathaṃ dhakārasya dvitvamiti
śaṅkā hṛdi nidhāya tasya
sthānivadbhāvaprāpakasūtramāha-sthānivadādeśaḥ | gurusthānāpanne
guruputrādau sthānāpatyā taddharmalābho lokataḥ siddhaḥ |
kuśādisthānāpanneṣu śarādiṣu ca vaidikanyāyasiddhaḥ | iha tu śāstre
svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasyeti vacanātsthānidharmā ādeśeṣu na prāpnuyuriti
tatprāptyarthaṃ sthānivadādeśa ityārabdham | ṭhsthānaṃ prasaṅga' ityuktam
| yasya sthāne'nyadvidhīyate tatsthāni | yena vidhīyamānena anyatprasaktaṃ
nivartate sa ādeśaḥ | sthāninā tulyaḥ sthānivat | ṭhtena
tulya'miti vatipratyayaḥ | ādeśaḥ sthāninā tulyo bhati |
sthānidharmako bhavatīti yāvat | aliti varṇaparyāyaḥ | vidhīyata iti
vidhiḥukāryam | alāśrayo vidhi alvidhiḥ analvidhiḥ | alāśrayabhinne
kārye kartavye iti pratīyamāno'rthaḥ | alāśrayakārye kartavye
sthānivanna bhavatīti phalitam | alāśrayeti sāmānyavacanāt alā
vidhiḥ, alaḥ parasya vidhiḥ, alo vidhiḥ Âli vidhiśceti sarvasaṃgrahaḥ |
alā vidhau yathā-vyūḍhora skena | atra visarjanīyasya saḥ' iti
visargasthānikasya sakārasya va#sirgatvamāśritya aḍvyavāya iti ṇatvaṃ
prāptaṃ na bhavati | alaḥ parasya vidhau yathā-dyauḥ | ṭhdiva āṬ'diti
vakārasthānikasya āṬkārasya sthānivadbhāvena haltvātataḥ parasya
sorhalṅyādilopaḥ prāpto na bhavati | alo vidhau yatā dyaukāmaḥ |
ṭhdiva u'diti vakārasthānikasya ukārasya sthānivadbhāvena
vakāratvāt ṭhlopo vyorvalī'ti lopaḥ prāpto na bhavati | ali
vidhau yathā-ka iṣṭaḥ | yajeḥ ktaḥ | atra yakārasthānikasaṃprasāraṇasya
ikārahasya sthānivadbhāvena haśtvāt haśi ce'tyutvaṃ prāptaṃ na
bhavati | al ceha sthānibhūtaḥ, sthānyavayavaśca gṛhyate | tataśca
ādeśasya sthānibhūto yo'l, sthānyavayavaśca yo'l, tadāśrayavidhau
na sthānivaditi phalati | tatra sthānībhūtā'lvidhau
vyūḍhoraskenetyudāhṛtameva | yathā vā-dhivi prīṇana iti dhātorlaṭi
prathamapuruṣasya jherantādeśe ṭhdhinvikṛṇvyora ca' iti vikaraṇasya
ukārasya yaṇi vakāre sati tasya sthānivadbhāvenārdhadhātukatvāt
svato valāditvācca iḍāgamaḥ prāpto na bhavati, vakārasya
sthānibhūto yo'l ukāraḥ, tadādeśaṃ vakāramārdhadhātukatvenāśritya
pravartamānasya iṭaḥ sthānyalāśrayatvāt | sthānyavayavālāśrayavidhau yathā
pratidīvya | iha ktvādeśasya ya ityasya sthānivadbhāvena
balādyārdhadhātukatvādiḍāgamaḥ prāpto na bhavati | iḍāgamasya
valāditvaviṣaye sthānyavayavabhūtālāśrayatvāt | tadetadāha-ādeśaḥ
sthānivatsyānnatu sthānyalāśrayavidhāviti | sthānyalāśrayetyatra
sthānīti kim ?| rāmāya | iha ṭhsupi ce'ti dīrghasya
yañādisubāśrayasya ādeśagatayakārarūpālāśrayatve'pi tasmin
kartavye yādeśasya sthānivadbhāvena suptvaṃ bhavatyeva, dīrghasya
ādeśagatayakārarūpālāśrayatve'pi sthānyalāśrayatvā'bhāvāt | na ca
nīñdhātorṇbuli akādeśe vṛddhau nai-aka iti sthite aikārasya
sthānivadbhāvena īkāradharmakatvādāyādeśo na syāt, īkārasya
āyādeśābhāvāditi vācyam, iha hi sthāniprayuktaṃ yat kāryaṃ
śāstrīyaṃ tadevātidiśyate | īkārasya ca āyādeśabhāvo na
śāstravihita iti na tasya īkārasthānike aikāre atideśa ityāstāṃ
tāvat | aneneti | udāhṛtena sthānivatsūtreṇa ihausudhy ityatra
īkārasthānikasya yakārasya sthānivadbhāvena
ackāryakāritvamāśritya aci na dvitvamityarthakena anacītyanena
dhakārasya dvitvaniṣedho na śaṅkanīya ityarthaḥ | kuta ityata
āha--analvidhāviti tanniṣedhāditi | sthānivatvaniṣedhādityarthaḥ |
yakārādeśasthānībhūto yo'l īkāraḥ tadgatamactvaṃ yakāre
āśritya pravartamānasya yakāradvitvaniṣedhasya sthānyalāśrayatvāditi
bhāvaḥ |
(51) acaḥ parasminpūrvavidhau |1|1|57|
nanu sudh y ityatra māstu sthānivaditi sūtreṇa sthānivadbhāvaḥ |
tadgutarasūtreṇa tu sthānivatvaṃ syādeveti
śaṅkāmudbhāvayiṣyaṃstathāvidhamutarasūtramāha-acaḥ parasmin |
sthānivatsūtreṇaiva siddhe kimarthamidaṃ sūtramityata
āha-alvidhyarthamiti | alāśrayavidhāvapi sthānivadbhāvārthamityarthaḥ |
tena vavraśceti sidhyati | ṭho vraścū cchedane' | liṭi tipi ṇali
dvitvam | ṭhliṭhaḷbhyāsasye'ti abhyacāse rephasya samprasāraṇam |
ṛkāraḥ | pūrvarūpam | uradatvam | raparatvam | halādiśśeṣaḥ |
tatrābhyāse vakārasya punaḥ samprasāraṇaṃ na, ñakārasthānikasya
uradatvasya sthānivadbhāvena samprasāraṇatayā ṭhna samprasāraṇe
samprasāraṇam' iti niṣedhāt | pūrvasūtreṇa tvatra sthānivadbhāvo
na sambhavati--samprasāraṇaniṣedhasya sthānyalāśrayatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
pūrvasūtrādiha sthānivadādeśa ityanuvartate | aca ityetadādeśa
ityanenānveti-aca ādeśa iti | parahasminniti sati saptamī | tataśca
paranimitaka iti labhyate | taccādeśaviśeṣaṇam |
tadāha--paranimito'jādeśaiti | vidhīyata iti bidhiḥukāryam |
pūrvasya vidhiḥ pūrvavidhiḥ | pūrvatvaṃ ca yadyapi sāvadhikam, trayaṃ
cātra saṃnihitaṃ-sthānī ādeśaḥ paranimitaṃ ceti | tatra sthānī
tāvannāvadhirbhavitumarhati, tasyādeśenāpahārāt | nāpyādeśaḥ,
nāpi paranimitam, vaiyākaraṇa ityatra
ikārasthānikayaṇādeśātatparanimitādākārācca pūrvasya na
yvābhyāmityaikārasya āyaṭādeśe kartavye yaṇādeśasya
sthānivadbhāvenā'ctvāpateḥ | tathāpi sthānyapekṣayaivā'tra pūrvatvaṃ
vivakṣitaṃ, sthānina ādeśe nāpahṛtatve'pi bhūtapūrvagatyā
tatpūrvatvasya sambhavāt | tadetadāha--sthānibhūtādacaḥ
pūrvatvenetyādi | atra sthānini sati yadbhavati tadādeśe|ñapi
bhavati, yanna bhavati tadādese'pi na bhavatītyevamaśāstrīyasyāpi
kāryā'bhāvasya atideśo bhavati | tatrādye vavraścetyudāhṛtameva, tatra
ṭhna samprasāraṇe samprasāraṇa'miti niṣedhakāryasya śāstrīyatvāt |
dvitīye tu gaṇayatītyudāharaṇam | gaṇa saṃkhyāna iti curādau
adantadhātuḥ | tasmāṇṇic | ato lopaḥ | tip śap ṇerguṇaḥ,
ayādeśaḥ | gaṇayatīti rūpam | atra ṇici parata upadhābhūtasya
gakārādakārasya ṭhata upadhāyāḥ' iti na bhavati,
prakṛtasūtreṇā'llopasya sthānivadbhāvāt | akāre sthānini sati
gakārādakārasya upadhātvabhaṅgādupadhāvṛddhirna pravṛtimarhati |
vṛddhyabhāvasyāśāstrīyatve'pi allope atideśāt | na cātra
gakārādakārasya upadhātvabhaṅgādupadhāvṛddhirna pravṛtimarhati |
vṛddhya bhāvasyāśāstrīyatve'pi allope atideśāt | na cātra
gakārādakārasya sthānyakārānna pūrvatvam, ṇakāreṇa vyavadhānāditi
vācyam, pūrvatvaṃ hyatra vyavahitā'vyavahitasādhāraṇam, utarasūtre
svare niṣedhālliṅgāt | tacca tatraiva spaṣṭībhaviṣyatītyalam | iti
yaṇa iti | anena sūtreṇa sudhÂ y ityatra dhakārasya dvitvaniṣedhe
kartavye īkārasthānikasya yakārasya sthānidbhāve prāpte
tatpratiṣedhasūtramārabhyata ityarthaḥ |

| ādinīti ṅyantaṃ luptasaptamīkam | ādinīśabde pare

ityarthaḥ | tadāha-pūtraśabdasyetyādinā | putraśabdasyāvayavasyetyarthaḥ |

ṭhsupyajātau' iti ṇiniḥ | ṭhṛnnebhya' iti ṅīṣ | he pāpe | tvaṃ
putrādinītyanvayaḥ | putraghātinītyarthaḥ | īdṛśākrośasya prāyeṇa

haradataḥ | mādhavo'pyevam | atra ukārātparasya takārasyā'naci ceti
prāptaṃ dvitvaṃ niṣidhyate | rephasya tu na kvāpi

ityasya kiṃ prayojanamityarthaḥ | ṭhkiṃ pṛcchāyāṃ jugupsane'
ityavyayavarge'maraḥ | evamutaratrāpyevañjātīyakeṣu draṣṭavyam |
tatvakathana iti | yasyāḥ putrāḥ svayameva mriyante tāṃ prati
putrādinīti vastusthitikathane tu na dvitvaniṣedhaḥ, tatra nindāyā
apratīterityarthaḥ | tatpare ca | vārtikametat | sa ādinīśabdaḥ paro
yasmātsa tatparaḥ | ādinīśabdaparake putraśabde ca pare
putraśabdāvayavasya yaro na dvitvamityarthaḥ | putraputrādinī tvamiti |
putrasya putrānatīti vigrahaḥ | atra pūrvasya putraśabdasya ādinīśabdaḥ
paro na bhavati, dvitīyaputraśabdena vyavadhānāt | ataḥ
pūrvasūtreṇā'prāpte dvitvaniṣedhe idamārabdham | vā hatajagdhayoḥ |
hataśabde jagdhaśabde ca pare putraśabdāvayavasya yaro dvitvaṃ vā
syādityarthaḥ | putrahatīti | takāradvitve rūpam | putro hato
yayeti vigrahaḥ | ṭhasvāṅgapūrvapadā'diti ṅīṣiti kecit |
vastutastu jātipūrvādityasya tatrānuvṛtergaurāditvānṅīṣiti
yuktam | putraghātasāhasasya strīṣveva

īkārāntatvāt | nanvevamapi ṭhprātipadikagrahaṇe

āha--gostriyoriti | lākṣaṇikatvāditi | lakṣaṇaṃuśāstraṃ | tatra bhava

(255) bahugaṇavatuḍati saṅkhyā |1|1|23|

(315) hrasvo napuṃsake prātipadikasya |1|2|47|
atha ādantāḥ | śriyaṃ pātīti śrīpāśabdo viśvapāśabdavadvijantaḥ
kvibanto vā | tasya na puṃsakatve hrasvavidhānamāha--hrasvo napuṃsake |

arthavadadhāturityataḥ prātipadikagrahaṇānuvṛtau punaḥ

(316) svamornapuṃsakāt |7|1|23|

luk' ityato lugityanuvartate | ityāha--klīvādityādinā |

pratyayo natu tadekadeśabhūtamakāramātram | ato lugamaḥ sarvādeśa
eva bhavati |

(1055) samarthānāṃ prathamādvā |4|1|82|
tadevaṃ samāsaprapcaṃ nirūpya taddhitaprakaraṇamārabhate--samarthānā
prathamādvā | vidheyasyā'darśanānnāyaṃ svatantravidhiriti matvāha--idaṃ
padatrayamadhikriyata iti | svaritatvapratijñābalāditi bhāvaḥ |
adhikārasyotarāvadhimāha--prāgdiśa iti yāvaditi | ṭhprāgdiso
vibhakti'riti sūtramutarāvadhirityarthaḥ ṭhsamarthānā'miti
nirdhāraṇaṣaṣṭhī | prāthamyaṃ ca ṭhtasyāpatya'mityāditatatsūtreṣu
prathamoccāritatvam | samarthānāṃ madhye prathamoccāritādityarthaḥ |
ṭhsamarthātprathamādve'ti suvacam | kecitu
bahuvacanabalādanekasamarthasamavāya evāsya pravṛtiḥ | evaṃca ṭhprāgdiśaḥ'
ityādiṣu svārthikapratyayavidhiṣu nā'sya pravṛtiriti labhyate ityāhuḥ
nanu subantātaddhitotpatervakṣyamāṇatvena taddhitavidhīnāṃ
padavidhitayā ṭhsamarthaḥ padaviṃdhi'riti paribhāṣayaiva
ekārthībhāvarūpasāmarthyalābhādiha samarthagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityata
āha--sāmarthyaṃ pariniṣṭhitatvamiti | samarthaḥ paṭuaḥ śakta iti paryāyāḥ

(1071) apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛti gotram |4|1|162|
apatyam | apatyādhikārātsiddhe punarapatyagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityata
āha--apatyatvena vivakṣitamiti | evaṃca pautratvādinā vivakṣitānāṃ
pautrādīnāṃ na gotrasaṃjñeti bhāvaḥ |
ṭhsantatirgotrajananakulānyabhijanānvayau' iti kośato gotraśabdasya
santativācakatvātputrasyāpi gotratve prāpte prautrādigrahaṇādiha
śāstre putrasya na gotratvam | nanu ṭhātmajastanayaḥ sūnuḥ sutaḥ putraḥ
striyāṃ tvamī | āhurduhitaraṃ sarve'patyaṃ tokaṃ tayoḥ same'
ityādikośādapatyaśabdasya putra eva rūḍhatvātkathamam ṭhapatyaṃ
pautraprabhṛtī'ti sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti cet, maivam--apatyaśabdo
hi nātmajaparyāyaḥ kiṃtu putrapautrādisaṃtatiparyāyaḥ, ṭhna patanti
nakare pitaro yena tadapatya'miti ṭhpaṅktiviṃśatī'ti sūtre bhāṣye
vyutpāditatvāt | tathā ca pautrādayo'pi pitāmahādīnāṃ
narakāduddhartāra iti teṣāmapyapatyatvamastyeveti ṭheko gotre' iti
sūtrabhāṣye spaṣṭam | etacca mahābhāratādau jaratkārvādyaupākhyāneṣu
prasiddhameva | kośastu sūtrabhāṣyādiviruddhatvādupekṣya eva | na
caivamapi gargasya putro'pi aṅgirasaḥ pautratvādgotraṃ syāditi
vācyaṃ, yasya yaḥ pautrādistasya tadgotramiti vyākhyānādityalam

sthavirataraḥ--ativṛddhaḥ | jīvatīti saptamyantamanuvṛtaṃ sapiṇḍe iti
saptamyante'nveti | atratyaṃ tu jīvatipadaṃ tiṅntam apatye'nveti,
yadapatyaṃ jīvati tadyauvasaṃjñakamiti | tataśca bhrāturanyasminvṛddhatame
sapiṇḍe jīvati sati pautraprabhṛterapatyaṃ jīvadeva yuvasaṃjñaṃ vā
syāditi phalitam | ekamiti | atratyamityarthaḥ | dvitīyamiti |
anuvartamānamityarthaḥ | ubhayoriti | hetutvasaṃbandhe ṣaṣṭhī |
ubhayahetukotkarṣavācakastaravityarthaḥ | tadeva vivṛṇoti-sthānena
vayasā ceti | sthānataḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ-pitṛvyaḥ, tasya pitṛsthānīyatvāt |
vayasā utkṛṣṭo-mātāmahaḥ | bhārtarīti
saṃnihitatvānmātāmahabhrātarītyartha iti kecit | pitṛvyaputra
ityanye | jīvatīti kimiti | jīvatidvayasya kiṃ prayojanamiti praśnaḥ
| mṛte mṛto vā gārgya eveti | mṛte sapiṇḍe caturthau gārgya eva,
mṛtaśca caturtho gārgya evetyarthaḥ |
(|) vṛddhasya ca pūjāyāmiti vācyam | 
vṛddhasya ceti | vārtikamidam | tatra vṛddhapadaṃ vivṛṇoti-gotrasyaiva
vṛddhasaṃjñā prācāmiti | gotrameva ṭhvṛddha'miti prācīnācāryā
vyavaharantītyarthaḥ | tathā ca vārtikasya phalitamarthamāha--gotrasya
yuvasaṃjñā pūjāyāṃ gamyamānāyāmiti |
udāharati--tatrabhavāngārgyāyaṇa iti | ṭhtatrabhavā'niti pūjyavācī,
yuvasaṃjñakānāmalpavayaskatvena vṛddhādhīnatvena sukhitayā ca pūjā |
tā gotraprabhṛtistṛtīyo'pi manyate |

jālma iti | vṛddhānanādṛtya svātantryaṃ bhajate tadviṣayamidam | 
(1075) eko gotre |4|1|93|
eko gotre | saṃkhyāviśeṣopādāne taditarasaṅkhyāvyavacchedasya
svabhāvasiddhatvādeka eveti gamyate |
apatyādhikārātpratyayādhikārāccāpatyapratyaya iti tadviśeṣyalābhaḥ |
tadāha--gotre eka evāpatyapratyayaḥ syāditi | āṬpagava iti |
upagorgotrāpatye ṭhtasyāpatya'mityaṇ | gārgya iti | gargasya
gotrāpatye ṭhgargādibhya' iti yañ | nāḍāyana iti | naḍasya
gotrāpatye ṭhnaḍādibhyaḥ' iti phak | ṭhgotra eka eva pratyayaḥ
syā'dityeboktau
tvanantarāpatyapratyayāntādaupagavaśabdādiñpratyayo na nivāryeta |
niyamasya sajātīyaviṣayatayā gotrapratyayāntādeva gotrapratyayo
vāryeta | ato'patyagrahaṇamityāhuḥ | nanvekasmingotre
yugapadanekapratyayā'prasaktervyarthamidaṃ sūtramiti cet,
maivam-apatyaśabdo hi putra eva rūḍha ityeka pakṣaḥ | putrādisādhāraṇa
ityanyaḥ pakṣa iti prakṛtasūtrabhāṣye sthitam | tadetat ṭhapatyaṃ
pautraprabhṛtī'ti sūtravyākhyāvasare prapañcitaṃ cāsmābhiḥ | tatra
prathamapakṣe upagoḥ pautre apatyapratyayena bubodhayiṣite sati tasya
upaguputrāpatyasya upaguṃ pratyapatyatvā'bhāvāt ṭhtasyāpatya'mityaṇna
sambhavati | tataśca upaguputre vācye ṭhtasyāpatya'mityaṇā
āṬpagavaśabde vyutpādite sati, āṬpagavasyāpatye vastutaḥ
upagostṛtīyā gotre vivakṣite āṬpagavaśabdāt ṭhata i'ñiti iñi
āṬpagavirityanenaiva upagostṛtīyo bodhanīyaḥ syāt | evañca
upagostṛtīye vivakṣite upagoraṇ āṬpagavādiñiti
prakṛtidvayātpratyayadvayamaniṣṭaṃ syāt | tatra yadyapi upagoraṇiṣṭaḥ,
tathāpi upagostṛtīye vivakṣite aniṣṭamiñpratyayamaṇpratyayo
ghaṭayatīti so'pyaniṣṭa eva | tathāca tatrāniṣṭapratyayadvayanivṛtaye
eko gotre apatyapratyayaḥ syādityanapatye'pi upagostṛtīye
apatyapratyayo vidhīyate | saca vastuto'ṇeva, na tviñ,
adantatvā'bhāvāt | vihite ca tasminnaupagavādiñapi nivartate,
gotre bubodhayiṣite ekasyaivāpatyapratyayasya vidheḥ | ataḥ
pratyayadvamālā nivartate | evamupagoścaturthe vivikṣite tasya upaguṃ
tatputraṃ ca pratyayapatyatvā'bhāvāt pautraṃ
pratyevāpatyatvādaupagaviśabdāt ṭhyañiñośceti phaki
prakṛtitrayādaniṣṭā ṭhāṬpagavāyana' iti pratyayatrayamālā syāt |
upagoḥ pañcame vivakṣite tu āṬpagavāyanaśabdādiñi
ṭhāṬpagavāyani'rityevaṃ prakṛticatuṣṭayamālā syāt | ṣaṣṭhe tu
āṬpagavāyaniśabdātphaki ṭhāṬpagavāyanāyana' ityevaṃ
prakṛtipañcakātpañca pratyayāḥ syuḥ | tadevaṃ phagiñoḥ paramparāyāṃ
mūlaprakṛterupagoḥ śatatame gotre vivakṣite ekonaśatātprakṛtibhyaḥ
ekonaśatamaniṣṭapratyayāḥ syuḥ | tadevaṃ phagiñoḥ paramparāyāṃ
mūlapratṛterupagoḥ śatatame gotre vivakṣite ekonaśatātprakṛtibhyaḥ
ekonaśatamaniṣṭapratyayāḥ syuḥ | atra tṛtīyaprabhṛti kasmiṃścidgotre
vivakṣite upaguṃ pratyanapatye'pi tasmin ṭheko gotre' ityaṇeva
bhavati, natu iñādi | yadā tvapatyaśabdaḥ putrapautrādisādhāraṇastadā
yadyapi upagoranantarāpatye putre iva pautrādiṣvapi vivakṣiteṣu
ṭhtasyāpatya'mityaṇi āṬpagava itīṣṭaṃ sidhyati | tathāpi
upagoranantarāpatye aṇi sati āṬpagavasyānantarāpatye
upagostṛtīye vivakṣite dvitīyasmādekaḥ pratyayoniṣṭaḥ prasajyeta |
evamupagoścaturthe vivakṣite siddhe'pi upagoraṇi āṬpagave,
tasmādiñi āṬpagaviḥ, tasmātphaki āṬpagavāyana ityevaṃ pratyayatrayamapi
kadācitprasajyeta | tatrāpi upagormūlaprakṛteraṇiṣṭa eva | iñphakau
tu pratyayāvaniṣṭau | tathā upagoścaturthe vivakṣite
dvitīyasmādeko'niṣṭapratyayaḥ, tṛtīyasmādanya ityevaṃ
prakṛtidvayādaniṣṭau dvau pratyayāviti paryavasyati | evaṃ pañcame
prakṛtitrayātrayaḥ pratyayāḥ | ṣaṣṭhe prakṛ-ticatuṣṭaya#accatvāraḥ pratyayā
ityevaṃ mūlāccchatatame gotre aṣṭanavateraṣṭanavatiraniṣṭapratyayāḥ
syuḥ | tatra ṭheko gotre' iti niyamavidhiḥ--ṭhgotre eka eva pratyayaḥ
syā'diti | tatrāpi prathamātikrame kāraṇā'bhāvānmūlaprakṛteryaḥ
pratyayaḥ prāptuṃ yogyaḥ sa eveti phalati | sūtre ekaśabdaḥ
prathamaparyāyaḥ | ṭheke mukhyānyakevalāḥ' ityamaraḥ | mukhe bhavo
mukhyaḥuprathamaḥ | ṭheko'nyārthe pradhāne ca prathame kevale tathā' iti
kośāntaram | tathāca mūlaprakṛtereva gotre vivakṣite
svayogyapratyayalābha iti vyākhyāntaram | gotre ekaḥ prathama evaśabdaḥ
pratyayatpādaka iti | tadetatsarvaṃ ślokadvayena saṃgṛhṇāti--gotre
svaikoneti | atra prathamaślokānte śrutaṃ ṭhprasajyate' ityetatpadaṃ

natu kadācidapi gotre āṬpagava ityaṇantamiṣṭaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ |
yadveti | svaṃugotraṃ, tat mūlapuruṣopagvakṣayā yatsaṅkhyākaṃ
tadapekṣayā dvyūnasaṅkhyākaprakṛtibhyastāvatāṃ

ṭhputra evāpatya'miti pakṣe prathamaḥ pakṣa unmiṣathatīti, ṭhputrapautrādi
sādhāraṇo'patyaśabda' iti pakṣe tu dvitīyaḥ pakṣa unmiṣatīti bhāvaḥ |
taddhānyai iti | tasyauuktaprakārābhyāmaniṣṭotpādanasya hāniḥunivṛtiḥ,
tadarthamidamityarthaḥ | tathotaramiti |
ṭhgotrādyaūnyastriyā'mityutarasūtramapi tathā yojyamityarthaḥ |
tatrāpatyaśabdaḥ putra eva rūḍha iti pakṣe aniṣṭaṃ
prapañcayati--piturevetyādinā | āṬpagavādiñsyāditi | ṭhata iñ
ityanene'ti śeṣaḥ | āṬpagavādeva iñ syannatūpagoraṇityarthaḥ,
tṛtīyasya upaguṃ pratyapatyatvā'bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | caturthe tvityataḥ

athā'patyaśabdaḥ putrapautrādisādhāraṇa iti pakṣe aniṣṭaṃ

aniṣṭapratyayāḥ syuriti | ṭhaṣṭanavati'riti śeṣaḥ | niyamārthamiti |

(1076) gotrādyaūnyastriyām |4|1|94|
gotrādyaūnyastriyām | gargasya gotraṃ gārgyaḥ, gargasya tṛtīyaḥ |
ṭhgargādibhyaḥ' iti gotre yañ | gārgyasya tṛtīyaḥ sagargasya pañcamo
yuvāpatyaṃ, tasminbubodhayiṣite gārgyaśabdāt gotrapratyayāntāt
ṭhyañiñośce'ti phaki ṭhgārgyāyaṇa' iti rūpamiṣyate | tathā
ṣaṣṭhādiṣvapi yuvāpatyeṣu ṭhgārgyāyaṇa' ityeveṣyate |
tadidamapatyaśabdaḥ putrapautrādisādhāraṇa iti pakṣe yadyapi
sulabhameva,gargātṛtīyaṃ gārgyaṃ prati pañcamādīnāmapyapatyatvāt,
tathāpi gargasya pañcamādyapatye yūni vivakṣite gargānmūlaprakṛterapi
iñ syāt | tathā gargasya antarāpatye iñi gārgiḥ, tadapatyatvena
vivakṣite gargānmūlaprakṛterapi iñ syāt | tathā gargasya
antarāpatye iñi gārgiḥ, tadapatyatvena vivakṣite gargasya
pañcamādau yūni gārgeḥ phaki ṭhgārgāyaṇa' ityapi syāt | tathā
gargasya caturthe yūni gotratvā'bhāvāt yañabhāve iñi gārgiḥ |
tadapatyatvena vivakṣite gargasya pañcamādau yūni gārgeḥ phaki
ṭhgārgāyaṇa' iti syāt | gotrapatyayāntādeva yūni pratyayā' iti
niyamaḥ kriyate--gotrādyaūnī'ti | tadāha--yūnyapatye
gotrapratyayāntādeveti | natu
mūlaprakṛtestadanantarāpatyapratyayāntādyauvapratyayāntācceti bhāvaḥ |
nacāpatyaśabdaḥ putra eva rūḍha iti pakṣe pañcamādau yūni
caturthādyapatyapratyayāntādeva pratyayaḥ syāt, natu
tṛtīyavācigotrapratyayāntāditi tatra viṣyarthamevedaṃ syāt, natu
niyamārthamiti vācyaṃ, ṭhputrapautrādisādhāraṇo'patyaśabda' ityeva
bhāṣye siddhāntitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | 
striyāṃ tu na yuvasaṃjñeti | iha ṭhastriyā'miti yogo vibhajyate |
yūnītyanuvartate | ubhayamapi prathamayā vipariṇamyate | tathāca ṭhstrī
uktayuvasaṃjñikā ne'ti phalitamiti bhāvaḥ | naca strībhinne yūni
gotrādevetyarthaḥ kuto nāśrīyate, evaṃ satyekavākyatvalasābhāditi
vācyaṃ, yuvasaṃjñayā gotrasaṃjñāyā bādhāt | naca ṭheko gotre' iti
niyamātannivṛtiḥ saṃbhavatīti vācyaṃ, yuvasaṃjñayā gotrasaṃjñāyā
bādhāt | naca satyapi yogavibhāge ṭhstriyāṃ na yuvapratyaya' iti
vyākhyāyatāmiti vācyaṃ, gotrapratyayena
yuvatyabhidhānānāpaterityalam | gargasyeti | gargasya pañcamādau
yūni gārgyaśabdādgotre yañantātphaki ṭhgārgyāyaṇa' iti
rūpamityarthaḥ | striyāṃ yuvasaṃjñāniṣedhasya prayojanaṃ
darśayati--striyāmiti | pañcamādiyuvatīnāṃ yuvasaṃjñāniraheṇa
gotratvāt | ṭheko gotre' iti niyamādgārgītyeva bhavati, natu
gārgyāyaṇīti rūpamityarthaḥ | ṭhstrībhinne yūni
gotrādeve'tyarthāśrayaṇe tu yuvasaṃjñayā gotrasaṃjñāyā bādhāt ṭheko
gotre' ityasyā'pravṛteḥ pratyayamālā syāditi bhāvaḥ |

vṛddhyabhāvapakṣe vṛddhiṃ prati phalopahitanimitatvā'bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ
| pūrvapadasya vṛddhipakṣe tu vṛddhiṃ prati phalopahitanimitatvasatvāt
syādeva utarapadākārasya vṛddhiniṣedhe'pi puṃvatvaniṣedhaḥ |
parimāṇāntasyetyārabhyā etadantaṃ sāptamikam | atha prakṛtaṃ
pāñcamikam | 
(1663) śatācca ṭhanyatāvaśate |5|1|21|

nanviha saṅghasyaiva pratyayārthatvāt katham ṭhaśate' iti niṣedha ityata
āha--iheti | pratyayārthaḥ saṅghaḥ prakṛtyarthāccchatātparimāṇānna bhidyate

niṣedhaḥ | śatena krītaṃ śatyaṃ śāṭakaśatam | atra hi niṣkaśataṃ

viruddhoktirvipralāpaḥ| tadāha-- viruddhoktirūpe iti|

(547) avādgraḥ |1|3|51|
avādgraḥ| ātmanepada'miti śeṣaḥ| ṭhgṛÃ' ityasya ṭhgra' iti pañcamī|
ṭhprakṛtivadanukaraṇa'mityasyā'nutyatvāt ṭhṛta iddhāto'riti na
bhavati| tadanityatve idameva mānam| avagirata iti|
śavikaraṇo'yam| ṭhavagṛṇātī'tyatrāpyātmanepadamāśaṅkya āha--
gṛṇātistviti| evaṃ ca tudādereva grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| 

(548) samaḥ pratijñāne |1|3|52|
samaḥ pratijñāne| giraterātmanepadamityarthaḥ| pratijñānam -
abhyupagamaḥ| saṅgirati grāsamiti| bhakṣayatītyarthaḥ| 

(549) udaścaraḥ sakarmakāt |1|3|53|
udaścaraḥ| utpūrvāccaradhātoḥ sakarmakadātmanepadamityarthaḥ| 

(550) samastṛtīyāyuktāt |1|3|54|
samastṛtīyā| sakarmakāditi nivṛtam|
saṃpūrvātṛtīyāntasamabhivyāhṛtāccarerātmanepadamityarthaḥ|
tṛtīyāyuktāditi kim ?| rathikāḥ saṃcaranti| atra yadyapi
rathenetyarthādgamyate, tathāpi
tṛtīyāntaśravaṇā'bhāvānnātmanepadam| etadarthameva yogagrahaṇam|
anyathā ṭhtṛtīyaye'tyevāvakṣyat| sakarmakādapyetadātmanepadaṃ bhavati,
aviśeṣāt, ata evaṭhtṛtīyāyuktāditi kim ?| ubhau lokau
saṃcarasībhaṃ cāmuṃ ca loka'miti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgaccchate| 

(551)dāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe |1|3|55|
dāṇaśca sā| ṭhsamastṛtīyāyuktā'dityanuvartate|
tadāha--saṃpūrvāditi| uktaṃ syāditi| ātmanepadamityarthaḥ| sā
cediti| taccchabdena tṛtīyā parāmṛśyate| tadāha--tṛtīyā cediti|
dāsyā saṃyaccchate iti| ṭhaśiṣṭavyavahāre dāṇaḥ prayoge caturthyarthe
tṛtīyā vācyā' iti tṛtīyā| nanu ṭhrathena samudācarate ityatra
ṭhsamastṛtīyāyuktā'diti pūrvasūtrasya na pravṛtiḥ, āṅa
vyavahitatvena sampūrvakatvā'bhāvāt ṭhtsamādityutarasye'ti
paribhāṣayā sama iti pañcamyā careravyavahitaparatvalābhāt| tathā
ṭhdāsyā saṃprayaccchate' ityatrāpi ṭhdāṇaśca sā ce'diti kathaṃ pravartate,
praśabdena vyavadhānādityata āha-- pūrvasūtre sama iti ṣaṣṭhīti| tathā
ca ṣaṣṭhaḷa paurvāparyameva gamyate, na tvavyavahitatvamiti bhāvaḥ|
teneti| ṣaṣṭhaḷaśrayaṇenetyarthaḥ| sūtradvayamiti|
ṭhsamastṛtīyāyuktā'diti pūrvasūtrasthasya ṣaṣṭhaḷntasyaiva samaḥ
ṭhdāṇaśce'ti sūtre'pyanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ|

(552) upādyamaḥ svakaraṇe |1|3|56|
upādyamaḥ| ṭhātmanepada'miti śeṣaḥ| nanu ṭhsvaṃ vasramutpādayatī'tyarthe
ṭhvastramupayaccchatī'tyatrāpyātmanepadaṃ syādityata āha--svakaraṇaṃ
svīkāra iti| asvasya sataḥ svatvena parigrahaḥ svakaraṇaśabdena vivakṣita
ityarthaḥ| cvipratyayastu vaikalpikaḥ, ṭhsamarthānāṃ
prathamādve'tyukteriti bhāṣye spaṣṭam| 

(553) vibhāṣopayamane |1|2|56|
vibhāṣopayamane| ṭhyamo gandhane' ito yama iti, ṭhhanaḥ sic' ityataḥ
sijiti, ṭhasaṃyogā'dityataḥ kiditi cānuvartate| tadāha-- yamaḥ
sickidvā syādvivāhe iti| upayamaśabdo vivāhe vartate iti bhāvaḥ|
rāmaḥ sītāmupāyateti| bhāryātvena svīkṛtavānityarthaḥ| sicaḥ
kitvapakṣe ṭhanudātopadeśe'ti makāralope ṭhhrasvādaṅgā'diti
sico lopaḥ| udavoḍheati| bhāryātvena svīkṛtavānityarthaḥ| sicaḥ
kitvapakṣe ṭhanudātopadeśe'ti makāralope ṭhhrasvādaṅgā'dita
sico lopaḥ| udavoḍheati| bhāryātvena parigrahaḥ-- udvāhaḥ|
gandhanāṅge upayame tviti| hiṃsāpūrvake vivāhe tvityarthaḥ|
rākṣasavivāhe tviti yāvat| ṭhhatvā bhitvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatīṃ
rudato haret| sa rākṣaso vivāhaḥ-' iti smṛteḥ| nityaṃ
kitvamiti| ṭhyamo gandhane' iti pūrvasūtreṇe'ti śeṣaḥ| yadi
gandhanāṅgake'pyupayamane paratvādiyaṃ vibhāṣā syātarha eṣā
prāptavibhāṣā syāt| tataśca ṭhna veti vibhāṣe'tyatra
bhāṣye'prāptavibhāṣāsvasyāḥ parigaṇanaṃ virudhyeta| ataḥ
pūrvavipratiṣedha āśrayaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ|

(554) jñāśrusmṛdṛśāṃ sanaḥ |1|3|57|
jñānaśra| prāgvaditi| ātmanepadamityarthaḥ| yadyapi ṭhapahnave jñaḥ,
ṭhakarmakācca' ṭhsampratibhyānādhyāne' iti sūtraiḥ, ṭhartiśrudṛśibhyaśce'ti
vārtikena ca jñādibhya ātmanepade kṛte ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' ityātmanepadaṃ
siddham, ṭhtathāpyapahnavādyabhāve'pyātmanepadārthaṃ jñāśrudṛśīnāmiha
grahaṇamiti matvodāharati-- dharmaṃ jijñāsate iti|
jñātumiccchatītyarthaḥ| śuśrūṣate iti| ṭhajjhanagamāṃ sanī'ti dīrghaḥ|
ṭhiko jha'liti sanaḥ kitvam| rṭhśyukaḥ kitī'ti iṇniṣedhaḥ|
susmūrṣate iti| smṛdhātoḥ sani ṭhajjhane'ti dīrghe
ṭhudoṣṭhaḷpūrvasye'tyutve raparatve ṭhhali ce'ti dīrghaḥ| 

(555)nā'nārjñaḥ |1|3|58|
nānorjñaḥ| anupūrvājjñādhātoḥ sannantānnātmanepadamityarthaḥ|
putramanujijñāsatīti| anujñātumiccchatītyarthaḥ| nanu sarpiṣā
pravartitumiccchatītyarthe ṭhsarpiṣo'nujijñāsate' iityatrāpi ṭhapahnave
jñaḥ', ṭhakarmakācce'tyātmanedasyāpyanena niṣedhe sati
sannantātparasmaipadameva syādityata āha-- pūrvasūtrastheveti| evaṃ ca
ṭhsarpiṣo'nujijñāsate' ityatra ṭhakarmakācce'tyātmanepadaṃ
nirbādhamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu ṭhakarmakācce'ti jñādhātorātmanepade
sannantātkathamamātmanepadalābha ityata āṅ-- pūrvavaditi|
kevalātsanvihīnājjñādhātorātmanepadavidhānātsannnatādapi
tasmāt ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' ityātmanepadamityarthaḥ| 

(556) pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ |1|3|59|
pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ| uktaṃ neti| ātmanepadaṃ netyarthaḥ|
pratyāṅavihopasargāveva gṛhyaete, vyākhyānāt| tadāha--
karmapravacanīyātsyādeveti| ṭhātmanepada'miti śeṣaḥ| devadataṃ
pratīti| ṭhlakṣaṇetthambhūte'ti ptiḥ karmapravacanīyaḥ| 

(557) pūrvavatsanaḥ |1|3|62|
pūrvavatsanaḥ| pūrveṇeva pūrvavat| ṭhtena tulyaṭamiti
tṛtīyāntadvatiḥ| pūrvaśabdena sanprakatirvivakṣitā| tadāha-- sanaḥ
pūrva ityādi| edidhiṣate iti|
sanprakṛteredhadhātorātmanepaditvātatprakṛtikasannantādātmanepadam|
ṭhnerviśaḥ' ityātmanepadavidhānātatprakṛtakasannantādapi ātmanepadam|
nanu ṭhśadeḥ śitaḥ' ṭhmriyaterluṅlaṅeśce'tyasya grahaṇam|
ṭhśade'rityādisūtradvaye ṭhpūrvavatsanaḥ' iti, ṭhnānorjñaḥ' ityato
neti cānuvartya śadermriyateśca sannanatānnātmanepadamiti
vyākhyeyamityarthaḥ| nanvevaṃ sati śīyate mriyate ityādāvātmanepadaṃ
na labhyetetyata āha-- vākyabhedeneti| ṭhśadeḥ śitaḥ'
mriyaterluṅliṅeśce'tyekaṃ vākyam. śidbhāvinaḥ
śaderātmanepadaṃ syāt, mṛṅe luṅliṅprakṛtibhūtāt,
śitprakṛtabhūtāccātmanepadaṃ syānnānyatretyarthaḥ| tena śīyate mriyate
mamāretyādi sidhyati| ṭhsano ne'tyaparaṃ vākyam| śadeḥ, mriyateśca
sannantānnātmanepadamityaparam| tena śiśatsati, mumūrṣati ityādau
nātmanepadamityarthaḥ| 

(558) propābhyāṃ yujerayajñapātreṣu |1|3|64|
propābhyāṃ| ṭhātmanepada'miti śeṣaḥ| svareti| svarau acau ādyantau
yasya saḥ svarādyantaḥ| tathābhūtopasargātparatva eva
yujerātmanepadamityarthaḥ| dvandvamiti| dvandvaṃ dviśaḥ, nyañci--
adhobilānītyartha-| 

(559) samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ |1|3|65|
samaḥ kṣṇuvaḥ| ṭhātmanepada'miti śeṣaṭhsamo
gamyṛccibhyā'mityatraiva ṭhsamo gamyṛccchikṣ ṇuva' iti na sūtritaṃ ,
tathā sati akarmakādityanuvṛtyā sakarmakānna syāt|
tatsūcayannudāharati-- saṃkṣṇute śastramiti|
tīkṣṇīkarotītyarthaḥ| 

(560) bhujo'navane |1|3|66|
bhujo'navane| avanaṃ---rakṣaṇam| tato'nyatra
bhujerātmanepadamityarthaḥ| nanu bhuja pālanā'byavahārayo' riti
dhātupāṭhe sthitam| tatra ṭhbubhuje pṛthivī'mityatra na pālanamarthaḥ.
tathā sati ṭhanavane' iti paryudāsādātmanepadā'yogāt|
nāpyabhyavaharaṇam, asaṃbhavāt| nahi pṛthivyā abhyavaharaṇaṃ saṃbhavati|
tathā ṭhvṛddho jano duḥkhaśatāni bhuṅkte' itpi na yujyate,
duḥkhaśatānāṃ pālanasya abhyavaharaṇasya cā'saṃbhavāt. tatrāha-- iha
upabhogo bhujerartha iti| dhātūnāmanekārthakatvāditi bhāvaḥ| mahaĀ
bhunaktīti| rakṣatītyarthaḥ| atra raudhādikasyaiva ṭhbhuja
pālanābhyavahārayo'rityasya grahaṇam -- natu ṭhbhujo kauṭilye' iti
taudādikasyā'pīti bhāṣyam| bhujati vāsaḥ u kuṭilī bhavatītyarthaḥ| 

(561) ṇeraṇau yatkarma ṇau cetsa kartā'nādhyāne |1|3|67|
ṇeraṇau| iha catvāryavāntaravākyāni| ṭhṇe'riti prathamaṃ vākyam|
pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā ṇeriti tadantagrahaṇam|
ātmanepadamityadhikṛtaṃ| tadāha-- ṇyantādātmanepadaṃ syāditi| ṭhaṇau
yatkarma ṇau ce'diti dvitīyaṃ vākyam| ṭhkartari karmavyatihāre'
itivatkarmaśabdo'tra kriyāparaḥ| yatadornityasambandhātaditi labhyate|
tathā ca dvitīyaṃ vākyam| tathā ca aṇau yā kriyā sā ṇyante cediti
labhyate. evaṃ sati pacati pācayatītyādau sarvatar aṇau
kriyāyāṇyante avaśyaṃ satvādvākyamidamanarthakam| tasmāt aṇau yā
kriyā saiva ṇyante cedityevakāro labhyate| tataśca dvitīyavākyasya
phalitamāha-- aṇau yā kriyā saiva ceṇṇyantenocyeteta| ṭhsa karte'ti
tṛtīyaṃ vākyam| atra ṭhaṇau yatkarmakārakaṃ sa ceṇṇau kartā syāditi|
atra taccchabdasya videyasamarpakakartṛśabdānusāreṇa puṃliṅgatā
jñeyā, ṭhśaityaṃ hi yatsā prakṛtirjalasye'tivat| atha ṭhanādhyāne'ti
caturtaṃ vakyaṃ vyācaṣṭe-- na tvādhyāne iti| ādhyānamutkaṇṭhāpūrvakaṃ
smaraṇam| tatra nātmanepadamiti prasajyapratiṣedho'yamiti manyate|
vastutastu ādhyāne ātmanepadaṃ netyarthāśrayaṇe bhavatītyatra
naño'nvitatvena asāmarthyādādhyānaśabdena sama#asā'saṃbhavātparyudāsa
evā'yam| ṭhna tvādhyāne' itimūlaṃ tu phalitārthakathanaparameva| tathā
ca ādhyānabhinne'rthe vidyamānāṇṇyantādātmanepadaṃ syādityevaṃ
prathamavākya eva ādhyāne ityasyānvayātrīṇyevā'tavākyānīti yuktam|
ṭhvākyatraya'mityeva ca bhāṣye dṛśyate| nanu ṭhṇicaśce'ti siddhe
kimarthamidaṃ sūtramityata āha-- ṇicaścetīti| paragāminyapi phale
ātmanepadārthamityarthaḥ| syādetat| ṭhvibhāṣopapadena pratīyamāne'
iti sūtraṃ vakṣyate| kartṛgāmini kriyāphale yadātmanepadaṃ vihitaṃ
tadupapadena kriyāphalasya kartṛgāmitve gamye vā syāditi tadarthaḥ|
ṭhsvaṃ yajñaṃ yajati yajate ve'tyādyaudāharaṇam| ṭhṇeraṇau' itsya tu
darśayate bhava ityanupadameva udāharaṇaṃ vakṣyate ita sthitiḥ| tatra
ṭhdarśayate bhavaḥ svayameve'tyatra phalasya kartṛgāmitvavivakṣāyāṃ
ṭhṇeraṇā'viti nityamātmanepadamiṣyate| tatra paratvāt
ṭhvibhāṣopapadene'ti vikalpaḥ syāt, ṭhṇeraṇau' itsya phale
ātmagāmitvagamakopapadā'bhāve sāvakāśatvāt| kiṃca
ṭhaṇāvakarmakāccitavatkartṛkā'diti vakṣyate| aṇyante yo
dhāturakarmakaḥ, citavatkartṛkaśca tasmāṇṇyantāt parasmaipadaṃ
syāditi tadarthaḥ| śete kṛṣṇaḥ| taṃ gopī śāyayatītyudāharaṇam|
ṇeraṇāvityasya tu darśayate bhava ityudāharaṇaviṣaya iti sthitiḥ| tatra
lūdhātorlunāti kedāraṃ devadata ityatar citavatkartṛkatvāt,
lūyate kedāra iti karmakartari karmaṇaḥ kedārasya kartṛtvena
vivakṣitatayā akarmakatvācca ṭhlāvayate kedāra' iti ṇyantāt
ṭhṇeraṇau' ityātmanepadaṃ bādhitvā partavāt ṭhaṇāvakarmakā'diti
parasmaipadameva syāt, ṇeraṇāvityasya darśayatebhava ityatra
sāvakāśatvādityata āha-- kartrabhiprāye tviti|
pūrvavipratiṣedheneti| pūrvavipratiṣedhāśrayaṇe ṭhrājā darśayate'
iti bhāṣyaprayogo mānam, anyathā tatra ṭhaṇāvakarmakā'diti
parasmaipadāpateḥ, darśanaviṣayo bhavatītyarthe paśyati bhava ityatra
dṛśeraṇāvakarmakatvāccitavatkartṛkatvācca| ṭhvibhāṣopapadene'ti
vikalpabādhaviṣaye pūrvavipratiṣedhāśrayaṇe tu vyākhyānameva
śaraṇam| anye tu ṭhdarśayate rāje'ti bhāṣyaprayogaḥ phalasya
paragāmitvaviṣayo bhaviṣyati| evaṃ ca kartṛgāmini kriyāphale
paratvādaṇāvakarmakādityasya pravṛtau na kiṃcidbādhakamiti
pūrvavipratiṣedhāśrayaṇaṃ cintyamityāhuḥ| taccintyam,
ṭhaṇāvakarmakā'dityasya paragāminyapi phale
paratvātpravṛterdurvāratvāt| nahyaṇāvakarmakādityatra kartrabhiprāya
ityasti, ṭhsvaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāye' ityasya bahuvyavahitatvāditi
śabdaratne prapañcitam| nanu darśanaviṣayo bhavatītyarthe darśayate bhava
ityatatra vastuto darśanakarmībhūtasyaiva bhavasya kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ tasya
ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇe'ti karmavadbhāvāt
ṭhbhāvakarmaṇo'rityātmanepadasiddheḥ ṭhṇeraṇau' iti sūtraṃ vyarthamityata
āha-- kartṛstheti| kartṛstho bhāvo yeṣāṃ te kartṛsthakabhāvakāḥ,
kartṛsthā kriyā yeṣāṃ te kartṛsthakriyāḥ, evaṃvidhā dhātava iha sūtre
udāharaṇam| ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇe' tyasya tu karmasthabhāvakāḥ,
karmasthakriyāścodāharaṇamiti prakṛtasūtre ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇe' ti sūtre
ca bhāṣye spaṣṭama| ato viṣayabhedāt ṭhkarmavat karmaṇe'tyanena
ṭhṇeraṇau'ityasya na gatārthateti bhāvaḥ| aparispandanasādhanasādhyo
dhātvartho bhāvaḥ| yathā darśanaśravaṇādiḥ| saparispandanasādhanasādhyo
dhātvarthaḥ| kriyā| yathā pākādiḥ| yadyapi darśane cakṣurunmīlanādirūpaṃ
spandanamasti tathāpi tadbhinnahastapādādiceṣṭaivā'tra
spandanamityavirodhaḥ| tatra kartṛsthabhāvakamudāharati-- paśyanti bhavaṃ
bhaktā iti| sakarmakeṣu dhātuṣu phalavyāpārayordhāturvartate| yathā
pacerviklityanukūlo vyāpāraḥ| tatra viklitiḥ phalam|
tadanukūlo'dhiśrayaṇādirvyāpāraḥ| dhātūpātavyāpārāśrayaḥ kartā
devadatādiḥ| vyāpāravyadhikaraṇadhātūpātaphalāśrayabhūtaṃ karma| yathā
taṇḍulān pacatītyatra viklityāśrayāstaṇḍulā iti sthitiḥ| prakṛte ca
dṛśeścākṣuṣajñānānukūlavyāpārthakatve sakarmakatvānupapatiḥ, phalasya
cākṣuṣajñānasya tadanukūlaprayatnādeśca samānādhikaraṇtavāt| ato
dṛśeścākṣujñānaviṣayatvāpatyanukūlavyāpāro'rthaḥ| tatra
jñānaviṣatvāpatiḥ phalam| tadanukūlaḥ prayatnādiv#apāro
devadataniṣṭhaḥ| evaṃ ca
prayatnādivyāpāravyadhikaṇacākṣuṣajñānaviṣayatvarūpaphalāśrayo ghaṭādiḥ
karmeti yujyate| tadetadāha-- cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayaṃ kurvantītyartha iti|
preraṇeti| yadā cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayatvāpatireva dṛśerartho vivakṣito
na tu tadanukūlavyāpāraḥ kṛñdhātugamyaḥ preṣaṇāṃśastadā paśyati
bhava ityasya cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayaḥ saṃpadyate ityarthaḥ|
saukaryātiśayavivakṣayā anukūlavyāpārāṃ'śasya avivakṣā bodhyā|
tathā ca cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayatvāpatereva dṛśyarthatvātadāśrayasya bhavasya
kartṛtvameva| tadāha-- viṣayo bhavatītyartha iti| lakṣaṇayā
cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayo bhavatītyartha ityarthaḥ| nacā'tra bhavasya vastuto
darśanakarmaṇa iha kartṛtvāt ṭhkarmavatkakarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' iti
karmavatvādyagādikameva syānna tu śabādīti śaṅkyaṃ,
ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇe'tyasya karmasthabhāvakeṣu, karmasthakriyeṣu ca pravṛteḥ|
ataḥ karmakartaryapi śabādikameveti bhāvaḥ| tata iti| kṛñdhātugamyaṃ
peraṣaṇāṃśaṃ vihāya
cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayatvāpativṛterdṛśerhetumaṇṇijityarthaḥ| darśayanti

mūle| kakṣyā hi rājadhānyādau janaviśeṣasaṅghātanivāsātmikā
anantarasthānaprāpikā| tadyathā rāmāyaṇe-- ṭhāpañcamāyāḥ kakṣyāyā nainaṃ
kaścidavāraya'dityādi| idaṃ ca prathamavākyaṃ preraṇāṃśatyāge paśyati

dṛśyarthe preraṇāṃ'śatyāgasay
preraṇāviśiṣṭārthakadṛśighaṭitaprathamavākyā'bhāve asaṃbhavāt|
preraṇāṃ'śatyāge paśyati bhava iti dvitīyā kakṣyā tu
darśanaviṣayatvāpatimātrārthakāddhetumaṇṇici darśayanti bhavaṃ bhaktā iti
tṛtīyavākyasya paśyanti bhavaṃ bhaktā iti prathamavākyasamānārthakasya
praveśāpateḥ| tṛtīyaṃ vākyaṃ tvidaṃ darśayantīti --
ṇyarthasyā'vivakṣāyāṃ darśayate bhava iti caturthavākyasya darśanaviṣayo
bhavatīti dvitīyavākysamānārthakasya ṇnaytaghaṭitasyopapādakamiti
spaṣṭameva| tathā ca prathamatṛtīyayoḥ kakṣyayoḥ paśyanti bhavaṃ bhaktāḥ,
darśayanti bhavaṃ bhaktā ityanayoḥ , tathā paśyanti bhavaḥ, darśayate bhava
iti dvitīyacaturthyoḥ kakṣyayośca tulyo'rtha ityarthaḥ| tatra
prathamadvitīyayoḥ kakṣyayordṛśerṇyantatvā'bhāvādeva taṅe na
prasaktiriti matvā āha-- tatra tṛtīyakakṣyāyāṃ na taṅiti| kuta ityata
āha-- kriyāsāmye'pīti| ṭhdarśayanti bhavaṃ bhaktā' iti tṛtīyakṣyāyāḥ,

saiva ceṇṇyantenocyete'tyaṃśasya satÂtave'pi prathamakakṣyāyāmaṇau

kartṛtvā'bhāvādityarthaḥ| evaṃ caturthakakṣyopapādikā tṛtīyakakṣyaiṣā
pratyudāharaṇaṃ cetyuktaṃ bhavati| aṇā yā kriyā saiva
ceṇṇyantenocyetetyaṃśasya tu adhyāropitapreraṇapakṣe

iti prakṛtasūtreṇe'ti seṣaḥ| tadevopapādayati---
dvitīyāmādāyeti| ṭhpaśyati bhava' iti dvitīyakakṣyāyāṃ yā
cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayatvāpatirūpā kriyā tasyā eva ṭhdarśayate bhava' iti
caturthakṣyāyāṃ ṇyantadṛśyarthatvādityarthaḥ| anena ṭhaṇau yā kriyā saiva
ceṇṇyantenocyete tyaṃśa upapāditaḥ| atha ṭhaṇau yatkarmakārakaṃ ṇau
sa cetkartā syā'dityaṃśamupapādayati-- prathamāyāmiti| ṭhpaśyanti
bhavaṃ bhaktā' iti prathamakakṣyāyāmaṇyantadṛśikarmaṇo bhavasya ṭhdarśayate

kartṛsthakriyadhātumuda#aharati--evamārohayate hastītyādi| tatra
prathamakakṣyāmāha-- ārohanti hastinaṃ hastipakā iti| hastinaṃ
pāntīti hastipāḥ| ta eva hastipakāḥ| svārthe kaḥ|
uparibhāgākramaṇānukūlavyāpāro ruharerthaḥ| tatra
prāsādamārohatītyādau uparibhāgākramaṇānukūlavyāpāraḥ
sopānagamanādiḥ| iha tu uccasya hastino nyagbhāvanameva
uparibhāgākramaṇānukūlo vyāpāro vivakṣitaḥ| tacca nīcīkaraṇaṃ|
tadāha-- nyagbhāvayantīti| atra
uparibhāgākramaṇānukūlanyagbhavanānukūlo'ṅkuśapātādirvyāpāraḥ|

iti| preraṇāṃśaparityāge sati
uparibhāgākramaṇānukūlanyagbhavanārthakāllaṭi ārohati, hastīti
nyagbhavatītyarthaḥ| preṣaṇāṃ'śaparityāge phalitamāha-- nyagbhavatītyartha
iti| atha tṛtīyakakṣyāmāha-- tato ṇijiti| preṣaṇāṃ'śaṃ parityajya
nyagbhavanārthakatvamāśritāddhātoḥ preṣaṇavivakṣāyāyaṃ hetumaṇṇijiti
bhāvaḥ| ārohayantīti| ṭhhastinaṃ hastipakā' iti śeṣaḥ|

iti| avivakṣitapreṣaṇāṇṇyantātprakṛtasūtreṇātmanepade ārohayate

nyagbhavatītyartha iti.tadadevaṃ ṭhnivṛtapreṣaṇaāddhātoḥ prākṛte'rthe

iti| dṛśe ruheśca pthamakakṣyāyāṃ karmībhūtasya bhavasya hastinaśca

iti| ṭhbhaktā'niti śeṣaḥ| tadāha-- paśta ārohataśca prerayatītyartha

paryavasyati| tatra prakṛtasūtreṇātmanepade darśayati bhavaḥ, ārohayate
hastīti ca siddhamityarthaḥ| paśyanti bhavaṃ bhaktā iti, ārohanti
hastinaṃ hastipakā iti ca prathamakakṣyāyāṃ karmaṇo bhavasya hastinaśca
tṛtīyakakṣyāyāṃ kartṛtvāt, prathamakakṣyāyāmaṇau yā kriyā tasyā
evā'tra tṛtīyakakṣyāyāṃ karmaṇo bhavasya hastinaśca tṛtīyakakṣyāyāṃ
kartṛtvāt,prathamakakṣyāmaṇau yā cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayaṃ kurvantīti,
nyagbhāvayantīti prakṛtyupātasyapreṣaṇāṃśasay tṛtīyakakṣyāyāṃ
tyāgāgadaṇau yā kriyā saiva ceṇṇyantenocyetetyaṃśasaykathaṃ
pravṛtiriti vācyam, ṭhsaiva ceṇṇyantene'tyatra ādhikyamātraṃ
vyavaccchidyate, natu nyūnatvamapītyadoṣāt| nanu dvitīyakakṣyāmeva
kuto na taṅtyita āha-- asminpakṣe dvitīyeti| kuta ityata āha--
samānakriyatvābhāvāditi| dvitīyakakṣyāyāmaṇau yā kriyā saiva
ceṇṇynatenocyetetyaṃśasyā'bhāvāditi yāvat|
tadevopapādayati-- ṇijarthasyeti| ṇeriti kim ?|
paśyatyārohatīti nivṛtapreṣaṇānmā bhūt| smarati vanagulmaṃ

smarantaṃ prerayatītyarthaḥ| smarayati vanagulma iti|

iti | sūtre samarthaśabdaḥ samarthāśrite lākṣaṇika iti bhāvaḥ | sāmarthyaṃ

svārthaparyavasāyināṃ padānāmākāṅkṣādivaśādyaḥ
parasparānvayastadvyapekṣābhidhaṃ sāmarthyam, viśiṣṭā apekṣā
vyapekṣeti vyutpateḥ | saṃbaddhārthaḥ samartha iti vyutpateśca | idaṃ ca
rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādivākya eva bhavati | tatra ca ekaikasya śabdasya yo yaḥ
saṃnihito yogyaśca tena tenānvayo bhavati | yathā rājñaḥ
puruṣo'śvaśceti, rājño devadatasya ca puruṣa iti, ṛddhasya rājñaḥ
puruṣa iti ca | ekārthībhāvalakṣaṇasāmarthyaṃ tu prakriyādaśāyāṃ
pratyekamarthavatvena pṛthaggṛhītānāṃ padānāṃ samudāyaśaktyā
visiṣṭaikārthapratipādakatārūpam | ṭhsaṅgatārthaḥ samarthaḥ',
ṭhsaṃsṛṣṭārthaḥ samartha' iti vyutpateḥ | saṅgatiḥ saṃsargaśca ekībhāva
eva | yathā-saṅgataṃ ghṛtaṃ taileneti | ekībhūtamiti gamyate | yathā
vā saṃsṛṣṭa#e'gniriti | ekībhūta iti gamyata iti bhāṣyācca | idaṃca
sāmarthyaṃ rājapuruṣa ityādivṛtāveva | ata eva ṭhṛddhasya rājapuruṣa'
ityevaṃ rājñi puruṣaviśeṣaṇe ṛddhatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ nānveti, viśiṣṭasya
ekapadārthatayā rājñaḥ padārthaikadeśatvāt | ṭhdevadatasya
gurukula'mityatra tu upasarjanasya nityasāpekṣatvātsamāsaḥ | yadvā
guruvaddevadato'pi viśeṣye pradāne kula evānveti | tatra guruṇā
kulasya utpādyatvasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ | devadatena tu kulasya
tadīyagurūtpādyatayā'nvayo gurugarbhaḥ | uktaṃ ca hariṇā-ṭhsaṃbandhiśabdaḥ
sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ samasyate | vākyavatsā vyapekṣā hi vṛtāvapi
na hīyate |' iti | samudāyena saṃbandho yeṣāṃ gurukalādinā |
saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste tu yujyante tadvatā saha |' iti ca |
etena ṭhayaśśūla' iti sūtre bhāṣye ṭhśivasya bhagavato bhaktaḥ' ityarthe
ṭhśivabhāgavataḥ' ityādi vyākhyātam |
ekārthībhāvaścā'yamalaukikavigrahavākye kalpyate | yathā
lādeśabhūtaśatṛśānacoraprathamāsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ lakāre'pi kalpyate
tadvat | ata eva ṭhlasya
aprathamāsamānādhikaraṇenārthenā'yogādādeśānupapatiḥ, tasya kvāpi
prayogā'bhāvā'di tyākṣipya ṭhādeśe sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā
anumānādgantavyaṃ prakṛterapi tadbhavati ' iti ṭhlaṭaśśatṛśānacau'
iti sūtrabhāṣye samāhitam | ṭhsiddhānāṃ śabdānāmanvākhyānāt
pacantaṃ devadataṃ paśyetyādiprayogadarśanāt sthānino'pi lasya
prakriyārthaṃ kalpitasya bodhakatvakalpanā sūcitā |
alokikavigrahavākye śrūyamāṇānāṃ ca śabdānāṃ klṛptaśaktityāge
mānā'bhāvāt pratyekaśaktisahakṛtayā samudāyaśaktyā
viśiṣṭopasthitiḥ | tataśca Âyamekārthībhāvo'jahatsvārthā

mahādādiśabdānāmanarthakatvādarthavadgrahaṇasaṃbhave anarthakasya

(639) prākkaḍārātsamāsaḥ |2|1|3|

(640) saha supā |2|1|4|
saha supā | ṭhsubāmantrite' ityataḥ ṭhsu'bityanuvartate | subantaṃ
subantena sahoccāritaṃ samāsasaṃjñaṃ bhavatīti phalati | evaṃ sati
ṭhparyabhūṣaya'dityādau subantasya tiṅntena samāso na syāt |
tatrāha--saheti yogo vibhajyata iti | samāsasaṃjñāyāṃ
anvarthatvādekasyā'prasaṅgātsupetyetāvataiva saheti siddhe
tadgrahaṇaṃ yogavibhāgārthamiti bhāvaḥ | ṭhsahe'tyatra ṭhsubāmantrite'
ityataḥ subityanuvartate | pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadantagrahaṇam |
ṭhsamarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' ityataḥ samarthagrahaṇamanuvṛtaṃ tṛtīyayā
vipariṇamyate | tadāha--subantamityādinā | samasyata iti |
ekīkriyate prayoktṛbhirityarthaḥ | samāsasaṃjñāṃ labhata iti yāvat |
kecitu subantaṃ kartṛ samarthena samasyate, ekībhavatītyarthaḥ | kartari
laṭ | ṭhupasargādasyatyūhyae'rityātmanepadam | samāsaśabdo'pi
kartari bāhulakādghañantaeva, karmaṇi ghañanto vā | tathā sati
samasyata iti kartari tiṅntaṃ phalitārthakathanaparamityāhuḥ | nanu
ṭhghaṭo bhavatī'tyatra samāse ghaṭa-bhavatītyapi loke prayogaḥ
syādityata āha--yogavibhāgasyeti | katipayeti | katipayāni
tiṅntāni utarapadāni yasyeti vigrahaḥ |paryabhūṣayaditi |
samāsāntodātatve śeṣanighāta iti ṭhkugati' iti sūtra#e kaiyaṭaḥ |
ṭhdevo devān kratunā paryabhūṣaya'dityatra tu svaravyatyayo bodhyaḥ
| anuvyacaladiti | ṭhacala'dityanena veḥ pūrvaṃ samāse sati tena
anoḥ samāsaḥ | natvanuvyoryugapatsamāsaḥ, subityekatvasya
vivakṣitvāt | ata eva ṭhmahiṣyā ajāyāśca kṣīra'mityatra kṣīraśabdena
subantayorna samāsa iti kaiyaṭaḥ | supā | ṭhsubāmantrite' ityataḥ
subityanuvartate | ṭhsamāsa' ityadhikṛtam | tadāha--supsupeti |
subantaṃ subantenetyarthaḥ | tataśca pūrvaṃ bhūta iti vigrahe
samāsasaṃjñā sthitā | samāsatvātprātipadikasaṃjñeti |
ṭhkṛtaddhitasamāsāśca ityanene'ti śeṣaḥ | 
(641) supodhātuprātipadikayoḥ |2|4|71|
supo dhātu |
ṭhdhātuprātipadikayo'rityavayavaṣaṣṭhītyāha--etayoravayavasyeti |
luksyāditi | ṭhṇyakṣatriyārṣañito yūni luk'

bhāvaḥ |

(644) prathamānirdiṣṭaṃ samāsa upasarjanam |1|2|43|

(646) ekavibhakti cāpūrvanipāte |1|2|44|
atra diśāśabdasyāpi upasarjanatvamāha-ekavibhakti | ṭhprathamānirdiṣṭaṃ

ṭhnirādayaḥ krāntādyarthe pañcamyā' iti samāse niṣkauśāmbiḥ

ṭhkauśāmbī'śabda eva vigrahe niyatavibhaktika iti

kauśāmbīśabdasyā'nena upasarjanatve'pina ṭhpūrvanipātaḥ

ṭhtulyārthai'riti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭamidam | prathamāntapadenaiva samāsa
ita# ṭhineka'miti sūtre bhāṣye sthitam |

(648) nāvyayībhāvādato'mtvapañcamyāḥ |2|4|83|

vibhaktyartho vivakṣitaḥ | ucyanta iti vacanāḥ | karmaṇi lyuṭ |
vibhakti-samīpa
samṛddhi-vyṛddhi-arthā-'bhāvā'tyayā-'saṃprati-śabdaprādurbhāva-paścāt-yathā-''nupūrvya-yaugapadya-sādṛśya-saṃpati-sākalya-anta'--eteṣāṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ dvandvaḥ | te ca te vacanāśceti vigrahaḥ | vibhaktyarthādiṣu vācyeśvityarthaḥ | ṭhavyaya'mityanuvartate | ṭhavyayībhāvaḥ' ṭhsamāsa' iti cādhikṛtaṃ | tadāha--vibhaktyarthādiṣviti | vibhaktau tāvaditi | vibhaktyarthe prathamamudāhriyata ityarthaḥ | harau ityadhiharīti | harau iti laukikavigrahaḥ | tena yāvadavagamyate tāvadevādhiharīti samāsenāpyucyata ityarthaḥ | adhiśabdasya harāvityanena avyayībhāvasamāse subluki samāsavidhāvavyayamiti prathamānirdiṣṭatvādadheḥ pūrvanipāte samāsādutpannasya supaḥ ṭhavyayādāpsupaḥ'iti lugiti bhāvaḥ | nanu laukikavigrahe samasyamāna#e'dhiśabdaḥ kuto nopāta ityata āha--saptamyarthasyaivātreti | tathācā'dhidyotyārthasyā'dhikaraṇatvasya saptamyaiva uktatvādadhiśabdo na pṛthagupātaḥ, nityasamāsatāyā vakṣyamāṇatvena svapadavigrahānocitnāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu harau iti pariniṣṭhitasandhikāryasya samāse sati ṭhāṬ' ityasya supo luki samāse rephādikāraḥ kutaḥ śrūyetetyata āha-hari ṅ iiti | saṃdhikāryātprāgalaukikavigrahavākya eva samāsapravṛteḥ ṭhpratyayotarapadayośce'ti bhāṣyasaṃmatatvāditi bhāvaḥ | yathā caitathā ṭhbhūtaṃpūrva' ityatrānupadamevoktam | nanvadhinā nipātenākaraṇatvasyoktatvāt kathaṃ harāviti saptamītyata āha-atra nipāteneti | vacaneti | supteyanuvartya subantenā'tra samāsavidhisāmarthyāt saptamī syādeveti bhāvaḥ | vastutastu anabhihitasūtrabhāṣye tiṅkṛtaddhitasamāsairityeva parigaṇamanaṃ dṛṣṭam | ato nipātenā'dhinā abhihite'pyadhikaraṇatve saptamī nirbādhā | ṭhviṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃbardhya svayaṃ chetumasāṃprata'mityatra tu ṭheṣṭavya' ityadhyāhāryam | kṛtā'bhidhānādviṣavṛkṣāddvitīyā na bhavati | naca kṛtaddhitasamāsairiti parigaṇanaṃ bhāṣye pratyākhyātamiti vācyam, ṭhkaṭṃa karoti bhīṣmamudāraṃ darśanīya'mityatra parigaṇanaphalasyā'nyathāsiddhereva tatroktatvādityāstāṃ tāvat | 
(650) avyayībhāvaśca |2|4|18|
avyayībhāvaśca | ayaṃ napuṃsakamiti | ṭhsa
napuṃsaka'mityatastadanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ | 
napuṃsakatvasya phalamāha-hrasvo napuṃsaka iti | gopāyatīti |
rakṣatītyarthaḥ | ṭhgupū rakṣaṇe'vic | ṭhāyādaya ārdhadhātuke vā'
ityāyapratyayaḥ | ṭhlopo vyoḥ' iti yalopaḥ | ṭhverapṛktasye'ti
vakāralopaḥ | gopāśabda akārāntaḥ | gāḥ pātīti | pātervici
upapadasamāse gopāśabda iti bhāvaḥ | 
adhigopamiti | vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvasamāse subluki napuṃsakatve
hrasvatve sati ṭhnāvyayībhāvāt' ityamipūrvarūpamiti bhāvaḥ |
ṭhgostriyoḥ' iti tu nātra prasajyate, strīpratyayāntatvā'bhāvāt |
samīpe iti | samīpārthakāvyayasya samāse udāharaṇaṃ vakṣyata ityarthaḥ |
kṛṣṇasya samīpamiti | laukikavigrahavākyametat | atra samasyamānasya
upaśabdasya sthāne samīpamiti prayuktam | kṛṣṇasya-upa iti tu na
vigrahaḥ nityasamāsatvenā'svapadavigrahaucityāt | 
nanu samayā grāmaṃ, nikaṣā laṅkāmārādvanādityatrāpi
samayādyavyayānāṃ samīpārthakatvādavyayībhāvaḥ syāt, tataśca ṭhgrāmaṃ
samayā, grāmaṃ nikaṣā, vanādārā'diti ca prayogo na syāt |
avyayībhāvasamāse'vyayasya pūrvanipātaniyamādityata āha samayeti |
vidhānasāmarthyāditi | samayā grāmaṃ, nikaṣā laṅkāmārādvanādityatra
śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ satyāmapi avyayībhāvasamāse sati
prātipadikāvayavatvādupapadavibhaktyoḥ dvitīyāpañcamyoḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷa
vā luki samāsātprātipadikārthādivivakṣāyāṃ sarvāsu vibhaktiṣu
jātāsu yathāyathasambhāve tadvikalpe ca ṭhsamayāgrāmaṃ',
ṭhnikaṣālaṅkamārādvanaṃ,' ṭhsamayāgrāmeṇa', nikaṣālaṅkena,
ṭhārādvanena' ṭhsamayāgrāme', ṭhnikaṣālaṅke', ṭhārādvane' iti syādeva
| tataśca dvitīyāpañcamyorvidhirvyarthaḥ syāt | ṣaṣṭhaḷṬva gatārthatvāt
| naca samāsātpunarupapadavibhaktī dvitīyāpañcamyau śaṅkye,
sakṛtpravṛtayoḥ punaḥ pravṛtya yogāt | vastutastu
madhyārthakasamayāśabdayoge dvitīyāvidhānasya
dūrārthakārāccchabdayoge pañcamīvidhānasya caritārthatvādidamayuktam
| nacaivaṃ sati ṭhsamayā grāma'mityādāvavyayībhāvaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, abbhakṣa
ityādāviva vibhaktyarthasamīpādimātravṛtyavyayasyaiva grahaṇāt,
samayānikaṣā''rāccchabdānāṃ cādhikaraṇaśaktipradhānatayā
samīpamātravṛtitvā'bhāvāt | grāmasya samīpe iti hi teṣāmarthaḥ |
upaśabdastu tanmātravācī | ṭhupakṛṣṇaṃ bhaktā' ityatra kṛṣṇasāmīpyavanta
iti bodhāt | madrāṇāṃ samṛddhiriti | ṭh sa'mityavyayaparyāyaḥ
samṛddhiśabdo vigrahavākye jñeyaḥ | etatsūtravihitasamāsasya
nityatayā'svapadavigrahaḥ | evamagre'pi jñeyam | saṃmadramiti | sarvatra
sublugādi pūrvavajjñeyam | samṛddhā madrāḥ saṃmadrā ityādau tu
nāvyayībhāvaḥ, vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyenāvyayārthaprādhānya eva
tatpravṛteriti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | yavanānāṃ vyṛddhiḥ duryavanamiti |
durśabdārthako vyṛddhiśabdo vigrahe jñeyaḥ | vigateti |
abhāvapratiyoginītyarthaḥ | ṛddherabhāvo vyṛddhiriti yāvat |
nacārthābhāve'yamiti bhramitavyaṃ, samasyamānapadārthā'bhāvasyaiva tatra
vivakṣitatvāt | iha ca yavanā'bhāvasyā'pratīteḥ |
yavanīyavṛddhyabhāvasyaiva pratīteḥ | taddhvanayannarthā'bhāve
udāharati--makṣikāṇāmabhāvo nirmakṣikamiti | vigrahe
nirśabdasamānārthakamabhāvapadamiti bhāvaḥ | ghaṭaḥ paṭo netyatra tu
nāvyayībhāvaḥ, arthagrahaṇasāmarthyenātyantā'bhāvasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt
| himasyātyayo'tihimamiti | atītyavyayaparyāyo'tyayaśabdo
vigrahe jñeyaḥ | arthābhāvetyanena paunarūktyaṃ nirasyati-atyayo dhvaṃsa
iti | arthā'bhāvaśabdenā'tyantābhāva eva vivakṣitaḥ | tena paṭasya
prāgabhāvo niṣpaṭamiti na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | sūtre asaṃpratītyasya
saṃprati na yujyate ityarthaḥ | ṭhetarhi saṃpratīdānī'mityamaraḥ |
yujikriyāntarbhāveṇa ekārthībhāvānnañsamāsaḥ | tadāha--nidrā saṃprati
na yujyate ityatinidramiti | atītyavyayasyā'saṃpratyarthakasya sthāne
ṭhsaṃprati na yujyate' iti vigrahavākyaṃ jñeyam | sūtre
ṭhśabdaprādurbhāva' ityanena śabdasya prakāśanaṃ vivakṣitaṃ,
tadāha--hariśabdasya prakāśa itihari iti | ṭhitī'tyavyayaṃ śabdaprakāśe
vartate | tasya hariśabdena svarūpapareṇa ṣaṣṭhaḷntena samāsa iti bhāvaḥ
| viṣṇoḥ paścādanuviṣṇu iti | ṭhanu' ityavyayaṃ paścādarte vartate
ityarthaḥ | bhāṣyeti | ṭhacaḥ parasmin' iti sūtrabhāṣye ityarthaḥ | ṭhtataḥ
paścāt' ityatrāvyayībhāve tu paścāccchabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ syāditi
bhāvaḥ | etadbhāṣyaprayogādeva etatsūtre tatadarthabodhakapadaghaṭakatayā
gṛhītāvyayena tatadarthakenā'yaṃ samāso neti vijñāyate | ata eva
ṭhyathā'sādṛśye' iti sūtre ṭhsādṛśyasaṃpatīti prāpnotī'tyevoktaṃ
bhāṣye | yathāśabdena tu bhavatyeva samāsaḥ, utarasūtrārambhāt | sūtre
yathāśabdena tadartho lakṣyate | yathārthe vidyamānamavyayaṃ samasyate iti
labhyata ityabhipretyāha--yogyateti | anurūpamiti | atrānu ityavyaya
yogyatāyām, ato yathārthe vartata iti bhāvaḥ | arthamarthaṃ
pratīti--laukikavigrahavākyam | atra vīpsāyāṃ dvirvacanam |
ṭhlakṣaṇetthaṃbhūtākhyāna' iti vīpsāyāṃ dyotyāyāṃ prateḥ
karmapravacanīyatvātadyoge dvitīyā | samāse tu dvirvacanaṃ na,
samāsena vīpsāyā dyotitatvāt--iti ṭhhayavaraṭ' iti sūtre kaiyaṭaḥ
| pratinā tasyoktatvāditi tu tatvam | pratinā tasyoktatvāditi tu
tatvam | nanvarthamarthaṃ pratīti laukikavigrahapradarśanaṃ na saṃbhavati |
nityasamāsatvādityata āha--pratiśabdasyeti | sāmarthyāditi |
avyayībhāvasamāsasya nityatve tu śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷamapi avyayībhāve
subluki samāsāt sarvavibhaktīnāmambhāve tadvikalpe ca pratyarthaṃ
pratyarthenetyādisiddhe dvitīyāphalakaṃ prate
karmapravacanīyatvavidhānamarthakaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | vastutastu
pratisthānamityādau ṭhupasargātsunoti' iti ṣatvā'bhāvasaṃpādana#ena
karmapravacanīyatvaṃ caritārthameva | ṭharthamarthaṃ prati pratyartha'miti
ṭhsarūpāṇā'miti sūtre bhāṣye prayogadarśanādiha vaikalpikasamāsa iti
tatvam | śaktimanatikramyeti | ṭhparāvarayoge ce'ti ktvāpratyayaḥ |
parāvaratvaṃ ca bauddham | at yathetyavyayaṃ padārthānatikrame vartata
ityarthaḥ | hareḥ sādṛśyaṃ saharīti | atra sahetyavyayaṃ sādṛśye vartata
iti bhāvaḥ | vakṣyamāṇaneti | ṭhavyayībhāve cākāle' ityanenetyarthaḥ |
jyeṣṭhasyānupūrvyeṇeti | ṭhkāryaṃ kṛ'miti śeṣaḥ | tatadvibhaktyā
vigraha iti pakṣābhiprāyeṇedam | pūrvasya krameṇa ityanupūrvaṃ | tataḥ
svārthe yañ | etatsūtragṛhītāvyayena samāso netyanupadamevoktam
| tathāpi sūtragṛhītānunā'pyanujyeṣṭhamiti samāsaḥ, anupūrveti
nirdeaśāt | sūtre yugapaccchabdātsvārthe ṣyañi yaugapadyaśabdaḥ |
taddhvanayannāha--cakreṇa yugapaditi | yugapatparyāyasya sahaśabdasya
cakreṇa ityanena samāse kṛte satītyarthaḥ | yugapaccchabdena tu na
samāsaḥ, sūtre gṛhītatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
(651) avyayībhāve cā'kāle |6|3|81|
avyayībhāve | sahasya saḥ syāditi | ṭhsahasya saḥ
saṃjñāyā'mityatastadanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ | na tu kāle iti |
kālavācake pare sahasya so netyarthaḥ | sacakramiti | cakreṇa
yugapatprayuktamityarthaḥ | sahapūrvāhṇamiti | samīpādau avyayībhāvaḥ |
sūtre sādṛsyeti svārthe ṣyañ | taddhvanayannāha--sadṛśaḥ sakhyā
sasakhīti | ṭhsahe'tyavyayaṃ sadṛśārthakamiti bhāvaḥ | guṇabhūte'pīti |
vacanagrahaṇasāmarthyenā'vyayārthaprādhānya eva samāsapravṛteḥ
guṇībhūtasādṛśye'prāptyā tadgrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | kṣatrāṇāṃ saṃpatiḥ
sakṣatramiti | kṣatriyāṇāmanurūpaṃ karmetyarthaḥ | sahetyavyayamatra saṃpatau
vartata iti bhāvaḥ | saṃpatisamṛddhiśabdayoḥ paunarūktyaṃ
pariharati-ṛddheriti | dhanadhānyādestyirthaḥ | anurūpa iti |
anurūpaḥuyogyaḥ, ātmabhāvaḥusvabhāvaḥ | svocitaṃ karmeti yāvat |
tṛṇamapīti | ṭhpara'varayoge ce'ti ktvā | parā'varatvaṃ bauddhameva |
sahaśabdo'trā'parivarjane vartate, na tu tṛṇasahabhāve'pīti bhāvaḥ |
nanvevaṃ sati sākalye kathamidamudāharaṇaṃ syādityatra
āha--sākalyenetyartha iti | pātre pariviṣṭaṃ sakalaṃ bhakṣayatīti
yāvat | na tvatreti | tṛṇabhakṣaṇasyā'prasakteriti bhāvaḥ | ante iti |
ṭhudāharaṇaṃ vakṣyate' iti śeṣaḥ | sūtre'ntaśabdena antāvayavasāhityaṃ
vivakṣitamityabhipretyodāharati-agnigranthaparyantamityādi |
agniśabdenā'gnicayanapratipādako grantho vivakṣitaḥ |
tenā'ntāvayavena sahitaṃ granthamiti vigrahaḥ | agnigranthaparyantamiti
bahuvrīhiḥ | ṭhgrantha'mityanyapadārthādhyāhāraḥ | adhīta iti tu
samāsapraviṣṭam | antāvayavena agnigranthena sahitaṃ
vedakalpasūtrādibhāgamadhīte ityarthaḥ | atra
kṛtsnasyānadhyetavyatvādagnigranthaparyantādhyayane
tatkārtsnyānavagamātsākalyātpṛthaguktiḥ | 
(652) yathā'sādṛśye |2|1|7|
yathā'sādṛsye | ṭhasādṛśye' iti chedaḥ | vyākhyānāt | asādṛśye
yogyatāvīpsāpadārthānativṛtirūpe vartamānaṃ yathetyavyayaṃ
samasyate ityarthasya yathārthatvādeva siddhe
niyamārthamidamityāha-asādṛśye eveti | nanu ṭhprakāravacane thā'liti

| sāmānyasya bhedako yo viśeṣaḥ sa prakāraḥ, tasminprakāre thāliti
ṭhprakāravacane thāl' ityāsyārthaḥ | tataśca
yadviśeṣadharmavānharistadviśeṣadharmavānhara iti bodhe sati
yataccchabdābhyāṃ tayoḥ prakārayorabhedāvagamādupamānatvapratītiriti

vartamānamavyayaṃ samasyata ityaṃśena vā, yathārthe vidyamānamavyayaṃ

bhāvaḥ | bhāṣye tu prakāravacane yathāśabdayoge sādṛsyetyanenaiva

śabdenduśekhare vistaraḥ |

(654) suppratinā mātrārthe |2|1|9|
suppratinā mātrārthe | subiti chedaḥ | mātrā-leśaḥ | tasminnarthe
vidyamānena pratinā subantaṃ samasyata ityarthaḥ | subityanuvartamāne
punaḥ subgrahaṇaṃ saṃnihitasyā'vyayamityasyānanuvṛtyarthaṃ,
taddhvanayannudāharati-śākasya leśa iti | atra ṭhpratī'tyavyayaṃ
mātrārthakam | atastena śākasyeti subantasya samāsaḥ | samāsavidhau
subantasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvena upasarjanatvātpūrvanipātaḥ, na tu
prateḥ, tasya samāsavidhau tṛtīyānirdiṣṭatvāt | vṛkṣaṃ pratīti | atra
pratermātrārthakatvā'bhāvānna tena samāsaḥ | na ca ṭhlakṣaṇettha'miti
karmapravacanīyatvavidhānasāmarthyādevā'tra samāso na bhaviṣyati, sati
samāse dvitīyāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷa vā luki aviśeṣāt, sakṛtpravṛtatayā
samāsātadvibhaktyanutpateriti vācyam, ṭhvṛkṣaṃ prati siñcatī'tyādau
ṭhupasargātsunotī'ti ṣatvanivṛtyā karmapravacanīyatvasya
caritārthatvādityanyatra vistaraḥ |

(656) vibhāṣā |2|1|11|

sthitam | tatra ṭhavyayaṃ vibhaktī'tyādyavyayībhāvādividhiṣuṭhsupsupe'ti
samāsamanūdya nāvyayībhāvādisaṃjñā vidheyāḥ | ṭhupapadamatiṅ'
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahulam' ṭhākhyātamākhyātena kriyāsātatye'
ityādau subantasya subantena samāsasya uddeśyasyā'prasiddheḥ |
atasteṣu samāsavidhānasyāvaśyakatvādarthādhikārānurodhātsarvatra
samāsa ityanuvṛtaṃ vidheyasamarpakamityāstheyam | tatra
ṭhsupsupe'tyeva siddhe ṭhavyayaṃ vibhaktī'tyādyavyayībāvādividhiṣu
samāsasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ satataḥ prācīnavidhervaikalpikatvaṃ jñāpayati
| na cāvyayībhāvādividhiṣu samāsavidhyabhāve'vyayādīnāṃ
samāsaśāstre prathamānirdiṣṭatvā'bhāvena
upasarjanatvā'bhāvātpūrvanipātaniyamo na syāt,
tadarthamavyayībhāvādividiṣu samāsavidhānaṃ caritārthamiti vācyaṃ,
ṭhprathamānirdiṣṭam' iti sūtre ṭhsamāse' ityasya
samāsatvavyā}yā'vyayībhāvādividhāyake śāstre
ityarthābhyupagamenā'vyayādīnāmupasarjanatvasiddhervaktuaṃ śakyatvāt |
tasmādavyayī bhāvādividhiṣu samāsavidhānaṃ ṭhsupsupe'ti samāsasya
vaikalpikatvaṃ jñāpayatīti sthitam . ṭhākaḍārā'diti sūtre
ṭhsupsupe'ti samāsaviṣaye vispaṣṭaṃ paṭuavispaṣṭapaṭuariti
vigrahapradarśanaparabhāṣyaṃ ceha liṅgamityalaṃ bahunā | evaṃca ṭhivena

paṭhitameva tatrāpi smāryata iti kaiyaṭaḥ |

(580)sārvadhātuke yak |3|1|67|
sārvadhātuke yak| dhātoriti| ṭhdhātorekācaḥ'
ityatastadanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ| bhāvakarmavācinīti|
ṭhciṇbhāvakarmaṇo'rityatastadanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ| ghaṭasya bhāvo
ghaṭatvamityādau prakṛtijñayabodhe prakāro bhāvaḥ| kaverayaṃ bhāva
ityādau abhiprāyaḥ| ṭhbhāvaḥ padārthasatāyāṃ kriyāceṣṭātmayoniṣu|
vidvallīlāsvabhāveṣu bhūtyabhiprāyajantuṣu' iti nānārtharatnamālā|
ṭhbhāvaḥ satāsvabhāvābhiprāyaceṣṭātmajantuṣu' ityamaraḥ| iha tu ṭhlaḥ
karmaṇi' ityatra bhāvaśabdo bhāvanāyāṃ yaugika ityāha-- bhāvo
bhāvaneti| laḥ karmaṇī'tyatra bhāvaśabdena bhāvanā vivakṣiteti bhāvaḥ|
bhāvanāśabdasya cintāyāmapi prasiddhatvādāha-- utpādaneti|
utpatyanukūlo vyāpāra ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca
bhūdhātorutpatyarthakāddhetumaṇṇau vṛddhyāvādeśayorbhāviśabdāt
ṭhera'jiti bhāve aci ṇilope bhāvaśabdaḥ,
bhāvayaterutpatyarthakāddhetumaṇṇyantāt striyāmityadhikāre
ṭhṇyāsaśrantho yu'jiti yuci anādeśe ṭāpi bhāvanāśabda iti
bodhyam| utpādanā ceyaṃ dhātvarthānnātiricyate iti darśayatumāha--
kriyeti| dhātvarthātmakakriyaiva utpādanetyarthaḥ| tathāhi
ṭhphalavyāpārayordhātu'riti siddhāntaḥ| pacadhātoḥ pāko'rthaḥ|
pāko--viklityanukūlavyāpāraḥ| tatra viklityaṃśaḥ phalam|
adhiśrayaṇādistadanukūlo vyāpāraḥ| tathāvidhavyāpārāśrayo
devadatādiḥ kartā, ṭhdhātūpātavyāpārāśraya karte'ti siddhāntāt|
adhiśrayaṇādivyāpārajanyā viklatiḥ phalaṃ, tadāśrayatvādodanaṃ karma,
ṭhvyāpārajanyaphalaśāli karme'ti siddhāntāt| evaṃ sakarmakeṣu sarvatra
jñeyam| ṭhedha vṛddhau'ityasminnakarmake'pi vṛddhyanukūlavyāpāro
dhātvarthaḥ| nacaivaṃ sati ṭhedhate devadata' ityatra
dhātūpātavyāpārāśrayatvādvyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalāśrayatvaṃ
karmatva'miti siddhāntāt| evaṃ ca phalotpatyanukūlavyāpārātmikā
kriyā dhātvartha iti siddham| etena kriyāvācī dhātuḥ, dhātuvācyā
kriyetyanyonyāśrayo'pi nirastaḥ| utpatyanukūlavyāpārasyaiva
kriyātvāt| taduktaṃ-- ṭhvyāpāro bhāvanā saivotpādanā saiva ca
kriye'ti| nanūtpatyanukūlavyāpārasyaiva sarvatra dhātuvācyatve
sarveṣāṃ dhātūnāmekārthatvāpatiḥ|
viklityāditatatphalotpatyanukūlavyāpārthakatvaṃ tu na saṃbhavati,
ekaikasya dhātorviklityāditatatphalāṃśe,
tadanukūlavyāpārātmakavyāpārasāmānye ca vācakatvānupapaterityata
āha-- sā cetyādi| pacyādayo dhātutvena rūpeṇa
utpattyanukūlavyāpārātmikaṃ kriyāmāhuḥ|
pacitvāditaviśeṣarūpeṇa tu viklityāditatatphalāṃśamāhuḥ| tathā ca
vācakatāvacchedakabedādviklityādiphalaviśeṣasya, kriyāsāmānyasya ca
vācyatā saṅgaccchate iti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca bhaṭṭirāha-- ṭhvibhajya senāṃ
paramārtha senāpatīṃścāpi purandaro'tha| niyojayāmāsa sa
śatrusainye karotirartheṣviva sarvadhātūn||' iti|
astibhavatividyatīnāmapi satānukūlavyāpāra evārthaḥ| tatra satā
ātmabharaṇam| tadanukūlavyāpārastu jāyate, asti, vipariṇamate,
varddhate, apakṣīyate, vinaśyatīti
vārṣyāyaṇipraṇītaṣaḍbhāvavikāreṣvanyatamo yathāyathaṃ jñeyaḥ|
bhūvādisūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭametat| prapañcataṃ ca mañjūṣāyāmityalam|
nanūtpādanātmakakriyārūpasya bhāvasya dhātuvācyatve ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ca
bhāve ce'ti bhāve kathaṃ lakāravidhiḥ| ananyalabhyasyaiva
śabdārthatvādityata āha-- bhāvārthakalakāreṇānūdyate iti| ṭhdvau' ṭhtrayaḥ'
ityādau dvivacanabahuvacanavadati bhāvaḥ| yuṣmadasmadbhyāmiti|
yuṣmadi asmida ca tiṅsamānādhikaraṇe upapade madhyamotamapuruṣau
vihitau| yuṣmadasmadostiṅsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca
tiṅvācyakārakavācitvameva| bhāve lakāre tu ṭhāsyate tvayā'
ṭhāsyate maye'tyādau bhāva eva tiṅvācyo natu yuṣmadasmadarthau,
ato na madhyamotamāvityarthaḥ| karmalakāre tu ṭhtvaṃ vandyase',ṭhahaṃ
vandye' ityādau lakārasya, yuṣmadasmadośca
sāmanādhikaraṇyasaṃbhavātpuruṣatrayamapi yathāyathamudāhariṣyate|
tiṅvācyeti| satvaṃ u dravyaṃ-- liṅgasaṅkyānvayayogyam|
tiṅvācyā yā bhāvanā kriyā sā asatvarūpā u
liṅgasaṅkhyānvayā'yogyā, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāt| tataśca tasyāṃ
tiṅvācyabhāvanāyāṃ dvitvabahutvayorapratīteryuvābhyāṃ
yuṣmābhirvā āsyate ityādau na dvivacanaṃ, bahuvacanaṃ cetyarthaḥ|
tiṅvācyetyanena kṛdvācyāyāḥ kriyāyā
liṅgasaṅkhyānvayitvātmakaṃ satvarūpatvamastītyuktaṃ bhavati| tadyathā -
pākau pākā ityādi| taduktaṃ --ṭhsārvadhātuke ya'giti sūtre bhāṣye -
ṭhkṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśate' iti|
dravyavalliṅgasaṅkhyānvayaṃ labhate ityarthaḥ, śabdaśaktisvabhāvāditi
bhāvaḥ| nanu tiṅvācyabhāvanāyā asatvarūpatayā dvivahuvacanā'bhāve
āsyate ityādau ekavacanaṃ ca na syādityata āha-- kiṃ
tvekavacanameveti| ṭhtiṅvācyabhāvalakārasye'ti śeṣaḥ| tasyeti|
ṭhdveyakayordvivacanaikavacane' ṭhbahuṣu bahuvacana'miti sūtranyāsaṃ
bhaṅktvā ṭhekavacanaṃ' dvibahuṣu dvibahuvacane' iti sūtranyāsaḥ
kartavyaḥ| tatra dvitvabahutvayordvibahuvacananiyame sati tayoraviṣaye
ekavacanamiti labhyate iti bhāṣye spaṣṭam| evaṃ ca ekavacanasya
ekatvamutsṛjya dvibahuvacanānyaviṣaye vihitatvena āṬtsargikatayā
ekatvasaṅkhyānapekṣatvādbhāvalakārasya
asatvarūpabhāvavācitve'pyekavacanameveti bhāvaḥ| anabhihite iti|
bhāvalakāre kartustiṅvācyatvā'bhāvena anabhihitatvātṛtīyetyarthaḥ|
tvayā mayeti| tvatkartṛkaṃ matkartṛkam anyakartṛkaṃ bhavanamityarthaḥ|

ṛtvigviśeṣavācibhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷntebhyaścchaḥ syādbhāvakarmaṇorityarthaḥ
|acchāvākīyamiti | ṭhā ca tvā'diti tvatalorapi sarvatra samāveśo
bodhyaḥ |
(1777) brāhmaṇastvaḥ |5|1|136|
brahmaṇastvaḥ | ṭhhotrābhyaḥ' ityanuvṛtamekavacanena vipariṇamyate |
tadāha--hotrāvācina iti | ṛtvigvācina ityarthaḥ | nanu ṭhbrahmaṇo
ne'tyevāstu, brahmaṇaśchāe na ityarthalābhe sati che niṣiddhe ṭhā ca
tvā'dityadhikārāt ṭhhotrābhyaścaḥ' ityeva bhāvakarmaṇostvapratyayaḥ
sidhyatītyata āha--veti vācye ṭhtasya bhāvastvatalau' ityanena brahmaṇaḥ
karmaṇi tvasyā'prāptestadarthaṃ tvapratyayavidhānamiti na śaṅkyam |
nāpi ṭhbrāhmaṇo ne'tyukte pūrvasūtravihitānāṃ tvatalchānāṃ niṣedhaḥ
syādityapi śaṅkyam, śabdopātasya cchasyaiva niṣedhāt | atra
hotrāgrahaṇānuvṛteḥ prayojanamāha--brāhmaṇaparyāyāditi |
|||| iti bālamanoramāyām nañsnañoradhikāraḥ | ||||




 siddhāntakaumudī
tasyā utarārddham |

vāsudevastu tadvyākhyāṃ vaṣṭi bālamanoramām||2||
ai ṭhmaṅgalādīni maṅgalamadhyāni maṅgalāntāni ca śāstrāṇi

śrautram| ṭhśrotriyasya yalopaśce'yalopaśce'tyaṇi ikārādutarasya
yakārā'kārasaṅghātasya lope ikārasya ṭhyasyeti ce'ti lopaḥ|
arhati--āryaiḥ praśasyamāneṣu vedavihitakarmasu yogyo
bhavatītyarhan| ṭharhaḥ praṃśasāyā'miti śatṛpratyayaḥ| arhato
bhāvaḥ--ārhantī| ṭharhato num ce'ti ṣyañi ādivṛddhau
prakṛternumāme ṣitvānṅīṣi ṭhhalastaddhitasye'ti yakāralope
ṭhyasyeti ce'tyakāralopaḥ| strītvaṃ lokāt| śrautraṃ ca ārhantī ca
vedavihitakarmayogyatā ca prasiddhairiti yāvat| guṇyairiti|
nityā'nityavastuvivekaḥ, ihā'mutrārthaphalabhogavirāgaḥ,
śamadamādisampatiḥ, mumukṣutvamityādipraśastaguṇasampannairityarthaḥ|
ṭhrūpādāhatapraṃśasayo'riti sūtre ṭhanyebhyo'pi dṛsyate' iti
vārtikena yap pratyayaḥ, tadbhāṣye ṭhguṇyā brāhmaṇyā' ityudāharaṇāt|
maharṣibhiriti| mahāntaśca te ṛṣayaśceti karmadhārayaḥ|
ṭhānmahata'ityātvam| atitapasvibhirityarthaḥ| ahardivamiti| ahaśca
divā ceti vīpsāyām ṭhacature'tyādinā dvandvo nipātitaḥ|
ahanyahanītyarthaḥ| toṣṭūayyamāno'pīti| ṭhṣṭuañ stutau', sakarmakaḥ|
guṇavatvenā'bhidhānaṃ stutiḥ| abhidhānakriyānirūpitaṃ karmatvamādaya
ṭhdevān stautī' tyādau dvitīyā| na tu guṇābhidhānameva stutiḥ,
tathā sati guṇasya dhātvarthopasaṅgṛhītatvenā'karmakatvāpateḥ|
ṭhdhātvādeḥ ṣaḥ saḥ' iti ṣakārasya sakāre ṣṭuatvanivṛtau,
ṭhdhātorekāca' iti bhṛśārthe yaṅ, ṭhikṛtsārvadhātukayo'riti dīrghe,
ṭhsanyaṅe'riti dvitve, ṭhśarpūrvāḥ khaya' iti sakārasyābhyāsagatasya
lope, ṭhguṇo yaṅluko'rityabhyāsokārasya guṇe, tataḥ parasya
sasya ṭhādeśapratyayayo'riti ṣatve, ṣṭuatvena takārasya ṭakāre,
ṭhtoṣṭūaye'ti yaṅntāt ṭhsanādyantā' iti dhātusaṃjñakātkarmaṇi laṭi

rūpam| bhṛśaṃ stūyamāno'pītyarthaḥ|
acintyajagadracanādyanantaguṇasampannatayā bhṛsaṃ saṅkīrtyamāno'pīti
yāvat| aguṇa iti| nirguṇa ityarthaḥ| ṭhsākṣī cetā kevalo
nirguṇaśce'tyādiśruteriti bhāvaḥ| nirguṇasya guṇavatvena
kathanātmikā stutirviruddhetyāpātapripannaṃ virodhamapiśabdo

(1) vartamāne laṭ |3|2|123|
vartamāne laṭ| ṭhdhāto'riti sūtramā
tṛtīyādhyāyasamāpteradhikṛtam| ṭhvartamāne' iti tatrānveti|
vartamāne'rthe vidyamānāddhātorlaḍiti labhyate| phalitamāha--
vartamānakriyāvṛteriti| dhātvarthakriyāyā vartamānatvaṃ tu
vartamānakālavṛtitvam| kālasya tu
vartamānatvam--atītānāgatabhinnakālatvam| ṭhbhūtabhaviṣyatoḥ
pratidvandvī vartamānaḥ kāla' iti bhāṣyam| vartamānatvaṃ ca na
pratyayārthabhūtakartrādiviśeṣaṇam| atītapākādikriye kartari
vartamāne pacatītyādyāpateḥ, kiṃtu dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇameva
vartamānatvam| laṭ tu tasya dyotaka eva| aṭāvitāviti| na ca akāra
uccāraṇārtha evāstviti vācyaṃ, liḍādi vailakṣaṇyāya
tasyāvaśyakatvāt| tathā ca tasya itsaṃjñāṃ vinā
nivṛtyupāyā'bhāvāditsaṃjñaivādartavyeti bhāvaḥ|

(2) laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cā'karmakebhyaḥ |3|4|69|
laḥ karmaṇi ca | vākyadvayamidaṃ sūtram| ṭhlaḥ karmaṇi ce'ti prathamaṃ
vākyam| ṭhla' iti prathamābahuvacanāntam| cakāreṇa ṭhkartari
kṛ'dityataḥ ṭhkartarī'tyanukṛṣyate| ṭhdhāto'rityadhikṛtam| lakārāḥ
karmaṇi kartari ca dhātoḥ syuriti labhyate|
sakarmakadhātuviṣayamevedam, akarmakeṣu ṭhkarmaṇī'tyasya
bādhitatvāt| tadāha lakārāḥ sakarmakebhya iti| evaṃ ca sakarmakebhyo
bhāve lakārāna bhavanti| sakarmakebhyo'pi bhāvalakārapravṛtau tu
ṭhdevadatena ghaṭṃa kriyate' ityādau bhāvalakāreṇa
karmaṇo'nabhihitatvāddvitīyā syāditi bhāvaḥ| ṭhbhāve
cākarmakebhyaḥ' iti dvitīyaṃ vākyam| atrāpi cakāreṇa
kartaivānukṛṣyate, na tu karma, asaṃbhavāt| tadāha-- akarmakebhyo
bhāve kartari ceti| atrā'karmakagrahaṇena avivakṣitakarmakā api
gṛhyante| tena ṭhdevadatena bhujyate' ityatra
sato'pyodanarūpakarmaṇo'vivakṣāyāṃ bhāve lakāro'styevetyanyatra
vistaraḥ|

(6) taṅanāvātmanepadam |1|4|100|
taṅanau| taṅ ca ānaśceti dvandvaḥ| pratyāhāra iti| ṭhta ātāmiti
taśabdamārabhya mahiṅiti ṅkāreṇe'ti śeṣaḥ| tadāha--
tādinavakamiti| iha pūrvasūtrālla ityanuvartate| tataśca ānagrahaṇena
śānackānacāveva gṛhyate, na tu ṭhtācchīlyavayovacanaśaktiṣu
cāna'śiti vihitaścānaśapi, tasya lādeśatvā'bhāvāt| tena
parasmaipadibhyo'pi cānaś sidhyati--nighnānā ityādau|
tadāha--śānackānacau ceti| etatsaṃjñānīti|
ātmanepadasaṃjñakānītyarthaḥ| pūrvasaṃjñeti| parasmaipadasaṃjñāpavāda
ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca tibādinavake parasmaipadasaṃjñā paryavasyati| atha
kasmāddhātoḥ parasmaipadaṃ, kasmādātmanepadamityākāṅkṣāyāmāha--
anudātaṅtiḥ| anudātaśca ṅca anudātaṅai| tāvitau yasya saḥ---
anudātaṅt| tismāt--anudātaṅtiḥ| dvandvānte śrūyamāṇa iccchabdaḥ
pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| anudāteto ṅtiśceti| labhyate|
ṭhupadeśe'janunāsika i'dityasmānmaṇḍūakaplutyā upadeśa ityanuvṛtaṃ
ṅti ityanena sambadhyate, natvanudāteta ityanena| upadeśādanyatra
anudātasyetsaṃjñāyā aprasaktatvenā'vyabhicārāt| ṭhbhūvādayo dhātava'
ityasmānmaṇḍūakaplutyā ṭhdhātava' ityanuvṛtaṃ pañcamyā
vipariṇatamanudātetā ṅtā ci viśeṣyata#e| tatrānudātedaṃśe
tadantavidheḥ prayojanā'bhāvānṅdiṃśe tadantavidhiḥ| tadāha--
anudāteta ityādinā| lasya sthāna iti| ātmanepadagrahaṇalabhyamidam,
tiṅaṃ lādeśatvaniyamāt| upadeśe kim ?| cukuṭiṣati| atra
ṭhgāṅkuṭādibhya' iti sana ātideśikameva ṅtvim,
natvaupadeśikam| dhātoḥ kim ?| adudruvat| atra ṭhṇiśrī'ti
caṅntānnātmanepadam| ṅdiṃśe tadantavidhyabhāve tu ṭhbobhūyate'
ityādau ṭhsanādyantā' iti dhātusaṃjñakādyaṅntādātmanepadaṃ na syāt|
ṭhṅti' ityevoktau yaṅe ṅtve'ipi tadvantasya
dhātorṅtvā'bhāvādātminepadaṃ na syāt|

(7) svaritañitaḥ kartrabhiprāyekriyāphale |1|3|72|
svaritañitaḥ| svaritaśca ñ ca svaritañau, tau itau yasya tasmāditi
bahuvrīhiḥ| iccchabdaḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| tadāha-- svariteto
ñitaśceti| dhātorityanantaraṃ ṭhlasya sthāne'iti śeṣaḥ|
kartāramabhipraiti gaccchatīti ṭhkartrabhiprāyam'| karmaṇyaṇ|
tadāha--kartṛgāminīti| evaṃ ca ṭhhotā yājyayā yajatī'tyādau
yāgaphalasya svargasya yajamānagāmitvena
hotṛgāmitvā'bhāvānnātmanepadam| tathā ṭhvetanena yajñadatabhṛto
devadataḥ pacatī'tyatrāpi pākaphalasya bhojanasya
paktṛgāmitvā'bhāvānnātmanepadam| dakṣiṇādilābhastu na phalam|
lokato vedato vā yaduddeśena kriyāpravṛtistasyaivātra

(11) yuṣmadyaupapade samānādhikaraṇe sthāninyapi madhyamaḥ |1|4|105|
yuṣmadi| upoccāritaṃ padamupapadam| yuṣmadi samīpoccārite
satītyarthaḥ| samānamekamadhikaraṇaṃ vācyaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ|
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca yuṣmadastiṅḥ sthānībhūtalakāreṇa vivakṣitam,
ṭhlaḥ parasmaipada'mityatastadanuvṛteḥ| tathā ca
phalitamāha--tiṅvācyakārakavācini yuṣmadīti| sthānaṃ--
prasaṅgo'syāstīti sthānī, tasmin| prasakte satītyarthaḥ| prasaṅgaśca
tadarthāvagatau satyāṃ vakrā aprayoga eva bhavati| tathā ca
ṭhsthāninī'tyanena upapadabhūte yuṣmadi prayogaṃ vinā svārthaṃ
bodhayati satītyarthaḥ paryavasyati| tadāha-- aprayujyamāna iti|
ṭhsthāninī'tyanuktau yuṣmadyaupapade prayujyamāna eva madhyamaḥ syāt|
tataśca rāma pāhītyādāvavyāptiḥ syāt| apinā
labdhamāha--prayujyamāne'pīti| ṭhyuṣmadyaupapade sthāninī'tyevoktau
rāma tvaṃ pāhītyādau yuṣmatprayoge madhyamo na
syādato'pigrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| atvaṃ tvaṃ saṃpadyata ityatra tu na
madhyamapuruṣaḥ, tatra yuṣmaccchabdasya gauṇatvāt| ṭhbhavānāgaccchatī'tyādau
bhavaccchabdayoge tu na madhyamapuruṣaḥ, yuṣmaccchabdasya
saṃbodhyaikaviṣayatvāt, bhavaccchabdasya tu svabhāvena
saṃbodhyā'saṃbodhyasādāraṇatvādityalam| 

(12) prahāse ca manyopapade manyaterutama ekavacca |1|4|106|
prahāse ca| vākyadvayamidaṃ sūtram| ṭhprahāse ca manyopapade iti
prathamaṃ vākyam| madhyama ityanuvartate| manadhātuḥ śyanvikaraṇa upapadaṃ
yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| manyapadaśravaṇabalāddhātāviti viśeṣyaṃ labhyate|
tadāha--manyadhāturityādinā| tasminprakṛtibhūte satīti|
tasmāddhātorlasya sthāne ityarthaḥ| madhyamaḥ syāditi| ṭhasmadyaupapade' iti
śeṣaḥ| asmadyautamaṃ ityutarasūtrātadanuvṛteḥ| evaṃ ca
utamapuruṣāpavādo'yaṃ madhyamavidhiḥ| ṭhmanyaterutama ekavacce'ti
dvitīyaṃ vākyam| tadvyācaṣṭe-- manyatestūtamaḥ syāditi|

(247) abhyastasya ca |6|1|33|

(251) śvayateraḥ |7|4|18|
śvayateraḥ| śvayateḥ-- a iti cchedaḥ| śvayateriti śtipā nirdeaśaḥ|
śvidhātorityarthaḥ| ṭhalo'ntyasye'tyantyasya ikārasyeti labhyate|
ṭhṛdṛśo'ṅe' ityato'ṅītyanuvartate| tadāha--śvayaterikārasyeti|
aśva a t iti sthite savarṇadīrghamāśaṅkyāha--pararūpamiti|
ārddhadhātukopadeśe adantatvā'bhāvānna allopaḥ| aśvanniti| aśvaḥ aśvatam
aśvata| aśvam aśvāva aśvāma| aṅbhāvapakṣe tvāha--vibhāṣeti| iyaṅiti|
ṭhcaṅī'ti dvitvamityapi jñeyam| tadāha--aśiśviyaditi|
aṅścaṅścā'bhāve tu aśvi īt iti sthite ikārasya sici vṛddhau
satyāmāyādeśe aśvāyīdita prāpte āha-- hmyanteti na vṛddhiriti|
śvigrahaṇāditi bhāvaḥ| na ca ṭhneṭī'tyeva sici aśvi īt iti stite
sici vṛddhyapekṣayā paratvādantaraṅgatvācca ikārasya guṇe ekāre
kṛte igantatvā'bhāvena sici vṛddhyaprāptyā ayādeśe kṛte
yāntatvādeva halantalakṣaṇavṛddherniṣedhasiddheḥ ṭhhmyante'tyatra śvigrahaṇaṃ
vyartamiti vyācyam, anavakāśatayā apavādatvena guṇaṃ bādhitvā
sici vṛddheḥ prāptau tanniṣedhārthatvādityalam| vṛdityasya
vyākhyānam-- yajādayo vṛtā iti| nanu bhvādayo vṛtā iti kuto
na vyākhyāyate ityata āha-- bhvādistvākṛtigaṇa iti|
culumpatīti| culumpadhāturlopārthakaḥ, tasyāpi bhvādigaṇe
pāṭhāccchabvikaraṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ| iti bhvādaya iti| nacaivaṃ sati ṭhada
bhakṣaṇe' ityādīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ dhātutvaṃ kthamiti śaṅkyaṃ,
śabvikaraṇā bhvādayaḥ samāptā ityarthāt| 
iti bālamanoramāyāṃ bhvādayaḥ|

pañcālā'ṅgavaṅgādiśabdeṣu yogasyauavayavārthasya pramāpakatve
sati tadabhāveupañcālāṅgādikṣatriyasambandhā'bhāve saṃprati
śūdrādirājake janapade pañcālādiśabdo na prayujyate, prayujyate ca
yataḥ, ataḥ pañcālādiśabdā janapadaviśeṣeṣu kevarūḍhā iti
yuktamityarthaḥ | tadāha-yadi hi yogasyeti |

(1279) kālopasarjane ca tulyam |1|2|57|

(1280) viśeṣaṇānāṃ cā'jāteḥ |1|2|52|
viśeṣaṇānāṃ cājāteḥ | kasya viśeṣaṇānāmityākāṅkṣāyāṃ

labhyate | tadāha--lubarthasyeti | tadvaditi | prakṛtivadityarthaḥ |
ṭhlupi yurtavadvyaktivacane' ityasmādutaraṃ paṭhitamidaṃ sūtraṃ tatraiva
vyākhyātumucitam | pañcālā ramaṇīyā iti | pañcālānāṃ nivāso
janapada ityarthaḥ | atra pratyayārthajanapadaṃ prati viśeṣaṇasyāpi
ramamīyaśabdasya prakṛtivadbahuvacanam | godau ramaṇīyāviti |
godayornivāso janapada ityarthaḥ | atra pratyayārthajanapadasya
tadviśeṣaṇasyāpi prakṛtivaddvivacanam | pañcālā janapada iti |
janapadaśabdasya jātivācitvānna prakṛtivadbahuvacanam | godau
grāma iti | atra grāmaśabdasya jātivācitvānna prakṛtivaddvivacanam | 
(|) harītakyādiṣu vyāktiḥ |
harītakyādiṣu vyaktiriti | vārtikamidam | ṭhlupi liṅgaṃ
prakṛtivadbhavati, na tu vacana'miti śeṣaḥ | harītakya iti |
ṭhharītakyādibhyaśce'ti vikārapratyayasya lup | atra pratyayārtheṣu
phaleṣu prakṛtivatstrīliṅgameva bhavati, na tvekavacanamiti bhāvaḥ |
(|) khalatikādiṣu vacanam |
khalatikādiṣu | vārtikamidam | eṣu lupi prakṛtivadvacanameva
bhavati, natu liṅgamityarthaḥ | khalatikaṃ vanānīti |
ṭhvaraṇādibhyaśce'ti lup | atra khalatikaśabdasya luptapratyayāntasya
prakṛtivatpuṃliṅgatvaṃ na bhavati, kintu ekavacanameveti bhāvaḥ |
manuṣyalupi pratiṣedha iti | vārtikamidam |
(|) manuṣyalupi pratiṣedhaḥ |
manuṣyalakṣaṇe iti | manuṣyātmake luptapratyayārthe yāni viśeṣaṇāni
teṣāṃ prakṛtivalliṅgavacanapratiṣedha ityarthaḥ | cañcā abhirūpa iti |
cañcā tṛṇamayī pratimā, tatsadṛśo manuṣyaścañcā | ṭhive pratikṛtau'
ityadhikāre ṭhsaṃjñāyā'miti kano ṭhlummanuṣye' iti lup | atra
luptapratyayāntasya cañcāśabdasya manuṣye vācye prakṛtiliṅgatvaṃ, na
tu tadviśeṣaṇasyā'bhirūpaśabdasyeti bhāvaḥ | iti
yuktavadbhāvaprakaraṇam |

(1286) kumudanaḍavetasebhyo ṅbhatup |4|2|87|

vetasvāniti | vetasā asminsantīti vigrahaḥ | ādyayoriti |
kumudvaccchabde, naḍvaccchabde ca ṭhjhayaḥ' iti matupo masya vakāraḥ,

vastutastu naḍvaccchabde'pi ṭhjhayaḥ' ityasyā'siddhatvāt ṭhmādupadhāyāḥ'
ityeva nyāyyaṃ, ṭhprakaraṇe prakaraṇamasiddhaṃ, natu ekasminneva prakaraṇe
pūrvayogaṃ prati parasyā'siddhatva'mityasya ṭhupasargādasamāse' iti

sthānivatvāt | ṭhna padānte'ti niṣedhastu na, pade anta iti vigṛhya
pade parataścaramāvayave kartavye padapadasthā'jādeśasyaiva
tanniṣedhapravṛterbhāṣye'bhyupagatatvāt | pūrvatrāsiddhe na
sthāniva'diti niṣedho'pi na, pade anta iti vigṛhya tatra
sthānivatvaniṣedhavyāvṛtisādhanaparabhāṣyaprāmāṇyena

(906) vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci |2|4|13|

() nityavīpsayoḥ |8|1|4|
nityavīpsayoḥ | nityaśabdena nityatvaṃ vivakṣitam | taśca
ābhīṇyamiti bhāṣyam | vyāptumicchā vīpsāuvyāptipratipādanecchā |
sā ca prayoktṛdharmaḥ | vyāptireva tu śābdabodhaviṣaya iti
bhāṣyasvarasaḥ | tathā ca ṭhnityavyāptyā'rityeva suvacanam | vyāptiśca
kārtsyanyena saṃbandhaḥ, upasargabalāt |
padasyetyadhikariṣyamāṇamihāpakṛṣyate | ṭhsarvasye'ti sthānaṣaṣṭhī |
ṭhdve' iti tvādeśasamarpakam | tasya ca ṭhśabdarūpe' iti
viśeṣyamarthāllabhyate, śabdānuśāsanaprastāvāt | te ca śabdarūpe
svarūpato'taścāntaratame pade iti sthāne'ntaratamaparibhāṣayā labhyate
| tataśca paunaḥpunye kārtsnye ca gamye kṛtsnāvayavaviśiṣṭasya
padasyā'rthataśca śabdataścāntaratame dve pade bhavata iti phalitam |
tadabhipretyāha--ābhīkṣṇye vīpsāyā ca dyotye iti | dyotyaṃ ca dyotyā
ca dyotyam | tasminnityarthaḥ |
ṭhnapuṃsakamanapuṃsakenaikavaccāsyānyatarasyā'miti napuṃsakaikaśeṣaḥ |
ekatvaṃ ca nityavīpse ca prakṛtigamye | dvirvacanaṃ tu dyotakam |
satyapi prakṛterdvitve dviruktayoḥ prakṛtyanatirekāditi bodhyam |
dvirvacanaṃ syāditi | dve pade ādeśau sta ityarthaḥ | tatrāvayavayoḥ
padatvaṃ svataḥ siddham | samudāyasya tu padadvayātmakasya
sthānivatvātsubantatvam | tena ṭhapacannapacanni'tyatra ṅmuṭ,
ṭhvṛkṣānvṛkṣā'nityatra ṭhpadāntasye'ti ṇatvaniṣedhaḥ, ṭhagre'gre' ityatra
ṭheṅḥ padāntā'diti pūrvarūpaṃ cetyādīnyavayavānāṃ padakāryāṇi
sidhyanti | ṭhpunaḥpuna'riti samudāyasya sthānivatvena
subantatvādbhāve ṣyañi, bhave ṭhañi ca paunaḥ punyam, paunaḥpunika
iti ca sidhyati | ṭhdve uccāraṇe sta' ityāśrayaṇe tu sarvaṃ padaṃ
dviruccārayedityarthaḥ phalitaḥ syāt | tataśca punarityekasyaiva
dviruccāryamāṇasya punaḥpunarityādeśatvā'bhāvena
sthānivatvā'prasaktyā subantatvavirahātadditotpatirna syāt |
tasmādādeśapakṣa eva śreyānityāstāṃ tāvat | ābhīkṣṇyaṃ
tiṅnteṣviti | ākṣīkṣṇyaṃ-paunaḥ punyam | taccaiha
pradhānabhūtakriyāyā eva | kriyāprādhānyaṃ cākhyāteṣvastīti ṭhpraśaṃsāyāṃ
rūpa'viti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam | avyayakṛtsvapi ktvātumunnādiṣu
kriyāprādhānyam, ṭhavyayakṛto bhāve' ityukteḥ tathā ca
tiṅnteṣvavyayasaṃjñakakṛdanteṣu ca paunaḥpunyanimitakadvirvacanaṃ
nānyatretyarthaḥ | tathaivodāharati--pacati pacati bhuktvā
bhuktveti | 
vīpsāyāmiti | ṭhudāhriyate' iti śeṣaḥ | vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣamiti | kṛtsnaṃ
vṛkṣamityarthaḥ | atra prakṛtatadvāṭikāgatavṛkṣakārtsnyaṃgamyate,
jagatītalasthitakṛtsnavṛkṣasecanasyā'śakyatvāt| sarvaśabdasya
kārtsnyavācitve'pi na dvitvamityanupadameva ṭhyathāsve' ityatra
vakṣyate | vṛkṣaṃ-vṛkṣamityatra kārtsnyāvagame'pi
pratyekaniṣaṭhamekatvameva bhāsate, natu bahutvam, ato na
bahuvacanam, ṭhekaikasya prācā'miti liṅgācca | ṭhsarvasye'tyabhāve
vṛkṣābhyāmityādau ṭhsvādiṣu' iti padatvamavalambya prakṛtibhāgamātrasya

() ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat |8|1|9|
ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat | dvirukta iti | dvirvacanaṃ prāpta ityarthaḥ | etacca
prakaraṇāllabhyate, ṭhvīpsāmātraviṣayamida'miti bhāṣyācca | teneti |

sublopamudāharati-ekaikamiti | iheti | ṭhekaika'mityatra ekamityasya
dvirvacane sati, ekamekamiti sthite supo luki,
samudāyātsubityanvayaḥ | nanu ṭhyatra saṅghāte pūrvo bhāgaḥ padaṃ

() ābādhe ca |8|1|10|

() karmadhārayavadutareṣu |8|1|11|

() prakāre guṇavacanasya |8|1|12|

(|) kriyāsamabhihāre ca |

() yathāsve yathāyatham |8|1|14|
yathāsve yathāyatham | vīpsāyāmiti | kārtsnyesaṃbandho

ṭhyuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ parasye'ti śeṣaḥ, ṭhyuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅso'ś'
ityatastadanuvṛteḥ | nanu byamādeśapakṣe ṭhśeṣe lopaḥ' ityado
lope yuṣmabhyamasmabhyamiti makārādakāro na śrūyetetyata āha--ādya
iti | lakṣyānurodhādihā'ntyalopapakṣa evāśrayaṇīyaḥ |
nanvantyalopapakṣe dakārasya lope sati ṭhbahuvacane jhalyet'
ityetvaṃ syādityata āha--tatrāṅgavṛteti | ṭhaṅgavṛteḥ
punarvṛtāvavidhi'riti paribhāṣayetyarthaḥ | aṅgevṛtaṃ vartanaṃ yasya
tat-aṅgavṛtaṃ, tasmin kārye pravṛte sati anyasya aṅgakāryasya
vṛtau pravṛtiviṣaye avidhiḥuvidirnāstītyarthaḥ | prakṛte ca
śeṣalope aṅgakārye pravṛte sati, anyat aṅgakāryametvaṃ na
bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | abhyam tviti | abyamādeśastu ṭilopapakṣe
antyalopapakṣe ca anukūla ityarthaḥ | tatra antyalopapakṣe abhyamo
jhalāditvā'bhāvātasmin pare etvaṃ na | kintu pararūpe sati
yuṣmabhyam asmabhyam iti sidhyati | ṭilopapakṣe tu aṅgasya
adantatvā'bhāvādapi etvaṃ na |
() ekavacanasya ca |7|1|32|
atha pañcamī | ekavacanasya ca | ṭhyuṣmadasyadbhyāṃ ṅso'ś' ityato

tadāha-ābhyāmiti | yuṣmasmadbhyāmityarthaḥ | anekāltvātsarvādeśaḥ
| ṭhna vibhaktau' iti tasya netvam | tvat maditi | yuṣmad as,
asmad as iti sthite tvamādeśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ ṅseradādeśe sati
pararūpe ṭhśeṣe lopaḥ' iti ṭilopaḥ | antyalopapakṣe dakāralope
sati trāyāṇāmakārāṇāṃ pararūpamiti bhāvaḥ | suvacamiti |
lāghavāditi bhāvaḥ |

() yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ ṅso'ś |7|1|27|
yuṣmadasmādbhyāṃ ṅso'ś | spaṣṭamiti | yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ parasya
ṅso'ś syāditi sugamamityarthaḥ | sitvātsarvādeśaḥ | tava mameti
| yuṣmad as, asmad asitisthite maparyantasya tavamamādeśayoḥ
kṛtayoraśādeśe dakārātpūrvayorakārayoḥ pararūpe'do lopaḥ |
antyalopapakṣe dakāralopaḥ, trayāṇāmakārāṇāṃ pararūpamiti bhāvaḥ |
yuvayoḥ āvayoriti | yuṣmad os, asmad os iti sthite
maparyantasya yuvāvādeśayoḥ ṭhyo'cī'ti dasya yatve pararūpamiti
bhāvaḥ |

() yuṣmadsamadoḥ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthayorvānāvau |7|1|17|
yuṣmadasmadoḥ ṣaṣṭhī | ṣaṣṭhaḷadiviśiṣyoriti |
ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyābhiḥ saha tiṣṭhata iti ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthau,
tayoriti vigrahaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaḷadiviśiṣṭayoriti yāvat |
ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsu paratastiṣṭata iti vigrahastu na bhavati,
ṭhpadasye'tyadhikāravirodhāt | padasyetyanuvṛtaṃ hi dvivacanena
vipariṇataṃ ṣaṣṭhīcaturthīdvitīyāsthayorityasya viśeṣaṇam | na hi
ṣaṣṭhaḷadivibhaktiṣu parataḥ patvamasti | bhyāmādau tatsatve'pi
taditaratra dvitīyādau tadabhāvāt | sthagrahaṇasya tu prayojanaṃ mūla
eva vakṣyate |

jijaniṣati| sisaniṣati| cikhaniṣati| atha kṅtorjhilviśeṣamasya
prayojanamāha-- jajñatīti| janan atīti sthite aterṅtve'ipi

ścutvena ñakāra iti bhāvaḥ ṭhjanasanakhanāṃ sa'nityāśritya

pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye| jajaṃsīti| ṭhnaśce'tyanusvāraḥ| jajāthaḥ jajātha|
jajanmi jajanvaḥ jajanmaḥ| jajāneti| jajñatuḥ| seḍayam| jajanitha

leṭiteti| ṭhyasya halaḥ' iti yalopaḥ| medhā āśugrahaṇe iti|
āśugrahaṇaÄ tvarayā bodhaḥ| ṭhsugrahaṇe' iti pāṭhāntaram| sukhyatīti|

(524) prātipadikārthaliṅgaparimāṇavacanamātre prathamā |2|3|46|
