ṭhavyayādāpsupaḥ' iti sūtre ṭhābgrahaṇaṃ vyarthamaliṅgatvā'diti bhāṣyoktarītyā'vyaye kasyāpi liṅgasyānupastha#itiriti prātipadikārthamātre ityasya bhavatyavyayamudāharaṇam | kṛṣṇaśabde puṃstvasya śrīśabde strītvasya jñānaśabde napuṃsakatvasya ca niyamena bhānamasti teṣāṃ niyataliṅgatvāt atasteṣu liṅganāmapi prātipadikārthāntarbhāvāteṣāmapi prātipadikārthamātre ityudāharaṇatvaṃ nirbādhamiti nanu droṇaśabdasya parimāṇaviśeṣavācino niyatapuṃliṅgatve

(|) akarmakadhātubhiryoge deśaḥ kālo bhāvo gantavyo'dhvā ca
karmasañjñaka iti vācyam |

(539) karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā |2|3|8|

varṣahetubhūtavaruṇajapotarakāle parjanyaḥ prāvarṣadityutaraṃ

tadubhayamanunā dyotyate | lakṣaṇatvaṃ ca jñānajanakajñānaviṣayatvam |

japātmakahetujñānajanyajñānaviṣayo varṣaṇamiti bodhaḥ |

iti sāvakāśam | ṭhhetau' iti tṛtīyā tu ṭhdhanena kula'mityādau
sāvakāśā | ṭhparjanyo japamanu prāvarṣa'dityatra tu tadubhayamapi
prasaktam | tatra paratvāddhetutṛtīyaiva syādityata āha--parāpīti |
ṭhanurlakṣaṇe' #iti karmapravacanīyatvaprayuktadvitīyāvidhinetyarthaḥ |
punaḥ saṃjñeti | ṭhvṛkṣamanu vidyotate vidyau' dityatra hi ṭhanurlakṣaṇe'
ityasya na prayojanam, ṭhlakṣaṇettha'mityeva siddheḥ | tataśca
ṭhanurlakṣaṇe' ityārambhasāmarthyāddhetubhūte lakṣaṇe'noḥ

(543) lakṣaṇetthambhūtākhyānabhāgavīpsāsu pratiparyanavaḥ |1|4|90|
lakṣaṇetthaṃbhūta | lakṣaṇaṃ jñāpakam | ayaṃ prakāra itthaṃ, taṃ prāpta
itthambhūtaḥ tasyākhyānamupapādakamitthambhūtākhyānam | bhāgaḥ
svīkāryo'śastatsvāmī vivakṣitaḥ | vyāptuṃ kārtsnyena
saṃbanddhumicchā vīpsā | lakṣaṇaṃ ca itthambhūtākhyānaṃ bhāgaśca vīpsā
ceti dvandvādviṣayasaptamī | tadāha-eṣviti | eṣvartheṣu dyotyeṣviti tu
nāśritam | vyāptumicchāyāstaddyotyārthatvā'bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ |
lakṣaṇe iti | ṭhudāharaṇaṃ vakṣyate' iti śeṣaḥ | vṛkṣaṃ pratīti |
lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvasaṃbandho dvitīyārthaḥ | sa ca pratyādidyotyaḥ | vṛkṣeṇa
lakṣyamāṇā vidyaudvidyotate ityarthaḥ | utpannavinaṣṭā vidyaut,
tadutpādito vṛkṣaprakāśo'pi utpannavinaṣṭa eva | tathāca
vṛkṣaprakāśotaraṃ vidyauto'satvena pratyakṣā'bhāvādanumeyā sā | tataśca
prakāśitena vṛkṣema vidyaujjñānādvṛkṣo lakṣaṇam | itthambhūtākhyāta iti |
ṭhudāharaṇaṃ vakṣyate' iti śeṣaḥ | bhakto viṣṇuṃ pratīti | ṭhbhaja
sevāyām' | bhaktirastyasyeti bhaktaḥ, matvarthīyo'rśaādyac,
viṣayatāsaṃbandhaḥ pratyādidyotyo dvitāyārthaḥ , tasya
bhaktāvekadeśe'nvayaḥ | viṣṇuviṣayakabhaktimānityarthaḥ | atra bhakto
bhaktirūpaṃ prakāraviśeṣaṃ prāptatvāditthambhūtastasya viṣṇuviṣayakatayā
upapādyatvādviṣayatāsaṃbandhastadupapādakaḥ pratidyotya iti jñeyam |
bhāge iti | ṭhudāharaṇaṃ vakṣyate' iti śeṣaḥ | lakṣmīrhariṃ pratīti |
svāmityaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | pratyādidyotyaḥ | tadāha--harerbhāga ityartha
iti | hareḥ svabhūteti yāvat | vīpsāyāmiti | ṭhudāharaṇaṃ vakṣyate'

sahayukte | ṭhpṛthagvinānānābhiḥ' itivat sahenetyeva siddhe
yuktagrahaṇaṃ sahārthakaśabdānāṃ sākamityādīnāmapi
grahaṇārthamityāha--sahārtheneti | putreṇeti |
pituratrāgamanakriyāsaṃbandhaḥ śābdaḥ, putrasya tu tatsāhityagamya
ārthika iti tasyā'prādhānyam | yadyapyāgamanakriyākartṛtvādeva
putrātṛtīyā siddhā tathāpi ṭhputreṇa saha sthūla' ityādyevāsya
mukhyodāharaṇamiti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | arthagrahaṇasya prayojanamāha--evaṃ
sākamiti | nanu ṭhputreṇāgataḥ pite'tyatra sahādiśabdā'bhāvātkathaṃ
tṛtīyetyata āha--vināpīti | vṛddho yūnā tallakṣaṇaścedi'ti sūtre
sahādiśabdā'bhāve'pi tadarthāvagame'pi
tṛtīyānirdeaśadarśanādityarthaḥ | 
(556) yenāṅgavikāraḥ |2|3|20|
yenāṅgavikāraḥ | aṅgānyasya santītyaṅgaṃuśarīram | arśaādyac |
tasya vikāra iti vigrahaḥ | yenetyanena prakṛtyarthabhūtamaṅgaṃ
parāmṛśyate | nahyavikṛtena aṅgena aṅgino vikāraḥ saṃbhavati |
tadāha--yenāṅgenetyādinā | akṣṇā kāṇa iti | kāṇaśabdaḥ
kāṇatvavati vartate | saṃbandhastṛtīyārthaḥ | sa ca kāṇatve'nveti |
tadāha--akṣisaṃbandhīti | saṃbandhaśca vikāraprayuktatvarūpaḥ |
akṣivikāraprayuktakāṇatvavāniti yāvat | yadyapi ekamakṣi vikalaṃ
kāṇamityucyate, tathāpyavayavadharmasya śarīre tadavaccchinnātmani
vyavahāro nirūḍhaḥ | dvau viprāvitivat akṣṇeti padasya prayogaḥ
samarthyaḥ |
(557) itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe |2|3|21|
itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇe | ayaṃ prakāra itthaṃ, taṃ bhūtaḥuprāptaḥ-itthaṃbhūtaḥ | ṭhbhū
prāptau' iti caurādikāt ṭhādhṛṣādvā' iti ṇijabhāve
gatyarthākarmaketyādinā kartari ktaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃujñāpakam |
prakāraviśeṣaṃ prāptasya jñāpake ityarthaḥ | tadāha--kaṃcitprakāramiti |
jaṭābhistāpasa iti | tapo'syāstīti tāpasaḥ | ṭhtapassahasrābhyāṃ
vinīnī' ṭhaṇce'ti matvarthīyo'ṇpratyayaḥ | tāpasatvavati vartate |
lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvastṛtīyārthaḥ | tadāha--jaṭājñāpyeti | naca jñāne
karaṇatvādeva tṛtīyā siddheti vācyaṃ, karaṇatvā'vivakṣāyāṃ
lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvamātravivakṣāyāṃ tṛtīyārthatvāt |
(558) saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ karmaṇi |2|3|22|
saṃjño'nyatarasyāṃ | saṃpūrvasya jñādhātoranukaraṇāt ṣaṣṭhaḷekavacanaṃ
ṭhsaṃjña' iti, tadāha--saṃpūrvasya jānāteriti | dvitīyāpavādo'yaṃ
tṛtīyāvikalpaḥ | saṃjānīte iti | samyak jānīte ityarthaḥ |
ṭhsaṃpratibhyāmanādhyāne' ityātmanepadam |
(559) hetau |2|3|23|
hetau | hetvarthe iti | heturiha kāraṇaparyāyo laukika eva
vivakṣito, natu ṭhtatprayojako hetuśce'ti kṛtrimaḥ, tasya cakāreṇa
kartṛsaṃjñāyā api satvena kartṛtṛtīyayaiva siddheḥ | nanu hetorapi
karaṇatvādeva tṛtīyā siddhetyāśaṅkya
hetutvakaraṇatvayorbhedamāha--dravyādisādhāraṇamiti | ādinā
guṇakriyāsaṅgrahaḥ | dravyaṃ guṇaṃ kriyaṃ ca prati yajjanakaṃ, tatra sarvatra
vidyamānamityarthaḥ | nirvāpārasādhāraṇaṃ ceti |
dvārībhūtavyāpāravati tadrahite ca vidyamānaṃ cetyarthaḥ | evaṃ ca
dravyaguṇakriyātmakakāryatrayanirūpitaṃ nirvyāpārasavyāpāravṛti ca
yataddhetutvamiti phalati | karaṇatvaṃ tviti | kriyājanakamātravṛti
vyāpāravadvṛti ca yatadeva karaṇatvamityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca
hetutvakaraṇatvayorbhedādanyatareṇa anyatarasya nānyathāsiddhiriti
bhāvaḥ | tatra dravyaṃ prati hetumudāharati--daṇḍena ghaṭa iti |
daṇḍahetuko ghaṭa ityarthaḥ | daṇḍe vyāpārasatve'pi
kriyājanakatvā'bhāvānna karaṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ | kriyāṃ prati
hetumudāharati-puṇyena dṛṣṭo haririti | vāgādinā
svargādiphale jananīye yadavāntaravyāpārabhūtamapūrvaṃ tat
puṇyamityucyate | tasya haridarśanajanakatve'pi nirvyāpāratvānna
karaṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ | guṇaṃ prati hetutve tu ṭhpuṇyena
brahmavarcasa'mityādyaudāhāryam | nanvadhyayanena vasatītyatra kathaṃ
tṛtīyā, adhyayanasya gurukulavāsaṃ prati hetutvā'bhāvāt, pratyuta
adhyayanasya vāsasādhyatvādityata āha--phalamapīha heturiti | adhyayanaṃ
yadyapi vāsaphalaṃ tathāpi vāsaṃ prati heturapi bhavati,
iṣṭasādhanatājñānasya pravṛtihetutayā adhyayanasya phalasya svajñānadvārā
vāsajanakatvāt | yadā tvadhyayane phale etādṛśaṃ hetutvamavivakṣitvā
adhyayanārthameva vāso vivakṣyate, tadā caturthyeva bhavati-adhyayanāya
vasatīti | etacca prakṛtasūtre kaiyaṭe spaṣṭam |
nanu alaṃ śrameṇa ityatra kāryasya
kasyacidapyaśravaṇātkaraṇatvahetutvayorasaṃbhavātkathaṃ tṛtīyetyata
āha-gamyamānā'pīti | na kevalaṃ śrūyamāṇaiva kriyā vibhaktau
prayojikā, kiṃ tu gamyamānā'pītyarthaḥ |
karaṇatṛtīyaiveyamityabhipretyāha--alaṃ śrameṇeti | ūṣarakṣetraṃ
pariṣkurvāṇaṃ pratīdaṃ vākyaṃ pravṛtam | atra alamiti nañarthe niṣedhe
vartate | ṭhalaṃ bhūṣaṇaparyāptiśaktivāraṇavācaka'mityamaraḥ |
ṭhsādhya'mityaṣyāhāralabhyam | tadāha--śrameṇa sādhyaṃ nāstīti | sadyaḥ
khedādhāyakatvātsādhane vyāpṛtireva śrama ityupacaryate | nanvevamapi
sādhanīyasya vrīhyādiphalasya kriyārūpatvā'bhāvātkathaṃ śramasya tatra
karaṇatvamityata āha--iheti | ṭhsādhya'mityatra prakṛtibhūto yo
dhātustadarthaḥ sādhanakriyā utpatyātmikā, tāṃ pratītyarthaḥ | etena
śramasya sādhanakriyāyāścā'bheda iti nirastam, śramaśabdena
vrīhyādyautpatyanukūlakarṣaṇādivyāpārasya, ṭhsādhanakriyāṃ pratī'tyanena
vrīhyādyautpateśca vivakṣitatvāt | ṭhgamyamānāpi kriyā vibhaktau
prayojike'tyatra udāharaṇāntaramāha--śateneti | vīpsāyāṃ
dvirvacanam | ekaikena śatena saṅkhyayā vatsānpāyayatīti
pratīyamānārthaḥ | tatra vatsaniṣṭhaśatasaṅkhyāyāḥ pāyane
karaṇatvā'bhāvātpariccchidyeti gamyate | ekaikaśatasaṅkhyayā
vatsānpariccchidyautadadhikavatsebhyo vyāvartya pāyayatītyarthaḥ | tathāca
śatasaṅkhyāyāḥ paricchedaṃ prati karaṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ |
(|) aśiṣṭavyavahāre dāṇaḥ prayoge caturthyarthe tṛtīyā |
aśiṣṭeti | idaṃca ṭhdāṇaśca sā ceccaturthyarthe' ityanena jñāpyata iti
padavyavasthāyāṃ vakṣyate | vaidikamārgānuyāyinaḥ śiṣṭāḥ,
vedamārgādapetā aśiṣṭāḥ, teṣāṃ vyavahāraḥu ācāraḥ, tasminviṣaye
dāṇdhāto prayoge sati caturthyarthe saṃpradāne tṛtīyā vācyetyarthaḥ
| dāsyeti | dāsyai kāmukaḥ prayaccchatītyarthaḥ | ṭhkāmuka' ityanena
ratyarthamiti gamyate | dāsyāṃ
ratirdhamaśāstraniṣiddhatvādaśiṣṭavyavahāra iti bhāvaḥ |
asiṣṭapadaprayojanamāha-dharmye tviti | dharmādanapeta ityarthaḥ | ṭhna
tṛtīye'ti śeṣaḥ | ṭhdharmapathyarthanyāyādanapete iti ya'diti
ratnākaraḥ | dharme tviti pāṭhastu sugama eva | iti tṛtīyā |
(560) karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam |1|4|32|
atha caturthī | karmaṇā yamabhi | karmasaṃjkena gavādidravyeṇa yamabhipraiti
śeṣitvena'dhyavasyati sa saṃpradānamityarthaḥ | śeṣitvaṃ-bhoktṛtvam |
saṃpradīyate yasmai tatsaṃpradānamityanvarthasaṃjñaiṣā | tataśca kasyāḥ
kriyāyāḥ karmaṇetyākāṅkṣāyāṃ dānasyeti gamyate |
tadāha--dānasyetyādinā | deyadravyoddeśyaṃ saṃpradānamiti phalitam
| dānasyeti kim ? payo nayati devadatasya | atra devadatasya
payonayanoddeśyatve'pi na saṃpradānatvaṃ, payaso
dānakarmatvā'bhāvāt | 
(561) caturthī saṃpradāne |2|3|13|
caturthī sampradāne | viprāyeti | vipramuddiśya gāṃ dadātītyarthaḥ |
anabhihita ityeveti | anuvartata evetyarthaḥ | dānīyo vipra iti |
dānoddeśya ityarthaḥ | ṭhkṛtyalyuṭo bahula'miti
bahulagrahaṇātsaṃpradāne'nīyar | tena kṛtā saṃpradānasya
viprasyā'bhihitatvānna caturthīti bhāvaḥ | nanu
dānakriyākarmoddeśyasyaiva saṃpradānatve ṭhpatye śete' ityatra
akarmakaśayanakriyoddeśyasya patyuḥ kathaṃ saṃpradānatvamityāśaṅkāyāṃ
ṭhkriyāgrahaṇamapi kartavya'miti vārtikaṃ pravṛtam |
(|) kriyayā yamabhipraiti so'pi saṃpradānam |
tadetadarthataḥ saṅgṛhṇāti-kriyayā yamiti | kriyoddeśyamapi
saṃpradānamiti yāvat | patye śete iti | pati muddiśya śete
ityarthaḥ | | nanvevamapi odanaṃ pacatītyādāvapi saṃpradānatvaprasaṅgaḥ
| na ca karmasaṃjñāvidhivaiyarthyaṃ śaṅkyam, ata eva tatra
karmatvasaṃpradānatvayorvikalpopapateriti cenna, ṭhpatye śete'
ityakarmakasthale sāvakāśāyāḥ saṃpradānasaṃjñāyāḥ sakarmakasthale
karmasaṃjñayā bāodhāt | tathāca akarmakakriyoddeśyamapi
saṃpradānamiti phalatīti bhāvaḥ | 
(|) karmaṇaḥ karaṇasaṃjñā saṃpradānasya ca karmasaṃjñā |
karmaṇaḥ karaṇa saṃjñetyādi | vārtikamidam | ṭhekasminvākye karmaṇaḥ
saṃpradānasya ca samavāye satī'ti śeṣaḥ |
yajadhātuviṣayamevedamityabhipretyodāharati--paśunā rudraṃ yajata
iti | atra yajadhāturdānārthaka ityabhipretyāha--dadātītyartha iti | idaṃ
vārtikaṃ chāndasameveti kaiyaṭaḥ |
(562) rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ |1|4|33|
rucyarthānāṃ | rucyarthānāṃ dhātūnāmiti | ṭhruca dīptāvabhiprītau ca' |
dīptiriha na rucyarthaḥ, prīyamāṇa iti virodhāt | tathāca
prītijananārthānāmityarthaḥ | prīyamāṇa iti | samavāyena prītyāśraya
ityarthaḥ | haraye rocate bhaktiriti | bhaktiḥ svaviṣayāṃ prīti harau
janayatītyarthaḥ | bhaktigatavyāpāraprayojyaprītyāśrayatvāddhareḥ karmatvaṃ
prāptaṃ, tadapavādo'yam | nanvevaṃ sati harirbhaktimamilaṣatītyatrāpi
bhakteḥ prītiviṣayatvātsaṃpradānatvaṃ syādityata āha-anyakartṛka iti |
samavāyena prītyāśrayāpekṣayā yadanyat, tatkartṛkābhilāṣo
rucdhātvarthaḥ | prītyāśrayakartṛkaḥ kiñcidviṣayaka icchāviśeṣo'bhilāṣaḥ
| tathā ca abhilaṣate rurcthakatvā'bhāvānna tadyoge saṃpradānatvam |
prakṛte ca prītyāśrayo hariḥ, tadapekṣayā yat anyatāubhaktiḥ,
tatkartṛkaiva prītiriti rūcyarthayogaḥ | nanviha bhakteḥ saṃpradānatvaṃ
kuto na syāt, viṣayatāsaṃbandhena bhaktirapi prītyāśrayatvādityata
āha--hariniṣṭhaprīterbhaktiḥ kartrīti | harereva samavāyasaṃbandhena
prītyāśrayatayā prīyamāṇatvādbhakteḥ kartryā uktarītyā
prīyamāmatvā'bhāvācca na saṃpradānatvamiti bhāvaḥ | bhaktirhariṃ
prīṇāti, prīṇayatītyādau tu na bhakteḥ saṃpradānatvaprasaktiḥ, tiṅa
abhihitatvāt, samavāyena prītyāśrayatvā'bhāvācca | nāpi hareḥ,
prīyamāṇa iti karmaṇi sānacprayogabalena prīdhātuyoge
rucyarthānāmityasyā'prasaktervijñānāt, anyathā prīdhātukarmaṇaḥ
saṃpradānatve karmaṇi śānaco daurlabhyāt | modakaḥ pathīti | atra
pathaḥ prīyamāmatvā'bhāvānna saṃpradānatvamiti bhāvaḥ |
(563) ślāghahnuṅsthāśapāṃ jñīpsyamānaḥ |1|4|34|
ślāghahnuṅ | ṭhślāghṛ katthane' ṭhhnuṅ apanayane' ṭhṣṭhā gatinivṛtau'
ṭhśapa upālambhe' eṣāṃ dvandvaḥ | ṭhśapā'mityanantaraṃ ṭhprayoge'
ityadhyāhāryam | ślāghādīnāṃ stutyādinā bodhanamarthaḥ, jñīpsyamāna
iti liṅgāt | jñāpanavācino jñapeḥ sannantātkarmaṇi śānac |
tadāha--eṣāṃ prayoge ityādinā | gopī smarādīti |
manmathapīḍāvaśādnopī ātmastutyā virahavedanāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ
bodhayatītyarthaḥ | kṛṣṇasyaiva stutyatve tu dvitīyaivetyāhuḥ |
hnute iti | sapatnyapanayanena svāśayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bodhayatītyarthaḥ |
tiṣṭhate iti | gantavyamityukte'pi sthityā svāśayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ
bodhayatītyarthaḥ | ṭhprakāśanastheyākhyayośce'tyātmanepadam | śapate
iti | upālambhena svāśayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bodhayatītyarthaḥ | 
(564) dhārerutamarṇaḥ |1|4|35|
dhārerutamarṇaḥ | ṭhdhāre'rityanantaraṃ ṭhprayoge' ityadhyāhāryam |
ṭhdhṛṅ avasthāne' ityasya hetumaṇṇyantasya dhāreriti nirdeaśaḥ |
tadāha--dhārayaterityādinā | anyasvāmikaṃ dravyaṃ niyatakāle
punararpaṇabuddhyā gṛhītam ṛṇamityucyate | tatra ṛṇasya
grahītā-adhamarṇaḥ, ṛṇasyārpayitā-dhanasvāmī-utamarṇaḥ |
pratimāsamaśītibhagādivṛddhyā utamamu adhikatāṃ prāptam ṛṇaṃ
yasyeti vigrahaḥ | bhaktāyeti | bhaktasaṃbandhī yo mokṣaḥu
aparimitanityasukhaviśeṣastaṃ dhārayatītyarthaḥ | dharate mokṣaḥ,
avatiṣṭhate ityarthaḥ | taṃ prerayati dhārayati, avasthāpayatīti yāvat |
pūjayanhi bhaktastulasīdalādidravyaṃ prayaccchati, tacca gṛhṇantuṣṭo
haristatpratadravyaṃ mokṣadānena niṣkrīṇāti | tadāhuḥ
paurāṇikāḥ-ṭhtoyaṃ vā patraṃ vā yadvā kiñcitsamarpitaṃ bhaktyā |
tadṛṇaṃ matvā devo niḥśreyasameva niṣkrayaṃ manute |' ityādi |
tathācātra bhaktasya ṛṇadātṛtvena utamarṇatvātsaṃpradānatvaṃ
saṃbandhaṣaṣṭhaḷpavādaḥ |
(565) spṛherīpsitaḥ |1|4|36|
spṛherīpsitaḥ | ṭhspṛha īpsāyām'curādāvadantaḥ | tataḥ svārthe
ṇici allopasya sthānivatvāllaghūpadhaguṇā'bhāve
spṛhiśabdātṣaṣṭhaḷekavacanam | ṭhprayoga' ityadhyāhāryam |
tadāha--spṛhayaterityādinā | nanu ṭhpuṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayatī'tyeva
syāt, natu puṣpāṇi spṛhayatītyapi | ubhayaṃ tviṣyate | tatrāha
īpsitamātra iti | yadā tvīpsitatvasyāpi na vivakṣā, kiṃ tu
viṣayatāmātravivakṣā, tadā ṭhpuṣpāṇāṃ spṛhayatī'ti sādhu | ṭhkumārya
iva kāntasya trasyanti spṛhayanti ce'tyādidarśanāt | vākyapadīye
tu spṛhayatiyoge karmasaṃjñāyāḥ śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷaścāyamapavāda iti
sthitam | helārājo'pyevam | tanmate puṣpāṇi spṛhayati
puṣpāṇāṃ spṛhayatītyādyasādhvevetyanyatra vistaraḥ | 
(566) krudhadruherṣyā'sūyārthānāṃ yaṃ prati kopaḥ |1|4|37|
krudhadruha | krudhādyarthānāmiti | ṭhkrudha krodhe' ṭhdruha drohe'
śyanvikaraṇau | ṭhīrṣya īrṣyāyāṃ' śabvikaraṇaḥ | ṭhasūñ upatāpe'
kaṇḍvādiḥ | eṣāmarthā evārthā yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ | haraye
krudhyatīti | ṭhrāvaṇādi'riti śeṣaḥ | hariviṣayakaṃ kopaṃ
karotītyarthaḥ | ghāteccāsamaniyataścitavṛtiviśeṣaḥ kopaḥ |
akarmakatvātṣaṣṭhī prāptā | druhyatīti | kopāddhariviṣayakamapakāraṃ
karotītyarthaḥ | akarmakatvātṣaṣṭhī prāptā | apakāro duḥkhajanikā
kriyā | dhātvarthopasaṅgrahādakarmakaḥ | īrṣyatīti | īrṣyā asahanam |
hariṃ kopānna sahata ityarthaḥ | karmaṇi dvitīyā prāptā | asūyati veti
| asūyā guṇeṣu doṣāropaḥ | yathāvihitakarmācāre
dambhādikṛtvāropaṇam | ihaga kopāddhariṃ durguṇaṃ manyata ityarthaḥ |
maināmiti | enāṃ bhāryāmanyo na paśyedityetadarthaṃ bhāryāguṇeṣu
doṣāropaṇaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | nātra bhāryāṃ prati kopaḥ, kintu
pareṇa dṛśyamānāṃ tāṃ na sahata ityeva vivakṣitamiti bodhyam |
evaṃca krodhadroherṣyāsūyānāṃ kopamūlakatvaevedamiti bhāṣye
sthitam | tathāca kupyati kasmai cidityādyasādhveva,
kopamūlakatvā'bhāvātkrudhārthakatvā'bhāvācca | prarūḍhakopa eva hi
krodhaḥ, ṭhnahyakupataḥ krudhyati' iti bhāṣyāt | 
(567) krudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoḥ karma |1|4|38|
krudhadruhoḥ | ṭhupasṛṣṭayo'rityetadvyācaṣṭe--sopasargayoriti |
pūrvasūtrāpavādo'yam | hareḥ krodhadrohoddeśyatvā'bhāvāt
ṭhkriyayā yamabhipraitī'ti saṃpradānatvasya na prasaktiḥ | nāpi
tādarthyacaturthyāḥ | krudhadruhorakarmakatvānnahareḥ karmatvam | ataḥ
śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ prāptāyā vācanikāṃ karmatvam |
(568) rādhīkṣyoryasya vipraśnaḥ |1|3|39|
rādhīkṣyoḥ | yadīya iti | yadviṣayaka ityarthaḥ | ṭhvipraśna'
ityetadvyācaṣṭe--vividhaḥ praśna iti | kṛṣṇāya rādhyati īkṣate vā |
pṛṣṭo garga iti | gagāç nāma jyotiḥ śāstravidṛṣiviśeṣaḥ, sa
kṛṣṇāya rādhyati īkṣate vetyanvayaḥ | ṭhrādha saṃsiddhau ' ṭhīkṣa darśane'
| iha tu prasnaviṣayaśubhā'śubhaparyolocanamarthaḥ, ṭhyasya vipraśna' iti
liṅgāt | tadāha--śubhāśubhaṃ paryolocayatītyartha iti | atra
śubhasyā'śubhasya ca praśnaviṣayasya dhātvarthopasaṅgrahākarmakāvetau |
ata eva rādhyatīti śyannupapadyate | anyathā ṭhrādho'karmakādi'ti
niyamācchÂayanna syāt | evaṃca kiṃ kṛṣṇasya śubhamaśubhaṃ veti pṛṣṭo
gargaḥ kṛṣṇaviṣayakaṃ śubhā'śubhaṃ paryolocayatītyarthaḥ | kṛṣṇasya
saṃpradānatvaṃ | ṣaṣṭhaḷpavādaḥ |
(569) pratyāṅbhyāṃ śruvaḥ pūrvasya kartā |1|4|40|
pratyāṅbhyām | pratyāṅbhyāmiti digyoge pañcamī |
parasyetyadhyāhāryaṃ śruva ityasya viśeṣaṇam | ṭhśru śravaṇe' | iha tu
preraṇāpūrvakābhyupagame vartate | pūrvaśabdaḥ preraṇātmakavyāpāraṃ
parāmṛśati | tadāha--ābhyāmityādinā | ṭhpūrvasye'tyasya
vyākhyānaṃ-pravartanārūpasyeti | preraṇārūpasyetyarthaḥ |
ṭhpratyāṅbhyā'mityanena samuditābhyāṃ parasyeti nārtho vivakṣitaḥ,
kintu pratyekameva tayornimitatvam, anyathā ṭhabhiniviśaśce'tivat
ṭhpratyāṅ śruvaḥ' ityeva brūyādityabhipretyodāharati--viprāya gāṃ
pratiśraṇoti āśraṇoti veti | atra pratipūrvaka āṅpūrvakaśca
śrudhātuḥ preraṇāpūrvakābhyapagame vartate, tataśca pravartitaḥ
pratijānīte iti labhyate kena pravartita ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ vipraḥ
kartṛtvenānveti | tatra viprasya preraṇākartṛtvātsaṃpradānatvaṃ
kartṛ tṛtīyāpavāda ityabhipretyāha--vipreṇeti | magyaṃ
gavādidravyaṃ dehīti vipreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ san devadatastubhyaṃ
dadāmītyabhyupagaccchatīti yojanā |

(571) parikrayaṇe saṃpradānamanyatarasyām |1|4|44|
parikrayaṇe | niyatakālamiti | ṭhtubhyametāvadvetanaṃ dīyate,
tadgṛhṇannetāvantaṃ kālaṃ tvaṃ mama karmakaro bhave'tyevaṃ
parimitakālaṃ bhṛtyā svīkaraṇaṃ parikrayaṇamityarthaḥ |
sādhakatamamityanuvartate | tadāha--tasminsādhakatamamiti |
saṃpradānatvā'bhāve karaṇasaṃjñā | śateneti |
suvarṇādiyatkiñciddravyaśatenetyarthaḥ | 
(|) tādarthye caturthī vācyā |
tādarthye caturthīti | ṭhcaturthī saṃpradāne' iti sūtrabhāṣye
paṭhitametat | tasmai idaṃ tadartham | arthena nityasamāsaḥ | tadarthasya
bhāvastādarthyam | brāhmaṇāditvāt ṣyañ | tena ca
upakāryopakārakabhāvasaṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ | tatra upakāryādeva caturthī,
bhāṣye yūpāya dāru, kuṇḍalāya
hiraṇyamityudāhṛtatvādityabhipretyodāharati-muktaye iti |
muktyarthamityarthaḥ | upakāryatvaṃ ca bahuvidhaṃ janyatvādi | yathā
muktaye hariṃ bhajatīti | muktirjanyeti gamyate | prāpyatvaṃ vā,
brāhmaṇāya dadhīti | brāhmaṇasyopakāryatvaṃ gamyate ityādi | nacaivamapi
anenaiva siddhe ṭhcaturthī sampradāne' iti sūtraṃ saṃpradānasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ
ca vyarthamiti vācyaṃ, ṭhharaye rocate bhaktiḥ' ityādau ṭhrucyarthānāṃ
prīyamāṇaḥ' ityādyartha tadāvaśyakatvāditi bhāṣye spaṣṭam | 
(|)klṛpi saṃpadyamāne ca ||
klṛpi saṃpadyamāne ceti | klṛpīti saptamī |
sampatiḥuvikārātmanā utpatiḥ | pariṇāma iti yāvat |
klṛpidhātau prayujyamāne sati saṃpadyamāne'rthe vartamānāccaturthī
vācyetyarthaḥ | bhaktiriti | jñānātmanā pariṇamate ityarthaḥ |
ṭhklṛpītyarthagrahaṇa'mityabhipretyādāharati--saṃpadyate jāyate
ityādīti | ādinā ṭhpariṇamate' ityādisaṅgrahaḥ |
pariṇāmatvaprakārakabodhārthamidaṃ vacanam | anyathā
tādarthyacaturthyaiva siddhamityāhuḥ |
(|)utpātena jñāpite ca |
utpātena jñāpite ceti | aśubhasūcaka ākasmiko bhūtavikāra
utpātaḥ, tena sūcite'rthe vidyamānāccaturthī vācyetyarthaḥ | vātāyeti
| mahābātasya sūciketyarthaḥ |
(|) hitayoge ca |
hitayoge ceti | ṭhcaturthī vācye'ti śeṣaḥ | brāhmaṇāya hitamiti |
brāhmaṇasya sukhakṛdityarthaḥ | ṭhyājanādī'ti śeṣaḥ |
(572) kriyārthopapadasya ca karmaṇi sthāninaḥ |2|3|14|
kriyārtha | kriyā arthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā kriyārthā | ṭhkriye'ti
viśeṣyamadhyāhāryam | kriyāphalakakriyāvācakamiti yāvat |
kriyārthā kriyā upapadaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ | tumuno viśeṣaṇametat |
upoccāritaṃ padam-upapadam | ṭhsthānina' ityapi tadviśeṣaṇam |
sthānaṃ prasaktirasyāstīti sthānī, tasyeti vigrahaḥ |
aprayujyamānasyeti yāvat | tādṛśasya tumunnantasya karmaṇi caturthīti
phalitam | ṭhtumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyā'miti
tumunvidhimahimnā kriyāphalakamupapadaṃ kriyāvācyeva labhyate |
tadāha--kriyārthā kriyeti | ṭhsthānina' ityasya
vyākhyānam-aprayujyamānasyeti | ṭhphalebhyo yātī'tyatra kasya
tumunnantasya prasaktirityata āha--phalānyāhartumiti | iha
phalāharaṇakriyārthā yānakriyā, tadvācane upapade
āhartumityadhyāhāralabhyatumunnantārthāharaṇakriyāṃ prati phalānāṃ
karmatvāccaturthī dvitīyāpavādaḥ | naca tādarthyacaturthyā gatārthatā
śaṅkyā, nahi yānakriyā phalārthā, kintu phalakarmakāharaṇakriyārthaiva,
ato na phalebhyastādarthyacaturthīprasaktiḥ | evaṃ ca
phalakarmakāharaṇakriyārthā yānakriyeti bodhaḥ |
udāharaṇāntaramāha--namaskurma iti | tumunnantārthādhyāhāraṃ
darśayati--nṛsiṃhamanukūlayitumiti | nacātra ṭhnamaḥsvastī'tyeva
caturthī siddheti vācyam, ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī'
iti dvitīyāpateḥ | etatsūcanārthamevedamudāharaṇāntaraṃ darśitam | 
(573) tumarthācca bhāvavacanāt |2|3|15|
tumarthācca | ṭhtumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyā'miti sūtram |
kriyārthānāṃ kriyāyāmupapadabhūtāyāṃ bhaviṣyati kāle
tumunṇvulau staḥ | bhoktuaṃ vrajati, bhojako vrajati |
bhaviṣyadbhujikriyārtho vrajatiratropapadam | asya tumuno'rtha
ivārtho yasya tasmāditi vigrahaḥ | bhāvaḥukriyā | ucyate aneneti
vacanaḥ, bhāvasya vacano bhāvavacanaḥ, tasmāditi vigrahaḥ | kriyāvācina
iti yāvat | ṭhpratyayā'diti śeṣaḥ | tatra ṭhavyayakṛto bhāve' iti
tumuno bhāva eva vihitatvena tumarthakasya pratyayasya bhāvavacanatve
siddhe punarbhāvavacanagrahaṇaṃ
sūtraviśeṣaparigrahaṇārthamityāha--bhāvavacanāśceti |
ṭhbhāve'ityadhikṛtya ye ghañādipratyayā vihitāste
kriyārthakriyāyāmupapadabhūtāyāṃ bhaviṣyati syuriti tadarthaḥ |
ṭhyāgāya yātī'tyādyaudāharaṇam | #evaṃ ca
kriyārthakriyopapadatvalābhārthaṃ tumarthāditi viśeṣaṇam | atra
tādarthyasya tumuneva ghañā dyotitatvāt ṭhuktārthānāmaprayogaḥ' iti
nyāyena tādarthyacaturthyā aprāptau prathamāyāḥ prāptāvidaṃ vacanam |
tumarthāditi kim ?| pākaḥ tyāda ityādau ghaño bhāve
ityadhikārasthatve'pi na caturthī | kriyārthakriyopapadatvā'bhāvena
tumarthakatvā'bhāvāt | bha#avavacanāditi kim ?| pācako vrajati |
paktuaṃ vrajatītyarthaḥ | ṭhtumunṇvulau' iti ṇvul | tasya
tumarthakatve'pi ṭhbhāve' ityadhikāre vidhyabhāvānna caturthī |
tādarthyasya ṇvulaivoktatvānna tādarthyacaturthī, kiṃtu prathamaiva |
(574) namaḥsvastisvāhāsvadhā'laṃvaṣaḍaḷegācca |2|3|16|
namaḥsvasti | yujyata iti yogaḥ | karmaṇi ghañ | ṭhnamas'
ityādibhiryuktādityarthaḥ | phalitamāha--ebhiryoge iti | na ca
tādarthyacaturthyā gatārthatvaṃ śaṅkyaṃ, tādarthyasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ
ṣaṣṭhīnivāraṇārthatvāt | tādarthyaṃ hi upakāryopakārakabhāvaḥ, tasya
yadā sambandhatvena bhānaṃ tadā ṣaṣṭhī, yatā ṭhguroridaṃ gurvartha'miti
bhāṣye spaṣṭam | evaṃca namaḥsvastyādiyoge tādarthyasya
śeṣatvavikṣāyāmapi caturthyevetyetadarthamidaṃ sūtram | 
(|) upapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī ||
nanu namaskaroti devānityatrāpi caturthī syādityata
āha--upapadavibhakteriti | padāntarayoganimitikā
vibhaktiḥ-upapadavibhakti, tadapekṣayā kārakavibhaktirbalīyasītyarthaḥ |
ṭhantarāntareṇe'ti sūtre bhāṣye paṭhitamidaṃ vacanam | tacca
nyāyasiddham | kriyākārakayorhi sambandhaḥ-antaraṅgaḥ | upapadārthena
tu yatkiñcitkriyākārakabhāvamūlakaḥ sambandha iti tannimitā
vibhaktirbahiraṅgeti kaiyaṭaḥ | anye tūpapadavibhaktyā
sambandhasāmānyamavagamyate, viśeṣāvagamastu
prakaraṇādiparyālocanayā labhyaḥ | kārakavibhaktyā tu
karmatvādisambandhaviśeṣo jhaṭityevāvagamyata iti sā
balīyasītyāhuḥ | namaskaroti devāniti | kāraśiraḥsaṃyogādinā
toṣayatītyarthaḥ | karaśiraḥsaṃyogādimātrārthatve'karmakatvāpātāt
| prajābhyaḥ svastīti | prajāsambandhi kuśalamityarthaḥ | agnaye svāheti
| agnyuddeśyakaṃ dravyadānamityarthaḥ | pitṛbhyaḥ svadheti |
pituddeśyakaṃ dravyadānamityarthaḥ | svaṃ rūpaṃ śabdasya' iti alaśabdasyaiva
grahaṇe ṭhkumārīṇāmalaṅkāra' ityatrātivyāptiḥ | kiṃca daityebhyo
hariralamityatraiva syāt, ṭhdaityebhyo hariḥ prabhu'rityādau na
syādityata āha--alamitīti | vārtikametat | alamityanena
paryāptyarthakaśabdānāṃ grahaṇamityarthaḥ | teneti |
paryāptyarthagrahaṇenetyarthaḥ | ityādīti | ādinā
ṭhkumārīṇāmalaṅkāra' ityatrātivyāptinirāsasaṅgrahaḥ | nanu
ṭhprabhurbubhūṣurbhuvanatrayasye'tyādau kathaṃ ṣaṣṭhītyata
āha--prabhvādiyoge ṣaṣṭhīti | kuta ityata āha--sa eṣāṃ grāmaṇārāta
nirdeaśāditi | nanvevaṃ sati ṭhdaityebhyaḥ prabhu'riti caturthī na syāt
| alaṃśabdastu paryāptītarārthaka eva bhaviṣyatītyata āha--tasmai
prabhavatīti | vaṣaḍindrāyeti | indroddeśyakaṃ havirdānamityarthaḥ |
nanu svasti gobhyo bhūyādityāśīrvākye caturthyeveṣyate | tatra
ṭhcaturthī'cāśiṣyāyuṣye'tyādinā paratvātpakṣe ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgaḥ ityata
āha--cakāraḥ punarvidhānārtha iti | teneti |
punarvidhānasāmarthyenetyarthaḥ | 
(575) manyakarmaṇyanādare vibhāṣā'prāṇiṣu |2|3|17|
manyakarmaṇi | ṭhaprāṇiṣvi'ti cchedaḥ | ṭhmana jñāne' divādiḥ,
śyanvikaraṇaḥ, ṭhmanu avabodhane' tanādirivikaraṇaḥ | tatra manyeti
śyanā nirdeaśāddaivādikasya grahaṇamityāha-manyateriti | karmaṇīti |
ato dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā pakṣe caturthīti sūcitam | tiraskāre iti |
ṭhanādāre' ityasya vyākhyānametat | ṭhanādaraḥ paribhavaḥ
parībhāvastiraskriyā' ityamaraḥ | na tvāṃ tṛṇamiti| he devadata tvāṃ
tṛṇatvenāpi na manye ityarthaḥ | nañupādānādayamartho labhyate |
tṛṇādpayadhamatvapratītestiraskārātiśayaḥ phalitaḥ | ṭhtṛṇaṃ tvāṃ
manye tṛṇāya ve'tyuktau tu tṛṇasāmyameva pratīyeta | na tu
tato'pyapakṛṣṭatvam | etadevābhipretya bhāṣye'pi nañupātaḥ | na ca
manyakarmatvā'viśeṣātvamiti yuṣmaccchabdādapi caturthī śaṅkyā,
anādaradyotake karmaṇītyarthasya vivakṣitatvāt | tṛṇameva
hyatrānādaradyotakaṃ, na tu yuṣmadarthaḥ | śyaneti |
tānādikamanudhātukarmaṇi dvitīyaiva, natu pakṣe caturthīti bhāvaḥ | na
tvāṃ tṛṇaṃ manve iti | manudhātoruvikaraṇasya
laḍutamapuruṣaikavacanam | nanu ṭhna tvāṃ nāvamannaṃ manye' ityatrāpi
caturthīvikalpaḥ syādityativyāptiḥ, ṭhna tvāṃ śune manye' ityādau
tu prāṇitvāccaturthīvikalpo na syādityavyāptiḥ , karmaṇaḥ
prāṇitvādityata āha--aprāṇiṣvityapanīyeti | na tvāṃ nāvaṃ manye
iti | jīrṇāṃ nāvaṃ prati vākyametat | na tvāmannaṃ manye
ityapyudāhāryam | kutsitamannaṃ prati vākyametat |
ubhayatrāpyaprāṇitve'pi na caturthīvikalpaḥ, kiṃtu dvitīyaiveti bhāvaḥ |
na tvāṃ śune manye iti | he devadata | tvāṃ śvatvenāpi na manye
ityarthaḥ | na tvāṃ kākaṃ manye, na tvāṃ śukaṃ manye, na tvāṃ sṛgālaṃ
manye ityapyudāhāryam | eṣu prāṇitve'pi na caturthīvikalpa iti
bhāvaḥ |
(576) gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyāmanadhvani |2|3|12|
gatyartha | śārīraparispandaḥ-ceṣṭā | manaseti | atra śārīraceṣṭāyā
abhāvānna dvitīyācaturthyau, kintu dvitīyaiveti bhāvaḥ |
ṭhāsthitapratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti vārtikamarthataḥ
saṅgṛhṇāti-gantrā'dhiṣṭhite iti | gantrākrānte adhvanyeva
anadhvanītyayaṃ niṣedha ityarthaḥ | yathā-panthānaṃ gaccchatīti | panthānaṃ
prāpnotītyarthaḥ | atra pathaḥ prāptyāśrayatvena gantrādhiṣṭhitvānniṣedhaḥ |
asya vārtikasya prayojanamāha-yadā tviti | utpathāditi |
amārgādityarthaḥ | lyablope pañcamī | ujjayinīṃ prāptuṃ prasthito
mohātanmārgātpracyuto mārgāntaraṃ praviṣṭaḥ | taṃ parityajya
punarujjayinīmārga ākramitumiṣyate, tadā'nadhvanīti
niṣedhā'bhāvāccaturthyapi bhavatyevetyarthaḥ | tādṛśaṃ lakṣyaṃ
darśayati--utpathena pathe gaccchatīti | ṭhutpathene'tyanantaraṃ
ṭhgantumaśakta' iti śeṣaḥ | utpathena ujjayinīṃ prāptumaśakta utpathaṃ
parityajya ujjayinīmārgaṃ praveṣṭuṃa tadīyaṃ mārgamanusaratītyarthaḥ |
atra ujjayinīmārgasya gantrādhiṣṭhitatvā'bhāvādanadhvanīti niṣedho na
bhavati, ataścaturthī bhavati, pakṣe dvitīyā ceti bhāvaḥ | iti caturthī |

(578) apādāne pañcamī |2|3|28|

nanu viśleṣānukūlacalanā'nāśrayabhūtaṃ yatadeva dhruvamiti
vyākhyāyatām, kimavadhitvavivakṣayetyata āha--dhāvato'śvātpatatīti |
aśvasya calanāśrayatve'pi patanakriyāṃ prati
kasmādityākāṅkṣāviṣayatvalakṣaṇamavadhitvaṃ na viruddhamiti bhāvaḥ |
(|) jugupsāvirāmapramādārthānāmupasaṃkhyānam |
jugupseti | jugupsādyarthakadhātubhiryoge

pāpaviṣaye kutsitatvabuddhyā na ramate ityarthaḥ | viramatīti |
ṭhpāpā'dityanuṣajyate | pāpaviṣaye na pravartata ityarthaḥ |
dharmātpramādyatīti | dharmaviṣaye muhyatītyarthaḥ |
vāstavasaṃyogaviśleṣayorabhāvādvacanamidam | yadā tu ṭhjugupsate'
ityāderjugupsādibhirnivartata ityartha āśrīyate, tadā
buddhikalpitaviśleṣāvadhitvamādāyāpādānatvaṃ siddhamiti idaṃ sūtraṃ
bhāṣye pratyākhyātam |

(581) vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ |1|4|27|
vāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ | pravṛtivimukhīkaraṇaṃ vāraṇam | yavebhya iti
| yaveṣu pravartitukāmāṃ gāṃ pravṛtivimukhīkarotītyarthaḥ |
saṃyogapūrvakaviśleṣā'bhāvāt ṭhdhruvamapāye' ityaprāptāvidaṃ
vacanam | tatra yavānāṃ svakīyatayā saṃrakṣaṇīyatvena
īpsitatvādapādānatvaṃ, natu goḥ, tasyāḥ
parakīyatvenānīpsitatvāt, vāraṇīyatayā īpsitatvāvyāghātācca |
tathāca ṭhtathāyuktaṃ ce'ti goḥ karmatvāddvitīyā | yadā tu yavāḥ
parakīyāḥ, gaustu svakīyā, tadā vāraṇamasaṃbhāvitameva | vastutastu
yavānāṃ parakīyatve'pi tadvināśādadharmaḥ syāt, yavasvāmī
gāmapahṛtya badhnīyāt, gosvāminaṃ ca yavasvāmī daṇḍayet, ato
yavānāṃ rakṣitumiṣṭatvādīpsitatvādapādānatvamastyeva | gostu
svakīyatve'pi bādhakanivṛtyai vārayitumiṣṭatamatvātkarmatvam | naca
gorīpsitatamatve'pi īpsitatvasyāpi satvādapādānatvaṃ kiṃ na
syāditi vācyam, īpsitatamatve ṭhvāraṇārthānā'mityapādānatvaṃ
bādhitvā ṭhkarturīpsitatama'miti karmatvasyaiva paratvātprāpteḥ | naca
ṭhvāraṇārthānāmīpsitaḥ' ityapādānatvasya ṭhkarturīpsatatama'miti
karmatvāpavādatvaṃ śaṅkyaṃ, ṭhkarturīpsitatama'miti karmatvaṃ hi
īpsitatamamātraviṣayam | vāraṇārthānāmityapādānatvaṃ tu
īpsitaviṣayam | tasya prakṛte īpsiteṣu yaveṣu parakīyeṣu
sāvakāśatvānna ṭhkarturīpsatatama'miti karmatvāpavādatvam | ataḥ
paratvādgoḥ svakīyāyāḥ parakīyayavāpekṣayā
īpsitatamatvātkarmatvameva | naca ṭhagnermāṇavakaṃ
pravṛtivimukhīkarotīti hi tadarthaḥ | tatrāgnisparśe māṇavakasya
dāhaprasaṅgātadviṣayapravṛkativimukhīkaraṇātmakavāraṇakriyayā''ptumiṣṭatamatvena vārayiturīpsitatamatvānmāṇavakasya karmatvam | agnestu vāraṇakriyepsitatamamāṇavakīyasparśakriyayā āptumiṣṭatamatve'pi vārayiturīpsitatatvādapādānatvam | etena tayoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇena | etāvataiva hariṃ bhajati, grāmaṃ gacchṃastṛṇaṃ spṛśati, viṣaṃ bhuṅkte ityādisarvalakṣyasaṅgrahāditi nirastam | kartṛvyāpārajanyaphalāśrayaḥ karmetyuktau hi ṭhvāraṇārthānā'miti sūtramasyāpavādaḥ syāt, viśeṣavihitatvāt | tathāca māṇavaksaya karmatvaṃ na syāt | nacāgnau ṭhbākaṇārthānā'miti sāvakāśamiti vācyaṃ, vārayaterhyatra sparśaphalakapravṛtivighaṭanamarthaḥ | taccānyato nayanādirūpam | tādṛśavyāpāraprayojyaphalaṃ māmavakakartṛkasparśaphalakapravṛtivirahaḥ | tatra svarśāśo'gniniṣṭhaḥ māṇavakaniṣṭhaśca, saṃyogarūpasya sparśasya dviniṣṭhatvāt | pravṛtivirahaśca viṣayatayā'gniniṣṭhaḥ, āśrayatayā māṇavakaniṣṭhaśca | tathāca kartṛvyāpāraprayojyaphalāśrayatvalakṣaṇakarmatvasya paratvādubhayatrāpi prāptau ṭhvāraṇārthānā'mityapādānatvaṃ niravakāśatvādapavādaḥ syāditi māṇavakādapi pañcamī syāt, tadbādhanārtha ṭhkarturīpsitatamaṃ karme'tyārabdhavyam | evaṃca īpsitamātre'gnau sāvakāśasyāpādānatvasya paratvādīpsitatame māṇavake bādhaḥ sidhyati | ṭhkarturīpsitatama'mityārabdhe ca dreṣyodāsīnasaṅgrahārthaṃ ṭhtathāyukta'mityapyārabdhavyamityāstāṃ tāvat | bhāṣye tu buddhikalpitasaṃyogaviśleṣakṛtamapādānatvāmāśritya pratyākhyātamidaṃ sūtram | 
(582) antarddhau yenā'darśanamiccchati |1|4|28|

(584) janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ |1|4|30|
janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ | janirjananamutpatiḥ | ṭhjanī
prādurbhāve'daivādiko'karmakaḥ | ṭhiṇjādibhyaḥ' iti bhāve iṇ |
ṭhjanivadhyośce'ti niṣedhānnopadhāvṛddhiḥ | janeḥ karteti vigrahaḥ |
śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷa samāsaḥ | ṭhtṛjakābhyāṃ kartarī'ti niṣedhastu kārakaṣaṣṭhaḷa
eveti vakṣyate | jāyamānasyeti | janadhātoḥ kartari laṭaśśānac,
śyan, ṭhjñājanorjā' ṭhāne muk' | utpatyāśrayasyetyarthaḥ |
prakṛtiśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe-heturiti | brahmaṇa iti | hiraṇyagarbhādityarthaḥ
| ghaṭādiṣu kulālādivatasya prajotpatau nimitakāraṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ
| vṛtikṛnmatametadayuktam, saṃyogaviśleṣasatvena ṭhdhruvamapāye'
ityeva siddhatvāt | ato'tra mūle hetuśabda upādānakāraṇapara eva |
ata eva bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ ṭhgomāyādvṛścikā jāyante'
golomā'vilomabhyo dūrvā jāyante' ityudāhṛtya pariṇāmeṣu
prakṛtidravyāvayavānusyūtisatve'pi buddhikṛtaviśleṣasatvāt
ṭhdhruvamapāye' ityeva siddhamiti pratyākhyānaṃ saṅgaccchate | evaṃ ca
ṭhbrahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante' ityatra brahmaśabdena
māyopahitamīśvaracaitanyameva vivakṣitam | taddhi
sarvakāryopādānamiti vedāntasiddhāntaḥ |
(585) bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ |1|4|31|

prabhava iti | prabhavatiuprathamaṃ prakāśate'sminniti prabhavaḥ |

asaṅgatiḥ, gaṅgāyastatrānutpateḥ | tadāha--prakāśate ityartha iti |

bhavati | etena ṭhjanikartu'rityanena ṭhdhruvamapāye' ityanena ca
gatārthatvaṃ nirastam | bhāṣye tu apakrāmatītyarthamāśritya

(586) anyārāditarartedikśabdāñcūtarapadājāhiyukte |2|3|29|
anyārāt | yukta iti bhāve kta ityāha-ebhiryoge iti | anya, ārāt,
itara, ṛte, dikśabda, añcūtarapada, āc, āhi etairaṣṭabhiryoge
satītyarthaḥ | bhinnādiśabdayoge pañcamīṃ

ityekārāntamavyayam | ṭhṛte varjane' ityamaraḥ | kṛṣmasya varjane

pūrvādaya eva gṛhyante natvaindrīkakubādayaḥ | saṃpratīti |
kadāciddigvācakānāmidānīṃ kālavācakānāmapi yoge pañcamī

āha--avayavavācīti | tasya paramiti | tasyeti hi prakṛtaṃ dviruktaṃ
parābhṛśati | dviruktasya paraṃuparāvayavabhūtamāmrehitamiti tadarthaḥ |
pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti | śasīrasya pūrvāvayava ityarthaḥ |
añcudhāturutarapadaṃ yasya sa añcūtarapadaḥuprāgādidikcchabdaḥ, natu
sadhryaṅ ityādiśabdo'pi, dikśabdasāhacaryāt | tena sadhryaṅ
devadatenetyatra na pañcamī | nanu dikśabdatvādeva siddhe
añcūtarapadagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityata āha--añcūtarapadasyeti
|ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthe'tnantaraṃ ṭhparatvātprāptā'miti śeṣaḥ | prāk pratyāgvā
grāmāditi | grāmāvadhika ityarthaḥ | ājiti | acpratyayāntayoge
udāharaṇaṃ vakṣyata iti sūcanamidam | dakṣiṇā grāmāditi |
grāmāvadhikāyāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśītyarthaḥ | āhīti |
āhipratyayāntayoge udāharaṇasūcanamidam | dakṣiṇāhi grāmāditi |
grābhāvadhikāyāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi dūra ityarthaḥ | ṭhāhi ca dūre'
ityāhipratyayaḥ | ājāhipratyayāntayordikśabdatve'pi ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthe'ti
ṣaṣṭhaĀ bādhituṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam | nanvevamapi ṭhbhavātprabhṛtyārabhya vā
sevyo hariḥ' ityādau kathaṃ pañcamī, anyādiśabdayogā'bhāvādityata
āha--apādāne iti | prabhṛtiyoge iti | prabhṛtyarthakaśabdayoge
ityarthaḥ | tathā hi--ṭhapādāne pañcamī'ti sūtre bhāṣye
ṭhyataścādhvakālanimānami'ti vārtikaṃ paṭhitvā kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇī
māse ityudāhṛtya ṭhidaṃ na vaktavyami'ti tadvārtikapratyākhyānamupakṣipya
ṭhidamatra prayoktavyaṃ sanna prayujyate, kārtikyāḥ prabhṛtyāgrahāyaṇī māse'
ityuktam | prabhṛtiśabdā'bhāve'pi tadarthasatayā pañcamī siddhetyarthaḥ |
evaṃ vadatā bhāṣyakṛtā ṭhprabhṛtyarthakaśabdayoge pañcamī'ti vacanaṃ
jñāpyate | anyathā pañcamyarthaṃ vārtikasyāvaśyakatvātadasaṅgatiḥ
spaṣṭaiva | evaṃca prabhṛtiśabdaparyāyaśabdayoge'pi pañcamī bhavati | ata
eva ca ṭhkārtikyāḥ prabhṛti' iti bhāṣyavyākhyāvasare ṭhtata ārabhyetyartha'
iti kaiyaṭa āha | tatra hi tata iti pañcamyāstasiḥ |
etatsarvamabhipretyodāharati--bhavātprabhṛtyārabhya veti | bhavaḥuutpatiḥ

| bhavamavadhiṃ parigṛhya hariḥ sevya ityarthaḥ |
utapatikṣaṇātmakapūrvavadhikotarakāle sarvadā āmaraṇaṃ hariḥ sevya
iti yāvat | atrārabhyeti kriyāpekṣayā karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyaiva,
ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī'tyukteḥ | yathā
ṭhsūryodayamārabhya ā'stamayājjapatī'tyādau | śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ
dvitīyaiva, ṭhupapadavibhakteḥ kārakavibhaktirbalīyasī'tyukteḥ | yathā
ṭhsūryodayamārabhya ā'stamayājjapatī'tyādau | śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu
ṣaṣṭhī bādhitvā bhavaśabdātpañcamī | prabhṛtiśabdayoge tu ārabhyetyarthe
kadāpi na dvitīyā, prabhṛtiśabdārthasyāvadhiṃ
parigṛhyaetyasyāvadhyādighaṭitvena kriyātvā'bhāvāt | apaparīti |
bahiśśabdayoge pañcamīṃ siddhavatkṛtya ṭhapaparibahirañcavaḥ pañcamyā'
iti samāsavidhānādbahiśśabdayoge pañacamī vijñāyate ityarthaḥ |
idaṃca ṭhapaparī'ti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam | ṭhkarasya karamo bahiḥ' iti
tvasādhveva | ṭhjñāpakasiddhaṃ na sarvatre'ti vā kathañcitsamādheyam | 
(587) apaparī varjane |1|4|88|
apaparī varjane | karmapravacanīyau sta iti | ṭhkarmapravacanīyāḥ'
ityadhikṛtasya dvivacanena vipariṇāma iti bhāvaḥ | varjane kim ?|
pariṣiñcati | sarvataḥ siñcatītyarthaḥ | atropasargatvāt
ṭhupasargātsunotī'ti ṣatvam | 
(588) āṅmaryādāvacane |1|4|89|
āṅmaryādāvacane | uktasaṃjña iti | karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ |
nanu ṭhāṅmaryādāyāmi'tyeva siddhe vacanagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityata
āha--vacanagrahaṇāditi | tena vineti maryādā | tena
sahetyabhividhiḥ | maryādāśabdo yatrocyate
tanmaryādāvacanamuṭhāṅmaryādābhividhyoḥ' iti sūtram | tatra ya
āṅ dṛṣṭaḥ sa karmapravacanīyasaṃjñakaḥ syādityarthaḥ | tathāca
maryādibhividhyorāṅ karmapravacanīya iti phalatīti bhāvaḥ | 
(589) pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ |2|3|10|
pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ | etairiti | apa āṅ pari-ityetairityarthaḥ |
karmapravacanīyairiti | ṭhkarmapravacanīyayukte' ityatastadanuvṛteriti
bhāvaḥ | apa hareḥ pari hareḥ saṃsāra iti | apahareḥ saṃsāraḥ,
parihareḥ saṃsāra ityanvayaḥ | hariṃ varjayitvā janimṛticakrātmakaṃ
saṃsaraṇamityarthaḥ | nanu ṭhvṛkṣaṃ prati vidyotate', ṭhbhakto hariṃ prati'
ityādau ṭhlakṣaṇetthaṃbhūte'ti karmapravacanīyatvāt
ṭhkarmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' iti dvitīyāṃ paratvādapavādatvācca
bādhitvā ṭhpañcamyapāṅparibhi'riti pañcamī syādityata
āha--pariratreti ṭhpañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' ityatra varjanārthakenā'pena
sāhacaryāt parirapi varjanārthakaṃ eva gṛhyata ityarthaḥ | ā mukteriti
| mukteḥ prāgiti yāvat | ā sakalāditi | brahma sakalamabhivyāpya
vartata ityarthaḥ | 
(590) pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ |1|4|92|
pratiḥ pratinidhi | sadṛśaḥ pratinidhiḥ, datasya pratiniryātanaṃ
pratidānam | uktasaṃjña iti | karmapravacanīyasaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ | 
(591) pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ |1|4|92|
pratinidhi | atreti sūtroktaviṣaye ityarthaḥ | sūtre yasmāditi
ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe pañcamī, asmādeva nirdeaśāt | ṭhkṛṣṇasya pratinidhiḥ' iti tu
ṭhjñāpakasiddhaṃ na sarvatre'ti samādheyam | tathāca yatsambandhinī
pratinidhipratidāne, tasmāt karmapravacanīyayuktātpañcamityarthaḥ
phalati | pradyaumnaḥ kṛṣṇātpratīti | yuddhādau pradyaumnaḥ
kṛṣṇanirūpitasādṛśyavānityarthaḥ | pañcamyarthaḥ sādṛśyam | pratistu
taddyotakaḥ | tilebhya iti | ṛṇatvena gṛhītān tilān svarūpeṇa
mūlyādyātmanā vā pratyarpayatītyarthaḥ | karmaṇi pañcamī |

(592) akartaryṛṇe pañcamī |2|3|24|
akartaryṛṇe | ṭhhetau' iti sūtramanuvartate | akartari hetubhūte
ṛṇe vidyamānādityarthaḥ | phalitamāha-kartṛvarjitamiti |
kartṛsaṃjñārahitamityarthaḥ | śatādbaddha iti | niyamitakāle
pratyarpaṇā'bhāve sati suvarṇādiśatena ṛṇena hetunā adharmaṇo baddha
ityarthaḥ | hetutṛtīyāpavādaḥ | śatena bandhita iti | ṭhadharmaṇa
utamarṇene'ti śeṣaḥ | bandherhetumaṇṇyantātkarmaṇi ktaḥ | adhamarṇa
utamarṇena baddha ityaṇyantasyārthaḥ | śatena ṛṇena prayojakakartrā
utamarṇena prayojyakartrā bandhanaṃ kārito'dharmaṇa iti ṇyantasyārthaḥ |
atra śatamṛṇaṃ prayojakatvāt kartṛsaṃjñaṃ hetusaṃjñe ca, ṭhtatprayojako
hetuśce'tyatra cakāreṇa kartṛsaṃjñāyā api vidhānāt | tataśca
śataśabdāt kartari tṛtīyāṃ bādhitvā'pavādatvātpañcamī syāt,
ato'kartarītyuktamiti bhāvaḥ | śatasya hetutve'pi kartṛtvānna tataḥ
pañacamīti bhāvaḥ | 
(593) vibhāṣā guṇe'striyām |2|3|25|
vibhāṣā | hetāvityanuvartate | tadāha--guṇe hetāvastrīliṅge
iti | ṭhvidyamānā'diti śeṣaḥ | jāḍaḷaditi | jaḍasya bhāvo jāḍaḷm |
ṭhguṇavacanabrāhmaṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ce'ti ṣyañ | nanu
dhūmādagnimānityādau kathaṃ pañcamī, dhūmāderaguṇatvādityata
āha--yogavibhāgāditi | ṭhvibhāṣā' iti yogo vibhajyate |
hetāvityanuvartate, pañcamīti ca | hetau pañcamī vā syādisyarthaḥ |
tataśca dhūmādagnimānityādi siddham | tataḥ-ṭhguṇe'striyā'miti |
tatra vibhāṣetyanuvartate pañcamīti ca | guṇe hetāvastrīliṅge
pañcamī vā syādityukto'rthaḥ | tataśca ṭhjāḍaḷadbaddha' ityādi siddham
| nanu vibhāṣetyeva siddhe guṇe'striyāmiti vyarthamityata
āha--aguṇe striyāṃ ca kvaciditi | yogavibhāgasya
iṣṭasiddhyarthatvāditi bhāvaḥ | atrā'guṇe udāharati--dhūmāditi |
ṭhagnimā'nityanantaraṃ'ṭhjñāyate' iti śeṣaḥ | dhūmasya
agnijñānahetutvādatra dhūmasya aguṇatve'pi hetutvātataḥ pañcamīti
bhāvaḥ | stirāyamudāharati--nāsti ghaṭa iti | ṭhghaṭa' ityanantaraṃ ṭhiti
jñāyate' iti śeṣaḥ | anupalabdherapi | upalabdhiḥujñānam, tasyā
abhāvaḥ-anupalabdhiḥ | nañtatpuruṣaḥ | na cārthā'bhāve'vyayībhāvaḥ
śaṅkyaḥ, arthā'bhāve tayorvikalpasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | 
(594) pṛthagvinānānābhistṛtīyā'nyatarasyām |2|3|32|
pṛthagvinā | pañcamīdvitīye ceti | ṭhtṛtīyā'bhāvapakṣe' iti śeṣaḥ |
ṭhapādāne pañcamī' ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthapratyayena' ṭhenapā dvitīyā'
ṭhpṛthagvinā' iti sūtrakramaḥ | tatra ṣaṣṭhītyasvaritatvānnānuvartate,
pañcamī dvitīyeti cānuvartate | tathāca tṛtīyā'bhāvapakṣe pañcamī
dvitīyā ceti bhāvaḥ | nanu tṛtīyā'bhāvapakṣe dvitīyaiva
saṃnihitatvāt syāt, natu pañcamyapi, ṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthetyatra
tadanuvṛterabhāvāt | ato'tra pañcamyāḥ samāveśo'nupapanna ityata
āha--anyatarasyāṅgrahaṇamiti | tṛtīyā cetyetābataiva
saṃnihitadvitīyāsamuccayasiddheranyatarasyāmiti guruyatnakaraṇaṃ
vyavahitāyā api pañcamyāḥ samuccayārtham,
avyayānāmanekārthakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu pañcamyāḥ
ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthe'tyatrānanuvṛtāyā ihānuvṛterasambhavātkathamiha
tadupasthitirityata āha--pañcamīdvitīye cānuvartete iti |
ṭhmaṇḍūakaplutye'ti śeṣaḥ | pṛthagrāmeṇeti |
rāmapratiyogikabhedavānityarthaḥ | evaṃ vinā nāneti | vinā
rāmeṇa, rāmāt, rāmam, | nānā rāmeṇa, rāmāt, rāmaṃ vā |
pṛthigvinānānāstrayo'pi bhedārthakā iti kecit |
ṭhpṛthagvināntareṇarte hiruṅnānā ca varjane' ityamaraḥ | rāmasya
varjane sukhaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | 
(595) karaṇe ca stokālpakṛcchrakatipayasyā'satvavacanasya |2|3|33|
karaṇe ca | ebhya iti | stoka alpa kṛcchra katipaya-ebhyaścaturbhya ityarthaḥ
| asatvapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe--adravyeti | anyatarasyāmityanuvartate,
pañcamīti ca | tataśca karaṇe pañcamī veti labhyate | tadabhāve tu
tṛtīyā siddhaiva | tadāha--tṛtīyāpañcamyāviti | stokena
stokādvāmukta iti | laghunā āyāsena mukta ityarthaḥ | āyāso na
dravyamiti bhāvaḥ | dravye tviti | dravye vṛtau stokena viṣeṇa hata
iti tṛtīyaivetyarthaḥ | alpenālpādvā muktaḥ, kṛcchreṇa kṛcchrādvā
muktaḥ | kaṣṭenetyarthaḥ | katipayena katipayādvā muktaḥ | akṛtsnena
sādhanenetyarthaḥ | 
(596) dūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā ca |2|3|35|
dūrāntika | ebhya iti | dūrārthakebhyo'ntikārthakebhyaścetyarthaḥ |
cakāro vyavahitayorapi pañcamītṛtīyayoḥ samuccayārthaḥ, natu
ṭhdūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷntarasyā'miti saṃnihitaṣaṣṭhaḷa api,
vyākhyānāt | tadāha--cātpañcamītṛtīye ceti |
prātipadikārthamātre vidhirayamiti | vyākhyānāditi bhāvaḥ | tathāca
prathamāpavāda iti phalitam | ṭhdūrādāvasathānmūtraṃ
dūrātpādāvanejanam' iti bhāṣyaprayogātsaptamyarthe'dhikaraṇe'pyayaṃ
vidhiḥ | nanu dūraḥ panthā ityatra kathaṃ na pañcamītyata
āha--asatvavacanasyeti | ṭhdūraḥ' ṭhpanthā' ityatra panthā dravyam |
tadviśeṣaṇaṃ dūraśabdaḥ satvavacana iti bhāvaḥ || iti pañcamī |
(597) ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe |2|3|50|
atha ṣaṣṭhī | ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe | uktādanyaḥ śeṣaḥ | ṭhkarmaṇi dvitīyā'
ityādisūtreṣu dvitīyādividhiṣu hi
karmakartṛkaraṇasaṃpradānāpādānādhikaraṇakārakāṇyanukrāntāni |
prathamāvidhau prātipadikārtho'nukrāntaḥ | etebhyo'nyaḥ
svasvāmibhāvādisaṃbandhaḥ śeṣapadārtha ityarthaḥ | tatrā'sati bādhake
saṃbandho viśeṣarūpeṇa sāmānyarūpeṇa ca bhāsate, ṭhna hi nirviśeṣaṃ
sāmānyami'ti nyāyāt | sati tu bādhake ṭhmātuḥ smaratī'tyādau
saṃbandhatvenaiva bhānam | karmatvādiviśeṣarūpeṇāpi bhāne
dvitīyādiprasaṅgāditi sthitiḥ | ṭhrājña puruṣa' ityatra
svasvāmibhāvarūpaviśeṣātmanā saṃbandhatvarūpasāmānyātmanā ca saṃbandhaḥ
ṣaṣṭhaḷrthaḥ | rājāśritasvāmitnirūpitasvatvātmakasaṃbandhāśrayaḥ puruṣa
iti bodhaḥ | āśrayatvādi tu saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsate | tatra puruṣo
mukhyaṃ viśeṣyam | saṃbandhastvādheyatayā puruṣaviśeṣaṇam | rājā
tu āśrayatayā saṃbandhaviśeṣaṇam | saṃbandhastvādheyatayā rājānaṃ prati
viśeṣyaṃ, ṭhpradhānapratyayārthavacanami'ti vacanena pratyayārthasya
prakṛtyarthaṃ prati prādhānyāvagamāt | ata eva puruṣaśabdādapi na ṣaṣṭhī,
rājanirūpitasaṃbandhāśrayaḥ puruṣa iti bodhe saṃbandhasya
prakṛtyarthapuruṣaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvena viśeṣyatvena ca bhānānupapateḥ
| yadā tu puruṣagatasvatvanirūpitasvāmityarūpasaṃbandhāśrayo rājeti
bodhaḥ, tadā puruṣasya rājeti puruṣaśabdāt ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyevetyanyatra
vistaraḥ | satāṃ gatamityādau
kartṛtṛtīyādikamāśaṅkyāha--karmādīnāmapīti |
karmatvakartṛtvādīnāmapi saṃbandhatvasāmānyātmanā vivakṣāyāṃ
ṣaṣṭhaḷeva, natu kārakavibhaktaya ityarthaḥ | tathāca ṭhktasya ca vartamāne'
iti sūtre bhāṣyaṃ--ṭhkarmatvādīnāmavivakṣā śeṣaḥ' iti | satāṃgatamiti
| bhāve ktaḥ | satsaṃbandhi gamanamityarthaḥ | kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ tu
sadbhirgatamiti tṛtīyā bhavatyeva | kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī tu na
bhavati, ṭhna loke'ti niṣedhāt | sarpiṣo jānīte iti |
karaṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ sarpiṣā upāyena pravartate ityarthaḥ | karaṇatvasya
saṃbandhatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhī, kartrāśritā sarpiḥsambandhinī
pravṛtiriti bodhaḥ | mātuḥ smaratīti | karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ mātaraṃ
smaratītyarthaḥ | karmatvasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu devadatakartṛkaṃ
mātṛsambandhi smaraṇamityarthaḥ | edho dakasyopaskurute iti |
edhaśabdo'kārāntaḥ puṃliṅgaḥ, ṭhkārake' iti sūtre ṭhedhāḥ pakṣyante'
iti bhāṣyaprayogāt | edhāśca udakāni ceti dvandvāt ṣaṣṭhī |
ṭhjātiraprāṇinā'mityekadbhāvaḥ | karmatvavivakṣāyāṃ edodakaṃ
śoṣaṇagandhadravyādhānādinā pariṣkurute ityarthaḥ | karmatvasya
śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu edhodakasambandhi pariṣkaraṇamiti bodhaḥ |
edhaśśabdaḥ sakārānto'pyasti napuṃsakaliṅgaḥ | ṭhkāṣṭhṃa dārvindhanaṃ
tvedha idhmamedhaḥ samit striyām' iti kośāt | ṭhyathaidhāṃsi
samiddho'gniḥ' ityādidarśanācca | tathā sati ṭhedhaḥ-dakasye'ticchedaḥ |
udakaśabdasamāveśe edha udakasyetyāpateḥ | udakaśabdaparyāyo
dakaśabdo'pyasti, ṭhbhuvanamamṛtaṃ jīvanaṃ syāddakaṃ ca' iti
halāyudhakośāt | tathāca edhaḥ kartṛ udakaṃ pariṣkurute ityarthaḥ |
karmatvasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhī,
nimbakarañjādikāṣṭhaviśeṣaprajvalitāgnitaptodakasya guṇaviśeṣo
vaidyaśāstraprasiddhaḥ | bhaje śambhoścaraṇayoriti | atra caraṇayoḥ
karmatvasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī | śambhucaraṇasaṃbandhi
bhajanamityarthaḥ | phalānāṃ tṛpta iti | atrāpi karaṇatvasya
śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī | phalasaṃbandhinī tṛptiriti bodhaḥ |

(599) sarvanāmnastṛtīyā ca |2|3|27|

(600) ṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthapratyayena |2|3|30|
ṣaṣṭhaḷtasartha | etadyoge iti | ṭhdikśabdebhyaḥ
saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyodigdeśakāleṣvastātiḥ' ityārabhya ṭhāhi ca
dūre' ṭhutarācce'tyantaiḥ sūtrairdigdeśakālavṛtibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ svārthe
pratyayā vihitāḥ | tatra ṭhdakṣiṇotarābhyāmatasuc' iti vihito
yo'tasucpratyayaḥ, tasyārthaḥudigdeśakālarūpaḥ, sa evārtho yasya
sa-atasarthapratyayaḥ, tadyoge ityarthaḥ | yadyapyatasarthapratyayeṣu astātireva
prathamasthāpi lāghavādatasarthetyuktam, na tvastātyartheti,
saṃyuktākṣaraghayitatvena gauravāt | dikśabdetīti | ṭhanyārādi'ti
sūtre dikśabdetyanena yā pañcamī vihitā tadapavāda ityarthaḥ |
dakṣiṇata iti | saptamīpañcamīprathamāntāt svārthe
digdeśakālavṛterdakṣiṇaśabdādatasuc | dakṣiṇasyāṃ, dakṣiṇasyāḥ,
dakṣiṇā vā digityarthaḥ | evaṃ deśe kāle ca | pura iti |
pūrvāśabdādastātyartheṭhpūrvādharāvarāṇāmasi puradhavaścaiṣām'
ityasipratyayaḥ prakṛteḥ purādeśaśca | pūrvasyāṃ, pūrvasyāḥ, pūrvā
vetyarthaḥ | purastāditi | pūrvaśabdādastātipratyaye sati ṭhāstāti
ce'ti prakṛteḥ purādeśaḥ | puraśśabdasamānārthakamidam | uparīti |
ṭhuparyupariṣṭādi'ti sūtreṇa ūrdhvaśabdādrilpratyayo

ūrdhvāyā diśaḥ, ūrdhvādigiti vā arthaḥ | evaṃ deśe kāle'pi |
(601) enapā dvitīyā |2|3|31|
enapā dvitīyā | ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthe'ti ṣaṣṭhaḷa nitya bādhe prāpte
āha--yogavibhāgāditi | enapeti yogo vibhajyate |
ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthe'ti pūrvasūtrātṣaṣṭhītyanuvartate | enabantenayoge
ṣaṣṭhī syādityarthaḥ | dvitīyeti yogāntaram | enapetyanuvartate |
enabantena yoge dvitīyā syādityukto'rthaḥ | dakṣiṇeneti |
ṭhenabanyatarasyāmadūre'pañcamyāḥ' ityenap | evamutareṇeti | utareṇa
grāmaṃ grāmasya vetyudāharaṇamityarthaḥ | pūrveṇa grāmaṃ grāmasya
vetyādyapi bodhyacam, dikśabdebhyaḥ enabvidheḥ | bhāṣye tu
ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷtasarthe'ti sūtrātprāk ṭhenapā dvitīyā' ityasya pāṭha iti
ṭhpṛthagvinā' iti sūtre uktam | ato'tra satyapi yogavibhāge
ṣaṣṭhīgrahaṇānuvṛterasaṃbhavādenapāyoge ṣaṣṭhaḷsādhureveti yuktam

(603) jño'vidarthasya karaṇe |2|3|51|

| śeṣa ityanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ | sarpiṣo jñānamiti | vastutaḥ

(605) kṛñaḥ pratiyatne |2|3|53|

(606) rujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāmajvareḥ |2|3|54|
rujārthānām | rujā pīḍā roga ityartho yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ |
bhāvavacanānāmityetadvyācaṣṭe--bhāvakartṛkāṇāmiti | vaktīti
vacanaḥ, kartari lyuṭ | prakṛtyarthau na vivakṣitaḥ | bhāvoudhātvartho,
vacanaḥukartā yeṣāmiti vigrahaḥ | bhāvakartṛkāṇāmiti phalitamiti
bhāṣye spaṣṭam | śeṣa iti karmaṇīti cānuvartate | tadāha--karmaṇi
śeṣa iti | idamapi samāsā'bhāvārthameva | caurasya rogasya rujeti |
atra rujeti vyādhikṛtasantāpādipīḍocyate | rogaścauraṃ
saṃtāpādinā pīḍayatīti paryavasanno'rthaḥ . rogakartṛkā
vastutaḥkarmībhūtacauragatā santāpādipīḍetyarthaḥ | atra bhāvaghañantena
rogaśabdena śārīrakṣayādivikāraviśeṣo vivakṣitaḥ | saca rujāyāṃ
kartā | tatkarmaścaurasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī | ṭhrogasya
coraruje'ti samāso na bhavatīti bodhyam | 
(|) ajvarisaṃtāpyoriti vācyam | 
ajvarisaṃtāpyoriti | ṭhrujārthānāṃ bhāvavacanānāṃ
jvarisaṃtāpivarjitānā'miti sūtraṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ | rogasya
caurajvara iti | atra caurajvaraśabde śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷa samāso bhavatyeva,
śeṣaṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ punarvidhyabhāvāt | evaṃ ṭhrogasya caurasaṃtāpa'
ityatrāpi bodhyam | atrā'jvarisaṃtāpyorityanuktau tu rujārthānāṃ
bhāvavacanānāṃ karmaṇi śeṣe cauraśabdātṣaṣṭhī syādityativyāptiṃ
darśayitumāha--rogakartṛkamiti | rogakartṛko
vastutaḥkarmībhūtacaurasaṃbandhī jvaraḥ saṃtāpo veti yāvat | evaṃca
jvarisaṃtāpyoḥ rujārthakatvādrogātmakabhāvakartṛkatvācca
tatkarmaṇaścaurasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ nā'nena ṣaṣṭhī, kintu kṛdyoge

(608) jāsiniprahaṇanāṭakrāthapiṣāṃ hiṃsāyām |2|3|56|
jāsinipra | karmaṇi śeṣe ityanuvartate |
tadāha--hiṃsārthānāmityādinā | idamapi samāsā'bhāvārthameva |
caurasyojjāsanamiti | ṭhjasu tāḍane' ṭhjasu hisāyām' iti
curādau | vastutaḥ karmībhūtacaurasaṃbandhinī hiṃsetyarthaḥ | ṭhjasu
mokṣaṇe' iti daivādikasya tu na grahaṇam, hiṃsārthatvā'bhāvāt,
jāsīti nirdeaśācca | niprāviti | niprahaṇeti niprapūrvasya
hanadhātornideśaḥ | tatra ni pra ityetau samastau gṛhyaete, pranītyevaṃ
vyukrameṇa ca gṛhyaete, preti nīti ca pṛthagapi gṛhyaete,
vyākhyānādityarthaḥ | samastāvudāharati--caurasya niprahaṇanamiti |
vastutaḥkarmībhūtacaurasaṃbandhi hananamityarthaḥ | ṭhhanteratpūrvasye'ti

niyamāt, nernakārasya tadanantarbhāvāt |
vyastāvudāharati--nihananaṃ prahaṇamanaṃ veti |
nimitā'bhāvānnihananamityatra ṭhbanteratpūrvasya' iti ṇatvaṃ na |
curādiriti | ṭhnaṭa nṛtau' iti tu na gṛhyate, nāṭeti
dīrghoccāraṇāditi bhāvaḥ | caurasyonnāṭanamiti |
upasargavaśānnāṭerhisāyāṃ vṛtiriti bhāvaḥ | caurasya krāthanamiti |
ṭhkratha hiṃsāyām' iti ghaṭādau | ṭhghaṭādayo mitaḥ' iti tasya
mitve'pi ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti na bhavati, iha dīrghanipātanāt |
vṛṣalasya peṣaṇamiti | hisetyarthaḥ | vyapahṛpaṇoḥ | śeṣapūraṇena
sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe--śeṣe karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī syāditi | samau tulyau arthau
yayoriti vigrahaḥ | śakandhvāditvātpararūpam | ekārthakasya
vyavapūrvakahṛñdhātoḥ paṇadhātośca karmaṇi śeṣatvena vivakṣite
ṣaṣṭhī syādityarthaḥ | idamapi samāsanivṛtyarthameva | nanu ṭhpaṇa
vyavahāre stutau ce'ti paṇadhātuḥ stutāvapi vartate, natu
vyavahāra eva, tatkathamanayorekārthakatvamityata āha--dyate iti |
dyaūteuakṣaiḥ krīḍane, krayavikrayaviṣayakamūlyasaṃvāde
cānayoḥuvyavahṛpaṇorekārthakatvamityarthaḥ | tathāca
etādṛśavyavahārārthakayoriti phalatīti bhāvaḥ | śatasya vyavaharaṇaṃ
paṇanaṃ veti | dyaūtavyavahāreṇa krayavikrayavyavahāreṇa vā
gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ | kevalavyavahārārthakatve'karmakatvāpātāt | tathāca
vastutaḥ karmībhūtaśatasaṃbandhi akṣakrīḍanena grahaṇaṃ,
krayavikrayaviṣayakamūlyasaṃvādena grahaṇaṃ vetyarthaḥ | 
(609) vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ |2|3|57|

(610) divastadarthasya |2|3|58|
divastadarthasya pūrvasūtre nirdiṣṭavyavahṛpaṇau taccchabdena
parāmṛśyete | tayoḥuvyavahṛpaṇorartha evārtho yasyeti vigrahaḥ |
tadāha--dyaūtārthasyeti | dyaūtamakṣakrīḍanena grahaṇamartho yasya diva iti
vigrahaḥ | krayeti | krayavikrayaviṣayakamūlyasaṃvādo'rtho yasyadiva iti
bahuvrīhiḥ | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīti | iha śeṣa iti nānuvartate,
vyākhyānāditi bhāvaḥ | tathāca karmaṇaḥ śeṣatvavivakṣā'bhāvāt ṭhṣaṣṭhī
śeṣe' ityaprāptau idaṃ vacanam, natu kṛdantayoge
samāsanivṛtyartham | taddhvanayannudāharati--śatasya dīvyatīti |
śatamakṣakrīḍanena, krayavikrayaviṣayakamūlyasaṃvādena vā gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ
| atra śeṣa ityananuvṛteḥ karmatvaprakāraka eva bodhaḥ | ata eva ṭhdvitīyā
brāhmaṇe' ityutarasūtre ṭhgāmasya tadahaḥ sabhāyāṃ dīvyeyuḥ' ityatra
nityaṣaṣṭhīprāptau dvitīyārtha'mityuktaṃ bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ saṅgaccchata
ityanyatra vistaraḥ |

(612) preṣyabruvorhaviṣo devatāsaṃpradāne |2|3|59|

haviŚvaśeṣavācakaśabdaparaḥ , vyākhyānāt | tathāca

(614) kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti |2|3|65|
kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti | kṛtpratyaye prayujyamāne satītyarthaḥ |
phalitamāha--kṛdyoga iti | tatra kartaryu dāharati--kṛṣṇasya kṛtiriti
| bhāve striyāṃ ktin | kṛṣṇakratṛkā sṛṣṭirityarthaḥ |
karmaṇyudāharati-jagata iti |
jagatkarmakasṛṣṭaḷnukūlavyāpāravānityarthaḥ | guṇakarmaṇīti |
kṛdantadvikarmakadhātuyoge'pradhānakarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhīvikalpa iṣyata ityarthaḥ
| pradhānakarmaṇi tu nityaiva ṣaṣṭhī | ṭhakathitaṃ ce'tyatra bhāṣye
sthitametat | netā'śvasyeti | ṭhakathitaṃ ce'tyatra ṭhgrāmamajāṃ
nayatī'tyudāharaṇe ajā pradānaṃ karma, grāmastu guṇakarmeti prapañcitaṃ
prāk | tadrītyā atra aśvaḥ pradhānakarma, srughnastu guṇakrameti jñeyam |
syādetat--kṛtīti vyartham | naca tiṅvyāvṛtyarthaṃ taditi
vācyam, ṭhodanaṃ pacatī'tyādau ṭhna loke'ti lādeśayoge
ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhādeva ṣaṣṭhaḷbhāvasiddheḥ | ṭhśatena krītaḥ śatyo'śvaḥ'
ityādau tu taddhitayapratyayābhihitatvādevā'śvādeḥ ṣaṣṭhī na bhaviṣyati
| na ca devadataṃ hirugityādau hirugādyavyayabodhyavarjanādikriyāṃ
prati karmaṃtvādanena ṣaṣṭhī śaṅkyā, ṭhna lokāvyaye'ti tanniṣedhāt |
śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu ṣaṣṭhaḷtra iṣyata eva | evañca pariśeṣa#atkṛdyoga
eveyaṃ ṣaṣṭhī paryavasyatīti kiṃ kṛdgrahaṇeneti pṛccchati--kṛti
kimiti | utaramāha--taddhite iti | taddhitayoge ṣaṣṭhīnivṛtyarthamiti
yāvat | kṛtapūrvī kaṭamiti | kaṭaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛto'neneti

(615) ubhayaprāptau karmaṇi |2|3|66|

ityarthaḥ | ubhayoḥ prāptāviti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāśrayaṇe tu odanasya pāko
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca prādurbhāva ityatrāpi karmaṇyeva ṣaṣṭhī syānna tu kartari

nimitatvalābhādbhinnakriyānirūpitakartṛkarmaṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhīprāptau nāyaṃ
niyama iti phalati |

athopapadavibhaktayaḥ | tulyārthaiḥ | śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷaṃ nityaṃ prāptāyāṃ
tṛtīyāvikalpoyam | tulyairiti bahuvacanādeva paryāyagrahaṇe
siddhe'rthagrahaṇaṃ padāntaranirapekṣaścetulyārthasteṣāṃ grahaṇārtham |
tena ṭhgauriva gavaya' ityādau netyāhuḥ | atulopamābhyāmiti
paryudāsādanavyayayoga evedamityanye | 
(622) caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyamadrabhadrakuśalasukhārthahitaiḥ |2|3|73|
caturthī ca | etadarthairiti | āyuṣya, madra bhadra, kuśala, sukha, artha,
hita-etadarthakairityarthaḥ | pakṣe ṣaṣṭhīti | cakāreṇa
tatsamuccāyāvagamāditi bhāvaḥ | āyuṣyaparyāyaścirañjīvitamiti |
kuśalaṃ nirāmayamiti madrabhadraparyāyau | śamiti sukhaparyāyaḥ |
prayojanamityarthaparyāyaḥ | pathyamiti hitaparyāyaḥ | ṭhhitayoge
ce'ti nityacaturthī tu nāśiṣi jñeyā | nanu ṭhsvaṃ rūpami'ti
paribhāṣayā āyuṣyādiśabdānāmeva grahaṇamucitamityata
āha--vyākhyānāditi | nanu madrabhadrayoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇādetadarthairiti
vyākhyānamayuktamityata āha--madrabhadrayoriti | iti ṣaṣṭhī | 
(623) ādhāro'dhikaraṇam |1|4|45|
ādhāro'dhikaraṇaṃ | ṭhkārake' ityadhikṛtaṃ prathamāntatayā
vipariṇamyate, tacca ādhārasya viśeṣaṇam, ādhāraḥ
kārakamadhikaraṇamiti labhyate | kriyānvayi kārakam | evañca
kasyādhāra ityākāṅkṣāyām upasthitatvātkriyāyā iti labhyate | kriyā
ca kartṛkarmagatā vivakṣitā | tadādhāratvaṃ ca na sākṣāt, kiṃtu
kartṛkarmadvāraiva, vyākhyānāt | tadāha--kartṛkarmadvāreti |
tanniṣṭheti | kartṛkarmaniṣṭhetyarthaḥ | 
(624) saptamyadhikaraṇe ca |2|3|36|
saptamyadhikaraṇe ca | cakārāddṭareti | ṭhdūrāntikārthebhyo dvitīyā
ce'ti pūrvasūtrāt ṭhdūrāntikārthebhyaḥ' ityasya
cakāreṇānukarṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | āṬpaśleṣika iti |
upaśleṣaḥusaṃyogādisaṃbandhaḥ, tatprayojya ādhāraḥ prathama ityarthaḥ |
vaiṣayika iti | viṣayatāsaṃbandhakṛta ādhāro dvitīya ityarthaḥ |
abhivyāpaka iti | sakalāvayavavyāptikṛta ādhārastṛtīya ityarthaḥ | tatra
āṬpaśleṣikaṃ kartṛdvārakamādhāramudāharati--kaṭe āste iti |
ṭhdevadataḥ' iti śeṣaḥ | tatra sākṣāddevadatātmakakartṛgatāmāsanakriyāṃ
prati kaṭasya saṃyogasambandhaṃ puraskṛtya devadatadvārā
tadādhāratvādadhikaraṇatvam | atha
karmadvārakamaupaśleṣikamādhāramudāharati-sthālyāṃ pacatīti |
ṭhtaṇḍulā'niti śeṣaḥ | atra sākṣātaṇḍulātmakakarmagatāṃ pākakriyāṃ
prati sthālyāḥ saṃyogasambandhaṃ puraskṛtya taṇḍuladvārā
ādhāratvādadhikaraṇatvam | rūpe rūpatvamasti, śarīre
ceṣṭāstītyādau samavāyena āṬpaśleṣikamādhāratvamityādi jñeyam |
atha vaiṣayikamādhāramudāharati--mokṣe icchāstīti | atra
kartṛbhūtecchāgatāṃ satākriyāṃ prati mokṣasya
viṣayatāsambandhapuraskāreṇa icchādvārā''dhāratvādadhikaraṇatvam |
athā'bhivyāpakamādhāramudāharati--sarvasminnātmāstīti | atra
ātmarūpakartṛgatāṃ satākriyāṃ prati kṛtsnavyāptiṃ puraskṛtya
ātmadvārā satādhāratvātsarvasyādhikaraṇatvam | atha
cakārānukṛṣṭadūrāntikārthebhya udāharati--vanasya dūre antike
veti | dūramantikamityarthaḥ | prātipadikārthamātre vidhirayam |
vibhaktitrayeṇeti | dvitīyāpañcamītṛtīyābhirityarthaḥ | vastutastu
upa samīpe śleṣaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tatkṛtamaupaśleṣikamiti vyutpatyā
sāmīpikamevādhāratvamaupaśleṣikam | ata eva ṭhadhikaraṇaṃ nāma
triprakāraṃ, vyāpakamopaśleṣikaṃ vaiṣayikamiti | śabdasya tu śabdena
ko'nyo'bhisaṃbandho bhavitumarhati anyadata upaśleṣāt | ṭhiko
yaṇaci' acyupaśliṣṭasye'ti ṭhsaṃhitāyām' ityatra bhāṣyaṃ saṅgaccchate
| acyupaśliṣṭasyauacsamīpoccāritasyetyartha iti kaiyaṭaḥ | ata eva
māse'tikrānte dīyata ityatra māsa āṬpaśleṣikamadhikaraṇamiti ṭhtatra ca
dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat' ityatra bhāṣyaṃ saṅgaccchate | ata eva ca
ṭhtadasminnadhikamiti daśāntāḍḍaḥ' ityatra ekādaśa bhāṣā adhika asmin
kārṣāpaṇaśate ityatrādhikānāṃ ekādaśānāṃ kathaṃ
śatasradhikaraṇamityākṣipya
vyāpakavaiṣayikādhikaraṇasaṃbhavādaupaśleṣikamadhikaraṇaṃ vijñāyata iti
bhāṣyaṃ saṅgaccchate | evaṃca ṭhkaṭe āste' ityādau
āṬpaśleṣikādhārodāharaṇaṃ mūloktamanupapannameva,
uktabhāṣyavirodhāt | evaṃca ṭhkaṭe āste' ityādau ekadeśavyāptyā
gauṇamabhivyāpakādhāratvam | sarvāvayavavyāptikṛtādhikaraṇatvameva
mukhyam, vaiṣayikamaupaśleṣikaṃ ca gauṇamityarthasya
bhāṣyasaṃmatatvāt | ata eva ṭhsvaritenādhikāraḥ' iti sūtre
ṭhsādhakatamaṃ karaṇa'miti sūtre ca bhāṣye ṭhadhikaraṇamācāryaḥ kiṃ
manyate ?| yatra kṛtsnamādhārātmā vyāpto bhavati | tarhi ihaiva saptamī
syāt-tileṣutailaṃ, dadhnisarpiriti | gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ, kūpe
gargakulamityatra tu na syāt, mukhya eva kāryasaṃpratyayā'dityāśaṅkya
svaritenādhikaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti vacanātamabgrahaṇācca na doṣa iti
samāhitam | evaṃca ṭhkaṭe āste, gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ' ityādau
gauṇamapyadhikaraṇaṃ saptamyarthaṃ eva | yadi tu ṭhgaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ'
ityādau sāmīpikamadhikaraṇatvaṃ na vivakṣyate tadā lakṣaṇeti bodhyam
| vistarastu śabdenduśekhare draṣṭavyaḥ | ktasyenviṣayasyeti | na ca
ṭhkṛtapūrvī kaṭa'mityatrāpi saptamī śaṅkyā, inpratyayānto yaḥ
ktapratyayāntastasya karmaṇītyarthābhyupagamāt | kartarīniriti |
bhāvaktāntādadhītaśabdāt kartarīnipratyaye kṛte
adhītītyasyādhītavānityarthaḥ paryavasyati | kim adhītavāniti
karmaviśeṣajijñāsāyāṃ vyākaraṇamadhyayane karmatvenānveti | tacca
vyākaraṇakarmatvaṃ na kenāpyabhihitamiti kṛtapūrvī kaṭamitivat
dvitīyāyāṃ prāptāyāmanena saptamīti bhāvaḥ |
(|) sādhvasādhuprayoge ca |
sādhvasādhuprayoge ceti | ṭhsaptamī vaktavye'ti śeṣaḥ | sādhuriti |
hitakārītyarthaḥ | asādhuriti | ahitakārītyarthaḥ | ubhayatra
śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷpavādaḥ | ṭhsādhunipuṇābyāmarcāyā'mityeva siddhe iha
sādhugrahaṇamanarcārtham | yathā sādhurmṛtyo rājani | iha tatvakathane
tātparyam | sādhunipuṇābhyāmityatra sādhugrahaṇamasya prayojanaṃ
vakṣyate | 
(|) nimitātkarmayoge |
nimitāditi | karmayoge hetuvācakāccchabdāt saptamī vācyetyarthaḥ
| nanu ṭhjāḍaḷena baddha' ityatrāpi saptamī syādityata āha--nimitamiha
phalamiti | phalamevetyarthaḥ | iṣṭasādhanatājñānasya pravartakatayā
phalasyāpi hetutvaṃ bodhyam | janyajankatvādisaṃbandhaṃ
vyāvartayitumāha--yogaḥ saṃyogeti | ayutasiddhayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ
samavāyaḥ | anyayostu saṃyogaḥ | carmaṇīti | carmārthaṃ vyāghraṃ
hantītyarthaḥ | atra dvīpinā karmaṇā carmaṇaḥ samavāya eva,
avayavāvayavinorayutasiddhatvāt | dantayoriti | dantārthamityarthaḥ
| atra kuñjareṇa karmaṇā dantayoḥ samavāya eva | keśeṣviti |
keśārthamityarthaḥ | camarī-mṛgaviśeṣaḥ | sīmnīti | sīmārthamityarthaḥ
| hetutṛtīyā prāpteti | tādarthyacaturthyapīti bodhyam | sīmā
aṇḍakośa iti | ṭhsīmā ghaṭṭasthitikṣetreśvaṇḍakośeṣu ca striyām'
iti medinī | puṣkalako gandhamṛga iti | ṭhatha puṣkalako gandhamṛge
kṣapaṇakīlayoḥ' iti medinī | atrāpi puṣkalakena karmaṇā sīmnaḥ
samavāya eva | haradatastu-sīmā grāmādimaryādā, tasyā jñānārthaṃ
puṣkalakaḥuśaṅkurhataḥunikhāta iti vyācaṣṭa | atra puṣkalakena kamaṇā
sīmnaḥ saṃyogo bodhyaḥ | vetaneneti | atra vetanaṃ bhṛtidravyam,
tadarthamityarthaḥ | atra vetanasya lūyamānasya dhānyasya ca tādarthyameva
saṃbandho, na tu saṃyogaḥ, nāpi samavāya iti bhāvaḥ | 
(625) yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam |2|3|37|
yasya ca | bhāvaśabdau kriyāparyāyāvityabhipretya vyācaṣṭe--yasya
kriyayeti | kriyā ca kartrāśrayā karmāśrayā ca | tatra
karmāśrayāmudāharati--goṣviti | devadataḥ kadā gata iti praśne
utaramidam | atra lakṣakatva saṃbandhe saptamī | śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷpavādaḥ |
vartamānadohanaviśiṣṭābhirgobhirjñāpyagamanavānityarthaḥ | atra
dohanakriyāyāḥ sākṣāllakṣakatā | gavāṃ tu tadāśrayatayā | tataśca
godohanadaśāyāṃ gata ityutaraṃ paryavasyati | ṭhdugdhāsu gata' ityatra
tu atītadohanaviśiṣṭābhirgobhirjñāpyamānagamanavānityarthaḥ |
godohotarakāle gata iti phalitam | kartṛgatakriyāyāstu
brāhmaṇeṣvadhīyāneṣu hagata ityudāhāryam | atra yadavaśyaṃ punaḥ
punarlakṣyajñāpakaṃ tadeva na lakṣaṇam | kiṃtu sakṛjjñāpakamapi |
yathā-yaṃ kamaṇlupāṇiṃ bhavānadrīkṣītsa chātra iti | yadyapi sakṛdasau
kamaṇḍalupāṇirdṛṣṭastathāpi tasya kamaṇḍalurlakṣaṇaṃ bhavatyeveti
prakṛtasūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam | ṭhudite āditye juhotī'tyatra tu
sāmīpikamadhikaraṇatvaṃ saptamyarthaḥ | uditādityasamīpakāla ityarthaḥ |
ādityodayotarasamīpakāla iti paryavasanno'rthaḥ | ṭhuparāge
srāyāt' ityatra tu uparāgapadena uparāgāśrayakālo lakṣyata
ityadhikaraṇasaptamyevetyanyatra vistaraḥ |
(626) ṣaṣṭhī cā'nādare |2|3|38|
ṣaṣṭhī cānādare | cātasaptamītyanukṛṣyate | anādare iti
viṣayasaptamī | yasya ceti pūrvasūtramanuvartate | anādare gamyamāne
sati yasya kriyayā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣyate tataḥ ṣaṣṭhī saptamī cetyarthaḥ |
phalitamāha--anādarādhikye iti | anādaro'dhiko yasmāditi vigrahaḥ
| rudati rudata iti | ṭhkadā saṃnyastavā'niti praśne utaramidam | atra
lakṣakatvaṃ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyorarthaḥ | anādaraviśiṣṭaṃ pravrajanaṃ dhātvarthaḥ |
ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyau tātparyagrāhike | anādaraśca
lakṣakakriyāśrayaputrādiviṣayaḥ |
vartamānarodanakriyāviśiṣṭaputrādijñāpyamanādaraviśiṣṭaṃ
pravrajanamityarthaḥ |
(627) svāmīśvarādhipatidāyādasākṣipratibhūprasūtaiśca |2|3|39|
phalitamāha--rudantaṃ putrādikamiti | svāmīśvara | ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyāviti
| cakāreṇa tadubhayānukarṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷṬva siddhe
kimarthamiha ṣaṣṭhīvidhānamityata āha--ṣaṣṭhaḷameveti | gavāṃ goṣu
veti | gosaṃbandhītyarthaḥ | gavāṃ goṣu vā īśvaraḥ | gavāṃ goṣu vā
adhipatiḥ | gavā goṣu vā dāyādaḥ | putrādibhirgrahītuṃ yogyaḥ
pitrādyarjitadhanāṃśo dāyaḥ | tamādata iti dāyādaḥ | ṭhāto'nupasarge'
iti kavidhau anupasargagrahaṇe satyapi ata eva nipātanātkaḥ |
gosaṃbandhidāyāda ityarthaḥ | gavāṃ ca dāye anvayaḥ
nityasākāṅkṣatvādvṛtiḥ | gavātmakasyāṃśasya ādāteti phalito'rthaḥ
| ṭhyasmādadhikam' iti sūtrabhāṣye tu dāyādaśabda svāmiparyāya iti
sthitam | gavāṃ goṣu vā prasūta iti | gosaṃbandhītyarthaḥ |
saṃbandhaśca bhoktṛtvarūpaḥ | tadāha--gā eveti |
evaśabdānmahiṣādivyāvṛtiḥ |
(628) āyuktakuśalābhyāṃ cā''sevāyām |2|3|40|

(629) yataśca nirdhāraṇam |2|3|41|
yataśca nirdhāraṇam | jātiguṇeti | ṭhyataḥ' iti ṭhtataḥ' iti ca
pañcamyarthe tasiḥ | yasmātsamudāyādekadeśasya
jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñābhiḥ
pṛthakkaraṇaṃusvetaravyāvṛtadharmaviśeṣavatvabodhanaṃ
nirdhāraṇaśabdavācyaṃ gamyate tasmātṣaṣṭhīsaptamyāvityarthaḥ | atra
svaśabdena ekadeśa ucyate | tatra jātyā pṛthakkaraṇamudāharati--nṛṇā
nṛṣu veti | nṛśabdo manuṣyasamudāye vartate |
udbhūtāvayavabhedavivakṣāyāṃ bahuvacanam | dvija iti tu
jātyabhiprāyamekavacanam | ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyoravayavāvayavibhāvaḥ
saṃbandho'rthaḥ, udāhṛtanirdhāraṇaviṣayatvarūpaśca | tataśca
manuṣyasamudāyaikadeśabhūto dvijaḥ svetaravyāvṛtaśraiṣṭhaḷrūpadharmaka
ityarthaḥ | guṇena pṛthakkaraṇamudāharati--gavāṃ goṣuveti |
gosamudāyaikadeśabhūtā kṛṣṇā gauḥ
svetaravyāvṛtabahukṣīratvarūpadharmiketyarthaḥ | kriyayā
pṛthakkaraṇamudāharati--gaccchatāṃ gaccchatsu veti |
gaccchatsamudāyaikadeśabhūto dhāvansvetaravyāvṛtaśaighryadharmaka ityarthaḥ |
saṃjñayā pṛthakkaraṇamudāharati--chātrāṇāmiti |
chātrasamudāyaikadeśabhūto maitranāmā svetaravyāvṛtapaṭuatvadharmaka
ityarthaḥ |
(630) pañcamī vibhakte |2|3|42|
pañcamī vibhakte | vibhāgo vibhaktimiti | bhāve ktapratyayāśrayaṇāditi
bhāvaḥ | ṭhyataścanirdhāraṇa'mityanuvartate | nirdhāraṇāvadhibhūtānāṃ

viśeṣātmanā bhedaśca sthitaḥ | evaṃ ca nirdhāraṇe sarvatra
kathaṃcidbhedasya satvādvibhakta ityanena bheda evetyartho vivakṣitaḥ |
tataśca yatra nirdhāraṇāvadhernirdhāryamāṇasya ca bheda eva, na tu
kenāpyupātarūpeṇā'bhedastatraivāsya
pravṛtirityabhipretyāha--nirdhāryamāṇasyeti | ṭhnirdhāraṇāvadhe'riti
śeṣaḥ, ṭhyataśca nirdhāraṇa'mityanuvṛteḥ |
atrāvadhivyavṛtadharmavatvabodhanameva , na tu
samudāyādekadeśasyetyaṃśo vivakṣitaḥ,
asambhavādityabhipretyodāharati--māthurā iti | avadhitvaṃ pañcamyarthaṃ
mathurādeśīyāḥ pāṭalīputradeśīyāpekṣayā atiśayenāḍhya dhanina
ityarthaḥ | atra
mathurādeśīyatvapāṭalīputradeśīyatvayorgotvā'śvatvavadvirodhātkathañcidapi tadrūpeṇa nā'bheda iti nirdhāraṇāvadheḥ pañcamīti bhāvaḥ | 
(631) sādhunipuṇābhyāmarcāyāṃ saptamyaprateḥ |2|3|43|

(633) nakṣatre ca lupi |2|3|45|

(634) saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye |2|3|7|
saptamīpañcamyau | kārakaśabdaḥ kartṛtvādiśaktiparaḥ, na tu
kartrādiparaḥ, vyākhyānāt |
madhyasyāvadhidvayasāpekṣatvātkārakayormadhyamiti vigrahaḥ |
tadāha--śaktidvayamadhye iti | ṭhkālādhvanoḥ' ityanuvṛtaṃ pañcamyantatayā
vipariṇamyata ityāha--yau kālādhvānāviti | adya bhuktveti |
sāmīpikādhikaraṇatve saptamyāmeva prāptāyāṃ vacanam | adya bhuktvā
dvyahe atīte tatsamīpe tṛtīye'hni bhoktetyarthaḥ | bhaviṣyati
luṭ | kartṛśaktyoriti | adyatanabhujikriyānirūpitakartṛtvasya,
dvyahotaradinagatabhujikriyāgirūpitakartṛtvasya cetyarthaḥ |
kārakaśabdasya kartrādiparatve tviha na syāt, ktvāpratyayasya
kartrekatve vidhānāt | kartṛśaktistu bhujikriyābhedādbhidyata eva |
kārakadvayamadhye'pyudāharati--ihastho'yamiti | ihāpi deśataḥ
sāmīpikamadhikaratvaṃ pañcamīsaptamyorarthaḥ | ihatiṣṭhannayamiṣvāsa
iṣuṇā krośotarasamīpadeśe lakṣyaṃ vidhyedityarthaḥ |
kartṛkarmaśaktyoriti | kartṛtvakarmatvarūpaśaktyormadhya ityarthaḥ |
kārakaśabdasya kartrādiparatve tvihaiva syāt | adya bhuktvāyamityatra na
syāditi sūcayitumidamaṣyudāhṛtam | nanu loke lokādvā adhiko
harirityatra avadhitvasaṃbandhe

lokādveti | avadhitvasaṃbandhaḥ saptamīpañcamyorarthaḥ | lokāpekṣayā
śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ |

(636) yasmādadhikaṃ yasyaceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī |2|3|9|

paryāyeṇa saptamīti | 
adhi bhuvi rāma iti | adhirīśvaraparyāyaḥ | saṃbandhaḥ saptamyarthaḥ | bhuvaḥ

adhiḥ svaśabdaparyāyaḥ | sambandhaḥ saptamyarthaḥ | rāmasya svabhūtā
bhūrityarthaḥ | atra svāmivācakātsaptamī | samāsapakṣe tviti |

rāmādhikaraṇikā bhūrityarthaḥ | khapratyayastu na,
adhyutarapadatvā'bhāvāt | 
(637) vibhāṣā kṛñi |1|4|98|

 atha tiṅnte kartṛkarmaprakriyā|
atha karmakartṛprakriyāṃ nirūpayiṣyankarmaṇaḥ kartṛtvaṃ sādhayitumāha--

ṭhsādhu' iti kriyāviśeṣaṃ saukaryātiśayadyotanāya| atitaikṣṇyāt

kāṣṭhāni pacantīti| atrāpi karaṇānāṃ kartṛtvavivakṣā| sthālī
pacatīti| atrā'dhikaraṇasya kartṛtvavivakṣā|
kāṣṭhānāmatiśuṣkatvāddhamanaphūtkārānapekṣayā sthālyā
atilaghutvādavilambyaśrapaṇatayā saukaryaṃ bodhyam| karmaṇastviti| ye
cchidibhidiprabhṛtaya ekakarmakāstatra karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāṃ
vṛkṣaścchinatī'tyādau prāk sakarmakatve'pi saṃprati sarmaṇaḥ
kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmakarmakā ete ityarthaḥ| ye tu dvikarmakāstatra ekasya
karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmapi itareṇa karmaṇā

mathyate'| kartari yathathā-- ṭhsudhāṃ kṣīrasāgaro mathna#ati'| atha
yaduktam-- ekakarmakeṣu karmaṇaḥ kartṛtvavivakṣāyāmakarmakatvamiti,

(591) na duhasnunamāṃ yakciṇau |3|1|89|

(594) tapastapaḥ karmakasyaiva |3|1|88|

kadāciṇṇyadapi syāt, yaṇṇyatorasārūpyeṇa vā'sarūpa ityasya
pravṛterityata āha-- - nānubandhakṛtamasārūpyamiti| vā'sarūpasūtre
bhāṣye sthimidam| anubandhavinirmuktasyaiva asārūpyaṃ
vivikṣitamityarthaḥ| prakṛte ca yaṇṇyatoranubandarahitayoḥ
sārūpyādvāsarūpavidherapravṛteḥ śapyamityādau ṇyadapavādo yadeveti
bhāvaḥ| 

(665) āṅe yi |7|1|65|

ṭhyī' iti viṣayasaptamīti bhāṣye spaṣṭam| ṭhvivakṣite' ityasya
prayojanamāha--numi kṛte iti| yatpratyaye vivakṣite tatpravṛteḥ
prāgeva numi kṛte
adupadhatvā'bhāvādyatpratyayasyā'pravṛterṇyadevetyarthaḥ| ṭhyati pare
nu'mityarthe tu adupadhatvādyadeva syānnatu ṇyaditi bhāvaḥ| ālambhyo
gauriti| yadyapi yaṇṇyatorna rūpabhedastathāpi ṇyati kṛte
ṭhtitsvarita'miti svaritatvam, yati tu ṭhyato'nāvaḥ'
ityādyaudātatvamiti svarabhedaḥ phalam|

(668) gadamadacarayamaścānupasarge |3|1|100|
gadamada| gada, mada, cara, yam eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ dvandvaḥ| anupasarga iti
saptamī pañcamyarthe| ebhyo'nupasargebhyo yadityarthaḥ| ṇyato'pavādaḥ|
upasargāṇṇyadeva| pragādyamityādi| carerāṅcā'gurāiviti|
vārtikamidam| āṅ upisarge satyapicareryatsyādagurau ityarthaḥ|
ācāryo gururiti| śuśrūṣaṇīya ityarthaḥ| nanu ṭhporadupadhā' dityeva
siddhe yameriha grahaṇaṃ vyarthamityata āha-- yamerniyamārthamiti|
anupasargādeva yamerṇyaditi niyamārthamityatyarthaḥ| tatphalamāha--
sopasargānmā bhūditi| nanu ṭhaniyamyasya nā'yuktiḥ' ityatra, ṭhtvayā
niyamyā nanu divyacakṣā' ityādau ca nipūrvanādyameḥ kathaṃ yat,
anupasargāditi niṣedhādityata āha-- nipūrvātsyādeveti| ṭhya'
diti śeṣaḥ| kuta ityata āha-- tena na tatreti| prakārāntareṇa
samādhate-- niyame sādhuriti veti| ṭhyamaḥ samupaniviṣu ce'ti
nipūrvādyamerbhāve appratyaye niyamaśabdaḥ| niyame sādhurityarthaḥ ṭhtatra
sādhuḥ' iti prāgghitīye yatpratyaye niyamyaśabdo vyutpādya ityarthaḥ| 


(669) avadyapaṇyavaryā garhyapaṇitavyā'nirodheṣu |3|1|101|
avadyapaṇya| avadya, paṇya, varya eṣāṃ dvandvātprathamābahuvacanam| garhya,
paṇitavya,anirodha eṣāṃ dvandvātsaptamībahuvacanam| avadyādayasrayaḥ
kramādgarhyādiṣu triṣvartheṣu nipātyante ityarthaḥ| nanu ṭhvadaḥ supi'
ityeva siddhe avadyagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityata āha-- nañyupapade iti|
yatkyapoḥ svare viśeṣaḥ,saṃprasāraṇatadabhāvau ceti bhāvaḥ| avadyaṃ
pāpāmiti|garhitatvādavācyamityarthaḥ| anudyaṃ gurunāmetava| atra nañi
upapade ṭhvadaḥ supīṭati kyapi ṭhvacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kitī'ti
saṃprasāraṇe rūpam| vacanā'narhamityarthaḥ| atra garhāyā
apratīteryadevedita na niyama iti bhāvaḥ| nanu
gurunāmno'garhyatvātakathaṃ vacanānarhatvamityata āha-- taddhi na garhyaṃ
vacanānarhaṃ ceti|kuta ityata āha-- ātmanāmeti| paṇyā gauriti|
paṇadhātorvyavahārārthakādyannipātyate iti bhāvaḥ| yadyapi ṭhpaṇa
vyavahāre stutau ca' iti dhātorrthadvayamasti, tathāpi paṇyaśabdasya
prayogabalena vyavahartavya eva rūḍhatvādiha vyavahārārthaka eva gṛhyate|
tadāha-- vyavahartavyeti| kretavyetyarthaḥ| pāṇyamanyaditi| ṇyati
upadhāvṛddhiriti bhāvaḥ| vyavahartavyādanyadityarthaḥ| tadāha--
stutyarhamiti| Âpratibandha iti| aniyama ityarthaḥ| vṛṅe yaditi|
ṭhvṛṅ saṃbhaktau' iti kraiyādikasyaivā'tra grahaṇaṃ, natu ṭhvṛñ varaṇe'
ityasya, anirodharūpārthasya saṃbhaktivācitva eva sāmañjasyāditi bhāvaḥ|
śatena varyākanyeti| puruṣaśatena parigrahītumarhā| anenaiva
varaṇīyeti niyamo nāstītyarthaḥ| vṛtyā anyeti| anurūpeṇa
varaṇīyetyarthaḥ| ṭhetistuśāsvṛdṛjuṣaḥ kya'biti tuk| atra aniyamasya
apratīterna yat| atra varyāśabdasya strīliṅgasya grahaṇātpuṃsi ṭhvāryā
ṛtvija' iti vṛtiḥ|

samānādhikaraṇādhikārāccātra kathaṃsamāsa ityata āha-- nipātanāditi|

nipātanādityanuṣajyate| ūrdhvamauhūrtike iti|
muhūrtādūrdhvakālīne ityarthaḥ| idaṃ ca loḍarthalakṣaṇa ityatrānveti|
liṅlaṭāviti| cāllaṭ samuccīyata iti bāvaḥ| vā sta iti| pakṣe
luṭlṛṭau yathāprāptam| cchanda iti| vedamityarthaḥ| iti tṛtīyasya
tṛtīye bhaviṣyatītyadhikārasthā lavidhayaḥ| athā'sminneva tṛtīyapāde
katipayānvidhīnāha-- 

(612) vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavadvā |3|3|131|
vartamānasāmīpye| svarthe pyañiti| asmādeva
nirdeaśāccaturvarṇāderākṛtigaṇatvādveti bhāvaḥ| ityārabhyeti|
tṛtīyasya dvitīye ṭhvartamāna la'ḍityārabhya āpādasamāpteḥ ṭhuṇādayo
bahula'miti tṛtīyapādādimasūtrātpāgvartamānādhikāraḥ|
tasminnadhikāre yena viśeṣaṇena yābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo vartamāne
pratyayā vahitāte sarve tenaiva viśeṣaṇena tābhyaḥ prakṛtibhyo
vartamānasamīpakāle bhūte bhaviṣyati ca vā bhavantītyarthaḥ| atra bhūte
bhaviṣyati cetyārthikaṃ, tayoreva vartamānasāmīpyasatvāt| kadā
āgato'sītyagataṃ prati praśnaḥ| ayamāgacchāmityutaram|
avyavahitapūrvakāle āgatavānasmītyarthaḥ| vartamānasamīpakāle bhūte
laṭ| ṭhaya'mityanena āgamanakālīnaṃ prasvedaparikarabandhādiyuktaṃ
rūpaṃ nirdiśyate idānīmāgamanaṃ sūcayitum| āgamamiti|
vartamānavatvā'bhāve bhūte luṅ| kadā gamiṣyasīti gamanātprāk
praśne, eṣa gacchāmītyutam| avyavahitotarakāle gamiṣyāmītyarthaḥ|
ṭheṣa' iti tu ayamitivadvayākhyeyaḥ| vartamānakālasamīpe bhaviṣyati
laṭ| gamiṣyāmi veti| vartamānavatvā'bhāve bhaviṣyati lṛṭ|

(613) āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca |3|3|132|
āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacca| nānuvartate iti| atra vyākhyānameva śaraṇam|
aprāptasya priyasay prāptīcchā āśaṃsā| sā ca bhaviṣyadviṣayaiva| bhūte
icchāvirahāt| tadāha-- bhaviṣyati kāle iti| devaścediti| deva u
parjanyaḥ, avarṣīcceddhānyamavāpamsma| varṣati cedvapāmaḥ| varṣiṣyati
cedvapsyāma ityanvayaḥ| bhūtavadbhāvādbhaviṣyati luṅ-- avarṣīditi
avāpsmeti ca bhavati| vapadhātorluṅ utmipuruṣabahuvacane
avāpsmeti bhavati|
vṛṣṭivāpayorubhayorapyāśaṃsāviṣayatvādubhatrāpi luṅ|
vartamānavatvapakṣe tu laṭ| tadubhayā'bhāve tu lṛṭ| nanu
bhūtavatvapakṣe laṅÂliṭāvapi kuto na syātāmityata āha--
sāmānyātideśe iti| bhūtatvasāmānye
vihitasyā'tideśādanadyatanabhūtatvaviśeṣavihitayorlaṅÂliṭornā'tideśa ityarthaḥ| etacca bhāṣye spaṣṭam| 

(614) kṣipravacane lṛṭ |3|3|133|
kṣipravacane lṛṭ| vacanagrahaṇātkṣipraparyāye iti labhyate| tadāha--
kṣipraparyāye iti| pūrvaviṣaye iti| āśaṃsāyāmityarthaḥ| ṭhāśaṃsāyāṃ
bhūtavacce'tyasyāpavādaḥ| nanu ṭhkṣipravacanene'tyetāvataiva āśaṃsāyāṃ
kṣipraparyāye upapade bhaviṣyati na bhūtavanna vartamānavaditi
lābhāllṛṅgahaṇamanarthakamityata āha-- neti vaktavye iti|
ṭhkṣipravacane ne'tyukte ṭhsāmānyātideśe viśeṣānatideśaḥ ini
nyāyena bhaviṣyatsāmānye vihitasya lṛṭa eva niṣedhaḥ syānnatu luṭaḥ,
tasyaanadyatanabhaviṣyadviśeṣavidhānāt| śīghraṃ vapsyāma iti|
anadyatanatvadyotāya śvaśśabdaḥ| atra na luḍiti bhāvaḥ| 

(615) āśaṃsāvane liṅ |3|3|134|
#aśaṃsāvacane liṅ| āśaṃsāyāḥ prāptīcchāyā bhūte
asaṃbhavādbhaviṣyatīti labhyata iti matvāha-- bhaviṣyatīti|
ṭhāśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacce'tyasyāpavādaḥ| tadāha-- natu bhūtavaditi|
guruścediti| gururupeyāccet kṣipramadhīyīyetyāśaṃse ityanvayaḥ|
kṣiprayoge'pi paratvālliReĀva, natu lṛḍiti bhāvaḥ| 

(616) nā'nadyatanavatkriyāprabandhasāmīpyayoḥ |3|3|135|
nā'nadyatanavat| kriyāyāḥ prabandhaḥ u sātatyam| tadāha-- kriyāyāḥ
sātatye iti| anadyatanabadityanena anadyane bhūte bhaviṣyati ca vihitau
laṅluṭau vivakṣitau| tadāha-- laṅluṭau neti| anadyatane bhūte
laṅ na bhavati, bhaviṣyatyanadyatane tu lugnetyartha-| kriyāsātatye
laṅniṣedhamudāharati-- yāvajjīvamannamadāditi| luṅ ṭhgāitisthe'
ti sico luk| sāmīpye udāhariṣyannāha-- sāmīpyamiti|
yeyamiti| porṇamāsyā upari kṛṣṇapakṣe katapayāhorātre
vyavadhāne'pi sāmīpyamastyeva, paurṇamāsyantareṇa sajātīyena
vyavadhānā'bhāvāt| ādhiteti| dhādhātorluṅ ṭhsthādhvoiricce'ti
dhādhātoritvaṃ, sicaḥ kitvaṃ ca ṭhhrasvādaṅgā'diti sico lopaḥ|
somenāyaṣṭeti| ṭhyeyaṃ paurṇamāsyatikrāntā tasyā'mityanuṣajyate|
atha kriyāsātatye luṭo niṣedhamudāharati-- yeyamamāvāsyeti|
somena yakṣyate iti| ṭhyeyamamāvāsyā āgāminī
tasyā'mityanuṣajyate| 

(617)bhaviṣyati maryādāvacane'varasmin |3|3|135|
bhaviṣyati maryādā| ṭhavarasmi'nniti cchedaḥ| anadyatanavanneti|
luṇnetyarthaḥ| ṭhakriyāprabandhārtha'miti bhāṣyam| ṭhasāmīpyārthaṃ ce'ti
kaiyaṭaḥ| yo'yamiti| kasmiṃścijjanapadaviśeṣe vasataḥ
āpāṭaliputrādyo'yaṃ gantavyo'dhvā tasya adhvano madhyavartinyāḥ
kauśāmbyāḥ yadavaraṃ pūrvapradeśastatra saktūn śvaḥ prabhṛti pāsyāma
iti yojanā| atra kauśāmbyā iti maryādā gamyate| ṭhavara'mityanena
avaratvaṃ gamyate| atra bhaviṣyatyadyatena luṇna, kiṃtu lṛḍeveti bhāvaḥ|
kālavibhāge| pūrvasūtramiti| ṭhbhaviṣyati
maryādāvacane'varasmi'nniti sūtramityarthaḥ| nanu kālamaryādāyāmapi
pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddhamityataāha-- ahorātreti| tathā ca
āhorātrasaṃbandhini pravibhāge ṭhbhaviṣyati maryādāvacane
ityuktavidhirna bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu ṭhbhaviṣyati
maryādāvacane'varasminkālavibhāge cānahorātrāṇāmityekameva
sūtraṃ kuto netyata āha-- yogavibhāga utarārtha iti| idamutarasūtre
spaṣṭībhaviṣyati| yo'yaṃ vatsara āgāmīti| kālato
maryādāyāmudāharaṇam| āgrahāyaṇyā iti| mārgaśīrṣapaurṇamāsyā
ityarthaḥ| yuktā iti| niyamayuktā ityarthaḥ| adhyeṣyāmahe iti| atra na
luṭ, kiṃtu lṛḍeveti bhāvaḥ| pañcadaśarātrayuktā iti| pañcadaśa
rātrayo yasya pakṣasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ| ṭhacpratyanvavapūrvādityatra ajiti
yogavibhāgādacsamāsāntaḥ| yadvāpañcadaśānāṃ rātrīṇāṃ samāhāraḥ
pañcadaśarātraḥ| ṭhahaḥsarvaikadeśe'tyacsamāsāntaḥ| ṭhsaṅkhyāpūrvaṃrātraṃ
klība'miti tu ṭhliṅgamaśiṣyaṃ lokāśrayatvālliṅgasye'ti vacanānna
bhavati|

(618) parasminvibhāṣā |3|3|138|

(620) votāpyoḥ |3|3|141|
votāpyoḥ| ayamapyadhikāraḥ| vā ā utāpyoriti chedaḥ| bhūte iti,
liṅnimite lṛṅiti cānavartate| tadāha--utāpyorityataḥ prāgiti|
ṭhutāpyoḥ samarthayo'rityataḥ prāgityarthaḥ| nanvanena
ṭhutāpyo'rityataḥ prāgbhūte liṅnimite
lṛṅvetyādhikārākrāntatvādbhūteceti pūrvamadhikārasūtraṃ
nirviṣayamityata āha-- pūrvasūtraṃ tviti| ṭhutāpyoḥ
samarthayorli'ṅtyāribhya icchārthebhyo vibhāṣe'tyataḥ prāk ṭhbhūte
ce'ti pūrvamadhikārasūtraṃ pravartata ityarthaḥ| imāvadhakārau
yatraliṅvidhistatraiva pravartetate, natu laḍādividhau,
liṅnimitā'bhāvāt|

(621) garhāyāṃ laḍapijātvoḥ |3|3|142|
garhāyām| api jātu anayordvandvaḥ| atra ṭhvotāpyoriti bhūte
liṅnimite lṛṅ vā ityadhikāro na saṃbadhyate| laḍvidhānena
tadviṣaye liṅÂnimitā'bhāvāt| kālatraye iti| vartamāne bhūte|
bhaviṣyati cetyarthaḥ| bhaviṣyatīti nivṛtam| ataḥ kālasāmānye
laḍiti bhāvaḥ| paratvāditi| anavakāśatvāccetyapi draṣṭavyam| ṭhapi
jāyā'mityatra , ṭhjātu gaṇikā'mityatra api- jātuśabdau
nindādyotakau| tadāha-- garhitametaditi| 

(622) vibhāṣā kathami liṅ ca |3|3|143|
vibhaṣā kathami| garhāyāmityeveti| anuvartata evetyarthaḥ| ṭhkālatraye
li'ṅiti śeṣapūraṇam| bhaviṣyatīti nivṛtamiti| bhāvaḥ cāllaḍiti|
ṭhsamuccīyate' iti śeṣaḥ| tathā ca kathamityasmin prayujyamāne
kālatraye garhāyāṃ liṅlaṭau vā sta iti phalitam| kathaṃ dharmaṃ
tyajeriti| tyaktatvān tyakṣyasi tyajasi vetyarthaḥ| ṭhgarhitametaditi
kathaṃśabdādgamyate| laṭi udāharati-- tyajasi veti| ukto'rthaḥ| pakṣe
iti| vibhāṣāgrahaṇālliṅlaṭorabhāvapakṣe bhūte vartamāne bhaviṣyati
ca kālatraye liṭÂlaṅÂluṅÂlaṭÂluṭÂlṛṭa ityarthaḥ| atreti| atrā u
uktaviṣaye bhaviṣyati kāle kriyāyā aniṣpatau gamyamānāṃ
ṭhliṅÂnimite lṛṅ kriyātipatau' iti nityameva lṛṅ, kathamo
garhāyāśca liṅÂnimitasya satvādityarthaḥ, viśeṣavihitatvāditi
bhāvaḥ| bhūte veti| ṭhvotāpyo'riti bhūte liṅ nimite lṛṅ
vetyadhikṛtvāduktaviṣaye bhūtakāle lṛṅ vetyarthaḥ| bhaviṣyi nityaṃ
lṛḍityatrodāharati-- kathaṃ nāmeti| ṭhtatra bhavā'niti samudāyaḥ
pūjyavācī| vedaprāmāṇyābhyupaganteti yāvat| evaṃvidhaḥ kathaṃ
dharmatyakṣyat, tatyāgasya garhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ|

(623) kiṃvṛte liṅÂlṛṭau |3|3|144|
kiṃvṛte liṅlṛṭau| nānuvartate iti| vyākhyānāditi bhāvaḥ|
vibhaktyantaṃ ḍataraḍatamāntaṃ ca kiṃśabdaniṣpannaṃ kiṃvṛtamityuktam|
tasminprayujyamāne garhāyāṃ liṅÂlṛṭau sta ityarthaḥ|
sarvalakārāṇāmapavādāviti vṛtiḥ| lṛṅ prāgviditi| bhaviṣyati
nityaṃ lṛṅ, bhūte veti prāguktamihāpyanusandheyamityarthaḥ|
liṅÂnimitasya kiṃvṛtasya garhāyāśca satvāditi bhāvaḥ| 

(624) anavaklṛptyamarṣayorakiṃvṛte'pi |3|3|145|
anavaklṛpyamarṣa| nivṛtamiti| vyākhyānāditi bhāvaḥ|
anavaklṛptyamarṣayorliṅÂlṛṭośca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ neṣyate,
alpāctarasya amarṣaśabdasya pūrvanipātatyāgāditi vṛtiḥ| na
sambhāvayāmīti| akiṃvṛte udāharaṇam| bhavān hiraṃ nindediti
yatanna saṃbhavāyāmi, na marṣaye vetyanvayaḥ| kiṃvṛte udāharati--kaḥ
katara iti| lṛṅÂprāgvaditi| bhaviṣyati nityaṃ lṛṅ, bhūte

(625) kiṅkilā'styartheṣu lṛṭ |3|3|146|
kiṅkilā| kiṃṅkileti| samudāyasya, astyarthānāṃ ca dvandvaḥ|
yāvaditi| ṭhgarhāyāṃ cetaḥ prāgityarthaḥ| kiṅkiletyasmin
astyartheṣu ca prayujyamāneṣu anavaklṛptyamarṣayorlṛṭ
syādityarthaḥ| pūrvasūtreṇa lṛṅlṛraṭoḥ prāptau
lṛḍevetyarthamidam| tadāha-- liṅe'pavāda iti| na śraddadhe iti| na
saṃbhāvayāmītyarthaḥ| tvaṃ śūdrānnaṃ bhokṣyase iti yatanna śraddadhe, na
marṣaye vā kiṅkiletyanvayaḥ| kiṅkileti krodhaṃ dyotayati|
astīti| śūdrasya strī śūdrī| tāṃ gamiṣyasītyasti bhavati vidyate
vetyanvayaḥ| atra lṛṅ neti| bhaviṣyati nityaṃ lṛṅ, bhūte
vetyuktamiha na saṃbhavati, atra liṅe vidhyabhāvena
liṅÂnimitavirahāt|

(627) yaccayatrayoḥ |3|3|148|

(630) śeṣe lṛḍayadau |3|3|151|

(631) utāpyoḥ samarthayorliṅ |3|3|152|

prabhṛtīti| ṭhvotāpyo'riti maryādāyāmāṅ| ṭhutāpyo'ratyataḥ

ṭhutāpyo'rityādisūtreṣu bhūte ṭhliṅÂnimite lṛṅ kriyātipatau'

ca lṛṅtyirthaḥ| 

(632) kāmapravedane'kacciti |3|3|153|
kāmapravedane'kacciti| ṭhakaccitī'ti ccedaḥ| tadāha-- natu

(633) saṃbhāvane'lamiticetsiddhā'prayoge |3|3|154|

iti| saṃbhāvane iti yat saptamyantaṃ tadāvartya prathamayā
