saptamyā alami iti ca vipariṇamyata ityarthaḥ| ṭhchāndasaṃ
vibhaktivyatyayamāśritye'ti śeṣaḥ| tathā ca saṃbhāvane iti saptamyantaṃ,
saṃbhāvanamiti prathamāntaṃ ca labhyate| tathā alamiti prathamāntamalabhi
iti saptamyantaṃ ca labhyate| tatra saṃbhāvane iti
saptamyantamarthanirdeaśaparaṃ| tadāha-- saṃbhāvane'rtha liṅÂsyāditi|
utkaṭānyatarakoṭikaṃ jñāna saṃbhāvanamityucyate|

rhetau| tadāha-- taccediti| tat u saṃbhāvanamÂ, alaṃ u
paryāptihetukaṃ cedityanvayaḥ| ṣidhadhātorjñānārthakāt
ṭhmatibuddhī'ta vartamāne karmaṇi kte siddhaśabdaḥ| siddhe
gamyamāne'pyalamarthe aprayogo yasya sa siddhā'prayogastasminniti
vigrahaḥ| alamīti saptamyantamatra viśeṣyasamarpakaṃ saṃbadhyate|
alaṃśabdaprayogaṃ vināpi tadarthe gamyamāne iti yāvat| tadāha--
siddhā'prayoge satīti| ṭhalamī'ti śeṣaḥ| api girimiti| balavantaṃ

(645) dhātusambandhe pratyayāḥ |3|4|1|

yāhi yāhītyayāsyaditi lṛṅ rūpim| yāsyati veti pāṭhe lṛṭi
udāharaṇam| kramastu na vivakṣitaḥ| pakṣe iti| dhvaṃviṣaye
svādeśā'bhāvapakṣe ityarthaḥ| yūyamadhīdhvamiti--
loṇmadhyamapuruṣabahuvacanam| bhāvakarmaṇostu bhūyasva bhūyasveti
bhūyate| pacyasva pacyasveti pacyate ityudāhāryam| atha ṭhsamuccaye
sāmānyavacanasye' tyasyodāharati-- samuccaye tviti|
abhyavaharatīti| pānaṃ dravadravyasya| dantasaṃmardanaṃ vinā bhakṣaṇam|
khādanaṃ tu -- kaṭhinadravyasya carvaṇam| tayoḥ
sāmānyarūpamabhyavaharaṇam, yathākathaṃcidbhakṣaṇātmakatvāt| pakṣe
hisvāviti| tadhvamorviṣaye kadāciddhisvādeśau pakṣe ityarthaḥ| ṭhpiba
khādetyabhyavaharate' tyudāhāryam| atreti| ṭhpiba
khādetyabhyavaharatī'tyādau
samuccīyamānapānakhādanādikriyāviśeṣāṇāmanuprayujyamānadhātuvācyābhyavaharaṇātamakakriyāsāmānyenā'bhedānvaya ityarthaḥ| pakṣe saktūniti| samuccaye loḍabhāvapakṣe anuprayogo'pi sāmānyavacanasya nāstīti bhāvaḥ| eteneti| ṭhsamuccaye'nyatarasyā'miti ṭhsamuccaye samānyavacanasye'ti ca sūtradvayena tadudāharaṇapradarśanena ca ṭhpurīmavaskande'tyādi māghakāvyasthaṃ ślokavākyaṃ vyākhyātamityarthaḥ| balī-- rāvaṇo, namucidviṣā u indreṇa saha, vigṛhya - virodhaṃ prāpya, puryāḥ u amarāvatyāḥ, avaskandanaṃ u pīḍanaṃ, nandanavanasya lavanaṃ, ratnānāṃ moṣaṇam, amarāṅganānāṃ haraṇamityevaṃprakāreṇa ahardivam u ahanyahani, asvāstyaṃ cakre u kṛtavānityanvayaḥ| itthaṃśabda itiparyāyo'vaskandanādikriyāviśeṣaṇāmasvasthyakriyāsāmānye'bhedaṃ grāhayati| phalitamāha-- avaskandalavanāditi| ādinā moṣaṇaṃ haraṇaṃ ca gṛhyate| bhramamūlakatvamupapādayati-- dvitayīsūtre iti| ananuvṛteriti| bhāṣye tadanuvṛteranuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ| tadanuvṛtyabhyupagame bādhakamāha--- loḍantasyeti| ṭhsamuccaye'nyatarasyā'miti sūtre ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre' itnuvṛtau ṭhavaskande' tyādiloḍantānāṃ ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre dve vācye' iti dvitvāpaterityathaḥ| bhrama eveti| madhyamapuruṣāṃ'śe, ekavacanāṃśe ca bhra evetyarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha-- puruṣavacanasaṃjñe iha netyuktatvāditi| atra bhāṣye hisvāntayoranabhivyaktasaṅkhyākālakatvātadabhivyaktaye'nuprayogasya nyāyata eva prāptatvādanuprayogavidhirmā'stu ityuktam| evaṃ ca ṭhtānīmāni kṣudrāṇyasakṛdāvartīni bhūtāni bhavanti jāyasva mriyasvetyetatṛtīyaṃ sthāna'miti śrutau ṭhsamuccaye'nyatarasyā'miti loṭo hisvāveva bhavato,na tvanuprayogaḥ| tatra jananamaraṇakriyayoreva vivakṣitatayā saṅkhyākālabhivyakteravivakṣitatvena tatrā'nuprayogasya prayojanā'bhāvāt| etena ṭhā ca satyalokādācā'vīcerjāyasvamriyasveti viparivartamānamātmānaṃ jīvalokaṃ cālokyā'smin saṃsāre nityā'śuciduḥkhātmakaṃ prasaṅkhyānamupavartate' iti vācaspatyagranthe'pi jāyasva mriyasveti vyākhyātam| nacātra ṭhsamuccaye'nyatarasyā'mityatra ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre' ityasyānanuvṛteruktatvātkathamiha paunaḥpunyamasakṛtpadagamyamityadoṣaḥ| kalpatarugranthe tu jāyasva mriyasvetyatra ṭhkriyāsamabhihāre' iti sūtreṇa lo'ḍityuktam, tatu dvitvāpaterupekṣyamiti śabdenduśekhare prapañcitam| iti śrīvāsudevadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ siddhāntakaumudīvyākhyāyāṃ bālamanoramāyāṃ lakārārthaprakriyānirūpaṇam|

(1821) tadasminnadhikamiti daśāntāḍḍaḥ |5|2|44|
atha matvarthīyāḥ--tadasminnadhikaṃ tadadhikamasminniti vigrahe
prathamāntāddaśanśabdāntātsamāsādasminnityarthe ḍapratyayaḥ syādityarthaḥ |
pratyayavidhau tadantavidhipratiṣedhādantagraham | ata eva
nirdeaśātpañcamyarthe saptamītyāhuḥ | ṭhāṬpaśleṣike'dhikaraṇe
saptamī'ti bhāṣyam | ṭhsāmīpikamadhikaraṇa'miti kaiyaṭaḥ | ekādaśa
māṣā adhikā asminniti | asmādityarthaḥ | asmin upaśliṣṭā iti vā |
na ca vyapadeśivatve kevaladaśanśabdādapi syāditi śaṅkyaṃ,
vyapadeśidbhāvo'prātipadikene'tyukteḥ | 
(1822) śadantaviṃśateśca |5|2|46|
śadantaviṃśateśca | śeṣapūraṇena sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe--ḍaḥ syādukte'rtheiti
| daśāntatvā'bhāvātpūrveṇā'prāptiḥ | triṃśaṃ śatamiti | he sati
ṭhṭi'riti ṭilopaḥ | viṃśamiti | viṃśatirisminnadhikā iti vigrahaḥ |
ṭhti viṃśate'riti tiśabdasya lopaḥ | antagrahaṇādekatriṃśaṃ śatamiti
siddham | anyathā pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā tadādiniyamaḥ syāt |
ṭhviṃśatāvapyantagrahaṇa'miti vārtikādekaviṃśaṃ śatamityādi siddham | 
(1823) saṅkhyāyā guṇasya nimāne mayaṭ |5|2|47|
saṅkhyāyā guṇasya ṭhtadasye'tyanuvartate | guṇaḥubhāgaḥ, aṃśaḥ |
nimīyate krīyate'neneti nimānaṃumūlyadravyam | ṭhmeṅ praṇidāne'
| karaṇe lyuṭ | tadāha--bhāgasya mūlya ityādi | ṣaṣṭhaḷrthe iti |
asyetyarthe ityarthaḥ | ṭhyavānāṃ dvau bhāgau
nimānamasyodaśvidbhāgasye'ti vigrahavākyam | dvābhyāṃ
yavaprasthābhyām eka udaśvitprasthaḥ kriyate yatra tatredaṃ vākyaṃ prayujyate
| ṭhdvimayamumaśvidyavānā'mityudāharaṇam | ṭhyavānā'miti
saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhī | yavaprasthadvayena kretavyamudaśvidityarthaḥ |
dviśabdasya bhāgavṛternityasāpekṣatve'pi pratyayaḥ | dvau vrīhiyavau
nimānamasyodaśvita iti | dvitvasaṅkhyāviśiṣṭau vrīhiyavarāśī yau
tau asya udaśvito nimānamityarthaḥ | atra udaśvidyāvat tadapekṣayā
vrīhiyavarāśyordvi guṇatvaṃ na vivakṣitaṃ, kiṃtu rāśadvitvameva
vivakṣitamiti dviśabdasya bhāgavṛtitvā'bhāvānna pratyayaḥ | 
(1824) tasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ |5|2|48|
tasya pūraṇe | saṅkhyāyā ityanuvartate |
saṅkhyeyārthakasaṅkhyāvācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḷntātpravṛtinimitasaṅkhyāyāḥ
pūraṇe vācye ḍaṭpratyayaḥ syādityarthaḥ | pūryate aneneti
pūraṇaḥuavayavaḥ, sa pratyayārthaḥ | ekādaśa iti | ekādaśatvasaṅkhyāyāḥ
pūrako'vayava ityarthaḥ | yasminnanupāte ekādaśatvasaṅkhyā na
sampadyate, yasminnupāte tu sā pūryate, so'vayavaḥ | ekadeśa iti
yāvat | pravṛtinimiteti kim ?| pañcānā ghaṭānāṃ pūraṇaṃ jalādi
| 
(1825) nāntādasaṅkhyādermaṭ |5|2|49|
nāntāsaṅkhyādermaṭ | ḍaṭo maḍāgamaḥ syāditi | śeṣapūraṇamidam
| ḍaṭi ṭakāra it | akāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | pañcama iti |
pañcanśabdāḍḍaṭi tasya bhaḍāgame sati nalopaḥ | yadyapimaṭaḥ
pratyayatve'pi na rūpabhedaḥ, tathāpi svaraviśeṣārthaṃ
maḍāgamāśrayaṇamiti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | 
(1826) ṣaṭkatikatipayacaturāṃ thuk |5|2|51|

paraḥ | ṣaṣṭha iti | apadāntatvātṣasya na jaśtvam | caturtha iti
apadāntatvānna rephasya visargaḥ |

staḥ | ādyakṣarasya lopaśceti | ṭhca' iti saṅghātasya lopaścetyarthaḥ |

(1830) tre saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca |5|2|55|

treḥ saṃprasāraṇaṃ ca | trestīyaḥ syātprakṛteḥ samprasāraṇaṃ cetyarthaḥ |
tṛtīya iti | trayāṇāṃ pūraṇa iti vigrahaḥ | tīyapratyaye sati rephasya
samprasāraṇamṛkāraḥ | ṭhsamprasārayaṇācce'ti pūrvarūpam | ṭhhalaḥ' iti
dīrghastu na bhavati, ṭhḍhralope' ityato'ṇa ityanuvṛteḥ |
(1831) viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍanyatarasyām |5|2|56|
viṃśatyādibhyaḥ | tamaṭi ṭakāra it | makārādakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | atra
ṭhpaṅktiviṃśatī'ti sūtrānukrāntā eva viṃśatyādayo gṛhyante natu
lokaprasiddhā ekaviśatyādayo'pi, viprakarṣāditi kaiyaṭaḥ |
ekaviṃśatitama' ityatra tu tadantavidhinā tamaḍityagre vakṣyate |
(1832) nityaṃ śatādimāsārdhamāsasaṃvatsarācca |5|2|57|
nityaṃ śatādi | śatādibhyo māsāt ardhamāsātsaṃvatsarācca parasya
ḍaṭo nityaṃ tamaḍāgamaḥ syādityarthaḥ | nanu
ṭhṣaṣṭhaḷadeśce'tyutarasūtreṇa śatatamaḥ sidhyatītyata āha--ekaśatatama
iti | ṭhasaṅkhyāde'riti paryudāsādutarasūtrasya nātra pravṛtiriti
bhāvaḥ | nanu māsārdhamāsasaṃvatsaraśabdānāṃ
saṅkhyāvācitvā'bhāvātebhyo ḍaṭa evā'prasaktestasya kathaṃ
tadaḍvidhirityata āha--māsāderiti | māsatama iti | māsasya
pūraṇaḥ-ardhamāsādiravayavaḥ | ardhamāsatama iti | ardhamāsasya
pūraṇastithyādiravayavaḥ | saṃvatsaratama iti | saṃvatsarasya pūraṇo
māsādiravayavaḥ | 
(1833) ṣaṣṭhaḷadeścā'saṅkhyādeḥ |5|2|58|
ṣaṣṭhaḷadeścāsahkhyādeḥ | saṅkhyāpūrvapadātpaṣṭaḷadeḥ parasya ḍaṭo
nityaṃ tamaḍāgamaḥ syādityarthaḥ | viṃśatyādibhyaḥ' iti
vikalpasyā'pavādaḥ | ekaṣaṣṭaḥ ekaṣaṣṭitama iti | saṅkhyāditvānnityasa
tamaṭo'bhāve ṭhviṃśatyādibhyaḥ' iti ḍaṭastamaḍvikalpaḥ | tamaḍabhāve
ḍaṭi ṭhyasyeti ce'ti ikāralope ṭhekaṣaṣṭa' iti rūpam | nanu
kevalasātṣaṣṭaḷadervihitasya nityatamaṭaḥ sahkhyādeḥ kathaṃ prasaktiḥ,
tamaḍāgamavidherapratyayavidhitve'pi ṭhgrahaṇavatā prātipadikena
tadantavidhiṃ jñāpayati | tena ṭhviṃśatyādibhyaḥ' iti
pūrvasūtramekaviṃśatitama ityādāvapi pravartata iti bhāṣye spaṣṭam |
evaṃca ṭhekānnaviṃśatitamaḥ' ityapi siddham | 
(1834) matau cchaḥ sūktasāmnoḥ |5|2|59|

vākīyaṃ sūktamiti | acchāvākaśabdo'syāsti, asminnastīti vā vigrahaḥ
| accāvākaśabdayuktamityarthaḥ | acchāvākaśabdāccchabdasvarūpaparāt
prathamāntāccchaḥ | vāravantīyaṃ sāmeti | ṭhaśvaṃ natvā
vāravanta'mityasyāmṛcyadhyūḍhamityarthaḥ | evamasyavāmīyamityapi |
ṭhasyavāmasye'tyasya ekadeśānukaraṇasyavāmeti | tasmāccchaḥ |
asyavāmaśabdasaṃyuktamityarthaḥ |
ṭhprakṛtivadanukaraṇa'mityasyā'nityātvātsupo na luk | 
(1835) adhyāyānuvākayorluk |5|2|60|

(1842) udarāṭṭhagādyaūne |5|2|67|

(1847) śītoṣṇābhyāṃ kāriṇi |5|2|72|

(481) supa ātmanaḥ kyac |3|1|8|
atha namadhātuprakriyā nirūpyante| supa ātmanaḥ| pratyayagrahaṇaparibhāṣayā
subantāditi labhyate| sannidhānādicchāṃ pratyeva karmatvaṃ vivakṣitam|
ātmanśabdaḥ svaparyāyaḥ| tādarthyasya śeṣatvavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhī|
svarthātkarmaṇa iti labhyate| svaśca icchāyāṃ sannidhāpitatvādeṣitaiva
vivakṣitaḥ| tathā ca svasmai yadiṣyate karmakārakaṃ tadvṛteḥ
subantādicchāyāṃ kyajvā syāditi phalati| tadidamabhipretya
āha--iṣikarmaṇa eṣitṛsambandhina ityādinā| eṣitrarthādiṣikarmaṇa
ityarthaḥ| eṣitrā svārthaṃ yadiṣyate karmakārakaṃ .dvācakātsubantāditi
yāvat| dhātvavayavatvāditi| subantātkyaci kṛte tadantasya
ṭhsanādyantā' iti dhātutvāditi bhāvaḥ| 

(482) kyaci ca |7|4|33|
kyaci ca| ṭhasya cvau' ityato'syetyanuvartate| ṭhī ghrādhmo'rityata
īgrahaṇaṃ ceti matvā śeṣaṃ pūrayati-- asyeti| akārasyetyarthaḥ|
putrīyatīti| kyaci putra ya iti sthite ītve putrīyamiccchatītyatra
putraśabdānna kyac| gavyatīti| gāmātmana iccchatītyarthaḥ| nāvyatīti|
nāvamātmana iccchatītyarthaḥ| apadāntatvāditi| ṭhlopaḥ śākalyasye'tyasya
padānta eva pravṛteriti bhāvaḥ| nanvantarvartivibhaktyā
padatvamastyevetyata āha-- tathā hīti| yathā padatvaṃ na bhavati
tathocyate ityarthaḥ| 

(483) naḥ kye |1|4|15|
naḥ kye| nakārādakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| ṭhsuptiṅnta'mityataḥ subantaṃ
padamityanuvartate| subantaṃ nakāreṇa viśeṣyate| tadantavidhiḥ|
nakārāntaṃ subantaṃ padasaṃjñaṃ syāditi labhyate| subantatvādeva
padatve siddhe niyamārthamidam| kyagrahaṇena kyackyaṅergrahaṇaṃ na tu
kyaṣaḥ, ṭhlohitaḍājbhyaḥ kyaṣvacana'miti vakṣyamāṇatayā
halantātkyaṣo'bhāvāt| tadāha kyaci kyaṅ cetyāidinā| nanu
gavyāṃcakāretyatra āma ārddhadhātukāvādeśasaṃpannavakārasya
yakāralopaṃ prati nimitatvā'saṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ| gavyiteti| iṭi
ato lopaḥ| rājīyatītyatra āha-- nalopa iti| rājānamiccchatītyarthe
kyaci rājan ya ti itisthite ṭhnaḥ kye' iti padatvānnakārasya lopa
ityarthaḥ| kṛte nalope ṭhkyaci ce'tyakārasya ītvamiti matvāha--
rājīyatīti| na ca ītve kartavye nalopasyā'siddhatvaṃ śaṅkyaṃ,
ṭhnalopaḥ supsvare'ti niyamādityalam| nanu tvāmātmana iccchati,
māmātmana iccchatītyatra yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ kyaci dhātvavayavatvātsupo
luki pratyayalakṣaṇā'bhāvāt ṭhtvamāvekavacane' iti kathaṃ tvamau
syātāṃ, vibhaktau parata eva tadvidhānādityata āha--
pratyayotarapadayośceti| supo lukā luptatve'pi kyacamādāya
maparyantasya tvamāviti bhāvaḥ| nanu yuṣmānātmana iccchati, asmānātmana
iccchati- yuṣmadyati asmadyatītyatrāpi kyacamādāya tvamau syātāmityata
āha-- ekārthayorityeveti| pratyayotarapadayośce'tyatra
ṭhtvamāvekavacane' iti sūtramanuvṛtam| ekavacanaśabdaśca na rūḍhaḥ,
kiṃtu ekatvaviśiṣṭārthavṛtitvamekavacanaśabdena vivakṣitamiti
yuṣmadasmatprakriyāyāṃ prapañcitaṃ prāk| tathā ca
yuṣmadasmadorekatvaviśiṣṭārthavṛtitvā'bhāvānna tvamāviti bhāvaḥ|
giramātmana iccchati, puramātmana iccchatītyatra girśabdātpurśabdācca
kyaci viśeṣamāha-- hali ceti| ṭhupadhādīrgha' iti śeṣaḥ| nanu
divamiccchati divyatītyatrāpi ṭhhali ce'ti dīrghaḥ syādityata āha--
dhātorityeveti| ṭhhali ce'ti sūtre ṭhsipi
dhāto'rityastadanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ| divyatīti|
divśabdo'vyutpannaṃ prātipadikamiti bhāvaḥ| iheti| ṭhhali ce'ti
sūtre dhātorityanuvṛteḥ puryatītyatra na dīrgha iti
mādhavagranthaścintya ityarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha-- purgiroḥ sāmyāditi|
ṭhgṛÃ śabde' ṭhpṛÃ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' ityābhyāṃ kvipi ṭhṛta
iddhātoṭariti ṭhudoṣṭhaḷpūrvasye'ti ca itve utve ca kṛte raparatve
girśabdasya ca niṣpateriti bhāvaḥ| prāmādika eveti|
divśabdasyā'vyutpannaprātipadikatvānna dhātutvam| divdhātoḥ
kvibantādūṭhi dyaūśabdācca kyaci ṭhdyaūyatī'tyeva ucitam| vici tu
laghupadhagūṇe ṭhlopo vyo'riti lope deśabdāt kyaci
deyatītyevocitamiti bhāvaḥ| adasyatīti| amumātmana iccchatītyarthe
adasśabdātkyaci supo lukā luptatvādvibhaktiparakatvā'bhāvānna
tyadādyatvam| sāntatvānnotvamatve| ṭhnaḥ kye' iti niyamena
padāntatvā'bhāvānna sasya rūtvamiti bhāvaḥ| kartṛśabdātkyaci
viśeṣamāha-- rīRﬁĀta iti| gārgyaśabdātkyaci viśeṣamāha--
kyacvyośceti| āpatyasya yaño yakārasya lopa iti bhāvaḥ| kṛte
yalope ṭhkyaci ce'tyakārasya ītvaṃ matvāha-- gārgīyatīti|
vātsīyatīti| vātsyaśabdātkyaci pūrvavat| kaviśabdātkyaci
viśeṣamāha-- akṛtsārveti| vācyatīti| vācśabdātkyaci ṭhnaḥ kye'
iti niyamena padatvā'bhāvānna kutvam| ṭhvacisvapī'ti saṃprasāraṇaṃ tu
na, ṭhdhātoḥ kāryamucyamānaṃ dhātuvihitapratyaye eve'ti niyamāt|

(484) kyasya vibhāṣā |6|4|50|
kyasya vibhāṣā| ṭhyasya halaḥ' ityato hala iti pañcamynatamanuvartate|
ṭhārddhadhātuke' ityadhikṛtam| tadāha-- halaḥ parayoḥ
kyackyaṅeriti| kyaṣ tu nātra gṛhyate, ṭhlohitaḍājbhyaḥ
kyaṣvacana'miti vakṣyamāṇatayā halantātadabhāvāt|
antalopamāśaṅkyāha-- ādeḥ parasyeti. tathā ca midh a itā iti
sthite āha-- ato lopa iti| tathā ca samidh itā iti sthite
laghūpadhaguṇamāśaṅkyāha-- tasya sthānivatvāditi| kyacsūtre
ṭhmāntāvyayebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ' iti vārtikam| māntebhyo'vyayebhyaśca
pratiṣedha ityarthe putramātmana iccchati putrīyatītyatra na syāt,
putrāviccchatītyādeva syāt| māntāni avyayāni māntāvyayāni tebhya
ityarthe svariccchatītyatra kyacaḥ pratiṣedho na syāt| atastadvārtikaṃ
vivṛṇvannāha-- māntaprakṛtiketi|

(485) aśanāyodanyadhanāyā bubhukṣāpipāsāgarddheṣu |7|4|34|
aśanāyodanya| aśanāya, udanya, dhanāya ityeṣāṃ dvandvaḥ| kyajantā iti|
ete trayaḥ śabdāḥ krameṇa bubhukṣādiṣvartheṣu nipātyante ityarthaḥ|
bhoktumicchā bubhukṣā| pātumicchā pipāsā| garddhaḥ abhikāṅkṣā|
aśanāyatīti| aśyate yatadaśanam u annaṃ, tadbhoktumiccchatītyarthaḥ|
ṭhkyaci ce'ti ītvā'bhāvo nipātyate| ṭhakṛtsārve'ti dīrghaḥ|
udanyatīti| udakaṃ pātumiccchatītyarthaḥ| udakaśabdasya udannādeśo
nipātyate, nalopā'bāvaśca| dhanāyatīti| jīvanārthaṃ satyapi dhane
adhikaṃ dhanaṃ vāñcchatītyarthaḥ| ṭhkyaci ce'ti ītvā'bhāvo nipātyate|
aśanīyatīti| aśanam u annaṃ, tatsaṅgrahītumiccchati
vaiśvadevādyarthamityarthaḥ| udakīyatīti|
sasyādisecanārthamudakamiccchatītyarthaḥ| dhanīyatīti| daridraḥ san
jīvanāya dhanamiccchatītyarthaḥ| 

(486) aśvakṣīravṛṣalavaṇānāmātmaprītau kyaci |7|1|51|

maithunārthaṃ vṛṣamiccchatītyarthaḥ| ṭhvṛṣasyantī tu kāmukī'ti kośastu
aśvavṛṣarūpaprakṛtyarthaparityāgeva maithunecchāmātre lākṣaṇikaḥ|

utkaṭecchā| sarvaprātipadikānāmiti| idamapi vārtikam| lālasāyāṃ

ṭhkṣīralavaṇayorlālasāyā'miti vārtikaṃ vyarthamiti śaṅkyaṃ,

(487) kāmyacca |3|1|9|
ṭhsupa ātmanaḥ kya'jityutaramidaṃ sūtram| tadāha-- uktaviṣaye iti|
putrakāmyatīti. kasyetsaṃjñā tu na, phalā'bhāvāt| anarthakatvāditi|
kāmyaca ekadeśasya yakārasya arthā'bhāvādityarthaḥ| nanu
bebhiditetyatrā'pi yakārasya anarthakatvāllopo na syādityata
āha--yasyetīti. ṭhyasya halaḥra' ityatra ṭhyasye'tyanena
yakārā'kārasaṅghātagrahaṇamityanuvapadamevoktamityarthaḥ| tathā ca
bebhidya itā iti sthite yaṅe yasya saṅghātasyā'rthavatvādyakāralopo
nirbādhaḥ| prakṛte tu kāmyajekadeśasya yasyā'narthakatvāllopo neti
bhāvaḥ| yaśaskāmyatīti| ṭhso'padādau' iti satvam| nanu kimātmana
iccchati kiṃkāmyati, svaḥkāmyatīti katham ? ṭhmāntāvyayānāṃ
ne'tyanuvṛterityata āha-- māntāvyayebhyo'pyayamiti|

(488) upamānādācāre |3|1|10|
upamānādācāre| ṭhsupa ātmanaḥ kya'jityataḥ supa ityanuvartate|
ṭhdhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakratṛkā'dityataḥ karmaṇa iti| tadāha -
upamānātkarmaṇa ityādinā| upamāṃ yatkarmakārakaṃ tadvṛteḥ
subantādityarthaḥ| putramiveti| ṭhdhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ' ityato
vetyanuvṛtiranena sūcitā| chātraṃ putratvena upacaratītyarthaḥ|
viṣṇūyatīti| dvijaṃ viṣṇutvena upacaratītyarthaḥ| adhikaraṇācceti|
upamānabhūtādhikaraṇavṛterapi subantādācāre kyajiti
vaktavyamityarthaḥ| prāsādīyati kuṭaḷamiti| prāsāde iva kuṭhaḷaṃ hṛṣṭo
vartate ityarthaḥ| kuṭīyati prāsāde iti| kuṭaḷamiva prāsāde kliṣṭo
vartate ityarthaḥ|

(489) kartuḥ kyaṅ sa lopaśca |3|1|11|

(402) tatprayojako hetuśca |1|4|55|
atha ṭhhetumati ce'ti ṇijvidhiṃ vakṣyan hetusaṃjñāmāha --

taccchabdena parāmṛśyate| tasya kartuḥ prayojakaḥ pravartayitā -
tatprayojakaḥ| tadāha -- kartuḥ prayojako hetusaṃjña iti| cakāraḥ
pūrvasūtropātāṃ kartṛsaṃjñāṃ samuccinoti| tadāha --
kartṛsaṃjñaśceti.devadataḥ pacati, taṃ prerayati yajñadata ityatra
devadatasyaiva
pākānukūlavyāpārātmakapacadhātvarthāśrayatvarūpakratṛtvasatvātprayojakasya tadabhāvādiha kartṛsaṃjñāvidhiḥ| prayojakasya prayojyakartrā anyathāsiddhatvāddhetutvā'prāptau hetusaṃjñāvidhiḥ|

(403) hetumati ca |3|1|26|

preṣaṇādivyāpāraḥ, tasmin vācye ṇic syādityarthaḥ|
ṭhdhātorekāco halāde'riti dhātorityanuvartate| tadāha -
prayojakavyāpāra #iti| preṣaṇādāvityādiśabdena
adhyeṣaṇānumatyupadeśādīnāṃ grahaṇam| tatra bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasya
pravartanā preṣaṇam| ājñetyarthaḥ| samānasyā'dhikasya ca sakhyācāryādeḥ

kaṣāyapāne hitāvabodhanena pravartanā-- upadeśaḥ| hananādbhītyā

prakaramādinā avagamyante| ṭhkulālo ghaṭṃa karotī' tyatra tu na ṇic,

yājakādiḥ prayojakaḥ, tanniṣṭhaḷaṃ preraṇāyāṃ bhūdhātorṇic|
vṛddhyāvādeśau| bhāvīti ṇijantam|

(433) ṇau gamirabodhane |2|4|46|
ṇau gamirabodhane| ṭhiṇo gā luṅī'tyata iṇa ityanuvartate| tadāha
--iṇo gamiriti| makārādikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ| gamayatīti|

airṣyyaditīṣṭaṃ na syāt| atastṛtīyavyañjanasyetyuktam| evaṃ ca

iti| ṭhtṛtīyaikāca'iti vyākhyāne ityarthaḥ| sannante pravartate iti|

sthitiḥ| tatra tṛtīyaikācaḥ saṃbhavātasya dvitvavidhiḥ| anyathā
ṭhajāderdvitīyasye'ti syāditi bhāva)| airṣyyaditi| yakāramātrasya
dvatve ṇilope saṃyuktādviyakārakaṃ rūpam.atha dvitīyavyākhyāyāṃ
rūpamāha-- airṣiṣyaditi| tadupapādayati-- dvitīyavyākhyāyāmiti|
ṇyantāccaṅ īrṣy i i t iti sthite ṭhna ndrāḥ' iti niṣedhādrephaṃ
varjayitvā ṭhajāderdvitīyasye'ti ṭhṣyi' ityasya dvitvaṃ na tu
yakāramātrasya, prathamavyākhyāne eva tṛtīyavyañjanasyetyukteḥ| tatra
ṭhṣyi' ityasya dvitve kṛte'pi abhyāse ṣakāraeva hal ikāraśiraskaḥ
śrūyate, na tu yakāro'pītyarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha--
halādiśeṣāditi| natu tṛtīyasyaikāca dvitīyavyākhyāyāmiha
dvitīyasyaikācaḥ kathaṃ dvitvamityata āha-- dvitvaṃ tu dvitīyasyaiveti|
ṭhekāca' iti śeṣaḥ| kuta ityata āha-- tṛtīyābhāveneti| īrṣy i a
t ityatra īrṣy iti prathamaikāc, rṣyi iti dvitīyaikāc , na tu
caṅ pire tṛtīyaikājasti| ato'tra ṭhtṛtīyaikāca' iti vārtikaṃ na
pravartate| tasmāddvitīyasyaiva ekāco dvitvamityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca
ṭhtṛtīyasyaikāca' iti vārtikaṃ sannanta eva pravartate| īrṣyaterāmaḥ
satvena tataḥ parasyaliṭo'bhāvāditi bodhyam| nanu ṭhprārthayanti
śayanotthitaṃ priyāḥ' iti māghakāvye prārthayantīti na
caurādikasvārthikaṇijantaṃ, tasyā''garvīyatayā ātmanepadaprasaṅgāt|

nivṛtaṃ preṣaṇaṃ yasmāt sa nivṛtapreṣamaḥ| saṃprati avivakṣitapreṣaṇa
ityarthaḥ| tsamāddhātorbhūtapūrvagatyā preṣaṇamādāya hetumaṇṇau kṛte

nanu saptamyantadvayasamudāyātkhapratyayotpatau tadantasya samudāyasya
prātipadikatvātadavayavayoḥ saptamyorluki ṭhsamāsamīna' iti syāt,
iṣyate tu ṭhsamāṃsamīne'ti | tadā--yalopa iti | pūrvapade vibhakte
tadavayavasya yakārasya lopaḥ avaśiṣyasya vibhaktyaṃśasya alukca
nipātyata ityarthaḥ | bhāṣye tu
ṭhyalopanipātanādavaśiṣṭavibhaktyaṃśasya na lu'gityuktam | nanu
samāṃ samāmiti nirdeaśādutarapade'pi yakāralopaḥ,
avaśiṣṭavibhaktyaṃśasya alukca syādityata āha--pūrvapade iti |
ṭhpūrvapadasya yalopavacana'miti vārtikāditi bhāvaḥ | 
(|) khapratyayānutpatau yalopo vā vaktavyaḥ |
khapratyayānutpatāviti | ṭhpadatadvaye'pī'ti śeṣaḥ | iha vibhāṣayā
kadācitkhapratyayā'bhāve sati ṭhsamāyāṃ samāyaṃ vijāyate' iti
vākyadaśāyāṃ saptamyantadvaye yakāralopo vā vaktavya ityarthaḥ | tatra
padadvaye'pi nipātanādeva yakāralopaḥ siddhaḥ, sūtre ubhayatrāpi
tathoccāraṇāt | vikalpa eva tu yalopasya vākyadasāyāṃ vācanika
iti bodhyam | etatsarvaṃ bhāṣye spaṣṭam |

tadāha--ābhyāṃ vatup syāditi | ābhyāṃ prathamāntābhyām ṭhasya
tatparimāṇa'mityarthe vatupsyādityarthaḥ | vasya ca gha iti | vakārasya
ghakāra ityarthaḥ | kiyāniti | kiṃ parimāṇamasyeti vigrahaḥ |
kiṃśabdādvatup | upāvitau | vakārasya ghakāraḥ | iyādeśaḥ | kim
iyat iti sthite ṭhidaṅkimorīśkī' iti kimaḥ kībhāve ṭhyasyeti
ce'ti īkāralope kiyaccchabdātsau ṭhugidacā'miti numi
atvasantasye'ti dīrghe, halṅyādisaṃyogāntalopāviti bhāvaḥ |
iyāniti | idaṃśabdādvatupi vakārasya ghakāre iyādeśe idam iyat
iti sthite ṭhidaṅkimorīśkī'ti śitvādidama īkāre sarvādeśe
ṭhyasyeti ce'ti īkārasya lope iyaditi pratyayamātraṃ śiṣyate | tataḥ
sau numādi pūrvavat | 
(1817) kimaḥ saṅkhyāparimāṇe ḍati ca |5|2|41|
kimaḥ saṅkhyā | tadasyetyanuvartate | saṅkhyāyāḥ
parimāṇaṃuparicchedaḥ | kiṃśabdaḥpraśne vartate | kā asya saṅkhyetyevaṃ
saṅkhyā paricchedaviṣayakapraśne
vidyamānātkiṃśabdātprathamāntādasyetyarthe ḍatipratyayaśca syādityarthaḥ |
katīti | kā saṅkhyā asyeti, kā saṅkhyā anayoriti ca praśno na
sambhavati, ṭhasye'tyanena ekatvasya, anayorityanena dvitvasya ca
jñātatvāt, jñāte ca praśnā'sambhavāt | kā saṅkhyā eṣāmiti tu
praśnaḥ sambhavati, tatra eṣāmityanena bahutvasya jñātatve'pi
tadvyāpyatritvacatuṣṭvādisaṅkhyānāmajñātatvāt | uktaṃ ca
bhāṣye--ṭhna dvyekayoḥ praśno'stī'ti | tataśca
nityabahuvacanānto'yaṃ katiśabdo ṭhḍati ce'ti ṣaṭsaṃjñakatvāt
ṭhṣaḍbhyo lu'giti jaśśasorvuk | kiyanta iti |
kiyānitivatprakriyā | bahuvacane viśeṣaḥ | ṭhsaṅkhyāparimāṇe'
ityukteḥ kimaḥ kṣepārthakatve ḍatirna bhavati | kā saṅkhyā eṣāṃ
daśānāmiti | ṭhdaśā'varā pariṣa'dityatra brāhmaṇabruvāṇāṃ melane idaṃ
vākyaṃ pravṛttm | saṅkhyeyadvārā saṅkhyāyāḥ kutsā'tra gamyate,
ṭhavratānāmamatrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām | sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ
pariṣatvaṃ na vidyate |' iti smaraṇāt |

(569) anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ |1|3|79|
anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ| ṭhparasmaipadamiti śeṣaḥ| nanu ṭhsvaritañitaḥ'
ityātmanepadasya kartagāmniyeva phale vidhānādakartṛgāmini phale
ṭhśeṣātkartarī'ti parasmaipadasya siddhatvāt kimartha midamityata āha--
kartṛge'pīti| gandhanādāviti|
gandhanāvakṣepaṇasevanasāhasikyapratiyatnaprakathanopayogeṣu ityarthaḥ|
mā bhūditi| bhāve karmaṇi lakārasya kartṛge
phaleparasmapaidanivṛtyarthaṃ kartarītyasyā'nuvṛtiriti bhāvaḥ| nanu
kartarītyasyānuvṛtāvapi ṭhanukriyate śabdaḥ svayameve'tyatra
karmakartari parasmaipadaṃ durvāramityāśaṅkya pariharati-- naceti|
evamapi u kartarītyasyānuvṛtāvapi karmakartari ātmanepadasya
prasaṅgo na śaṅkya ityarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha-- kāryātideśeti| tatra
karmakartari ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' ityātmanepadena pareṇā'sya
parasmaipadasya bādhādityanvayaḥ| nu karmaṇi yacchāstraṃ tat
ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇe'ti karmakartaryatidiśyate, tathā cā'tra karmakartari
ṭhbhāvakarmaṇo'rityātmanepadaśāstramiha prāptam| tasya ca
paratvā'bhāvāt ṭhanuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ' ityanena kathaṃ bādhaḥ syādityata
āha-- kāryātideśapakṣasya mukhyatayeti| śāstrātideśasya
kāryātideśārthatayā kāryātideśasya mukhyatvam| tataśca ṭhkarmavat
karmaṇe'tyanena karmaṇi vihitamātmanepadaṃ karmakartari vidhīyate|
tasya ca paratvātenātmanepadena ṭhanuparābhyāṭamiti parasmaipadaṃ
karmakartari bādhamarhatīti bhāvaḥ| ṭhkarmavatkarmaṇe'tyatra
śāstrātideśamabhyupagamyaāha----- śāstrātideśapakṣe tviti|
ṭhanuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ' ityatra ṭhkartari karmavyatihāre' ityasmādekaṃ
kartṛghaṇamanuvartate| tathā ṭhśeṣātkartari
parasmaipada'mityasmāddvitīyaṃ kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartate| tathā ca
ṭhsvabhāvataḥ eva yaḥ kartā, natu vivakṣādhīnaḥ karmakartā
tathāvidhakartaryeva anuparābhyāṃ kṛñaḥ parasmaipada'miti labhyate| evaṃ
ca karmakartari nāsya pravṛtirityarthaḥ|

(572) parermṛṣaḥ |1|3|82|

parasmaipaditvātparimarṣatītyeva rūpaṃ siddham| ato'min sūtre tasya
na grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| iheti| ṭhpare' riti yogo vibhajyate| ṭhvaha'

(38) midaco'ntyātparaḥ |1|1|47|

bhavatītyarthe ṭhśemucādīnām' ityādāvidaṃ na
pravarteta,tatrāntyasyāco'bhāvādata āha--aca iti ṣaṣṭhaḷntamiti |
ṭhyataśca nirdhāraṇamityanene'ti śeṣaḥ | ṭhaca' ityekatvamavivakṣitaṃ,
tadāha--acāṃ madhya ityādinā | antāvayava iti | etacca
ādyāntāvityato'ntagrahaṇānuvṛtyā labhyate,
ādyantaśabdaikadeśasyāntaśabdasya tanmātre
svaritatvapratijñābalenā'nuvṛtisaṃbhavāt | ādigrahaṇamanuvartya
parāditvābhyupagame tu vārīṇīti bahuvacane sarvanāmasthāne
cāsaṃmbuddhau ṭhiti nāntāṅgasya vihito dīrgho na sidhyet |
abhaktatve tu vahaṃliha ityatra ṭhvahābhre lihaḥ' iti khaśi, ṭharurdviṣa'diti
mumi tasya ṭhmo'nusvāraḥ' iti māntasya padasya vihito'nusvāro na
syāt | vastutastu yasya samudāyasya midvihitastasyā'cāṃ madhye
yo'ntyastasya samudāyasyā'ntāvayavaya iti vyākhyeyam | ata eva
ṭhsamudāyabhakto mit' iti bhāṣyaṃ saṅgaccchate | samāsāśrayavidhau
mūkāraśca vakṣyati--ṭhaṅgasya numvidhānātadbhakto hi nu'miti |
(39) ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyoga |1|1|49|
ṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā | sthānaṃ prasaṅga iti vakṣyati | tasmin
vācakatayā yogo yasyāḥ sā sthāneyogā | nipātanātsaptamyā
aluk | sthānena yogo yasyā iti vā vigrahaḥ | nipātanādetvam |

tāvadekaśataṃ ṣaṣṭaḷrthā ārthā yaunā maukhāḥ srauvāśca | śabdasya
śabdena traya eva saṃbandhāḥ--ānantaryaṃ sāmīpyaṃ prasaṅgaśceti |
tatrānyatamārthanirdhāraṇārthamidaṃ sūtramiti bhāṣyam | tataścaṭhiko

ik nirūpakatayā'nveti | aci parata ikaḥ prasaṅge yaṇÂ syāditi |
vivaraṇavākye tvasmin ṭhika' iti ṣaṣṭhī nirūpakatāyāmiti na
punaruktiḥ śaṅkāḥ | yatā--ṭhdevadatasyāvayavaḥ pāṇi'riti |

upapadhāpadasamabhivyāhāreṇā'vayavaṣaṣṭhītvanirdhāraṇāt,
paribhāṣāṇāṃ cā'niyame niyamanārthameva pravṛteḥ |
tadetadāha-anirdhāritetyādinā | anirdhāritaḥ sambandhaviśeṣo
yasyā iti vigrahaḥ | tadevamudāhṛtaprakṛtabhāṣyarītyāṭhiko
yaṇacī'tyādau ṣaṣṭhī sthānarūpasaṃbandhaviśeṣārthiketi sthitam |ṣa
matupsūtrabhāṣye tvanantarādayo na ṣaṣṭhaḷrthā iti sthitam | evaṃ sati
sthāne iti saptamyantapadena yogo yasyā iti vigrahe sthāne iti
saptamyantasyānukaraṇam | ṣaṣṭhīśrutau ṭhsthāne' iti saptamyantaṃ
padamupatiṣṭhata iti phalati | sthānena sthānapadārthena yogo yasyā
iti tṛtīyāntavigrahe
tvadhyāhṛtasthānapadārthanirūpitasaṃbandhārthiketyarthaḥ |
ṭhasterbhūrbhavatīti sandehaḥ sthāne anantare samīpe iti'
ityādiprakṛtasūtrabhāṣyasya tu asteranantare
ityadhyāhṛtānantarādipadārthanirūpitasambandhe ṣaṣṭhītyevārthaḥ |
anantarādīnāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḷrthatvaṃ tu nāstyeveti prauḍhamanoramāyāṃ
halantyamiti sūtre sthitam | tadvyākhyāne ca śabdaratne
śabdenduśekhare ca bahudhā prapañcitam | anirdhāriteti kim?|
ūdupadhāyā' ityatra ṭhgoha' iti ṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ sthānārthakatvaṃ mā bhūt |
sati tu tatrāpi sthānārthakatve, goho'ntyasya upadhāmātrasya ca ūt
syāt | nanu sthānaśabda ādhāravācī loke prasiddhaḥ | yathā śivasthānaṃ
kailāsaḥ, viṣṇusthānaṃ vaikuṇṭhamityādau | evaṃ ca iko yaṇacītyādau
ṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ sthānārthakatve prakṛtyarthasya tatra nirūpakatve'bhedena vā
anvaye sati iko'dhikaraṇe yaṇ syāditi igadhikaraṇako yaṇ
syāditi vā'rthaḥ syāt | tata iko nivṛtirna syādityata
āha--sthānaṃ ca prasaṅga iti | kvacidābhicāreṣṭau ṭhdarbhāṇāṃ sthāne
śaraiḥprastaritavya'mityatra sthānaśabdasya prasaṅge darśanāditi bhāvaḥ |
evaṃ ca tatra yathā śarairdarbhā nivartyante, tadvadiko yaṇacītyādāvapi
yaṇādibhirigādayo nivartyante | tatra ca yaḥ prasakto nivartate sa
sthānīti vyavahriyate, yo nivartayati sa ādeśa iti |
(40) sthāne'ntaratamaḥ |1|1|50|
sthāne'ntaratamaḥ | ṭhsthānaṃ prasaṅga' ityuktam | antaraśabdo'tra

śvāsā'ghoṣavivārālpaprāṇaprayatnakatvāt | tathā khakāro'pi dvitīyo
na bhavati, tasya mahāprāṇaprayatnasāmye'pi

ṅkāro vā kuto na syāditi cenna ,tamabgrahaṇena
uktātiprasaṅganirāsāt | atiśayito hyantaro'ntaratamaḥ | atiśayitaṃ

sādṛśyātiśayasatvāt | khakārasya mahāprāṇaprayatnasāmye'pi
ghoṣanādasaṃvāraprayatnavirahāt | gaṅyoḥ
ghoṣanādasaṃvāraprayatnasāmye'pi mahāprāṇaprayatnavirahāt |

dīrghasya ūkāraḥ | nanvevamapi cetā stotetyatra ikārasya ukārasya ca
sārvādhātukārdhadhātukayoriti guṇo bhavan pramāṇata
āntaryavānakāraḥ kuto na syādityata āha--yatreti | tena ikārasya

yāvatsthānasāmyasya sāvarṇyaprayojakatve'pi āntaratamyaparīkṣāyāṃ

(41) tasminniti nirdiṣṭe pūrvasya |1|1|66|

(44) ṅcci |1|1|53|
ṅcci | ṅkāra idyasya sa-ṅt | ṭhilo'ntyasye'tyanuvartate |
tadāha--ayamapīti | ṅdimapītyarthaḥ | avaṅ tāvaṅ

apavādaḥ | bāhulakaḥ karaṇe ghañ | yena nāprāpte yo vidhirārabhyate

ārabhyamāṇavidhistasyā'vaśyaprāptasya apavādo bādhaka iti tadarthaḥ |
ayaṃ ca nyāyasiddhaḥ | avaṅadayo hi ṅti ādeśāḥ sarve'nekāla eva |
teṣu cānekālviśeṣeṣu vidhīyamānena ṅtāmintyādeśatvena

bādhyate, viśeṣavihitatvāt, niravakāśatvācca | viśeṣaśāstra hi
viśeṣeṣu jhaṭiti pravartate, viśeṣāṇāṃ svaśabdenopātatvāt |
sāmānyaśāstraṃ tu sāmānyamukhena viśeṣeṣu pravartata iti tasya teṣu
mandapravṛtiḥ | ato viśeṣaśāstraṃ prabalam | uktaṃ ca bhaṭṭavārtike
ṭhavaśyameva sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaṃ prati gaccchati | gatamātraṃ ca tatena
viśeṣe sthāpyate dhruvam ||' iti | kiṃ ca yadi ṅcceiti
śāstramaneka#alviśeṣeṣu ṅtsu ni pravarteta, tarhi tadanarthakameva

ṭhasterbhū'rityādiṣvanekālṣu aṅtsu tisya sāvakāśatvāt | ato

ṭhanekālśitsarvasye'tyasyāvakāśaḥ-ṭhasterbhūḥ'ṭhidama i'śityādiḥ |
atastulyabalatvamubhayoḥ |

(47) svaritenādhikāraḥ |1|3|11|
svaritenādhikāraḥ | adhikāraḥuvyāpṛtiḥ | yathā loke ṭhadhikṛto
grāme'sā'viti vyāpṛta iti gamyate | śabdasya ca
utarasūtreṣvanuvṛtireva vyāpṛtiḥ | svaritenausvaraviśeṣeṇa
adhikāra utaratrānuvṛtirūpavyāpāraḥ pratyetavyaḥ | yat padaṃ
śāstrakṛtā svaritākhyasvaraviśeṣaviśiṣṭamuccāritaṃ
tadutarasūtreṣvanuvartanīyamiti yāvat |
phalitamāha--svaritatvayuktamityādinā |
ānunāsikyavatsavritoccāraṇamapi pratijñāgamyam |
anuvṛtāvutarāvadhistu vyākhyānādevāvagantavyaḥ | yadyapi
nivṛtivadanuvṛtirapi vyākhyānādeva bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ sūtreṇa,
tathāpi bhāṣye etatprayojanaṃ bahudhā prapañcitam |
paranityeti | parādīnāṃ madhye pūrvapūrvāpekṣayā utaramutaraṃ
śāstraṃ balavataparamityarthaḥ | ṭhutarotara'mityatra ṭhānupūrvye dve
vācye' iti dvitvam | ṭhkarmadhārayavadutareṣu' iti
karmadhārayavadbhāvātsupo luk | balavaccchabdāt
ṭhdvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau ' iti īyasun |
ṭhvinmatorlu'giti matupo luk | parāpekṣayā
nityāntaraṅgāpavādāḥ, nityāpekṣayā'pi antaraṅgāpavādau,
antaraṅgāpekṣayāpi apavāda ityevaṃ krameṇa pūrvapūrvāpekṣayā
utarotarabalavatvamiti phalito'rthaḥ | paraṃ vipratiṣedhasūtrāt
balavat | parānnityaṃ yathā--tudati | atra ṭhtudādibhyaḥ śaḥ' iti
śapratyayaṃ bādhitvā paratvālladhūpadhaguṇaḥ prāptaḥ, sa ca śapratyaye
pravṛte sati na pravṛtimarhati | śapratyayastu kṛte'kṛte'pi
laghūpadhaguṇe pravṛtimarhatīti sa nityaḥ | ṭhkṛtākṛtaprasaṅgī yo
vidhiḥ sa nitya' iti hi tallakṣaṇam | ato nityaḥ śapratyayo
laghūpadhaguṇaṃ bādhitvā prathamaṃ pravartate | tataḥ ṭhsārvadhātukamapit'
iti śasya ṅtvāt ṭhkiṅiti ca ' iti niṣedhānna guṇaḥ |
aklṛptā'bhāvakasya nityaśāstrasyā'bhāvakalpanāpekṣayā
klṛptā'bhāvakasyā'nityaśāstrasyaiva tatkalpanaṃ yujyata iti nityasya
balavatve bījam | parādantaraṅgaṃ yathā--ubhaye devamanuṣyāḥ | atra
ṭhprathamacarame'ti paramapi vikalpaṃ bādhitvā ṭhsarvādīnī'ti nityaiva
sarvanāmasaṃjñā bhavati, tasyā vibhaktinirapekṣatvenāraṅgatvāt |
alpāpekṣamantaraṅgamiti hi tallakṣaṇam | tasya balavatve bījamāha--
asiddhaṃ bahiraṅgamantaraṅge | antaraṅgaśāstre prasakte
bahiraṅgaśāstramavidyamānaṃ pratyetavyamityarthaḥ | iyaṃ tu paribhāṣā
ṭhvāhaūṭhÂa'sūtre bhāṣye sthitā | parādapavādo yathā--dadhnā |
asthidadhītyanaṅÂ | iha paramapyanekāliti sarvādeśaṃ bādhitvā
ṭhṅcce'tyintādeśaḥ, tasya yena nāprāptinyāyena tadapavādatvāt |
apavādasya balavatve bījaṃ | tvanupadamevoktam | nityādantaraṅgaṃ
yathā--grāmaṇini kule iha | nityamapīko'cīti numaṃ bādhitvā
ṭhhrasvo napuṃsake' iti hrasvaḥ | prathamataḥ kṛte numyanajantatvādhrasvo
na syāt | antaraṅgādapavādo yathā--daityāriḥ | śrīśaḥ | paramapi
savarṇadīrghaṃ bādhitvā'ntaraṅgatvādādguṇe yaṇi ca
prāpte'pavādatvātsavarṇadīrghaḥ |
akṛtavyūhāḥ pāṇinīyāḥ | na kṛtaḥ akṛtaḥ,
vyūhauprakṛtipratyayavivecanaṃ yaiste'kṛtavyūhāḥ
pāṇinīyāḥupāṇiniśiṣyā ityakṣarārthaḥ | tarhi sarvasya śāstrasya
vaiyarthyamityato'dhyāhṛtya vyācaṣṭe-nimitamityādinā | ṭhseduṣa'
ityādyaudāharaṇam | tacca śabdādhikāre ṭhsedivas'śabdanirūpaṇāvasare
mūla eva spaṣṭībhaviṣyati | iyaṃ paribhāṣā nirmūlā niṣphalā ceti
paribhāṣenduśekhare spaṣṭam | 
iti śrīvāsudevadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ siddhāntakaumudīvyākhyāyāṃ
bālamanoramāyāṃ paribhāṣāprakaraṇam ||

() dikÂśabdebhyaḥ saptamīpañcamīprathamābhyo digdeśakāleṣvastātiḥ

() atiśāyane tamabiṣṭhanau |5|3|55|
atiśāyane | atipūrvakaḥ śīṅdhāturupasargavasādutkarṣe vartate |
utkarṣaścādhikyaphalako nyakkāraḥ, natvādhikyamātraṃ, tathā sati
akarmakatvāpātāt | na ceṣṭāpatiḥ, tathā sati ṭhśuklamatiśete
kṛṣṇataraḥ' ityādibhāṣyavirodhāt | atiśayitāuatiśāyanaḥ
bāhulakaḥ kartari lyu'ḍiti bhāṣyam | ata eva nipānāddīrghaḥ |
ṭhatiśāyane' iti prakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇam | atiśayitari
vidyamānātprātipadikātsvārthe tamap iṣṭan ca syādityarthaḥ |
phalitamāha--atiśayaviśiṣṭārthavṛteriti | yadi tu atiśāyanaśabdasya
bhāvalyuḍantatvaṃ tarhi pratyayārthasya prādhānyāpatau
śuklatarādiśabdācchuklādigatamatiśayanamiti bodhaḥ
syānnatvatiśayitaśukla iti | tatā ca śuklataraḥ śuklatareti puṃstvaṃ
strītvaṃ ca na syāt | ṭhatiśāyane vartamānā'dityarthe tu
atiśayaprakarṣādiśabdebhya eva syānnatu paṭvādibhyaḥ | atiśayaviśiṣṭe
lakṣaṇayā vidyamānādityarthe atiśayyamānādapi pratyayāpatiḥ |
atiśayanakartari lakṣaṇāyāṃ tu bhāṣyoktameva sādhi ityāstāṃ tāvat |
ayameṣāmiti | dvayorekasya nirdhāraṇe tarabīyasunāvapavādau
vakṣyete | ataḥ pariśeṣādbahūnāmekasya nirdhāraṇe asya tamapaḥ
pravṛtiriti bhāvaḥ | atiśayenāḍhaḷ iti | dravyasya jātervā tvataḥ
prakarṣayogo nāsti, anyathā ṭhghaṭatama' ityādyāpateḥ | kiṃtu
guṇadvāraiva dravya.jātyoḥ prakarṣayogaḥ | tathā ca ṭhāḍhaḷtama' ityatra
utkarṣaviśiṣṭa āḍhÂayaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ tamaptu taddyotakaḥ | tamapi sati
ṭhsupo dāthu' iti supo luk, ṭhghakālataneṣu' iti yogena
subantādeva taddhitotpateruktatvāt | atra
ātiśāyanikapratyayāntādātiśāyanikapratyayo'nabhidhānānna bhavati |

() taraptamapau ghaḥ |1|1|22|

| tasya ātiśāyanikaprakaraṇabahurbhūtasya satve tatsaṃgrahaṇārthaṃ

() kimetiṅ
kimetiṅvyaya | ṭhāmu' iti chedaḥ | ukāra uccāraṇārthaḥ | kim, ete,
tiṅ, avyaya--eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ dvandvaḥ | ṭhkimetiṅvyayaprakṛtiko ghaḥ'
iti madhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ | phalitamāha--kima edantādityādinā |
ebhya ityarthaḥ | kintamāmiti atyantasvārthiko'yaṃ tamap,
natvatiśāyane | eṣāmatiśayenāḍhaḷ itivadeṣāmatiśayena ka iti
vigrahasyā'saṃbhavāt | jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñābhi samudāyādekadeśasya
pṛthakkaraṇaṃ hi nirdhāraṇam | prāhṇe tamāmiti | prāhṇaupūrvāhṇaḥ |
ṭhprāhṇā'parāhṇamadhyāhnāḥ trisandhya'mityamaraḥ | atiśayite pūrvāhṇe
ityarthaḥ | pūrvāvayavagataprakarṣādahnaḥ prakarṣo bodhyaḥ | atra aharna
dravyam, sūryodayādārabhya sūtrāstamayāvadhikasyaiva kālasya
ahanśabdārthatvāt | tasya ca udayādikriyāghaṭitatvānna dravyatvamiti
bhāvaḥ | pacatitamāmiti | atiśayinatā pākakriyetyarthaḥ, tiṅnteṣu
kriyāviśeṣyakabodhasyaiva ṭhpraśaṃsāyāṃ rūpa'viti sūtrabhāṣye
prapañcitatvāt | ato'tra kriyāyā evana prakarṣo natu dravyasyeti bhāvaḥ
| uccaistamāmiti | ṭhāśaṃsatī'tyadhyāhāryam | atiśayena
uccairāśaṃśanādikriyetyarthaḥ | atrāpi kriyāyā eva prakarṣo na tu
dravyasya | uccaistamastaruriti | atiśena uccaistarurityarthaḥ | atra
uccaistvaprakarṣasya tarau dravye bhānādābhyanetyarthaḥ |
ṭhkiṃtamā'mityādau ṭhyasyeti ce'ti lopaṃ paratvādbādhitvā
hrasvāntalakṣaṇanuṭo nivṛtyarthamāmu ityukāroccāraṇam | sati tu
tasmin ṭhniranubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakasye'ti paribhāṣayā
nuḍvidhāvasya na grahaṇamityādi ṭhāmi sarvanāmnaḥ' iti sūtrabhāṣye
prapañcitam | 
() dvivacanavibhajyopapade tarabīyasunau |5|3|57|
dvivacana | ucyate'neneti vacanam | dvayorarthayorvacanaṃ dvivacanam
| dvyarthapratipādakamiti yāvat | na dvivacanasaṃjñakamiha gṛhyate,
vyākhyānāt vibhaktavyaṃ--vibhajyam | ṭhṛhalo'riti ṇyataṃ bādhitvā
nipātanādyat | dvivacanaṃ ca vibhajyaṃ ceti samāhāradvandvaḥ |
dvivacanavibhajyaṃ ca tadupapadaṃ ceti karmadhārayaḥ |
dvyarthapratipādake vibhaktavyaviṣayake ca upapade satīti phalitam |
prātipadikāditi, tiṅ iti cānuvartate |
subantātaddhitotpatiriti siddhāntātsubantatvaṃ prātipadikaviśeṣaṇaṃ
labhyate | phalitamāha--dvayorekasyetyādinā | dvayormadhye
anyatarāpekṣayā atiśayaviśiṣṭasvārthavṛteḥ,
vibhāgaprayojakībhūtadharmavācakācca śabdātsvārthe tarabīyasunau sta
iti yāvat | yadyapyatra dve subantatiṅnte prakṛtī, dvau ca pratyayau,
tathāpi na yathāsaṅkhyam, vyākhyānāt, atha dvivacanopapade
udāharati--ayamanayoriti | atra upoccāritaṃ padam upapadam, natu
kṛtramaṃ, taddhitavidhau tadasaṃbhavāt, dhātvadhikāra eva

yuṣmāsu asmāsu, yuṣmābhiḥ asmābhirityatra subantānāṃ ṭeḥ

yuvakayoḥ, āvakayoḥ, yuṣmakāsu asmakāsu, yuṣmakābhiḥ

(|) okārasakārabhakārādau supi sarvanāmnaṣṭeḥ prāgakac |

ṭhvibhaktau parato vihitaḥ kimaḥ ka ādeśaḥ sākackārthaḥ, kaḥ kau ke

āgamaḥ |

() ṭhā'jādāvūrdhvaṃ dvitīyādacaḥ |5|3|83|

spaṣṭam |
() kiṃyatado nirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac |5|3|92|
kiṃyatado nirdhāraṇe | kim, yat, tat eṣāṃ samāhāradvandvātpañcamī
| dvayorekasya nirdhāraṇe gamye nirdhāryamāṇavācibhyaḥ kimādibhyo
ḍatarac syādityarthaḥ | anayoḥ kataro vaiṣṇava iti | ko vaiṣṇava
ityarthaḥ | atra vaiṣṇavatvaguṇena kuaṃśabdārtha idamarthābhyāṃ nirdhāryate |
ataḥ kiṃśabdāḍḍataraci ḍitvāṭṭilope ṭhkatara' iti bhavati | evaṃ
yaccchaśabdāt, taccchaśabdācca ḍataraci ṭilope yataraḥ tatara iti bhavati
| nirdhāryamāṇavācibhya iti kim ?| kayoranyataro devadataḥ,
yayoranyataraḥ, tayoranyatara ityatra kimādibhyo na bhavati | 
() vā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac |5|3|93|
vā bahūnām | kiṃyatada iti, nirdhāraṇe iti, ekasyeti cānuvartate
| bahūnāmiti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | tadāha--bahūnāṃ madhye nirdhāraṇe
ḍatamajvā syāditi | ṭhmadhye' ityanantaram --ekasyeti śeṣaḥ |
jātiparipraśne gamye ityapi bodhyam | jātiśca paripraśnaśceti
samāhāradvandlaḥ | jātau paripraśne ca gamye ityarthaḥ | tatra
jātāviti kiṃyatadāṃ sarveṣāmeva viśeṣaṇam | paripraśnagrahaṇaṃ tu
kima eva viśeṣaṇaṃ, tacca kṣepārthakasya kimo nivṛtyartham |
yatadostu paripraśnagrahaṇaṃ na viśeṣaṇam, asaṃbhavāditi vṛtau
spaṣṭam | atra vārtikam--ṭhkimādīnāṃ dvibahvarthe
pratyayavidhānāparipraśnagrahaṇaṃ na viśeṣaṇam, asaṃbhavāditi vṛtau
spaṣṭam | atra vārtikam--ṭhkimādīnāṃ dvibahvarthe
pratyayavidhānādupādhyānarthakya'miti | ṭhpūrvasūtre dvayoriti, atra
sūtre jātiparipraśne iti ca na kartavye iti bhāva' iti kaiyaṭaḥ |
tadāha--pratyākhyātamākare iti | kṣepārthasya tvanabhidānānna grahaṇamiti
tadāśayaḥ | pūrvasūtre dvayoriti ceti bodhyam | tathāca ṭhkatama
eṣāṃ pācakaḥ, śūro, devadataḥ, ityatra kriyāguṇasaṃjñābhirapi
nirdhāraṇe ḍatamaj bhavati | ṭheṣāṃ kataro devadataḥ' ityatra
bahūnāma#ekasya nirdhāraṇe ḍatarac bhavati | ata eva pratyayaḥ' iti
sūtrabhāṣye ṭhbahuṣvāsīneṣu kascchit kaṃcitpṛccchati kataro
devadataḥ' iti prayogaḥ saṅgaccchate | katamo bhavatāṃ kaṭha iti |
ṭhgotraṃ ca caraṇaiḥ sahe'ti kaṭhasya jātitvam | vāgrahaṇamakajarthamiti
| anyathā mahāvibhāṣayā|ñapavādena mukte
utsargasyā'pravṛteruktatvādakac na svāditi bhāvaḥ | naca
ṭhavyayasarvanāmnā'mityasyādhikāratvātadanuvṛtyaiva siddhe vāgrahaṇaṃ
vyarthameveti vācyam, ihaiva sūtre tadanuvṛtirnatu pūrvasūtre iti
jñāpanārthatvāt | ato ḍatarajviṣaye nā'kac | mahāvibhāṣayeti |
ata eva ṭhavakṣepaṇe' iti sūtre bhāṣye ṭhka etayorarthayorviśeṣaḥ' iti
prayogaḥ saṅgaccchate | ṭhtamabādayaḥ prāgavakṣepaṇakano nityāḥ
pratyayāḥ' iti tu prāyikamiti bhāvaḥ | 
kimo'sminniti | ṭhvā bahūnā'miti prakṛtasūtraviṣaye'pītyarthaḥ,
bahuṣvāsīnaṣu ityādyaudāhṛtabhāṣyaprayogāditi bhāvaḥ |
() ekācca prācām |5|3|94|
ekācca prācām | śeṣapūraṇena sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe--ḍatarac--ḍatamacca
syāditi | ṭhpūrvasūtradvayaviṣaye' iti śeṣaḥ | ṭhmahāvibhāṣayaiva siddhe
prācāṅgrahaṇaṃ na kartavya'miti bhāṣyam | ata eva nā'kajarthaṃ tat | 
() avakṣepaṇe kan |5|3|95|
apakṣepaṇe kan | vyākaraṇakena garvita iti | vyākaraṇaṃ hi svato na
kutsitaṃ, kiṃ tu adhītaṃ sadadhyetṛkutsāhetubhūtaṃ
garmāvahadavakṣepaṇam | nanvavakṣepaṇaṃ kutsā | tatkathaṃ
vyākaraṇamavakṣepaṇaṃ syāt, ṭhkutsita' ityanena gatārthaṃ cedamityata
āha--yenetara iti | avakṣepaṇaśabdaḥ karaṇe lyuḍanta iti bhāvaḥ | 
||||| iti bālamanoramāyām prāgivīyānāṃ pūrṇo'vadhiḥ | |||||

(1492) tasya vikāraḥ |4|3|134|
atha vikārārthapratyayā nirūpyate | tasya vikāraḥ | vikriyate iti
vikāraḥ | karmaṇi ghañ | prakṛtekavasthāntarātmikā vikriyāṃ prāpta
ityarthaḥ | vikāra ityarthe ṣaṣathṭhaḷntādaṇādayaḥ sādhāraṇā,
vakṣyamāṇāśca vaiśeṣikā yathāvihitaṃ syurityarthaḥ | 
(|)aśmano vikāre ṭilopo vaktavyaḥ |
aśmano vikāra iti | vikārārthakapratyaye pare aśmanśabdasya ṭilopo
vaktavya ityarthaḥ | ṭha'niti prakṛtibhāvāpavādaḥ | āśma iti | aṇi
ṭilope rūpam | evaṃ carmaṇo vikāraḥ cārmaḥ kośaḥ | ṭhcarmaṇaḥ
kośe' ityupasahkhyānāṭṭilopaḥ | bhāsmana iti | bhasmano vikāra
ityarthaḥ | aṇi ṭha'niti prakṛtibhāvānna ṭilopaḥ | mārtika iti |
mṛtikāyā vikāra ityarthaḥ | atra ṭhprāṇirajatādibhyo'ñ' ṭhorañ'
ṭhanudātādeśce'tyādivakṣyamāṇapavādaviṣayabhinnamudāharaṇam | tatra
aśman, bhasman, carman ititrayaṃ maninpratyayāntaṃ
nitsvareṇādyaudātam | mṛtikāśabdo'pi ṭhmṛdastika'nniti tikannanto
nitsvareṇādyaudātaḥ | 
(1493) avyave ca prāṇyoṣadhivṛkṣebhyaḥ |4|3|135|
avayave ca prā |prāṇivācina oṣadhivācino vṛkṣavācinaśca
ṣaṣṭhaḷntebhyo'vayave vikāre ca aṇādayaḥ uktā vakṣyamāṇāśca pratyayā
yathāvihitaṃ syuḥ, anyebhyastu vikāramātra ityarthaḥ | prāṇina
udāraharati--māyūra iti | ṭhlaghāvante' iti mayūraśabdo bhadhyodātaḥ
| tataḥ ṭhprāṇirajatādibhyaḥ' ityañ | oṣadherudāharati--maurvamiti |
mūrvā oṣadhiviśeṣaḥ | tasyā avayavo vikāro vetyarthaḥ |
āṬtsargiko'ṇ | ṭhanudātādeśce'tyañ tu vakṣyamāṇo na bhavati,
ṭhtṛṇadhānyānāṃ ca dvyaṣā'mityādyaudātatvāt |
vṛkṣasyodāharati--paippalamiti | pippalaḥ-aśvatthaḥ, tasyāvayavo
vikāro vetyarthaḥ | ṭhlaghāvante' iti madhyodātaḥ pippalaśabdaḥ |
ṭhanudātādeśce'ti vakṣyamā'ṇā'ñobhāve āṬtsargiko'ṇ |
(1494) bilvādibhyo'ṇ |4|3|136|

(1522) jambvā vā |4|3|165|
jambvā vā | jambviti | jambvāḥ phalamityarthaḥ | año luki
viśeṣyānusāreṇa napuṃsakatvāddhrasva iti bhāvaḥ | 
(1523) lup ca |4|3|166|
lup ca | lukaiva siddhe subvidheḥ phalamāha--lupi yuktavaditi
jambūriti | jambvāḥ phalamityarthaḥ | phalapratyayasya lupi yuktavatvena
viśeṣyaliṅgavacane bādhitvā strītvamekavacanaṃ cetyarthaḥ | tathāca
jambvāḥ phalānyapi jambūreva |
(|) phalapākaśuṣāmupasaṅkhyānam |
phalapāketi | phalapākena śuṣyantīti phalapākaśuṣa--oṣadhayaḥ,
tadvācibhyaḥ parasya phalapratyayasya lupa upasaṅkhyānamityarthaḥ | ṭhphale
lugi'tyasyāpavādaḥ | vrīhaya iti | vrīhyākhyānāmoṣadhīnāṃ
phalānītyarthaḥ | evaṃ mudgāḥ | bilvādyaṇo lup |
yuktavadbhāvātpuṃstvaṃ, natu viśeṣyanighnatvam | 
(|) puṣpamūleṣubahulam | 
puṣpamūleṣviti | vārtikamidam | ṭhvikārāvayavapratyayasya lup
syā'diti śeṣaḥ | puṣpaṃ malliketi | ṭhatha dvitīyaṃ
prāgīṣā'dityanuvṛtau ṭhmādīnāṃ ce'ti phiṭsūtreṇa madhyodāto
mallikāśabdaḥ | tataḥ ṭhanudātādeśce'tyaño lup |
yuktavatvātstrītvam | jātīti | ṭhlaghāvante' ityantodāto
jātiśabdaḥ | tataḥ ṭhanudātādeśce'tyaño'nena lup |
yuktavatvātstrītvam | jātīti | ṭhlaghāvante' ityantodāto
jātiśabdaḥ | tataḥ ṭhanudātādeśce'tyaño'nena lup |
yuktavatvātstrītvam |vidārīti | jātiṅīṣantamidaṃ
pratyayasvareṇāntodātam | anudātā ditvādañi tasya lup,
yuktavatvātstrītvam | pāṭalānīti | bilvāditvādaṇ | evaṃ sālvāni
| nanvaśokasya puṣpam aśokaṃ, karavīrasya puṣpaṃ-karavīramityatrāpi
ṭhpuṣpamūleṣu bahula'miti lupi yuktavatvātpuṃstve aśokaḥ puṣpaṃ,
karavīraḥ puṣpamiti syādityata āha--bahulagrahaṇāditi | tathāca
yuktavatvasyā'pravṛteḥ viśeṣyanighnatvameveti | bhāvaḥ | 
(1524) haritakyādibhyaśca |4|3|167|
harītakyādibhyaśca | harītakyādīnāmiti | vārtikamidam | eṣāṃ
prakṛtiliṅgameva luptapratyayārthe atidiśyate, natu
prakṛtivacanamapītyarthaḥ | harītakya iti | jātiṅīṣantaḥ
pratyayasvareṇāntodāto harītakīśabdaḥ | tato'nudātāditvādañi
tasya ṭhphale lu'giti luki prāpte lupi yuktavatvātstrītve
viśeṣyānurodhādbahuvacanam | 
(1525) kaṃsīyaparaśabdayoryañañau luk ca |4|3|168|
kaṃsīyaparaśabda | atra yañañorna luk, vidhivaiyarthyāt | nāpi
prakṛtyoḥ, pratyayā'darśanasyaiva luktvāt | ataḥ
pariśeṣātprakṛtyekadeśayoścchayatoriti labhyate |
tadāha--cchayatoriti | kaṃsīyamiti | kaṃso nāma dhāturlohaviśeṣaḥ
| ṭhtasmai hita'miti cchaḥ | kāṃsyamiti | kaṃsīyaśabdādyañi cchasya luki
ādivṛddhau ṭhyasyeti ce'tyakāralopaḥ | paraśabdamiti | ṭhtasmai
hita'mityadhikāre ṭhugavādibhyo ya'diti orguṇe ṭhvānto
yī'tyavādeśaḥ | pāraśava iti | paraśabdaśabdādañi yato luki
orguṇe pāraśavaḥ | ṭhhalastaddhitasye'ti tu na, ītītyanuvṛteḥ |
anāpatyatvāt ṭhāpatyasya ce'tyapi lopo na prasajyata iti bhāvaḥ |
|||||iti bālamanoramāyām prāgdīvyatīyāḥ ||||||

(89) plutapragṛhyā aci nityam |6|1|125|
atha prakṛtibhāva iti | ṭhnirūpyate' iti śeṣaḥ | platupragṛhyāḥ | vakṣyanta
iti | ṭhdūrāddhūte ce'tyādinā, īdūdedityādinā cetyarthaḥ |
prakṛtyeti | ṭhprakṛtyāntaḥ pāda' mityatadastadanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ |
prakṛtyā svabhāvenā'vasthitāḥ syurityarthaḥ | sandhayo na bhavantīti
yāvat | ehi kṛṣṇā3 atreti | ṭhdūrāddhūte ce'ti ṇakārādakāraḥ
plutaḥ | tasya akāre na savarṇadīrghaḥ | harī etāviti | ṭhīdūde'diti
rephādīkāraḥ pragṛhyaḥ | tasya yaṇādeśo na bhavati | nanu sarvatra
vibhāṣeti pūrvasūtre vibhāṣetyasyā'svaritatvādeva
nivṛtisiddheriha nityagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti pṛccchati-nityamiti
kimiti | utaramāha-harī etāviti | nityagrahaṇe satyeva harī
etāvityādau ṭhplutapragṛhyā acī' tyayameva kevalaḥ prakṛtibhāvaḥ
syādityarthaḥ | ṭhyathā'śabdo yogyatāyām | ayameva prakṛtibhāvaḥ
prāptuṃ yogyaḥ | sa ca nityagrahaṇe sati prāpnuyādityarthaḥ |

dhātava odita iti divādigaṇe uktamityarthaḥ| sūna iti| ṣūṅḥ ktaḥ,
natvaṃ| rṭhśyukaḥ kitī'tīṇniṣedhaḥ| dūna iti| ṭhdūṅ paritāpe'
asmāt ktaḥ, svāditvena oditvānnatvam| nanu ṭhḍīṅ vihāyasā
gatau' ityasya uḍḍīna iti kathaṃ rūpaṃ, seṭkatvādugantatvā'bhāvena
rṭhśyukaḥ kitī'ti niṣedhasyā'pravṛterityata āha-- odanmadhye ḍīṅḥ
pāṭhasāmarthyānneḍiti| iṭi sati niṣṭhātasya odito ḍīṅḥ
paratvā'bhāvānnatvā'prasaktestasya oditsu pāṭho vyarthaḥ syādityarthaḥ|

(828) dravamūrtisparśayoḥ śyaḥ |6|1|24|

iti| saṃprasāraṇaṃ syāditi| ṭhṣyaṅḥ

(829) śyo'sparśe |8|2|47|
śyo'sparśe| śyaḥ- asparśe iti chedaḥ| dīrgha iti| natvātprāgeva ṭhhala'
iti dīrgha ityucitam, natvasya traipādikatvāt| śīnaṃ ghṛtamiti|
ghanībhūtamityarthaḥ| dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt| yadyapi
ghṛte'pyanuṣṇasparśo'styeva, tathāpi śītākhyasparśaviśeṣa eva

syādityetāvadevāstvityarthaḥ| śītaṃ jalamiti| śītasparśavadityarthaḥ|
atra ṭhdravamūrtī'ti saṃprasāraṇameva na tu niṣṭhānatvamityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca
ṭhdravamūrtisparśayo'ritsya sparśe idamudāharaṇam| ṭhśyo'sparśe' ityasya
tu pratyudāharaṇamiti bodhyam| sūtrayoḥ sparśaśabdaḥ pradhānabhūte
guṇabhūte ca vartate| tatra guṇabhūte viśeṣyanighnaḥ| śītā āpaḥ,
śītaṃ jalamityādi| yadā tu sparsaviśeṣo guṇaḥ prādhānyena
vivakṣitastadā klībatvameva| ṭhśītaṃ guṇe'ityamaraḥ|
#esaṃprasāraṇavidhau pṛccchati-- dramūrtisparśayoḥ kimiti| saṃśyāna

bhāvaḥ|

bhūteṣvapi kriyāyā bhūtatvā'bhāvādbhūte vihitā niṣṭhā na
prāptetyārambhaḥ|

(863) niṣṭhāyāṃ seṭi |6|4|52|

upadeśe ugantatvamādāya iṇniṣedhasiddhirityalam| īdita udāharati--
dīptaiti| ṭhdīpī dīptau' divādiḥ| īditvānneṭ| gūḍha iti|
ūditvena veṭkatvāt ṭhyasya vibhāṣe'ti neṭ|
ḍhatvadhatvaṣṭuatvaḍhalopadīrghāḥ| vanu vataḥ| tanu tata iti| ṭhudito
ve'ti ktvāyāṃ veṭkatvāt ṭhyasya vibhāṣe'ti neṭ|
ṭhanudātopadeśe'ti nakālopaḥ| pateḥ sanīti| ṭhpatlṛ gatau' asya
ṭhtanipatidaridrāṇānupasaṅkhyāna'miti sani veṭaktvāt ṭhyasya
vibhāṣe'ti niṣṭhāyāmiṇniṣedhe prāpte ityartaḥ| ṭhpatita' śabde iṭṃa
sādhayituṃ yuktyantaramiti vaktavyam, tatu na saṃbhavati| eṣāṃ
ṭhse'sici kṛtacṛtachﬁadatṛdanṛtaḥ' iti sakārādau veṭkatayā ṭhyasya
vibhāṣe'tyeva niṣṭhāyāṃ nityamiṇniṣedhāsiddheḥ| tataśca
eṣāmīditkaraṇāt ṭhyasya vibhāṣe'ti iṇniṣedhasya anityatvaṃ
vijñāyate| evaṃ ca kṛtādīnāṃ ṭhyasya vibhāṣe'ti
iṇniṣedhasyā'bhāvasaṃbhāvanāyāṃ ṭhśvīditaḥ'
iṇniṣedhārthamīditvamarthavat|tathā ca patitaśabde ṭhyasya

dhūño veṭkatve'pi ṭhyasya vibhāṣe'ti niṣṭhāyāmiṇniṣedhaḥ
syādityata āha-- yasya vibhāṣetyatreti|

(865) dhṛṣiśasī vaiyātye |7|2|19|

hiṃsāyā'mityasya tu ṭhudito ve'ti ktvāyāṃ veṭkatvāt ṭhyasya

ca iḍvikalpe prāpte tadaṃśe nityārtho'tra vidhirastu, tataśca
bhāvādikarmabhyāmanyatra vaiyātyā'bhāve'pi ṭhāditaśce'tīṇniṣeda eva

bhāvaḥ| tatra vṛddhasaṃmatimāha-- ata eveti|
bhāvakarmaṇordhṛṣeranabhidhānādevetyarthaḥ| anyathā dhṛṣerāditvāt
ṭhvibhāṣā bhāvādikarmaṇo'riti bhāve ādikarmaṇi ca iḍvikalpe

iḍvikalpārthaṃ, bhāvādikarṇorvaiyātye dhṛṣeranabhidhānāt|
tasmāddhṛṣerāditvaṃ vyarthamiti haradata āhetyarthaḥ| mādhvastviti|

yāvatī vedistadapekṣayā dviguṇā triguṇā vā'śvamedhādau vedirasti,

bhavatītyarthaḥ | ṭhsaṅkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyuvṛtigaṇane kṛtsuc'
ṭhdvitricaturbhyaḥ suc' iti dviśabdat kriyābhyāvṛtau suci kṛte
dviriti tririti ca rūpam | tatra prākṛtaṃ parimāṇam asyā astīti
tāvatī | prākṛtaparimāṇeti yāvat | dviriti taccchabdārthe
prakṛtiparimāṇe'nveti | dviḥ -tāvatīti vigrahaḥ dvirāvṛtaṃ
prāka#ﬁtaṃ yat parimāṇaṃ tadvatyāśvamedhikī vedirityarthaḥ | ata eva
nipātanātsamāsaḥ, acpratyayaḥ, tāvatīśabdasya ṭhbhasyā'ḍhea' iti puṃvatve
ṅīpo nivṛtau pratyayasyā'ḍitve'pi prakṛternāntatvā'bhāve'pi
ṭilopaḥ | dvistāvatī tristāvatī rajjuriti | atra
vedyāmapravṛteracpratyayaṭilopasamāsā na bhavantītyarthaḥ | tathāca
pratyudāharaṇe ṭhdvi'riti bhinnaṃ padam | 
(938) upasargādadhvanaḥ |5|4|85|
upasargādadhvanaḥ | upasargāt paro yo'dhvanśabdastasmādac
syādityarthaḥ | prādhvo ratha iti | ṭhatyādayaḥ' iti samāsādac |
ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ |
(939) na pūjanāt |5|4|69|
na pūjanāt | ṭhparebhya' ityadhyāhāryam | ṭhsamāsāntā' iti
pūrvasūtramanuvartate | tadāha--pūjanārthāditi | ṭhpūjāyāṃ
svatigrahaṇaṃ kartavya'miti vārtikamabhipretyodāharati--surājeti |
suuśobhano rājeti prādisamāsaḥ | atirājeti | pūjyo
rājetyarthaḥ | ubhayatrāpi ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaḥ' iti ṭajña bhavati |
svatibhyāmeveti | svatibhyāṃ paro yo rājanśabdastasmādevetyarthaḥ,
tathā vārtikāditi bhāvaḥ | neheti | ṭhniṣedhe' iti śeṣaḥ |
paramarāja iti | paramaścāsau rājā ceti vigrahaḥ | atigava iti |
ṭhatyādayaḥ' iti samāsaḥ | ateḥ pūjanārthakatvā'bhāvānna ṭaco niṣedhaḥ
| evaṃ ṭhparamarāja' ityatrāpi | ityataḥ prāgiti | ṭhprāgbahuvrīhigrahaṇaṃ
kartavya'miti vārtikārthasaṅgraho'yam | susakthaḥ svakṣa iti |
suuśobhane sakthinī yasya, suuśobhane akṣiṇī yasyeti ca vighaḥ |
ṭhbahuvrīhau sakthyakṣṇo'riti ṣac | kimaḥ kṣepe | kiṃrājā kiṃsakheti
| iha ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaḥ' iti ṭajñabhavati, ṭhkiṃ kṣepe' iti samāsaḥ |
kiṃrājaḥ kiṃsakha iti | kiṃśabdo'tra praśne | kasya rājā, ko rājeti
vā vigrahaḥ | 
(940) nañastatpuruṣāt |5|4|71|
nindānavagamānna ṭaco niṣedhaḥ | nañastatpuruṣāt | śeṣapūraṇena
sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭa--samāsānto neti |
nañpūrvaṃpadātatpuruṣātsamāsānto neti phalitam | adhuraṃ
śakaṭamiti | avidyamānā dhūryasyeti vigrahaḥ |
nañpūrvapadatve'pyatatpuruṣatvāt ṭhṛkpū'riti samāsāntasya na
niṣedhaḥ | 
(941) pathovibhāṣā |5|4|72|
patho vibhāṣā | patha iti | pathinśabdādityarthaḥ | apathimiti | na
panthā iti vigrahe nañtatpuruṣaḥ |ṭhṛkpūḥ' ityapratyaye sati
ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ | ṭhpathaḥ saṅkhyāvyayāde'riti
napuṃsakatvam | apanthā iti | apratyayā'bhāve rūpam |
tatpuruṣādityeveti | anuvartata evetyarthaḥ | apatho deśa iti |
avidyamānaḥ panthā yasyeti vigrahaḥ | bahuvrīhitvāt
ṭhṛkpū'rityapratyayasya na pākṣiko'pi niṣedhaḥ |
|||||iti bālamanoramāyām samāsāntaprakaraṇam ||||||

(969) gharūpakalpacelaḍbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyo'nekāco hrasvaḥ
|6|3|43|
atha samāsāśrayavidhirnirūpyate--gharūpa | ṭhutarapade' ityadhikṛtaṃ
celaḍādiṣvanveti, natu gharūpakalpeṣu , ghaśabdavācyataraptamapoḥ
rūpapkalpapośca pratyayatvāt | naca tadantagrahaṇe sati teṣūtarapadatvaṃ
saṃbhavatīti vācyaṃ, ṭhhṛdayasya hāìllekhe'tyatra utarapadādhikāre
pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇā'bhāva iti bhāṣye uktatvāt | ṭhstriyāḥ
puṃva'dityato bhāṣita puṃskādityanutam | ṅya ititadantagrahaṇaṃ,
kevasyānekāctvā'bhāvāt | tadāha---bhāṣitapuṃskādyo ṅīti |
etadartameva ṭhstriyāḥ puṃva'dityatra bāśitapuṃskāditi
pañcamyantamupātaṃ ṣa tatra ṭhbhāṣitapuṃskādyo ṅīti | etadarthameva
ṭhstriyāḥ puṃva'dityatra bhāṣitapuṃskāditi pañcamyantamupātaṃ | tatra
ṭhbhāṣitapuṃskādyo ṅīti | etadarthameva ṭhstriyāḥ puṃva'dityatra
bhāṣitapuṃskāditi pañcamyantamupātaṃ | tatra ṭhbhāṣitapuṃskāyā' iti
ṣaṣṭhaḷntopādāne tu iha tadanuvāìtirna syāt, asaṃbhavāt | nahi
ṅīppratyayasya tadantasya bhāṣitapuṃskatvamasti | naca tatrāpi
nārthavatsyāt, anūṅiti paryudāsātstrīpratyayalābhena tadantasya
bhāṣitapuṃskatvā'bhāvāditi vācyam, tatra
striyā'ityasvaritatvātstrīpratyayagrahaṇaṃ netya#uktatvāt| brāhmaṇitarā
brāhmaṇitameti | atiśāyane taraptamapau | naca ṭhtasilādiṣvi'ti
puṃvatvena ṅīpho nivṛtiḥ saṅkhyāḥ, ṭhjāteśce'ti niṣedhāt |
brāhmaṇirūpeti ṭhpraśaṃsāyāṃ rūpap' | brāhmaṇikalpeti |
ṭhīṣadasamāptau'iti kalpap | brāhmaṇicelīti | ṭhcila vasane'
tasmādaci celaḍiti pacādau paṭhitam | ṭitvānṅīp | ityādīti |
brāhmaṇimatā | brāhmaṇihatā | brūña iti | brūñdhātoraci kṛte ṭhbruvo
vaci'riti vacyādeśasya laghūpadhaguṇasya ca abhāvo nipātyata ityarthaḥ
| celaḍādīnīti | samāsavṛtiviṣaye celaṅ bruvagotrahatā
ityutarapadāni kutsanavācīnīti kṛtvā ṭhkutsitāni kutsanai'riti
karmadhāraya ityarthaḥ | āmalakotareti | āmalakīśabdasya vṛkṣavācitve
nityastrīliṅgatvādbhāśitapuṃskatvā'bhāvena na hrasva iti bhāvaḥ |
nanu ṭhna padānte'ti sūtre bhāṣye bimbabadaryāmalakaśabdānāṃ
bhāṣitapuṃskatvāvagamātkathamāmalakīśabdasya vṛkṣaviśeṣe
nityastrīliṅgatvamityarucerāha--kuvalītareti | bṛkṣaniṣeśe
nityastrīliṅgo'yamiti bhāvaḥ | amarastu ṭhkarkandhūrbadarī kolī
ghoṇṭā ṭhkubalaphanile' iti napuṃsakatvamāha |

(456) pratyayasthātkātpūrvasyāt idāpyasupaḥ |7|3|44|
pratyayasthāt | kakārāditi | k iti varṇādityarthaḥ | akāra

(458) udīcāmātaḥ sthāne yakaḥ pūrvāyāḥ |7|3|46| 
udīcāmātaḥ | ṭhpratyayasthāt' iti sūtramanuvartate | yaśca kaśca yakau,
tau pūrvau yasyā iti vigrahaḥ | yaketi varṇagrahaṇam,
akārāvuccāraṇārthau | ṭhyakapūrvāyā' ityetadāta ityasya viśeṣaṇam |
tena arthagataṃ strītvamākāre āropya ṭhyakapūrvāyā' iti
strīliṅganirdeaśaḥ | tena ākārasya strīvācakatvaṃ labhyate |
tadāha--yakapūrvasyetyādinā | udīcāṃgrahaṇaṃ vikalpārthameva natu
deśato vyavasthārthamiti ṭhna veti vibhāṣā' iti sūtre bāṣye
spaṣṭam | naca ṭhṣaṣṭhī sthāneyogā' ityeva siddheriha sthānegrahaṇaṃ
vyarthamiti vācyam, anuvāde paribhāṣāṇāmanupasthiteḥ | tatra ca
idameva sthānegrahaṇaṃ jñāpakam | ata eva
ṭhvṛddhiryasyācāmādistadvṛddha'mityatra yasyādirvṛddhirityanuvāde
ikparibhāṣā na pravartate | tatpravṛtau tu śālāśabdasya vṛddhasaṃjñā na
syāt, śakārādākārasya ikśtānikatvā'bhāvāt | tatasca śālīya
iti ṭhvṛddhāccchaḥ' iti chāe na syāt, ṭhāṬpagavīya' ityādāveva
syādityalam | ke'ṇa iti hrasva iti | āryāśabdātsvārthike kapratyaye
yakārākārasya ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasva ityarthaḥ | punaṣṭāpi āryakāśabdaḥ |
tatra yakārādakārasya ākārasthānikatvāditvavikalpaḥ |
ṭhpratyayasthā'diti nityasyetvasyāpavādaḥ |
tadāha--āryakā-āryiketi | yakārapūrvasya udāharaṇamidam | atha
kakārapūrvasya udāharati--caṭakakā caṭakiketi | caṭakāśabdātsvārthe
kaḥ, ṭhke'ṇaḥ' iti hrasvaḥ, punaṣṭāp, itvavikalpa iti bhāvaḥ |
sāṅkhāśyiketi | saṅkāśena nirvṛtaṃ nagaraṃ sāṅkāśyam |
ṭhvṛñcchaṇakaṭha'jityādinā saṅkāśidbhyo ṇyaḥ, ādivṛddhiḥ, ṭhyasyeti
ce'tyakāralopaḥ | sāṅkāśyaśabdādbhavārthe ṭhdhanvayopadhādvuñ' |
akādeśaḥ ṭhyasyeti ce'tyakāralopaḥ, ṭāp, ṭhpratyayasthā'diti
nityamitvam | iha yakārādakārasya
ākārasthānikatvā'bhāvāditvavikalpo na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | nanu

na tvapatyādhikārapaṭhita ityarthaḥ | yadyapi ṭhyañaśce'ti sūtre
ṭhāpatyagrahaṇaṃ kartavya'mityeva bhāṣye dṛśyate, tathāpi tatra
āpatyapadamapatyādhikāravihitaparamiti manoramāyāṃ śabdaratne ca
prapañcitam |

(467) āyaneyīnīyiyaḥ phaḍhakhacchaghāṃ pratyayādīnām |7|1|2|
āyaneyīnīyiyaḥ | āyan, ey, īn, īy, eṣāṃ
dvandvātprathamābahuvacanam | pha, ḍha, kha, ccha, gh-eṣāṃ
dvandvātṣaṣṭhībahuvacanam | phādiṣvakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ |

itvenitvasvaropayoge'pi netvaṃ, phino nitkaraṇājjñāpakāt |
tatsāhacaryādīno'pi nasya netvam | eyādiṣu ca yasya netvaṃ, ṅīṣaḥ
prāptyabhāvātkauravyaśabdāṭṭāp, māṇḍūabātu ṅīṣiti bhāvaḥ |
yadyapīha ṭhṭāmṅīpo'riti pāṭhaḥ prāyeṇa dṛśyate prayojanā'bhāvāt |
nanu ṣphasya taddhitasaṃjñā kimarthetyata āha--taddhitāntatvāditi |
ṣphāntasya prātipadikatve prayojanamāha--vakṣyamāṇo ṅīṣiti |
ṭhṣidgaurādibhyaśce'tyatra prātipadikādityanuvṛtaṃ, tataśca
ṣphāntasya prātipadikatvā'bhāve ṅīṣ na syāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu
ṣphapratyayenaiva strītvasya dyotitatvāduktārthānāmaprayoga iti
nyāyādatra kathaṃ ṅīṣityata āha--ṣitvasāmarthyāditi | ṣpheṇa
dyotite'pi strītve ṣitkaraṇasāmarthyānṅīṣityarthaḥ | gārgyāyaṇīti
| gargasyāpatyaṃ strīti vigrahaḥ |
gargādiyañantādgārgyaśabdātṣphaḥ, ṣakāra it, phakārasya
āyannādeśaḥ, ṭhyasyeti ce'ti yakārādakārasya lopaḥ,
ṭhhalastaddhitasye'ti tu na bhavati, ītītyanuvṛteḥ | ṭhāpatyasya
ce'tyapi na, anātīti niṣedhāt | ṣitvānṅīṣ | ṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ

(470) vayasi prathame |4|1|20|
vayasi prathame | prāṇināṃ kālakṛtāvastāviśeṣo vayaḥ | tacca
kaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ vārdhakaṃ ceti tridhā | ṭhpitā rakṣati kaumāre
bhartā rakṣati yauvane | putrastu sthāvire bhāve na strī
svātantrayamarhati ||' iti darśanāt | caturvidhaṃ vaya ityanye | ṭhādye
vayasi nādhītaṃ dvitīye nārjitaṃ dhanam | tṛtīye na tapastaptaṃ
caturthe kiṃ kariṣyati ||' iti darśanāt | ṭhprathame vayasī'tyanantaraṃ
ṭhvidyamānā'diti śeṣaḥ | ṭhajādyataṣṭāp' ityato'ta ityanuvṛtena
prātipadikādityadhikṛtaṃ viseṣyate | tadantavidhiḥ |
striyāmityadhikṛtam | ṭhṛnnebhyaḥ' ityato ṅībityanuvartate |
tadāha--prathamavayovācina ityādinā | kumārīti |

(471) vayasyacarama iti vācyam | 
vayasyacarama iti | caramamuantyaṃ vayaḥ, tadbhinnam acaramaṃ | prathame

ciraṇṭīti | anayordvitīyavayovācitvādaprāptiriti bhāvaḥ |
anayordvitīyavayasi aprasiddhatvādāha--yāvanavācināviti |
bhāṣyaprāmāṇyāditi bhāvaḥ | śiśuriti | śiśuśabdasya
prathamavayovācitve'pi adantatvā'bhāvānna ṅībiti bhāvaḥ | kanyāyā
neti | ṭhṅī'biti śeṣaḥ | kuta ityata āha--kanyāyāḥ kanīna ceti |
naca ṭhdvivarṣā strī'tyādāvapi ṅīp śaṅkyaḥ, śālādāvapi

(472) dvigoḥ |4|1|21|
dvigoḥ | ṭhstriyā'miti ṭhata' iti ṭhṅī' biti cānuvartate |
tadāha-adantāditi | trilokīti | trayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ samāhāra iti
vigrahaḥ | ṭhtaddhitārthotarapadasamāhāre ce'ti dvigusamāsaḥ |
ṭhakārāntotarapado dviguḥ striyāmiṣṭaḥ' iti strītvam |
trilokaśabdāṭṭābapavādo ṅīp | ṭhyasyeti ce'ti bhāvaḥ | nanu
triphalā tryanīkā ityatrāpi ṅīp prāpnotītyata āha--ajāditvātriphalā
tryanīketi | ṭhbhavatī'ti śeṣaḥ | trayāṇāṃ phalānāṃ samāhāra iti,
trayāṇāmanīkānāmiti ca vigrahe ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti dviguḥ |
ṭhakārāntotarapadaḥ' iti strītvam, ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅīpaṃ
bādhitvā'jāditvāṭṭābiti bhāvaḥ | anīkaśabda aindravāyavāgratve
śukāgratve āgrayaṇāgratve ca vartate iti tryanīkādhikaraṇe mīmāṃsakāḥ
| aparimāṇa| ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅībiti cānuvartate |
prātipadikādityadhikṛtamaparimāṇādibhirviśeṣyate | tadantavidhiḥ |
(473) aparimāṇabistācitakambalyebhyo na taddhitaluki |4|1|22|
tadāha-aparimāṇāntādityādinā |
aparimāṇāntamudāharati-pañcabhiriti | taddhitalukaṃ
darśayati-ārhīyaṣṭhak, adhyardheti lugiti | pañcabhiraśvaiḥ krīteti
vigrahe ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti dviguḥ |
ṭhārhādagopuccchasaṅkhyāparimāṇāṭṭha'gityadhikāre ṭhtena
krīta'miti ṭhak, ṭhadhyardhapūrvāddvigorlugasaṃjñāyā'miti tasya
luk | atra ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅīp na bhavati, aparimāṇāntadvigutvāt |
nanvatra ṭhdvigo'riti prāptaṅībniṣedhe'pi ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇa'ñiti
ṭhagnimitako ṅīb durvāraḥ | dvābhyāṃ śatābhyāṃ krītā dviśatetyatra
ṭhsaṅkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥ' iti kanaḥ ṭhadhyardhe'ti luki
ṭhaparimāṇe'ti niṣedhasya caritārthatvāditi cetsatyam,
ṭhṭiḍḍhāṇa'ñityatra pratyāsatyā ṭiḍḍhāṇañādīnāṃ
yo|ñakārastadantamiti vivakṣitam | pañcāśvaśabdaścāyaṃ
ṭhagavayavākārānto na bhavatīti na doṣaḥ | naca pratyayalakṣaṇena
ṭhagavayavākārāntatvaṃ śaṅkyaṃ, varṇāśraye pratyayalakṣaṇā'bhāvāt |
vistādiśabdānāṃ tu parimāṇaviśeṣavācitvāt
ṭhaparimāṇe'tyanenā'prāpteḥ pṛthagupādānam | dvau bistāviti |
ṭhsuvarṇabistau hemno'kṣe' ityamaraḥ | ṭhguñjāḥ pañca-ādyamāṣakaḥ | te
ṣoḍaśa akṣa iti ca | guñjāpañcakaṃ māṣaparima#aṇam | māṣaṣoḍaśakam
akṣaparimāṇam, tacca aśītiguñjātmakam tasmin hemaviṣaye
akṣaparimāṇe suvarṇabistaśabdāvityarthaḥ | dvau bistau pacatīti
vigrahe ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti dviguḥ | ṭhsambhavatyavaharatipacatī'ti ṭhak,
tasya ṭhadhyardhe' ti luk | ṭhdvigo'riti ṅīpi pritaṣiddhe sati
ṭāpi-ṭhdvibistā mūṣā'| dvibista parimāṇakahiraṇyaṃ dvāvayatītyarthaḥ |
paciriha drāvaṇe draṣṭavyaḥ | dvyāciteti | ṭhācito daśa bhārāḥ'
ityamaraḥ | ṭhtulā striyāṃ palaśataṃ bhāraḥ syādviṃśatiḥ pumā'niti ca |
dvāvācitau vahatītyarthe
ṭhāḍhakāciḍhapātrātkho'nyatarasyām'dvigoṣṭhṃa śca' iti
khaṭhanorabhāve prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ | ṭhadhyardhe'ti tasya luk | anena
ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅīpi niṣiddhe ṭāpi-ṭhdvyācitā śakaṭī' |
dvikambalyeti | kambalasya prakṛtibhūtaṃ dravyaṃ kambalyam ūrṇāpalaśataṃ
| ṭhtadarthaṃ vikṛteḥ prakṛtau' ityarthe ṭhkambalācca saṃjñāyā'miti yat |
dvābhyāṃ kambalyābyāṃ krīteti vigrahe ṭhtena krīta'miti ṭhañaḥ
ṭhadhyarddhe'ti luk, ṭhdvigo'riti ṅīpi anena pratiṣidhde ṭāp |
nanvatra | ṭhna tadditalukī'tyevāstu | tāvataiva pañcabhiraśvaiḥ krītā
pañcāśveti siddheḥ ṭhaparimāṇe'ti māstu | evaṃca dvibistā
dvyācitā dvikambalyetyapi siddhe vistādigrahaṇamapi māstvityata
āha--parimāṇāntātviti | ṭhguñjāḥ pañca tu māṣaḥ syāte suvarṇastu
ṣoḍaśa | palaṃ suvarṇāścatvāraḥ pañca vāpi prakīrtitam || paladvayaṃ
tu prasṛtaṃ dviguṇaṃ kuḍavaṃ matam | caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ prasthaḥ
prasthāścatvāra āḍhakaḥ ||' iti smṛtiḥ | dvāvāḍhakau pacatīti vigrahe
ṭhāḍhakācitapātrātkho'nyatarasyāṃ'ṭhdvigoṣṭhṃaśce'ti khaṭhanorabhāve
prāgvatīyaṣṭhañ | ṭhadhyardhe'ti luk | ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅīp |
dvyāḍhakīti rūpam | ṭhna taddhitalukī'tyevāvatyevokte'trāpi ṅīpo
niṣedhaḥ syāt | ato'parimāṇānna taddhitalukīti vaktavyam |
tāvatyukte dvibistetyādau parimāṇatvānṅībniṣedho na syāt |
ato bistādigrahaṇamapīti |
(474) kāṇḍāntātkṣetre |4|1|23|
kāṇḍāntātkṣetre | ṭhdvigoḥ' iti, ṭhna taddhitalukī'ti cānuvartate |
tadāha--kṣetre ya ityādi | dve kāṇḍe iti | ṣoḍaśāratnyāyāmo daṇḍaḥ
kāṇḍamiti smṛtiḥ | dve kāṇḍe pramāṇamasyā iti vigrahe ṭhtaddhitārtha'
iti dvigusamāse dvikāṇḍaśabdasya kṣetravartitve
napuṃsakatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāya kṣetrabhaktiriti viśeṣyopādānam |
taddhitalukaṃ darśayitumāha-pramāṇe dvayasajiti | naca kāṇḍādityasya
prātipadikaviśeṣaṇatayā tadantalābhādantagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamiti
śaṅkyam, alasati hyantagrahaṇe kṣetra ityetatkāṇḍasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ
syāt, śrutatvāt | kṣetre yaḥ kāṇḍaśabdastadantāditi labhyeta evaṃca
ṭhdvikāṇḍā kṣetrabhakti'rityatra dvikāṇḍaśabdasyaiva
kṣetravartitvātkāṇḍaśabdasya pramāṇavācitvānṅībniṣedho na syāt |
dvābhyāṃ kāṇḍābhyāṃu kāṇḍapramitakṣetrābhyāṃ krītā ṭhdvikāṇḍī
bahave'tyatraiva ṅīmniṣedhaḥ syāt | ato'ntagrahaṇam | dvikāṇḍī
rajjuriti | pūrvavanmātraco luki ṭhdvigo'riti ṅīp |
kṣetravṛtitvā'bhāvānna tanniṣedha iti bhāvaḥ | nanu ṭhaparimāṇe'ti
pūrvasūtre parimāṇaśabdena kiṃ paricchedakamātraṃ vivakṣitam, uta
ṭhūrdhvamāna#ṃ kilonmānaṃ parimāṇaṃ tu sarvataḥ | āyāmastu pramāṇaṃ
syāt' iti vārtikānusāreṇa paritaḥ-sarvata ārohataḥ pariṇāhataśca
yena miyate tat parimāṇamityāḍhakakuḍavādyeva āyābhavyāvṛtaṃ
vivakṣitam ?| nādyaḥ, tathā sati dvau hastau pramāṇamasyā iti vigrahe
dvihastā bhitirityatra pūrvavanmātracau luki ṅībniṣedho na syāt |
na dvitīyaḥ, tathā
satikāṇḍaśabdasyāyāmapramāṇaparatayoktaparimāṇaparatvā'bhāvena
ṭhaparimāṇe'tyanenaiva ṭhdvikāṇḍā kṣetrabhakti'rityatrāpi
ṅībniṣedhasaṃbhavena ṭhkāṇḍāntātkṣetra eva ṅībniṣedhaḥ, nānyatra
ṭhdvikāṇḍīrajju'rityādāviti niyamārthamityanyatra vistaraḥ |
(475) puruṣātpramāṇe'nyatarasyām |4|1|24|
puruṣāt | dvigoriti taddhitalukīti ṅībiti cānuvartate |
tadāha--pramāṇe ya ityādinā | pramāṇamāyāmaḥ, ṭhāyāmastu pramāṇaṃ
syāt' iti vacanāt | dvau puruṣāviti | ṭhpañcahastāyāmaḥ puruṣaḥ'
iti śulvasūtrāt | dvau puruṣau pramāṇamasyā iti vigrahe ṭhtaddhitārtha'
iti dvigusamāsaḥ | pramāṇe dvayasajdaghnañmātracaḥ' iti vihitasya
mātracaḥ ṭhpramāṇe laḥ, dvigornitya'miti luk | atroktarītyā
puruṣapramāṇasya āyāmātmakasya ṭhaparimāṇe'ti nityaṃ ṅībniṣedhe
prāpte vikalpārthamidaṃ vacanam | anye tu ṭhtadasya parimāṇa'miti
ṭhakaḥ ṭhaño vā ṭhadhyardhe'ti luk | tatra hi
utarasūtrānurodhātparimāṇa śabdena paricchedakamātraṃ gṛhyate
ityāhurityāstāṃ tāvat | dvipuruṣī dvipuruṣā vā parikheti |
tiryak dvipuruṣāyatetyarthaḥ | durgaṃ paritaḥ tatsaṃrakṣaṇārthau
jalāśayaḥ parikhā | atha kuṇḍamiva ūdho yasyā iti bahuvrīhau
kuṇḍodhasśabdaḥ |

ṭhsamāsakṛdantataddhitāntāvyayasarvanāmajātisaṃkhyāsaṃjñāśabdavyatiriktamarthavaccchabdarūpaṃ guṇavacanasaṃjñaṃ bhavatī'tyuktam | tadidaṃ prakṛtasūtrabhāṣyasthalakṣaṇasyāsyoktasya prapañcanaparaṃ veditavyam | parantu ākaḍārasūtrabhāṣye saṃkhyāśabdabhinnatvamapyupātam | tadapyuktalakṣaṇe niveśyam | na caivamapi mṛdupaṭvādiśabdānāṃ guṇaviśiṣṭadravyavācitvādguṇavacanatvā'bhāva iti vācyaṃ, guṇavacanetyanvarthasaṃjñayā guṇopasarjanadravyavācitvasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt | evaṃ ca rūpaśabdasya na guṇavacanatā tasya prādhānyena rūpavācitayā rūpavati prayogā'bhāvāt | rūpādiśabdasyāpi guṇavacanaśabdena grahaṇe ṭhguṇavacanebhyo matupo lugiṣṭaḥ' ityatrāpi rūpādiśabdānāṃ grahaṇāpatau ṭhrūpo ghaṭaḥ' ityādiprayogāpateḥ | prapañcitaṃ caidarūṇādhikaraṇe'smābhiradhvaramīmāṃsākutūhalavṛtau | śuciriti | śukletyarthaḥ | ṭhśuklaśubhraśuciśvetaviśadaśyetapāṇḍarāḥ' ityamaraḥ | naca śucidhātoḥ ṭhigupadhāt ki'dityauṇādike ipratyaye utpannasya śuciśabdasya ākaḍārasūtre bhāṣye kṛdantasya guṇavacanatvaparyudāsādevātra ṅīṣ na bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, uṇādīnāmavyutpatipakṣāśrayaṇāt | ākhuriti | mūṣiketyarthaḥ | ākhostu jātiviśiṣṭadravyavacanatvāduktaguṇavacanatvā'bhāvānna ṅīp | ṭhkharusaṃyogāpadhānne'ti vārtikam | kharuśca saṃyogāpadhaśceti samāhāradvandvaḥ | kharuśabdāt saṃyogopadhāñca ṭhvoto guṇavacanādi'ti ṅīp netyarthaḥ | kharuśabdamaprasiddhatvādvyācaṣṭe--patiṃvarā kanyeti | patilābhotkaṇṭhāvatītyarthaḥ | āṬtkaṇṭhaḷlakṣaṇaguṇopasarjanadravyavācitayā guṇavācitvāt prāptiḥ | pāṇḍuriti | śvetetyarthaḥ | saṃyogopadhatvānna ṅīp |
(495) bahvādibhyaśca |4|1|45|
bahvādibhyaśca | guṇavacanatvādeva siddhe bahugrahaṇaṃ vyarthameveti
prāñcaḥ | vastutastu anupadodāhṛtākaḍārasūtrabhāṣyarītyā
saṅkhyāśabdānāṃ guṇavacanatvā'bhāvādaprāptasya ṅīṣo vidhānārtaṃ
bahugrahaṇamityāhuḥ | bahvī bahuriti | vaipulyavācī
bahuśabdo'yam | tritvādiśamaniyatasaṅkhyāviśeṣavācitve tu
ekavacanānupapateḥ | vaipulyavācitve'pi ṭhbahugaṇavatuḍati saṅkhyā'
iti saṅkhyāśabdatvānna guṇavacanatvamiti na vaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ |
ṭhkṛdikārādaktinaḥ' iti bahvādyantargaṇasūtram | kṛto
yaikārastadantātprātipadikāt ṅīṣ vā syāt, na tu
ktinnāntādityarthaḥ | rātriḥ rātrīti | ṭhrāśadibhyāṃ trip' iti
rādhātorauṇādi kastrip | guṇavacanatvā'bhāvāt,
udantatvā'bhāvāccā'prāpte vacanam | ṭhsarvato'nnarthādityeke' ityapi
bahvādyantargaṇasūtrameva | kṛdikārāntādṛkṛdikārāntādapi ṅīṣ vā
syāt, natu ktinnarthakapratyayāntādityarthaḥ | śakaṭiḥ śakaṭīti |
śakaṭiśabdasya avyutpannaprātipadikatvāt kṛdantatvā'bhāvāt ṭhsarvata'
iti vacanam | avyutpatipakṣe rātriśabdo'pyudāharaṇaṃ bodhyam |
ajananiriti | ṭhstriyāṃ ktinni'tyadhikāre ṭhākrośe nañyaniḥ' iti
nañi upapade janeranipratyayaḥ | ṭhaktina' ityaktau atra niṣedho na
syādato'ktinnarthādityuktiriti bhāvaḥ | nanu hanadhātoḥ striyāṃ
karmaṇi ktini ṭhanudātopadeśe'tyādinā nalope hatiśabdaḥ, tasya
ktinnantatvātkathaṃ paddhatiśabdānṅīṣityata āha--ktinnantatvāditi | gaṇe
iti | bahvādigaṇa ityarthaḥ | nanu pādābhyāṃ hatiriti vigrahe
ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahula' śabdasya grahaṇāt, bhatvā'bhāvācca |
ṭhpādasya padājyātigopahateṣu' ityapi na saṃbhavati, tasya
ājyādiṣveva pareṣu pravṛterityata āha--himakāṣīti | himādiṣu
pareṣu pādaśabdasya padādeśaḥ syāditi tadarthaḥ |

(498) krītātkaraṇapūrvāt |1|4|50|

tvadantamiti kathamatra ṅīṣiti cet, satyam--samāsasya
tāvadalaukikavigrahavākyaṃ prakṛtiḥ | vastra bhis krīta iti sthite

dhātu' iti subluki vastrakrīteti prātipadikasya adantatvaṃ
nirbādhamiti bhāvaḥ | etacca ṭhpuṃyogādākhyāyā'miti sūtre bhāṣye

ānaśivahe - ānaśvahe| aṣṭeti| vraścādinā śasya ṣatve ṣṭuatvam|
vidhiliṅyāha-- aśnuvīteti| āśīrliṅ ūiditvādiḍvikalpaṃ
matvāha---- akṣīṣṭa aśiṣīṣṭeti| luṅ isica iṭpakṣe āha--
āśiṣṭeti| aniṭpakṣe ṭhjhalo jhalī'ti sico lopaṃ matvāha---
āṣṭeti| ṣṭigha dhātuḥ ṣopadeśaḥ| seṭ| ā gaṇāntāditi|
svādigaṇasamāptiparyantamityarthaḥ| ityuktamiti| bhvādāviti bhāvaḥ|
kitvapakṣe āha--- aniditāmiti nalopa iti| nanvaniditāmiti
nalope sati ṭhata ekahalmadhye' ityetvasiddheḥ ṭhdambheśce'ti
vyarthamityata āha-- tasyābhīyatvāditi| nalopasyetyarthaḥ| dabhyāditi|
āśīrliṅ ṭhiniditā'miti nalopaḥ| cchandasīti| gaṇasūtramidam|
tadvyācaṣṭe - ā gaṇāntāditi| ri kṣi iti| ri kṣi ciri jiri dāśa
dṛ iti ṣaṭ dhātavaḥ| ādyadvitīyavekārakṣarau| tadāha-- riṇoti|
kṣiṇotīti| ayaṃ bhāṣāyāmapīti| kṣidhāturityarthaḥ| tatra prayogaṃ
darśayati-- na tadyaśa iti| vṛditi| svādayo vṛtā ityarthaḥ| iti
svādayaḥ|

() ive pratikṛtau |5|3|96|
atha taddhite svārthikaprakaraṇaṃ nirūpyate | ive pratikṛtau | kansyāditi
| ṭhavakṣepaṇe ka'nnityatastadanuvṛteriti bhāvaḥ | ivārthaupamānatvam |
tadvati vartamānātprātipadikātkansyātpratikṛtibhūte upameye iti
phalitam | mṛdādinirmitā pratimā pratikṛtiḥ | aśvaka iti |
pratikṛteḥ strītve'pi ṭhsvārthikāḥ prakṛtito
liṅgavacanānyanuvartante' iti puṃliṅgatvam | 
() saṃjñāyāṃ ca |5|3|97|
saṃjñāyāṃ ca | ṭhka'niti śeṣaḥ | samudāyaścediti|
prakṛtipratyayasamudāyaścetprakṛtyarthasadṛśasya saṃjñetyarthaḥ |
pūrvasūtreṇaiva siddhe kimarthamidamityata āha--apratikṛtyarthamārambha
iti tathāca pratikṛtāviti nivṛtam | iva iti tvanuvartata eva |
tadāha--aśvasadṛśasyeti | aśvasadṛśaśya amanuṣyasya kasyacitsaṃjñaiṣā |
aśvasadṛśo'yamaśvakasaṃjñaka iti bodhaḥ |
() lummanuṣye |5|3|98|
lummanuṣye | saṃjñāyāṃ ceti vihitasyeti | natu ṭhivepratikṛtau'
iti vihatasya pratikṛtitvā'saṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ | cañceva manuṣyaḥ
cañcetyudāharaṇaṃ vakṣyancañcāśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe--cañcā tṛṇamayaḥ
pumāniti | cañceti | cañcātulyo manuṣyo'yaṃ cañcāsaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ
| vardhriketi | vardhri carmamayī pratikṛtiḥ | tatulyo manuṣyo'yaṃ
vardhrikāsaṃjñaka ityarthaḥ | lupi yuktavatvātstrītvam | vacanaṃ tu
viśeṣyavadeva, ṭhharītakyādiṣu vyakti'rityukteḥ | tena ṭhcañce iva
manuṣyau' ityatra cañcā iti na bhavati | 
() jīvikārthe cāpaṇye |5|3|99|
jīvikārthe cāpaṇye | paṇyaṃ--vikrīyamāṇam |
tadāha--avikrīyamāṇamiti | vāsudeva iti| vāsudevatulyā
jīvikārthā avikreyā pratikṛtirityarthaḥ | evaṃ śiva ityādi | kathaṃ
pratikṛteravikreyāyā jīvikārthatvamityata āha--devalakānāmiti |
pratimāṃ gṛhītvā bhikṣārthaṃ pratigṛhamaṭatāmityarthaḥ | tatadāyataneṣu
pratiṣṭhitāsu pūjārthapratimāsu utarasūtreṇa lubvakṣyate |
hastikānvikrīṇīte iti | jīvikārthaṃ hastitulyapratikṛtīrvikrīṇīte
ityarthaḥ | atra paṇyatvapratīteḥ kano na luk | ṭhsajñāyāṃ ce'tija
vihitasya nāyaṃ lup, kintu ṭhive pratikṛtau' iti vihitasyaiva,
bhāṣye pratikṛtāveva etadudāharaṇāt | paṭhanti |
cābhiyuktāḥ--ṭhrāmaṃ sītāṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ jīvikārthe vikrīṇīte yo
rāmādiśabdāḥ pratikṛtiṣu vartante | tāsāṃ cātra paṇyatayā kano
lubdurlabha iti rāmasītālakṣmaṇaśabdānāmapaśabdatvamityāśayaḥ | 
() devapathādibhyaśca |5|3|100|
devapathādibhyaśca | kano lup syāditi | śeṣapūraṇamidam | ṭhive
pratikṛtau' iti vihitasya devapathādibhyaḥ parasya kano lupsyāditi
yāvat | devapatha iti | devānāṃ panthāḥ devapathaḥ |
tatpratikṛtirityarthaḥ | ṭhive pratikṛtau lopaḥ kano devapathādiṣu'
iti | arcāḥupratimāḥ | pūjārthāsu tāsu, citrakarmasu, dhvajeṣu
devapathādigaṇapaṭhiteṣu ṭhive pratikṛtau'vihitasya kano
lubityarthaḥ | ṭhtadrājasye' ti sūtre kaiyaṭo'pyetaṃ ślokaṃ papāṭha |
arcāsu yathā--śivo viṣṇurgaṇapatirityādi | citrakarmasu
yathā--rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaḥ indrajidityādi | dhvajeṣu yathākapiḥ garuḍaḥ
vṛṣabha ityādi | 
() vasterḍhañ |5|3|101|

ce'tyādipūrvasūtreṣu kvāpi pratikṛtāvityasyā'nivṛterna

() śilāyā ḍhaḥ |5|3|102|

| yogeti | ṭhśilāyā' ityeko yogaḥ | ḍhañityanuvartate, ive iti

() samāsācca tadviṣayāt |5|3|106|
samāsāccā | taccchabdena prakṛta ivārthaḥ parāmṛśyate |
tadāha--ivārthaviṣayāditi | ivārthaḥ
sādṛśyamupamānopameyabhāvātmakaṃ, tadviṣayakādityarthaḥ |
sādṛsyavadathabodhakātsamāsāditi yāvat | yadyapi ghanaśyāma iti
samāso'pi sādṛśyavadarthabodhakastathāpi
sādṛśyavadarthabodhakasamasyamānayāvatpadāvayavakātsamāsāditi
vivakṣitamiti na doṣaḥ | cchaḥ syāditi | cakāreṇa
pūrvasūtropātaccchasyānukarṣāditi bhāvaḥ | ṭhivārthe'iti śeṣaḥ |
ṭhpūgāññyaḥ' ityataḥ prāgivādhikārāt | tataśca
ivārthasamasyamānayāvatpakātsamāsādivārthe cchaḥ syāditi labhyate |
kākatālīyo devadatasya vadha iti | kākaḥ kaścidakasmātāla vṛkṣasya
mūlaṃ gatastālaphalapatanānbhṛtaḥ | tathaiva
kaściddevadato'kasmānnirjanapradeśe kvacidgataścoreṇa hatastatredaṃ
vākyaṃ pravṛtam | atra samāsārthagataṃ sādṛśyamekaṃ, pratyayārthagatam
anyatsādṛśyaṃ ca bhāsate | tathāhi--kākagamanamiva tālapatanamiva
kākatālamiti samāsasya vigrahaḥ | atra ṭhkāka' śabdaḥ kākāgamanasadṛśe
devadatāgamane lākṣaṇikaḥ | ṭhtāla'śabdastu tālapatanasadṛśe
corāgamane lākṣaṇikaḥ | kākāgamanasadṛśaṃ detavadatāgamanaṃ,
tālapatanasadṛśaṃ corāgamanamiti ca kākatālamiti samāsādbodhaḥ |
yadyapyatra kākatālaśabdayormilitaya#erekatrānvayā'bhāvāddvandvasamāso
na saṃbhavati, parasparānvayā'bhāvena asāmarthyācca, tathāpi asmādeva
vidhibalāt ṭhsupsupā' iti samāsaḥ | tathāca kākatālasamāgamasadṛśo
devadatacorasamāgama iti samāsārthaḥ | tadāha--ihetyādi | atra
corasamāgama ityasya coreṇa devadatasya samāgama ityarthaḥ |
tadevaṃvidātsamāsātkākatālaśabdādivāntarārthe sādṛśyāntare
cchapratyayaḥ | tatra
samāsātmakakākatālaśabdabūtaprakṛtyartharūpakākatālasamāgamasadṛśadevadatacorasamāgame sati tālapatanakṛtakākamaraṇe upasthite upamānatvaṃ, devadatavadhe corāgamakṛte upameyatvaṃ ca cchapratyayena gamyate | tataśca tādṛśacorasamāgame sati tālapatanakṛtakākamaraṇasadṛśo devadatasya corakṛto vadha iti cchapratyayena labhyate | tadāha--tatprayukta iti | tādṛśatālapatanaprayuktetyarthaḥ | sadṛśa ityanantaraṃ ṭhdevadatavadha' iti śeṣaḥ | tathā ca kākatālasamāgamasadṛśo devadatacorasamāgamaḥ, taddetukastālapatanakṛta kākamaraṇasadṛśaścorakṛto devadatavadha ityevaṃ ṭhkākalatālīyo devadatavadha' iti samāsādbodhaḥ |etadevābhipretyoktaṃ bhāṣye ṭhkākāgamanamiva tālapatanamiva kākatālam | kākatālamiva kākatālīya'miti | atra kākatālamiti ivārthagarbhitakevaladvandvānna bhavati, ivāntarārthasya sādṛśyāntarasyā'pratīterityalam | ajākṛpāṇīya iti | ajāgamanamiva kṛpāṇapatanamiva ajākṛpāṇam, tadiva ajākṛpāṇīyaḥ | ajākṛpāṇasamāgamasadṛśo devadatacorasamāgamaḥ samāsārthaḥ, kṛpāṇapatanaprayuktā'jāmaraṇasadṛśo devadatavadhaścorakṛtaḥ pratyayārthaḥ | atra sarvatra atarkitopanatatvaṃ sādhāraṇo dharma ityāha--atarkiteti |

(1239) khalagorathāt |4|2|50|
khalagorathāt | samūha ityeva | khala, go, ratha ebhyo yaḥ syādityarthaḥ
| khalyā gavya rathyeti | khalānāṃ gavāṃ rathānāṃ ca samūha iti vigrahaḥ
| yadyapi pāśidṣveva eṣāṃ pāṭho yuktastathāpi utarasūtre
eṣāmevānuvṛtyarthaṃ pṛthak pāṭhaḥ | 
(1240) initrakaṭaḷcaśca |4|2|51|
initra | syuriti | ini tra kaṭaḷc--ete syurityarthaḥ | khalinīti |
khalānāṃ samūha iti vigrahaḥ | inipratyaye nakārādikāra uccāraṇārthaḥ
| strītvaṃ lokāt | nāntatvānṅīp | gotreti | gavāṃ samūha iti
vigrahaḥ | gośabdātraḥ | strītvaṃ lokāt | ṭāp | rathakaṭaḷeti |
rathānāṃ samūha iti vigrahaḥ | kaṭhaḷci kakārasya netvam, ataddhita
ityukteḥ strītvāṭṭāp | 
(|) khalādibhya inirvaktavyaḥ |
khalādibhya iti | ṭhinitrakaṭaḷcaśce'ti sūtre inigrahaṇamakṛtvā
ṭhgorathātrakaṭaḷcau' ityeva sūtraṃ kṛtvā ṭhkhalādibhya ini'riti
pṛthakkartavyamityarthaḥ | 
(1241) viṣayo deśe |4|2|52|
viṣayo deśe | samūha iti nivṛtaṃ | tasyetyanuvartate | tasya
viṣaya ityarthe prathamoccāritātṣaṣṭhaḷntātpratyayāḥ syuriti labhyate |
tadāha--ṣaṣṭhaḷntāditi | ṭhviṣaya'śabdaṃ
vyācaṣṭe--atyantapariśīlite'rthe iti | ṭhdevadataviṣayo'nuvāka
ityatra tathā darśanāditi bhāvaḥ | tarhi tatrātivyāptiḥ syādityata
āha--sa cediti | saḥu atyantapariśīlito'rtho deśaścedityarthaḥ |
evaṃca atanyatapariśīlite deśe gamye pratyayāḥ syuriti phalitam |
viṣayaśabdo hyayaṃ kvacidgrāmasamūhātmake janapade vartate |
tadyathā--ṭhsāmantasya rājño viṣayo'nena labdha' iti | kvacidindriyagrāhyae
vartate | tadyathā ṭhcakṣurviṣayo rūpa'miti | kvacidanyatrā'vṛtau vartate
| yathā ṭhmatsyānāṃ viṣayo jala'miti | anyatra nāstīti gamyate |
prakṛte tu ṭhdevadataviṣayo'nuvāka ityarthaḥ | atra deśasyānavagamānna
pratyaya iti bhāvaḥ | viṣaya iti kim ?| devadatasya kadācidgantavyo
mārgaḥ | na ca ṭhdevadatasya gṛha'mityatra
atyantaparicitadeśatvātpratyayaḥ syāditi vācyaṃ,
janapadasamūhātmakātyantapariśīlitadeśasyaivātra vivakṣitatvāt |

(1249) tadadhīte tadveda |4|2|59|
tadadhīte | tadadhīte ityarthe, tadvetītyarthe ca dvitīyāntādaṇādayaḥ
syurityarthaḥ | gurumukhādakṣarānupūrvīgrahaṇamadhyayanam |
śabdārthajñānaṃ vedanam | etena adhyayanavidhirarthajñānaparyanta iti
katipayamīmāṃsakoktiḥ parāstā, pṛthaggrahaṇavaiyarthyāt |

vaiyākaraṇa iti | aṇi ṭhna yvābhyāmi'tyaijāgamaḥ |
(1250) kratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak 
ṛtūkthādi | ṭhtadadhīte tadvede' tyarthayoḥ--kratu,
ukthādi,sūtrāntaḥ-ebhyaḥ ṭhak syādityarthaḥ |
kratuviśeṣavācināmeveti | na tu kratuśabdasyaivetyarthaḥ | anyathā
ukthādigaṇa eva kratuśabdamapi paṭhediti bhāvaḥ | nanu kratuviśeṣāṇāṃ
kathamadyayanam, akṣaragrahaṇātmakatvā'bhāvādityata āhatebhya iti |
agniṣṭomādiśabdāḥ kratuviśeṣeṣu mukhyāḥ | tatpratipādakagrantheṣu
tu gauṇāḥ | tatra
kratuviśeṣātmakamukhyārthakebhyo'gniṣṭomādiśabdebhyo veditari
pratyayāḥ | agniṣṭomādikratupratipādakagrantheṣu lakṣaṇayā
vidyamānebhyastu tebhyo'dhyetarītyarthaḥ | āgniṣṭomika iti |
agniṣṭomaṃ kratuṃ veti, tatpratipādakagranthamadhīte iti vā'rthaḥ |
ukthaśabdaḥ sāmasu mukhyaḥ | sāmalakṣaṇagranthe prātiśākhye tu gauṇaḥ |
tatra gauṇārthakādeva ukthaśabdāṭṭhagityāha--ukthaṃ sāmaviśeṣa iti |
ṭhagniṣṭomastotrātparaṃ yatsāma gīyate' iti vṛtikṛdukteriti
bhāvaḥ | bhāṣye tu sāmaśabdaparyāya ukthaśabda iti lakṣyate | 
(|) mukhyārthātūkthaśabdāṭhÂaṭhagaṇau neṣyete |
mukhyārthāditi | sāmavācina ukthaśabdātu na ṭhak | tasminniṣiddhe
tadadhīte ityaṇ ca na bhavatītyarthaḥ | bhāṣye tu
mukhyārthakādukthaśabdāṭṭhak netyeva lakṣyate |
ukthādigaṇapaṭhitānnyāyādiśabdāṭṭhakamudāharati--nyāyamiti |
ṭhadhīte veti ve'ti śeṣaḥ | naiyāyika iti | ṭhaki aijāgamaḥ |
vṛtimiti | ṭhadhīte veda ve'ti śeṣaḥ | vārtika iti | ṭhaki
ādivṛddhau raparatvam | sāṅgrahasūtrika iti | saṃgrahākhyaṃ
sūtramadhīte veti vetyarthaḥ | vidyālakṣaṇeti | vidyā, lakṣaṇa,
kalpa-etadantādapi ukte'rthe ṭhagityarthaḥ | 
(|) aṅgakṣatradharmatripūrvādvidhāntānneti vaktavyam |
aṅgeti | aṅga, kṣatra, dharma, tri-etatpūrvakādvidyāntātsamāsāṭṭhak
netyarthaḥ | tataśca aṇeva | trividyā iti |
śākapārthivāditvādvidhāśabdasya lopa iti bhāvaḥ | tisro vidyāstrividyā
iti na vigrahaḥ, ṭhdiksaṅkhye saṃjñāyā'miti niyamāt | nāpi tisro
vidyā adhīte veda veti taddhitārthe dviguḥ, tathā sati taddhitasya
dvigunimitatayā ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti lugāpateḥ | tisṛṇāṃ
vidyānāṃ samāhara iti dvigurapyatra nirbādha eva | 
(|) ākhyānākhyāyiketihāsapurāṇebhyaśca |
ākhyāneti | ākhyāna, ākhyāyikā, itihāsa, purāṇa-ebhyaśca ukte'rthe
ṭhagvaktavya ityarthaḥ | tatra ākhyānaśabdena ākyāyikāśabdena ca
ākhyānaviśeṣavācina ākhyāyikāviśeṣavācinaśca grahaṇam | itihāsa
purāṇaśabdayostu svarūpayoreva grahaṇam | ākhyānaṃ nāma
kathāprabandhaḥ | ṭhākhyāyikopalabdhārthā purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇa'mityamaraḥ |
ṭhitihāsaḥ purāvṛta'miti ca | ṭhsargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo
manvantarāṇi ca | vaṃśānucaritaṃ ceti purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣamam | tatra
ākhyānādudāharati--yavakrītamiti | ākhyāyikāyā
udāharati--vāsavadatāmiti | lugvaktavya iti | ṭhuktapratyayasye'ti śeṣaḥ
| 
(|) sarvādeḥ sādeśca lugvaktavyaḥ |
sarvaveda iti | aṇo luki ādivṛddhyabhāvaḥ | sarvatantra iti |
sarvatantrāṇyadhīte veda vetyarthaḥ | savāŚtaka iti | vārtikena saha
savārtikam | ṭhtena sahe'ti bahuvrīhi | ṭhvaupasarjanasye'ti sabhāvaḥ
| savārtikaṃ sūtramadhīte ityarthaḥ | dvigoriti | dve tantre adhīte
veti vetyarthe taddhitārthe dvigunimitatvādaṇo luki
ādivṛddhyabhāve ṭhdvitantra' iti rūpamityarthaḥ | 
(|) ikanpadotarapadāccchataṣaṣṭeḥ ṣikanpathaḥ | 
ikanpadotarapadāditi | padaśabda utarapadaṃ yasya sa padotarapadaḥ,
tasmādukte'rthe ikanpratyayo vaktavyaḥ | śataṣaṣṭeḥ ṣikanpatha iti |
śataśabdātṣaṣṭiśabdācca paro yaḥ pathinśabdastasmādukterthe
ṣikanpratyayo vaktavya ityarthaḥ | pūrvapadika iti | pūrvapadamadhīte
veti vetyarthaḥ | evamutarapadikaḥ | śatapathika iti | śatapathaṃ nāma
vājasaneyibrāhmaṇaṃ | tadadhīte veti vetyarthaḥ | śatapathikīti |
ṣitvānṅīṣiti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ ṣaṣṭhipathikaḥ | ṣaṣṭipathikīti |

(1253) vasantādibhyaṣṭhak |4|2|63|

(1254) proktālluk |4|2|64|

(1255) gāthividathikeśigaṇipaṇinaśca |6|4|165|
gāthividathi | ṭhinaṇyanapatye' ityato'ṇītyanuvartate |
ṭhprakṛtyaikā'jityataḥ prakṛtyeti ca | tadāha--ete'ṇi prakṛtyā
syuriti | gāthin, vidathin, keśin, gaṇin, paṇin-ete
ityarthaḥ | apatye'pyaṇi prakṛtibhāvārthamidam | tato yūnyapatye iti
| mūlaprakṛtipaṇī | tadapekṣayā caturthe'patye yūni vivakṣite
pāṇinaśabdādgotrā'ṇantādata iñi pāṇiniriti rūpamityarthaḥ |
pāṇina śabdasya anantarāpatyapratyayāntatve tu tato'nantarāpatye
mūlaprakṛtipaṇyapekṣayā tṛtīye gotrāpatye iñna saṃbhavati, ṭheko
gotre' iti niyamāt | nāpi mūlaprakṛtyapekṣayā caturthā'patye
yūni pāṇinaśabdādanantarāpatyapratyayāntādiñsaṃbhavati,
ṭhgotrādyaūnyastriyā'miti yūnyapatye
gotrapratyayāntādevā'patyapratyayaniyamāt | ato
gotrā'ṇpratyayāntātpāṇinaśabdādyaūni iñpratyaya ityuktamiti bodhyam
