(1256) ṇyakṣatriyārṣañito yūni lugaṇiñoḥ |2|4|58|
atra iño lukamāśaṅkitumāha--ṇyakṣitriyārṣa | ṇyādayaḥ sarve
gotrapratyayā eva gṛhyante, ṭhgotrādyaūnī'tyukteḥ |
tadāha--gotrapratyayāntādityādi | ṇyapratyayasyodāharati--kauravya
iti | kurorgotrāpatyaṃ kauravyaḥ | ṭhkurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ' |
kauravyasyāpatyaṃ yuvetyarthe'ta iñ | tasyānena luk |
kṣatriyapratyayasyodāharati--śvāphalka iti | śvaphalkasya gotrāpatyaṃ
śvāphalkaḥ | ṭhṛṣyandhake'tyaṇ | śvāphalkasyāpatyaṃ yuvetyarthe ṭhata iñ' |
tasyā'nena luk | ārṣapratyayasyodāharati--vāsiṣṭha iti | vasiṣṭhasya
gotrāpatyaṃ vāsiṣṭhaḥ | ṛṣyaṇ | vāsiṣṭhasyāpatyaṃ yuvetyarthe iñ |
tasyānena luk | ñita udāharati--taikāyaniriti | tikasya
gotrāpatyaṃ taikāyani | tikādibhyaḥ phiñ | taikāyanerapatyaṃ
yuvetyarthe tasyāpatyamityaṇ | tasyānena luk | vāmarathyasyeti |
vāmarathasya gotrāpatyaṃ vāmarathyaḥ | ṭhkurvādibhyo ṇyaḥ' vāmarathyasya
chātrā ityarthe ṭhkaṇvādibhyo gotre' iti chāpavādo'ṇ, tasyānena
luṅga bhavati, tasya yuvārthakatvā'bhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | ityaṇo luktu
na bhavatīti | ṭhṇyakṣatriye'ti sūtreṇa pāṇinirityatra [aṇaḥ parasyaṭiṇo
luṅna bhavatītyarthaḥ | kuta ityata āha--ārṣagrahaṇeneti |
pāṇiniśabde paṇinśabdādaṇpratyayasya āṬtsargikasya vastugatyā
ṛṣivācitve'pi ṛṣau pratipadoktatvā'bhāvānna tataḥ parasya iño
lugiti bhāvaḥ | naca paṇinśabdādgotrāpatye ṭhṛṣyandhake'tyaṇeva
kuto na syāditi vācyaṃ, yatra āṬtsargikasya aṇa iñādinā bādhaḥ
prasaktaḥ, tatraiva tadvādhanārthabhṛṣyaṇaḥ pravṛteḥ | vastutastu
ṭhvā'nyasminsapiṇḍe' iti sūtrabhāṣye'triśabdāt ṭhitaścāniñaḥ' iti
ḍhaki ātreyaśabdādiño ṭhṇyakṣatriyārṣe'ti
lu'gityuktatvādidamupekṣyam | ṭhṇyakṣatriye'tyatra tu ṛśivācakasya
rūñasyaiva grahaṇam | paṇinśabdaḥ, tadapatye pāṇinaśabdaśca na
ṛṣivācakau | ata āṬtsargikāṇanta eva pāṇinaśabda iti

samāsaprasaṅgādityata āha--patyartheti | yājakādau patyarthakasyaiva
bhartṛśabdasya grahaṇaṃ, vyākhyānāt | tataśca ṭhvajrasya bharte'tyatra
ṭhyājakādibhiśce'ti samāso neti bhāvaḥ | kathaṃ tarhīti | trāyāṇāṃ
bhuvanānāṃ samāhārastribhuvanaṃ | ṭhtaddhitārthe'ti dviguḥ |
ṭhakārāntotarapado dviguḥ striyā'miti tu na bhavati, ṭhpātrādyantasya
ne'tyukteḥ | ṭhtribhuvanasya vidhāte'ti tṛco yoge kathaṃ karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhaḷa samāsa ityākṣepaḥ | pariharati--śeṣaṣaṣṭhaḷeti | pratyāsatyā
kārakaṣaṣṭhaḷa evāyaṃ niṣedha iti bahuṣviti sūtre kaiyaṭa āhetyarthaḥ |

(700) kartari ca |2|2|16|
kartari ca | kartarītyetatṣaṣṭhītyanuvṛte'nyeti | tadāha--kartari
ṣaṣṭhaḷa iti | akeneti | ṭhtṛjakābhyāṃ kartarī'tyatastadanuvṛteriti
bhāvaḥ | bhavataḥ śāyiketi | ṭhstriyāṃ kti'nnityadhikāre
dhātvarthanirdeaśe ṇvul, akādeśaḥ, ṭāp | ṭhkartṛkarmaṇo'riti
kartari ṣaṣṭhī | atra akasya kartrarthakatvā'bhāvāt ṭhtṛjakābhyā'mityasya
na prāptiḥ | nanu pūrvasūtre ṭhtṛjakābhyā'miti
samastapadopādānātkathamihā'kasyaivānuvṛtiḥ, na tu tṛca ityata
āha-neheti | tadyoge iti | tṛcaḥ kartari vihitatvena ṭhsraṣṭāṃ
kṛṣṇa' ityādau kartuḥ kṛtābhihitatayā tatra kartari ṣaṣṭhaḷa
evā'prasaktyā tatsamāsaniṣedhasya ṭhśaśaśrṛṅgeṇa kaṇḍūayanaṃ na
kartavya'mitivadasaṃbhavaparāhatatvādityarthaḥ | 
(701)nityaṃ krīḍājīvikayoḥ |2|2|17|

ktin' ityadhikāre ṭhsaṃjñāyā'miti bhāve ṇvulityarthaḥ | atra karmaṇi
ṣaṣṭhÂayāḥ samāsaḥ | vastutastu ṭhstriyāṃ kti' nnityadhikāre

(702) pūrvāparādharotaramekadeśinaikādhikaraṇe|2|2|1|
pūrvāpara | ṭhpūrvāparādharotara'miti samāharadvandvātprathamaikavacanam
| ekadeśaśabdo'vayave rūḍhaḥ | ekadeśo'syāstītyekadeśī-avayavī,
teneti labhyate | adhikaraṇaṃudravyam | ekamadhikaraṇam-ekādhikaraṇam
| ekatvaviśiṣṭadravye vartamāne'vayavivācakasubantena
pūrvāparādharotaraśabdāḥ subantāḥ samasyante, sa tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ |
phalitamāha-avayavinā sahetyādinā | nanu pūrvaścāsau kāyaśceti

āha--ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavāda iti | pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti vigrahe ṭhṣaṣṭhī'ti

| pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti | atra pūrvaṃ kāyasyeti vigrahavākyam | ṭhardha'miti

nirdeaśādavayavavṛtidikśabdayoge pañcamyabhāvātṣaṣṭhī | pūrvakāya
iti | pūrvaśabdasya samāsavidhau prathamānirdhiṣṭatvāt pūrvanipātaḥ |
ṭhparavalliṅga'miti puṃstvamiti bhāvaḥ | ṭhyatrotsargāpavādau

pravartate' iti ṭhpāre madhye ṣaṣṭhaḷa ve'tyatroktam | tataśca
ekadeśisamāsā'bhāve ṣaṣṭhīsamāso na bhavati | 
aparakāya iti | aparaṃ kāyasyeti vigrahaḥ | aparakāyaḥ | utarakāyaḥ |
ekadeśinā kimiti | ekadravyavācinā pūrvādayaḥ samasyanta
ityevāstvityarthaḥ | pūrvaṃ nābheḥ kāyasyeti | atra ṭhnābhe'riti
pūrvaśabde'nveti | digyoge pañcamī | nābhyapekṣayā yat
pūrvamarddhaṃ tat kāyāvayavabhūtamityarthaḥ | atra nābhiśabdasya
pūrvāṃśe'nvayaḥ | atra pūrvasyāṃśaya nābhiravadhireva, na tvavayavī |
ato nābhiśabdena pūrvaśabdasya samāso na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
pūrvaśchātrāṇāmiti | atra chātraśabdaḥ chātrasamudāyaparaḥ |
udbhūtāvayavasamudāyāpekṣaṃ bahuvacanam |
avayavāvayavibhāvasambandhe ṣaṣṭhī | chātrasamudāyasya pūrvamardhamityarthaḥ
| atra chātrasamudāyasya ekatve'pi udbhūtāvavayakatayā
bahutvādekasaṃkhyāvaiśiṣṭaḷa'bhāvānna samāsa iti bhāvaḥ | nanu ahno
madhyaṃ madhyāhna ityatra kathamekadeśisamāsaḥ, madhyaśabdasya
pūrvādiṣvanantarbhāvādityata āha--sarvo'pyekadeśa iti |
pūrvādibhinno'pītyarthaḥ | jñāpakāditi | ṭhtatpuruṣasye'ti
ṭhahassarvaikadeśasaṃkhyātapuṇyācce'ti ca prakṛte,-ṭhahno'hna etebhyaḥ'
ityekadeśavācakātparasyā'hanśabdasyā'hnādeśo vidhīyate |
tataścāhnaḥ sāya iti vigrahe avayavivṛtinā ahanśabdena ṣaṣṭhaḷntena
avayavavṛtisāyaśabdasya tatpuruṣasamāse sati
pratamānirdiṣṭatvātsāyaśabdasya pūrvanipāte sati
ekadeśavṛtisāyaśabdātparasyā'hanśabdasyā'hnādeśe rātrāhnāhāḥ
puṃsīti puṃstveṭhsāyāhna' iti bhavati | tasmātsaptamyekavacane pare
ṭhsaṅkyāvisāye'ti sāyaśabdapūrvakasyāhnaśabdasyā'hannādeśavikalpa
uktaḥ | sāyāhni, sāyāhani, sāyāhne ityudāharaṇam | tatra ahnaḥ sāya
iti vigrahe yadi sāyaśabdasya pūrvādyapraviṣṭatvādahanśabdena samāso
na syāt tadā ṭhṣaṣṭhī' iti sūtreṇa ahanśabdasya ṣaṣṭhaḷntasya sāyaśabdena
samāse sati ṣaṣṭhaḷntasyaiva samāsaśāstre pratamānirdiṣṭatvāt
pūrvanipāte sati sāyaśabdātparasyāhnaśabdasyā'hannādeśavidhānaṃ
nirviṣayaṃ syāt, ataḥ ṭhsarvo'pyekadeśo'hnā samasyate' iti
vijñāyate ityarthaḥ | madhyāhna iti | ahno madhyamiti vigrahe'yaṃ
samāsaḥ | ṭhrājāhaḥsakhibhyaṣṭac' iti ṭac | ṭhahno'hna etebhyaḥ'
ityahnādeśaḥ | sāyāhna iti | ahnaḥ sāya iti vigrahaḥ | madhyāhnavat |
nanu ṭhsarvo'pyekadeśaḥ kālena samasyate' ityayuktaṃ,
ṭhsaṃkhyāvisāye'ti sūtre'hantaśabdasyaivaupātatayā
taditarakālavācinā sarvasyaikadeśasya samāsajñāpana#a'nupapaterityata
āha--jñāpakasyeti | ahanśabdena saha sāyaśabdasya ekadeśisamāsaṃ
siddhavatkṛtya
sāyaśabdādahnaśabdopādānātsarveṇāpyavayavivṛtikālavācinā
sarvasyaikadeśasya samāso jñāpyate, jñāpakasya sāmānyā pekṣatvāt,
natvahanśabdena sāyaśabdasyaiva pūrvādyapraviṣṭatve'pi samāso jñāpyata
iti bhāvaḥ | madhyarātra iti | rātrermadhyamityarthaḥ | paścimarātreti |
rātreḥ paścimamiti vigrahaḥ | ṭhahaḥ sarvaikadeśe'tyacsamāsāntaḥ |

(715) pūrvakālaikasarvajaratpurāṇanavakevalāḥ samānādhikaraṇena
|2|1|49|
pūrvakālaika | ṭhsu'bityanuvṛtaṃ bahuvacanena vipariṇamyate |
supeti cānuvartate | pūrvaḥ kālo yasya sa pūrvakālaḥ |
pūrvakālavṛtirityarthaḥ | tataśca ṭhpūrvakāle'tyanena
pūrvakālavṛtyarthakaśabdasya grahaṇam | ekādiśabdāstu ṣaṭ svarūpaparā
eva | tathāca pūrvakālādayaḥ saptasubantāḥ samānādhikaraṇena
subantena samasyante, sa tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ | samānam-ekam
adhikaraṇaṃuvācyaṃ yasyeti vigrahaḥ | ekārthavṛtitvaṃ
sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti phalitam | pūrvanipāteti | paścādanuliptaḥ
pūrvaṃ snātatvena, pūrvaṃ snāto vā paścādanuliptatvena viśeṣṭuṃa
śakyate, ato ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇe'ti samāse sati anyatarasya
pūrvanipāte prāpte pūrvakālavṛtiśabdasyaiva pūrvanipātārthamidaṃ
vacanam | evamekādīnāmapītyarthaḥ | ekaśabdaviṣaye
prayojanāntaramapyāha--ekaśabdasyeti | ṭhdiksaṃkhye saṃjñāyāṃ
samasyete' iti niyamasya vakṣyamāṇatayā ṭhekanātha' ityatra
viśeṣaṇasamāsasya bādhe prāpte tatpratiprasavārthamapyekagrahaṇamityarthaḥ
| snātānulipta iti | vigrahavākyavadiha pūrvapaścāccchabdā'bhāve'pi
snānānulepanayoḥ paurvāparyaṃ samāsagamyameva | ṭhpūrvakālaḥ
samasyate' ityukte parakālenetyarthātpratīteḥ | ekanātha iti |
ekaścāsau nāthaśceti vigrahaḥ | sarvayājñikā iti | yajñamadhīyate
vidanti vā yājñikāḥ | ṭhkratūkthādisūtrāntāṭṭhak' | sarve ca te
yājñikāśceti vigrahaḥ | jarannaiyāyikā iti | mīmāṃsāmadhīyate
mīmāṃsakāḥ | ṭhkramādibhyo vun' | purāṇaśca te mīmāṃsakāśceti
vigrahaḥ | navapāṭhakā iti | navāśca te pāṭhakāśceti vigrahaḥ | atra
purāṇasāhacaryānnavaśabdo nūtanavācyeva gṛhyate, na tu
saṅkhyāviśeṣavācī | kevalavaiyakaraṇā iti | vyākaraṇamadhīyate
vidanti vā vaiyākaraṇāḥ | ṭhtadadhīte tadvede'tyaṇ | na yvābhyā'miti
vṛddhiniṣedha aijāgamaśca | kevalāśca te vaiyākaraṇāśceti vigrahaḥ | 
(716) diksaṃṅkhye saṃjñāyām |2|1|50|
diksaṃkhye | adhikāra iti | ṭhpūrvakālaike'ti sūtrasthaṃ
ṭhsamānādhikaraṇene'tyetadā pādasamāpteranuvartata ityarthaḥ | tataśca
diksaṅkhye samānādhikaraṇena subantena samasyete, sa tatpuruṣa
ityarthaḥ | nanu ṭhviśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇe'ti yadi diksaṅkhyayossamāsaḥ
syātarhi saṃjñāyāmeve'ti niyamaśarīrābhyupagamāt | ṭhpūrvasūtraṃ'
ṭhpūrvamāsaḥ' ṭhpūrvasamudraḥ' ityādau tu saṃjñātvā'bhāve'pi
kāladeśavācakatvāt samāso bhavatyeva | nanu ṭhtrilokanāthaḥ
pitṛsadmagocaraḥ' iti kathaṃ kālidāsaprayogaḥ, trilokaśabdasya
asaṃjñātvāt | trayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ samāhāra iti vigrahe ṭhtaddhitārtha'
iti dvigusamāse tu ṭhdvigoḥ' iti ṅīpprasaṅgaḥ |
ṭhakārāntotarapado dviguḥ striyāmiṣṭaḥ' iti strīliṅgatvāt |
pātrāditvānna strītvamityabhyupagame ṭhyadi trilokī gaṇanāparā
syā'dityādiprayogā na yujyeranniti cetsatyam | lokaśabdo'tra
lokasamudāyaparaḥ | tyavayavo lokastriloka iti madhyamapadalopī
samāsaḥ | etacca ṭhdvigorluganapatye' iti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam |
ṭhṣoḍaśapadārthānā'mityatra tu ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākāḥ padārthā iti
madhyamapadalopī samāsa ityalam | pūrveṣukāmaśamīti | pūrvaśabdasya
iṣukāmaśamīśabdena samāsaḥ | deśaviśeṣasya saṃjñeyam | saptarṣaya
iti | marīcyatriprabhṛtīnāṃ saptānāmṛṣīṇāṃ saṃjñeyam | neheti |
asaṃjñātvāditi bhāvaḥ | 
(717) taddhitārthotarapadasamāhāre ca |2|1|51|
taddhitārtha | ekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhidyate | tatra
taddhitārthetyaṃśe vaiṣayikādhāratve vartate | utarapadetyaṃśe
sāmīpikamādhāratvamādāya parasaptamī paryavasyati | samāhārāṃśe tu
vācyatayā ādhāratve saptamī | pūrvasūtrāddiksaṃkhye ityanuvartate |
tadāha--taddhitārthe viṣaye iti | taddhitārthe
bhaviṣyataddhitajanyajñānaviṣaye satītyarthaḥ | taddhite bhaviṣyatīti
yāvat | prāgvaditi | samānādhikaraṇena samasyate sa tatpuruṣa
ityarthaḥ | taddhitārthe diksamāsamudāharati--pūrvasyāmiti | samāse
kṛte iti | pūrvasyāṃ śālāyāṃ bhava iti vigrahe ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti
samāse kṛte ṭhdikpūrvapadā'diti ñapratyate kṛte ṭhyasyeti
ce'tyākāralope ādivṛddhiriti bhāvaḥ | 
(|) sarvanāmno vṛtimātre puṃvadbhāvaḥ | 
sarvanāmna iti | mātraśabdaḥ kārtsnye |
samāsataddhitādivṛtigatasarvanāmnāṃ puṃvatvamiti tadarthaḥ | yadi tu
ṭhtaddhite pare diksaṅkhye samasyete' ityucyate, tarhi utpanne taddhite
samāsaḥ, samāse kṛte dikpūrvapadatvātaddhita ityanyonyāśrayaprasaṅgaḥ
| ṭhtaddhitārthe vācye diksaṃkhye samasyete' iti tu na vyākhyātaṃ,
taddhitārthasya taddhitavācyatayā samāsārthatvā'bhāvāt | atastaddhite
bhaviṣyatītyeva vyākhyātumucitam | āparaśāla iti | aparasyāṃ
śālāyāṃ bhava iti vigrahaḥ | samāsādi paurvaśālavat | 
utarapade parato diksamāsamudāharati-pūrvā śālā priyā
yasyetyādinā | nanu bahuvrīhisamāse kṛte supāṃ
luptatvādutarapade parataḥ pūrvayoḥ kimanena samāsenetyata
āha--tena śālāśabde ākāra udāta iti | avāntaratatpuruṣe sati
samāsāntodātatvena lakārādākāra udāta ityarthaḥ | asati
tvavāntaratatpuruṣe pūrvapadaprakṛtisvareṇādyaudātatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
| nanu pūrveṣāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ samāhāra ityatrāpi samāsaḥ syādityata
āha--dikṣviti | dikṣu samāhāro dviguviṣayo na bhavatītyarthaḥ |
samāhāre dikpūrvapadasamāso nāstīti yāvat | 
saṅkhyāyāstaddhitārthe iti | samāsa udāhriyata ityarthaḥ | tatra taddhitārthe
udāharati-ṣāṇmātura iti | māturutsahkhyāsambhadrapūrvāyāḥ' ityaṇ,
prakṛterukāraścādeśaḥ, ādivṛddhiśca | atha utarapade parata
udāharati-pañcagāva iti | avāntaratatpuruṣasyeti | utarapade parato
vihitasyetyarthaḥ | vikalpe prāpte iti | ṭhmahāvibhāṣādhikārā'diti
śeṣaḥ | tataśca pañcagośabdayostatpuruṣā'bhāvapakṣe
ṭhgorataddhitalukī'ti tatpuruṣaprayuktaṭajabhāve ṭhpañcagodhana' ityapi
syāditi bhāvaḥ | 
(|) dvandvatatpuruṣayorutarapade nityasamāsavacanam | 
dvandvatatpuruṣayoriti | utarapade parato yau dvandvatatpuruṣau
tayornityatvaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ | samāsagrahaṇaṃ tu saṃpātāyātam,
ananvayāt, utarapade parataḥ samāsasaṃjñayā avyabhicārācca,
utarapadaśabdasya samāsotarakhaṇḍe rūḍhatvāt | 
(718) gorataddhitaluki |5|4|92|
gorataddhitaluki |
ṭhtatpuruṣasyāṅgule'rityatastatpuruṣasyetyanuvṛtaṃ pañcamyā
vipariṇataṃ gorityanena viśeṣyate | tadantavidhiḥ |ṭhrājāhaḥ
sakhibhyaḥ' ityataṣṭajityanuvartate | ṭhsamāsānta' ityadhikṛtam |
tadāha--go'ntādityādinā | ataddhitalukīti kim ?| pañcabhirgobhiḥ
krītaḥ pañcaguḥ | atra taddhitasya ṭhadhyardhe'ti luk | pañcagavadhana iti |
tripadabahuvrīhau kṛte sati dhanaśabde utarapade pare
pūrvayostatpuruṣe ṭaci avādeśa iti bhāvaḥ | atra
ṭhdvandvatatpuruṣayo'riti vārtike dvandvasyodāharaṇaṃ tu vāk ca tvak
ca priyā yasya sa vāktvacapriya iti bodhyam | iha tripadabahuvrīhau
kṛte pūrvayornityadvandvaḥ | tena ṭhdvandvāccudaṣahāntātsamāhāre'
iti ṭajapi nitya eva | na ca vāktvakcchabdayoḥ
parasparasāmānādhikaraṇyā'bhāvātkathamiha tripadabahuvrīhiriti
vācyaṃ, dvayoḥ priyāśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyamādāya tadupapateḥ |
saptamīviśeṣaṇe bahuvrīhau' iti jñāpakena ṭhkaṇṭhekāla' ityādāviva
vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīhisaṃbhavācca | ṭhvāktvacapriyaḥ' iti bhāṣye
udāharaṇamevātra liṅgamityalam | atha samāhāre udāhartuṃ vigrahaṃ
darśayati--pañcānāṃ gavāṃ samāhāra iti |

(720) dvigurekavacanam |2|4|1|

(721) kutsitāni kutsanaiḥ |2|1|53|
kutsitāni | vartamāne ktaḥ, vyākhyānāt | tadāha--kutsyamānānīti
| kutsanairiti karaṇe lyuṭ | prāgvaditi | samānādhikaraṇena

pūrvanipātaniyamārthamidaṃ sūtramityarthaḥ | pāpanāpita iti |
pāpaścāsau nāpitaśceti vigrahaḥ | aṇakakulāla iti | aṇakaścāsau
kulālaśceti vigrahaḥ | 
(723) upamānāni sāmānyavacanaiḥ |2|1|55|
upamānāni | upamīyante sadṛśatayā pariccchidyante yaistāni--upamānāni
| sādṛśyanirūpakāṇītyarthaḥ |
sāmānyamuupamānopameyasādhāraṇadharmaḥ, tamuktavantaḥ śabdāḥ
sāmānyavacanāḥ | bāhulakaḥ kartari lyuṭ | pūrvaṃ sāmānyamuktvā
tadviti dravye ye paryavasyanti te sāmānyavacanā iti yāvat | tathāca
sādṛśyanirūpakaśabdā'paraparyāyā upamānaśabdā
upamānopameyasādhāraṇadharmaviśiṣṭavācibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇaiḥ
samasyante sa tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ | ghanaśyāma iti | nanviha ghana iva śyāma
iti vigrahe ghanaśabdasya śyāmaśabdasya
caikārthavṛtitvalakṣaṇasāmānādhikaraṇyā'bhāvātkathamiha samāsaḥ,
ivaśabdāpekṣatvenā'sāmarthyāccetyata āha--iha pūrvapadamiti | evaṃ ca
ghanaśabdo lakṣaṇayā ghanasadṛśe rāme vartate, śyāmaśabdo'pi rāme
vartata iti sāmānādhikaraṇyam | ata eva mṛgīva capalā
mṛgacapaletyatra ṭhpuṃvatkarmadhāraye'ti puṃvatvaṃ sidhyati | ghanaśabdasya
bhūtapūrvagatyopamānaparatvaṃ nirvāhyam | tathāca ṭhghanasadṛśaśyāmaḥ'
iti bodhaḥ | sādṛśyaṃ tadbhinnatve sati tadgatadharmavatvam | evaṃca
sādṛśyapratiyogyanuyoginoḥ sādhāraṇadharmavatvaṃ labdham | sa ceha
sādhāraṇadharma utarapadopasthāpya eva gṛhyate, saṃnihitatvāt | tathāca
ghanagataśyāmatvasadṛśaśyāmatvavāniti bodhaparyavasānam | nanu
viśeṣaṇasamāsena siddhe kimarthamidaṃ sūtramityata
āha--pūrvanipāteti | anyathā ubhayorapi guṇavacanatayā
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve kāmacārātkhañjakubjaḥ kubjakhañja itivadaniyamaḥ
syāditi bhāvaḥ | 
(724) upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ sāmānyā'prayoge |2|1|56|
upamitam | prāgvaditi | samānādhikaraṇaiḥ samasyate sa tatpuruṣa
ityarthaḥ | atropamitasya
nityamupamānākāṅkṣatvādupamānabhūtavyāghrādibhirityarthasiddham |
nanu viśeṣaṇasamāsenaiva siddhe kimarthamidaṃ sūtramityata
āha-viśeṣyasyeti | upamānopameyasamabhivyāhāre upamānasyaiva
viśeṣaṇatvātpūrvanipāte prāpte viśeṣyasya
pūrvanipātanārthamidamityarthaḥ | puruṣavyāghra iti | puruṣo vyāghra
iveti vigrahaḥ | atra sādṛśyopapādakaḥ śauryātmakaḥ sādhāraṇadharmaḥ, sa
iha nopāta iti bhavati samāsaḥ | puruṣovyāghra iva śūra iti |
śauryeṇa vyāghrasadṛśa iti yāvat | atra
śauryasyopamānopameyasādhāraṇadharmasya prayogānna samāsa iti bhāvaḥ
| ṭhbhāṣyābdhiḥ kvātigambhīraḥ' iti kaiyaṭaprayogastu
mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamādheyaḥ | bāṣyamevābdhiriti rūpakaṃ vā | na
ca puruṣaśabdasya śūraśabdasāpekṣatvādasāmarthyādevātra samāsasya na
pravṛtiḥ, ataḥ ṭhsāmānyā'prayoge' iti vyarthamiti vācyaṃ,
samasyamāneṣvapradhānasyaiva hi sāpekṣatvaṃ sāmarthyavighātakaṃ na tu
pradhānasya | tathācā'tra puruṣasya pradhānatayā tasya śūrāpekṣatve'pi
astyeva sāmarthyamiti samāsapravṛteḥ, tannivṛtyarthaṃ sāmānyā'prayoga
iti vacanam | idameva ṭhpradhānasya sāpekṣatve'pi na
sāmarthyavighātakatva'miti jñāpayati | tena ṭhrājapuruṣaḥ sundara'
ityādau samāsaḥ siddho bhavatīti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | 
(725) viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa bahulam |2|1|57|
viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa | viśiṣyate aneneti viśeṣaṇam,
itarasmādvyāvartakam | vyāvartyaṃ tu viśeṣyaṃ bhinnatvena
jñāyamānam | samānādhikaraṇenetyadhikṛtam | tadāha--bhedakamiti
prāgvaditi | samasyate sa tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ | nīlotpalamiti |
nīlapadaṃ tāvadutpalamanīlādutpalādvyāvartayatīti
viśeṣaṇasamarpakam | tasya utpalapadena viśeṣya samarpakeṇa samāsaḥ |
pratamānirdiṣṭatvādviśeṣaṇasyapūrvanipāta iti bhāvaḥ | naca
utpalapadamanutpalānnīlaṃ vyāvartayatītyutpalapadasyāpi viśeṣaṇatvaṃ
syāditi vācyaṃ, jātiśabdo guṇakriyāśabdasamabhivyāhāre
viśeṣyasamarpaka eva, na tu viśeṣaṇa samarpakaḥ, svabhāvāt |
yathā-ṭhnīlotpalaṃ' ṭhpācakabrāhmaṇa' iti | guṇaśabdayoḥ samabhivyāhāre
viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya na niyamaḥ | yathā-khañjakubjaḥ kubjakhañja iti |
kriyāśabdayorapyaniyamaḥ | yathā-ṭhkhañjapācakaḥ' ṭhpācakakhañja' iti
-itibhāṣye spaṣṭam | tathā ṭhkailāsādriḥ' ṭhmandarādriḥ'
ṭhayodhyānagarī'tyādau saṃjñāśabdā api viśeṣaṇasamarpakā eva,
svabhāvāt | sāmānyajāti-viśeṣajātiśabdayoḥ samabhivyāhāre tu
viśeṣajātireva viśeṣaṇam | ṭhśiṃśapāvṛkṣa' ityādi jñeyam | nanu
vāgrahaṇena siddhe bahulagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamityata āha--bahulagrahaṇāditi
| 
(726) pūrvāparaprathamacaramajaghanyasamānamadhyamadyamavīrāśca |2|1|58|
pūrvāpara | pūrvādaya samānādhikaraṇena samasyante ityarthaḥ |
viśeṣaṇasamāsenaiva siddhe kimarthamidamityata āha-pūrvanipāteti |
aparādhyāpaka iti | bahulagrahaṇānuvṛtyā pācakādikriyāśabdaiḥ
pūrvādīnāmeṣāṃ na samāsa iti samarthasūtre bhāṣye sthitam | tataśca
ṭhaparādhyāpakaḥ' ityudāharaṇamupekṣyam | ṭhaparamīmāṃsaka'
ityudāharaṇamucitam | 
(|)aparasyārddhe paścabhāvo vaktavyaḥ | 
aparasyārdhe iti | ṭhpaścā'diti sūtrabhāṣye idaṃ vārtikaṃ sthitam |
prathamavaiyakaraṇaḥ | caramavaiyākaraṇaḥ | ṭhmacyānmaḥ' | madhyamavaiyākaraṇaḥ
| vīravaiyākaraṇaḥ | ākṣipati-kathamekavīra iti | hiuyataḥ,
anenauprakṛtasūtreṇa, vīraśabdasyaikaśabdena samāse sati vīraśabdasya
pūrvanipāte sati vīraika iti syāt, ataḥ ṭhekavīraḥ' iti
kathamityanvayaḥ | nanu ṭhpūrvakālaike'ti sūtreṇaikaśabdasya vīraśabdena
samāse sati ṭhekavīraḥ' iti nirbādhamityata āha--pūrvakālaiketi
bādhitvā paratvāditi | pariharati--bāhulatāditi |
bahulagrahaṇānuvṛterasya sūtrasyā'pravṛtau ṭhpūrvakāle'tyeva samāso
bhavatītyarthaḥ | 
(727) śreṇyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ |2|1|59|
śreṇyādayaḥ | śremyādayaḥ kṛtādibhiḥ samānādhikaraṇaiḥ samasyante sa
tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ | 
(|) śreṇyādiṣu cvyarthavacanaṃ kartavyam | 
śreṇyādiṣviti | śreṇyādiṣu samāsavidhau cvyarthavacanaṃ |
cvipratyayārthe'bhūtatadbhāve gamye śreṇyādīnāṃ samāso vaktavya
ityarthaḥ | aśremaya iti | śilpena paṇyena vā jīvināṃ samūhāḥ-śreṇayaḥ
| pūrvaṃ śilpena paṇyena vā jīvitumasamarthā idānīṃ tena jīvituṃ
samarthāḥ kṛtā ityarthe samāse sati ṭhśreṇikṛtāḥ' iti bhavatītyarthaḥ |
śreṇiśabdo hrasvāntaḥ, bhāṣye tathaivodāharaṇāt | yadā tu siddhā eva
śreṇayaḥ pariṣkṛtāstadā tu na samāsaḥ, cvyarthā'bhāvāt |
cvipratyayāntasya tu paratvāt ṭhkugatī'ti nityasamāsaḥ | tataḥ
ṭhcvau ce'ti śreṇiśabdasya dīrghaḥ | 
(728) ktena nañviśiṣṭenā'nañ |2|1|60|
ktena nañviśiṣṭenānañ | nañviśiṣṭena ktāntena
samānādhikaraṇena saha nañrahitaṃ ktāntaṃ samasyate, tatpuruṣa ityarthaḥ
| kṛtaṃ ca taditi | ekadeśasya karaṇātkṛtam,
ekadeśāntarasyā'karaṇātadevā'kṛtam | pūrvanipātaniyamārtham |
siddhaṃ ca tadabhuktaṃ cetyatra tu nāyaṃ samāsaḥ, viśiṣṭaśabdo
hyatrādhikavācī | yathā ṭhdevadatādyajñadataḥ svādhyāyena viśiṣṭa' ityukte
adhika iti gamyate | nañaiva viśiṣṭaṃ | nañmātrādhikena ktānteneti
labhyate | evaṃca samānaprakṛtikatvaṃ ktāntayoḥ paryavasannamiti
bodhyam | 
(|) śākapārthivādīnāṃ siddhaye utarapadalopasyopasaṅkhyānam |
śākapārthivādīnāmiti | ṭhvarṇo varṇene'ti sūtrabhāṣye idaṃ vārtikaṃ
paṭhitam | śākapārthiva iti | śākaḥ priyo yasya sa śākapriyaḥ | ṭhvā
priyasye'ti priyaśabdasya paranipātaḥ śākapriyaścāsau pārthivaśceti
vigrahe bahuvrīhigarbho viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ | tatra pūrvakhaṇḍe bahuvrīhau
utarapadasya priyaśabdasya lopaḥ | devabrāhmaṇa iti | devāḥ priyā yasya sa
devapriyaḥ, sa cāsau brāhmaṇaśceti vigrahaḥ | pūrvavadutarapadalopaḥ |
devapūjako brāhmaṇa iti vā vigrahaḥ | 
(729) sanmahatparamotamotkṛṣṭāḥ pūjyamānaiḥ |2|1|61|
sanmahatparama | ṭhsamānādhikaraṇaiḥ samasyante sa tatpuruṣaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ |
sadvaidya iti | san-vaidya iti vigrahaḥ |
cikitsāśāstrarakūlaṅkaṣajñānavatvaṃ satvam | tena vaidyasya pūjā
gamyate | pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ sūtram | vakṣyamāṇeneti |
mahāṃścāsau vaiyākaraṇaśceti vigrahe'nena samāse sati mahaccchabdasya
ṭhānmahataḥ' iti vakṣyamāṇena ākāre'ntādeśe savarṇadīrghe
ṭhmahāvaiyākaraṇa' iti bhavatītyarthaḥ | nanūtkṛṣṭo
gaurityatrotkṛṣṭaśabdasyā'tiśayitavācitayā tena goḥ
pūjāvagamātkathamiha samāso na bhavatītyata āha--paṅkāduddhṛta
ityartha iti | utpūrvakaḥ kṛṣadhāturihoddharaṇārthaka iti bhāvaḥ |
paramavaidyaḥ, utamavaidyaḥ, utkṛṣṭavaidyaḥ | guṇakriyāśabdaiḥ samāse
sadādīnāṃ pūrvanipātaniyamārthamidaṃ sūtram | 
(730) vṛndārakānāgakuñjaraiḥ pūjyamānam |2|1|62|

viśeṣaṇasamāsenaiva siddhe viśeṣyasya pūrvanipātaniyamārthaṃ sūtram
| govṛndāraka iti | vṛndārakaśabdo devatāvācī | ṭhamarā nirjarā
devāḥ' ityupakramyaṃ, ṭhvṛndārakā daivatānī'tyamaraḥ | gaurvṛndāraka
iveti vigrahaḥ | gaurnāga iva gonāgaḥ | gauḥ kuñjara iva gokuñjaraḥ
| nāgaśabdaḥ kuñjaraśabdaśca gajavācī | atra gaurvṛndārāditulyatvāt
śraiṣṭhaḷṃ gamyata iti pūjyamānatā | nanu vyāghrāderākṛtigaṇatvāt

bhāvaḥ | 
(731) katarakatamau jātiparipraśne |2|1|63|
katarakatamau | jātiparipraśne gamye katarakatamo samānādhikaraṇena
samasyete ityarthaḥ | katarakaṭha iti | anayo kaḥ kaṭha ityarthaḥ |
ṭhkiṃyatadornirdhāraṇe dvayorekasya ḍatarac' | kaṭhena proktamadhīte
kaṭhaḥ | vaiśampāyanāntevāsitvāt prokte ṇiniḥ |
ṭhkaṭhacarakāllu'giti tasya luk | tataḥ ṭhtadadhīte ' ityaṇaḥ
ṭhproktāllu'giti luk | katamakalāpa iti | eṣāṃ kaḥ kalāpa iti
vigrahaḥ kalāpinā proktamadhīte kalāpaḥ | ṭhkalāpino'ṇ' |
ṭhsabrahmacārī'ti ṭilopaḥ | ṭhvā bahūnāṃ jātiparipraśne ḍatamac' |
nanu ghaṭatvādivatkaṭhaśākhādhyetṛtvādikaṃ na jātiḥ, ṭhākṛtigrahaṇā
jātiḥ' iti lakṣaṇasya ṭhliṅgānāṃ ca na sarvabhāk,
sakṛdākhyātanirgrāhyā' iti lakṣaṇamasya ca tatrā'pravṛterityata
āha--gotraṃ ceti | atra katamaśabdasya jātiparipraśna eva
vyutpādanātarārthameva jātiparipraśnagrahaṇam | evaṃcā'nayoḥ kataro
devadata ityatra na bhavati samāsaḥ | ṭheṣāṃ katamo devadataḥ' iti tu
nāstyeva, jātiparipraśna eva ḍatamaco vidhānāt | vastutastu
ḍataratamavidhau dvayoriti bahūnāmiti jātiparipraśne iti
pratyākhyātaṃ bhāṣye | evaṃca ṭhkatama eṣāṃ devadata' ityapyasti | tatra
samāsā'bhāvāya jātiparipraśnagrahaṇamiti śabdenduśekhare stha#tim |

(735) puṃvatkarmadhārayajātīyadeśīyeṣu |6|3|42|
puṃvatkarmadhāraya | ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvadbhāṣitapuṃskādanū'ṅiti vartate
| ekāpi saptamī viṣayabhedādbhidyate |
karmadhārayāṃśe'dhikaraṇasaptamī | jātīyadeśīyaviṣaye parasaptamī |
tadāha--karmadhāraye iti | ṭhtathābhūta'mityanantaraṃ ṭhstrīvācaka'miti
śeṣaḥ | ṭhbhāṣitapuṃskādanū'ṅtyetit ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat' iti sūtre
sphuṭīkariṣyate | nanu karmadhāraye ṭhstriyāḥ puṃva'dityanena siddhaṃ
puṃvatvaṃ, jātīyadeśīyayostu ṭhtasilādiṣvākṛtvasucaḥ' ityanena
siddhamityata āha--pūraṇīpriyādiṣvaprāpta iti | apūraṇīpriyādiṣviti
paryudāsāditi bhāvaḥ | mahānavamīti | mahatī cāsau navamī ceti
vigrahaḥ | ṭhsanmahadi'tyādinā samāsaḥ | navānāṃ pūraṇī navamī |
ṭhtasya pūraṇe ḍaṭ'ṭhnāntādasaṃkhyādermaṭ'| ṭitvānṅīp | atra
navamīśabdasya pūraṇapratyayāntatvātasmin pare ṭhstriyāḥ puṃvat' iti
puṃvatvamaprāptamanena vidhīyate | kṛte puṃvatve ṭhānmahataḥ'
ityātvamiti bhāvaḥ | kṛṣṇacaturdaśīti | caturdaśānāṃ
pūraṇī-caturdaśī | ḍaṭa | ṭhnastaddhite' iti ṭilopaḥ | ṭitvānṅīp
| kṛṣṇā cāsau caturdaśī ceti vigrahaḥ | mahāpriyeti | mahatī
cāsau priyā ceti karmadhārayaḥ | atrāpi
priyādiparyudāsādaprāptamanena vidhīyata iti bhāvaḥ | 
ṭhpuṃvatkarmadhāraya' ityasya prayojanāntaramāha--tathā kopadhāderiti |
ṭhna koradhāyāḥ' ṭhsaṃjñīpūraṇyośca' ṭhvṛddhinimitasya ca
taddhitasyā'raktavikāre' ṭhsvāṅgāccetaḥ' ṭhjāteśce'ti pañcasūtryā
pratiṣiddha ityarthaḥ | karmadhārayādāviti | karmadhāraye
jātīyadeśīyayośca parayorityarthaḥ | pācakastrīti | pācikā cāsau
strī ceti karmadhārayaḥ | atra ṭhna kopadhāyāḥ' iti puṃvatvasya
pratiṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ | databhāryā pañcamabhāryeti datā cāsau bhāryā
ceti, pañcamī cāsau bhāryā ceti ca karmadhārayaḥ | atra
ṭhsaṃjñāpūraṇyośce'ti pratiṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ | sraugghnabhāryeti |
sraugghnī cāsau bhāryā ceti karmadhārayaḥ | atra ṭhvṛddhinimitasya
ce'ti pratiṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ | sukeśabhāryeti | sukesī cāsau bhāryā
ceti karmadhārayaḥ | atra ṭhsvāṅgācceta' iti niṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ |
brāhmaṇabhāryeti | brāhmaṇī cāsau bhāryā ceti karmadhārayaḥ | atra
ṭhjāteśce'ti niṣedhaḥ prāptaḥ | 
atha jātīyadeśīyayoḥ pratiprasavamudāharati--evaṃ pācakajātīyā
pācakadeśīyeti | ṭhprakāravacane' iti jātīyar | ṭhīṣadasamāptau'
iti daiśīyar | ubhayatrāpi ṭhtasilādiṣu' iti puṃvatvasya ṭhna
kopadhāyāḥ' iti niṣedhaḥ | prāptaḥ | ityādīti | datajātīyā,

(770) tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham |3|1|92|
athopapadasamāsaṃ vakṣyannupapadasaṃjñāmāha--tatropapadaṃ saptamīstham |
adhikā'yam | ṭhsaptamī'ti tadantagrahaṇam | saptamyante pade
vācyavācakabhāvasaṃbandhena tiṣṭhatīti saptamīstham |
saptamyantavācyamiti yāvat |
dhātorityadhikārasūtrādutarasūtramidam | tataśca
tadadhikārāntargateṣu ṭhkarmaṇya'ṇityādisūtreṣu
yatsaptamyantamuccāritaṃ tadeva iha vivakṣitam | evaṃca tadudāharaṇe
kumbhaṃ karoti kumbhakāra ityatra saptamyantavācyaṃ kumbhādīti
paryavasannam | kumbhādeśca upapadasaṃjñāyāṃ
prayojanā'bhāvātadvācakapadeṣu viśrāmyati | tathāca
dhātorityadhikārāntargate karmaṇītyādisūtre yatsaptamyantaṃ
ṭhkarmaṇī'tyādi, tadvācyaṃ yatkumbhādi, tadvācakaṃ padam upapadasaṃjñaṃ
syādityadhikṛta veditavyamityarthaḥ phalitaḥ | tadāha--saptamyante pada
ityādinā | tatra ṭhdhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkāt' iti,
ṭhdhātorekāco halādeḥ' iti, ṭhdhāto'riti ca krameṇa trayo
dhātvadhikārāḥ | tatra pratyāsatyā tṛtīyadhātvadhikārasthasaptamyantasyaiva
grahaṇāt ṭhdhātorekācaḥ' ityādhikāre ṭhcli luṅī'tyatra saptamyantaṃ na
gṛhyate | anyathā karmaṇītyādāviva luṅnte abhūdityādāvupapado
dhātoḥ clirityarthaḥ syāt | nanu tatreti vyarthaṃ,
tṛtīyadhātvadhikārasya prakṛtatvādeva
grahaṇasaṃbhavādityāśaṅkyā--tasmiṃśca satyeveti | ayamāśayaḥ--tatreti
bhinnaṃ vākyaṃ kramavyatyāsena yojyam | saptamīsthamupapadasaṃjñaṃ
syāt, ṭhtatra'utasminsati iti cādhikṛtaṃ veditavyamiti |
tathācopapade sati vakṣyamāṇaḥ pratyayaḥ syāditi ṭhtatre'tyasyārthaḥ
phalati | tathāca ṭhkarmaṇya ṇityatra idaṃ sūtramupasthitam | karmaṇīti
saptamyantaṃ prathamāntatvena vipariṇamyate | saptamīnirdeaśastu
upapadasaṃjñāpravṛtyarthaḥ | ṭhdhātoraṇsyātkartaryarthe, karmavācakaṃ tu
kumbhādipadamupapadasaṃjñaṃ pratyetavyam, tasminnapapade satyava
aṇsyā'diti phalati | ṭhtasminsatyevā'ṇsyā'dityabhāve tu
kāretyevaṃ kevalādapi dhātoḥ kartaryarthe aṇpratyayaḥ syāt|
karmaṇīti saptamyantanirdeaśastu kumbhakāra ityādau upapadasaṃjñāṃ
prāpayyaṭhupapadamati'ṅiti nityasamāsasaṃpādanena kumbe tyasya
kāretyasya ca sādhutvaprāpaṇārthatayā caritārthaḥ | ṭhtasminnupapade
satyevāṇsyā'dityukte tu kumbhādyaupapadasya ampratyayotpatau
nimitatvāvagamānna kevalādaṇpratyayaḥ, upapadasaṃjñāyāḥ
pratyayavidhisaṃniyogaśiṣṭatvalābhāt | ṭhdhaḥ karmaṇi ṣṭran' ṭhbhuvo
bhāve' ityādau saptamyantamarthanirdeaśaparameva, vyākhyānāditi
bhāṣyakaiyaṭādiṣu spaṣṭam |
(771) upapadamatiṅ |2|2|19|

ṭhjyotiṣṭomena yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityādāvityanyatra vistaraḥ |

viśeṣyasyā'liṅgatvātadviśeṣaṇasya kamanīyaśabdasyānavyayasya
liṅgaviśeṣāvagamakatvā'bhāvānnapuṃsakatvameveti bhāvaḥ | idaṃ
cā'niyataliṅgaviṣayam | tena ādiṃ pacati, prātarādirityatra na
bhavati, ādiśabdasya niyataliṅgatvāt | 
(811) tatpuruṣo'nañkarmadhārayaḥ |2|4|19|
tatpuruṣo'naña | nañsamāsakarmadhārayābhyāṃ bhinnastatpuruṣo
vakṣyamāṇakāryabhāgityarthaḥ | tadāha--adhikāro'yamiti |
ṭhparavalliṅgamityataḥ prā'giti śeṣaḥ | 
(812) saṃjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu |2|4|20|
saṃjñāyāṃ kantho | sugamameva | upajñā | upajñāyateuprathamaṃ jñāyata
ityupajñā | ṭhstriyāṃ kti'nnityadhikāre ṭhātaścopasarge' iti karmaṇyaṅ
| upakramyateuārabhyate ityupakramaḥ | karmaṇi ghañ |
ṭhnodātopadeśasye'ti vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ | upajñā copakramaśceti
samāhāradvandvaḥ | ṭhtatpuruṣa' ityasya viśeṣamidam | tadantavidhiḥ |
ṭhsa napuṃsaka'mityato ṭhnapuṃsaka'mityanuvartate | 
(813) upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām |2|4|21|
tadāha--upajñānta upakramāntaśceti | taccchabdena upajñopakramau
vivakṣitau | ādiśabdo bhāvapradhānaḥ prāthamye vartate |
tayorādiḥuprāthamyaṃ--tadādiḥ | tasya ācikhyāsāuākhyātumicchā |
vivakṣāyāmiti yāvat | tadāha--tayorādirityādi |
pāṇinerupajñeti | kartari ṣaṣṭhī | pāṇinyupajñaṃ grantha iti |
pāṇininā prathamaṃ jñāyamāna ityarthaḥ | idaṃ prakaraṇaṃ paravaliṅgatvasya
viśeṣyanighnatvasya cāpavādaḥ | nandopakramaṃ droṇa iti |
nandenārabhyamāṇa ityarthaḥ | kartari ṣaṣṭhaḷa samāsaḥ |
(814) chāyā bāhulye |2|4|22|
chāyā bāhulye | chāyayā tatpuruṣasya
viśeṣaṇātadantavidhimabhipretyāha--chāyānta iti | pūrvapadārtheti |
kasya bāhulye

bāhulye kim ?| kuḍaḷsya chāyā kuḍaḷcchāyā |
(815) sabhārājā'manuṣyapūrvā |2|4|23|
sabhā | rājā ca amanuṣyaśca rājā'manuṣyau, tau pūrvau yasyāḥ
sā-rājā'manuṣyapūrvā iti vigrahaḥ | sabhayā
tatpuruṣaviśeṣaṇātadantavidiḥ | rājaśabdena rājaparyāya eva
vivakṣitaḥ, na tu rājanśabdaḥ | tadāha--rājaparyāyapūrva iti |
inasabham īśvarasabhamiti | inasya īśvarasya vā sabheti vigrahaḥ |
inesvaraśabdau rājaparyāyāviti bhāvaḥ |
(|) paryāyasyaiveṣyate |
paryāyamātragrahaṇe pramāṇaṃ darśayati--paryāyasyaiveṣyata iti |
ṭhbhāṣyakṛte'ti śeṣaḥ | ṭhsvaṃ rūpa'miti sūtre ṭhjitparyāyavacanasyaiva
rājādyartha'miti vārtikaṃ bhāṣye paṭhitamiti bhāvaḥ | rājasabheti |
rājanśabdapūrvakatve'pyatra rājaparyāyapūrvakatvaṃ nāstīti bhāvaḥ |
candraguptasabheti | ṭhcandragupta' iti rājaviśeṣasya nāma, na tu
tatparyāya iti bhāvaḥ | nanvamanuṣyapūrvakatvāddevasabhetyādāvapi
syādityata āha--amanuṣyaśabdo rūḍhaḷeti | asuraśabdo daityāniveti
bhāvaḥ |
(816) aśālā ca |2|4|24|

pūrvasūtre klībatvamuktam, saṃprati saṅghātavācinaḥ sabhāśabdasya
klībatvamucyata ityāha--saṅghātārthā yā sabheti | sabhāśabda ityarthaḥ |
(817) vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām |2|4|25|
vibhāṣā senā | prathamārte ṣaṣṭhī | ṭhtatpuruṣa' ityanuvṛtaṃ
senādibhirviśeṣyate | tadantavidhiḥ | tadāha--etadanta iti |
pratyekābhiprāyamekavacanam | śvaniśamiti | śuno niśeti vigrahaḥ |
kṛṣṇacaturdaśītyāhuḥ | ṭhśunaścaturdaśyāmupavasataḥ paśyāmaḥ' iti
tiryagadhikaraṇe śābarabhāṣye sthitam | dṛḍhasena iti | dṛḍhā senā

aseneti | tatpuruṣatve'pi nañsamāsatvānna klībatvavikalpaḥ |
paramaseneti | karmadhārayatvānna kīlbatvam |

(1526) prāgvahateṣṭhak |4|4|1|
prāgvahateṣṭhak | vahatītyekadeśena ṭhtadvahati rathayugaprāsaṅga'miti
sūtraṃ parāmṛśyate ityabhipretyāha--tadvahatītyata āti | 
(|) tadāheti māśabdādibhya upasaṃkhyānam |
tadāheti | itiśabdo vyutkrameṇa taccchabdānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ |
tadityāhetyarthe māśabda--svāgataityādiśabdebhyaṣṭhaka
upasaṅkhyānamityanvayaḥ | ṭhta'dityanena vākyārtho vivakṣitaḥ |
itiśabdastasya vākyārthasya karmatvaṃ gamayati | ṭhmā śabdaṃ
kārṣī'rityāhetyādyarthe tadvākyāvayavāt ṭhmāśabda'
ityādiśabdāṭṭhagiti yāvat | māśābdika iti | śabdaṃ mā
kārṣīrityanvayaḥ | ṭhmāṅ luiṅ'iti loḍarthe luṅ | ṭhna māḍaḷege'
ityajāgamaniṣedhaḥ | śabdaṃ na kuru ityarthaḥ | atra āheti
brūñdhātvarthavyaktavacanakriyāṃ prati ṭhmā śabdaṃ kārṣī'riti vākyārthaḥ
karma | tadvākyaikadeśo māśabdeti samudāyaḥ | tasmānnirvibhaktikādayaṃ
pratyayaḥ | na hi māśabdeti samudāyādvibhaktirasti | evaṃca māśabdeti
samudāyāṭṭhaki ṭhmāśabdika' iti rūpam | ṭhmā śabdaḥ kārī'ti pāṭhe
tu kārīti karmaṇi luṅ | śabdo na kārya ityarthaḥ | naca tadāhetyarthe
māśabdādibhyaṣṭhagiti yathāśrutamabyupagamya māśabdamāhetyādyarthe
māśabdetyādiśabdebhyo dvitīyāntebhyaṣṭhagityeva kuto na
vyākhyāyata iti vācyam, evaṃ sati ṭhāhau prabhūtādibhyaḥ'
ityutaravārtikārambhavaiyarthadhyāpateriti bhāvaḥ | 
(1527) svāgatādīnāṃ ca |7|3|7|
svāgatādigaṇe-svāgata, svadhvara iti paṭhitaṃ, tatra
viśeṣamāha--svāgatādīnāṃ ca | ṭhna yvābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu
tābhyāmaica' iti prakaraṇe ṭhna karmavyatihāre' ityasmādutaraṃ
sūtramidam | aijña syāditi | śeṣapūraṇamidam | ṭhna yvābhyāṃ
padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyāmaica' iti prāpta aijña syādityarthaḥ |
svādhvarika iti | svadhvara ityāhetyarthaḥ | atha
svāgatādigaṇaśeṣamudāharati--svaṅgasyeti | vyāṅgiriti |
vyaṅgasyāpatyamiti vigrahaḥ | vyaḍasyeti | na vidyate ḍo yasya sa
aḍaḥ, vigato'ḍo vyaḍaḥ | svāpateyamiti |
ṭhpathyatithivasatisvapaterḍhañ' | dvārāditvādaic prāpto niṣidhyate

(|) āhau prabhūtādibhyaḥ |

prabhūtādibhyaṣṭhagvācya ityarthaḥ | pāryāptika iti | paryāptamāhetyarthaḥ
| 
(|) pṛccchatau paradārādibhyaḥ | 
pṛccchatāviti | ṭhta'dityanuvartate | pṛccchatītyarthe dvitīyāntebhyaḥ
susnātādibhyaṣṭhagvācya ityarthaḥ | saukhaśāyanika iti | sukhaśayanaṃ
pṛccchatītyarthaḥ | anuśatikādiriti | ṭhsukhaśayanaśabda' iti śeṣaḥ |
tataśca ṭhanuśatikādīnāṃ ce'ti pūrvotarapadayorādivṛddhiriti
bhāvaḥ | 
(|) gaccchatau paradārādibhyaḥ | 
gaccchatāviti | tadityanuvartate | gaccchatītyarthe paradārādibhyo
dvitīyāntebhyaṣṭhagityarthaḥ | pāradārika iti | paradārāngaccchatītyarthaḥ
| gaurutalpika iti | gurutalpaṃ gaccchatītyarthaḥ | gurutalpougurustrī |

ktvāpratyaye gatisamāse lyapi ṭhmayateridanyatarasyā'miti itve
ṭhhrasvasya pitī'ti tugāgame apamityetyavyayam, ṭhktvātosunkasunaḥ'
ityukterityarthaḥ | nirvṛtamityarthe
apamityetyavyayātprathamāntādyācitaśabdācca tṛtīyāntātkak kan ca
yathāsaṅkhyaṃ syātāmityarthaḥ | apamityetyaṃśe
tṛtīyāntatvā'saṃbhavātprathamāntādyācitaśabdācca tṛtīyāntātkak kan
ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ syātāmityarthaḥ | apamityetyaṃśe

taditi prathamoccāritam | tataśca sya adhyayanaviṣaye ṭhtatkarma
vṛta'mityarthe taccchabdagamyaviśeṣyavācakātprathamāntāṭṭhak
syādityarthaḥ | tadāha--prathamāntāditi | ṭhvṛtaṃ karma prati
viśeṣyasamarpakā' diti śeṣaḥ | adhyayane vṛteti | viṣayasaptamyeṣā
| yā kriyeti | anena karmaśabdaḥ kriyāpara iti sūcitam |
prathamāntasyārtha iti | ṭhanena karma vṛta'mityetatadityasya prathamāntasya
viśeṣaṇamiti sūcitam | tadityananuvṛtau karmaśabdasyaiva sūtre
pratamānirdiṣṭatvātata eva pratyayaḥ syāt, natu tadviśeṣyavācakāt,
tasya
prathamānirdiṣṭatvā'bhāvādityabhipretyodāharati--etamanyadvṛtamasya
aikānyika iti | ṭhtaddhitārtha' iti samāse ekānyaśabdāṭṭhahagiti
bhāvaḥ | dvaiyanyikaḥ, traiyanyikaḥ | aijāgamo viśeṣaḥ |

 atha utarakṛdantam|
(1) uṇādayo bahulam |3|3|1|
atha utarakṛdantaprakriyā nirūpyante| uṇādayo bahulaṃ| tṛtīye'dhāye
tṛtīyapādasyedamādimaṃ sūtram| vartamāne saṃjñāyāṃ ceti|
ṭhvartamāne la'ḍityataḥ, ṭhpuvaḥ saṃjñāyā'mityataśca tadanuvṛteriti
bhāvaḥ| ata eva ṭhnañi hana eha ca' nañpūrvāddhanterasipratyaye
prakṛterahādeśe vyutpanno'nehasÂśabdo vartamānakāla evetyuktaṃ
bhāṣye| saṃjñāśabdaścā'tra rūḍhaśabdaparaḥ| vaidikānāmapi
śabdānāmupalakṣaṇam| ata eva ṭhnaigamarūḍhibhavaṃ hi susādhu' iti
vārtikam, ṭhvaidikā rūḍhaśabdāścauṇādikā' iti bhāṣyaṃ ca
saṅgaccchate| rūḍhāścaite uṇādipratyayāntā avayavārthaśūnyā
asantamapyavayavārthamāśritya prāyaḥ kartari vyutpādyāḥ| ṭhuṇādayo
ve'tyanuktvā bahulagrahaṇasya prayojanamāha---kecaditi| tadevāha---
saṃjñāsvityādi| bhāṣyastho'yaṃ ślokaḥ| ḍittho ḍivittha ityādau
dhāturūpāṇi pratyayāśca yathāsaṃbhavamūhyāḥ|
guṇaniṣedhādikāryavaśādanūbandhaṃ vidyāt| anūbandhamityatra
ṭhupasargas ghañyamanuṣye' iti dīrghaḥ| etat-- uṇādiṣu śāstraṃ u
śāsitavyam| ṭhkṛvāpājī'tyādisūtreṇa tu śākaṭāyanapraṇītāni
asyaiva bahulagrahaṇasya prapañca ityarthaḥ|

(2) bhūte'pi dṛśyante |3|3|2|

(4) tumunÂṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām |3|3|10|

ityavyayatvamityarthaḥ| tataśca ṭhavyayakṛto bhāve' iti vacanādbhāve

#anārthatvaṃ tumunā dyotyaṃ, vācyaṃ vā| kṛṣṇaṃ darśako yātīti|

ṭhakenorbhaviṣyadādhamarṇyayo'riti na ṣaṣṭhī| nanu tumuno
bhāvārthakatve tadviṣaye kartari vihitānāṃ tṛjādīnamapravṛtāvapi

ṭhtumunṇvulau' iti vihitasya ṇvulo'pavāda ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca ṇvulā
bādhitasya ṭhkarmaṇya'ṇityasya ayamaṇvidhiḥ pratiprasavārtha iti sthitam|
nanu ṇvulā bādhitasyā'ṇaḥ pratiprasave'pi ṭhāto'nupasargeṭa iti
kapratyayaḥ ṭhkambalādayo vrajatī'tyatra durnivāraḥ| kapratyayasya
karmaṇyaṇapavādatvāt, sarūpatvena ca vā'sarūpavidhyapravṛteḥ| nacāyaṃ
vaiśeṣiko'ṇvidhiḥ kapratyayasyāpyapavāda iti śaṅkyaṃ, na
hyayamapūrvo'ṇvidhiḥ| kiṃtu lāghavāt ṭhkarmaṇya'ṇityaṇevā'tra
pratiprasūyate| saca ṭhkarmaṇya'ṇityaṇ sāmānyavihitaḥ ṭhāto'nupasarge
kaḥ' iti vaiśeṣikasya nā'pavādaḥ, pratyuta kapratyaya eva tadapavādaḥ|
ataḥ ṭhkambahaladāyo vrajatī'tyatra karmaṇyaṇapavādaṃ
ṭhtumunṇvulā'viti ṇvulaṃ bādhitvā kapratyayaḥ syādityata āha---
paratvādayamiti| ādinā ṭhsāmago gurukulaṃ vrajatī'tyādau
ṭhgāpoṣṭa' gityādisaṅgrahaḥ| ṭhaṇkarmaṇi ce'ti hyāvartate|
pratiprasavavidhirapūrvavidhiśca| tatrapratiprasavavidhinā ṇvulā aṇo
bādhanivṛtiḥ| apūrvavidhivihatsaya tvaṇastṛtīyapādīyasya
dvitīyapādasthakapratyayāpekṣayā paratvātkādipratyayā aṇā anena
bādhyanta ityarthaḥ| etacca bhāṣye spaṣṭam| ita ūrdhvam -- ṭhlṛṭ śeṣe
ce'tyādisūtreṣu kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāmiti nivṛtam|
bhaviṣyatītyevānuvartate iti bodhyam|

ṇilopāpavādaḥ| vigaṇayyeti| ṭhgaṇa saṅkhyāne' curādiḥ,
kathādiradantaḥ| tasmāṇṇic| ato lopaḥ| ktvo lyapi ṇerayādeśaḥ|
prabebhidayyeti| bhidadhātoryaṅ idvitvam| ṭhguṇo
yaṅluko'rityabhyāsasya guṇaḥ, jaśtvaṃ, ṭhyasya halaḥ' iti
yakāralopaḥ, ato lopaḥ, ktvo lyapi ṇerayādeśaḥ|

(151) vibhāṣā pareḥ |6|1|44|

tadāha-- parervyeña iti| pariparvādvyeñaḥ ktvo lyapi yakārasya
saṃprasāraṇe pūrvarūpe ca kṛte pari vi ya iti sthite āha--
tukamiti| kathamiti| svāpakāla eva mukhavyādānaṃ, hāsakāla eva
netranimīlanam| evaṃ ca vyādānanetranimīlanayoḥ
svāpahāsapūrvakālakatvā'bhāvāt kathaṃ ktvāpratyaya ityākṣepaḥ|
samādhate--- vyādāneti| yadyapi svāpahasanotpatyutarakālake
vyādānanimīlane natu tatpūrvakālake, tathāpi
vyādānotpatyutarakāle nimīlanotpatyutarakāle'pi ca svāpahāsau
anuvartete| tatra svāpotpattikālīnavyādānasya
hāsotpattikālīnanimīlanasya ca
tatkālīnasvāpahāsapūrvakālakatvā'bhāve'pi
tadutakālānuvṛtasvāpahāsāpekṣayā pūrvakālakatvasatvāt
ktÂvāpratyaya ityarthaḥ| ṭhmāmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na

ṭhstitasye'tyādyadhyāhāryam|

(152) ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca |3|4|22|
ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ca| ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāleṭa ityutaramidaṃ
sūtamar| tadāha--- pūrviṣaye iti|yadyapi vā'sarūpavidhinā ktvā
siddhaḥ| stryadhikārātprāgeva vā'sarūpavidhipakṣe'pi ktvāvidhau
vā'sarūpavacanasya vā'sarūpasūtrabhāṣye prapañcitatvāt, tathāpi
ṭhvibhāṣāgreprathame'ti sūtre ubhayorvidhānāya cakāraḥ| tatra hi ṭhagre
bhojaṃ vrajati devadataḥ' ṭhagre bhuktve' tyādau devadatakratṛkabhojane
yajñadatādikartṛkabhojanāpekṣayā pūrvakālatvamagrādiśabdena
bodhyate, na tu vrajanādikriyāpekṣayā pūrvakālatvam| tataśca
ṭhsamānakartṛkayo'riti ktvāpratyayasya tatra na prasaktiḥ| nāpi
ṭhvibhāṣā'gre' ityanena ābhīkṣṇye tatrā'prāptavidhiriti yujyate|
ābhīkṣṇye pūrvavipratiṣedhena ṭhābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ce'tyasyaiva
pravṛteriṣṭatvāditi śabdenduśekhare vistaraḥ| dvitvamiti|
ṭhnitatyavīpsayorityanene'ti śeṣaḥ| smṛtvāsmṛtveti| ṭhnamati
śiva'mityanuṣajyate| pāyaṃpāyamiti| ṭhāto yuk ciṇkṛto'rita
yuk| vā dīrgha iti. gamerṇyantāṇṇamuli ṭhmitāṃ hrasvaḥ' iti hrasve
kṛte ṭhciṇṇamulo'riti dīrghavikalpa ityarthaḥ| vyavasthiteti|
vyākhyānāditi bhāvaḥ| upasṛṣṭasyeti| upasargapūrvasyetyarthaḥ|
jāgṛdhātorṇamuli vṛddhimāśaṅkyāha--- jāgra iti|
ṇyantasyāpyevamiti| jāgṛdhātorṇau vṛddhiṃ bādhitvā
ṭhjāgro'viciṇṇalÂṅtsu'iiti guṇe ṇilope ṭhjāgara' mityeva
rūpamiti bhāvaḥ|

(153) na yadyanākāṅkṣe |3|4|23|
na yadyanākāṅkṣe| yatprāptamiti| ktvā, ṇamul cetyarthaḥ| yatreti|
yasminvākye pūrvotarakālikakriyāpade staḥ, tadvākyaṃ vākyāntaraṃ
nākāṅkṣati cedityarthaḥ| pūrvotarakālikakriyāpadadvayayuktaṃ vākyaṃ
vākyāntaraṃ nākāṅkaṣati cediti yāvat| yadayamiti|
ṭhya'dityavyayam| yadā'yaṃ bhuṅkte tataḥ paraṃ paṭhatītyarthaḥ| idamekaṃ
vākya bhujipaṭhikriyāpadadvayayuktaṃ na vākyāntaramākāṅkṣatīti bhāvaḥ|
yadayaṃ bhuktvā vrajatīti| bhujivrajikriyāpadadvayayuktamidaṃ vākyam|
tatoṭh'dhite'iti vākyāntaramākāṅkṣati| nā'trāyaṃ niṣedha itiḥ

(154) vibhāṣā'greprathamapūrveṣu |3|4|24|
vibhāṣā'gre| agre, prathama , pūrva, eṣāṃ dvandvaḥ| ṭhagre' ityavyayam,
edantaṃ vā nipātanāt| nānuvartate iti| etacca bhāṣye spaṣṭam|

ṭhpūrva'miti kriyāviśeṣaṇam| pakṣa #eiti| ktvāṇamulau

(155) karmaṇyākrośe kṛñaḥ khamuñ |3|4|25|

(156) svādumi ṇamul |3|4|26|
svādumi ṇamul| svādumītyarthagrahaṇam, vyākhyānāt| tathā ca
svāduparyāye upapada iti labhyate| ṭhkarmaṇyākrośe' iti
pūrvasūtrātkṛña ityanuvartate, natu khamuñ, asvaritatvāt| tataśca
ṭhābhīkṣṇye ṇamul ce'tyato ṇamulityanurtate, ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ
pūrvakāleṭa iti sūtraṃ ca| tadāha-- svādvartheṣvityādinā|nanu
svāduśabdasyasvādāvityeva nirdeaśa ucita ityata āha--
svāduśabdasyeti| nanvatra khamuñevānuvartatām| evaṃ ca
svādumimāntatvanipānamapi na kartavayamityāśaṅkya striyāṃ
cvyantasyā'vyayatvāt ṭharurdviṣa'diti mum durlabhaḥ, tatra mumvidhau
ṭhanavyayasye'tyanuvṛteḥ| tataśca asvāduaṃ svāduaṃ kṛtvā bhuṅkte
svāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte ityatrāpi mum na syāt, khamuñaḥ khitvasya
coraṅkāramityatra sāvakāśatvāt| kiṃca ṭhcvau' iti dīrgāpatiḥ|
ato ṇamuli svāduśabde māntatvanipātanamiti bhāvaḥ|
svādumītyarthagrahaṇasya prayojanamāha-- saṃpannaṅkāramiti| atra ṭhasya
cvau' iti ītvā'bāve'pi māntatvanipātanasya phalaṃ bodhyam|
svāduparyāyāviti| vṛtyādigrantheṣu tathā darśanāditi bhāvaḥ|
vā'sarūpeṇa ktvāpīti| yadyapi ṭhstriyāṃ kti'nnityata#ḥ prāgeva
vā'sarūpavidhiriti bhāṣye sthitantathāpi tatraiva bhāṣye ṭhktvāyāṃ
bāvacana'miti ktvāpratyaye vā'sarūpavidhipravṛterviśiṣya vacanādiha
ktvāpi bhavatītyarthaḥ| ṭhvā'sarūpavidhiḥ striyāmityādhikārāt
prāgūrdhvaṃ ca bhavatī'ti pakṣāntaramapi tatraiva bhāṣye sthitam| tatpakṣe
ktvāyāṃ vā'sarūpapravṛtirnirbādhetyāstāṃ tāvat| anyathaivam|
anyathā, evam,katham, ittham, eṣāmavyayānāṃ
dvandvātsaptamībahuvacanam| siddhaḥ aprayogaḥ u prayogā'bhāvo yasay
kṛñaḥ sa siddhā'prayoga iti vigrahaḥ| tadāha-- eṣu kṛña ityādi| nanu
kṛño'prayoge kathaṃ tadartāvagatiḥ, arthā'gatyabhāve tatprayogo vā
kimartha ityata āha-- vyarthatvāditi | niṣphalatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
arthasyā'vivakṣitatve'pi ṇamulpratyayasādhutvārthaṃ tatprayoga iti
bhāvaḥ| tadeva darśayati--- itthaṃ bhuṅkte ityartha iti|
ṭhsamānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle' ityasaṃbhavānnānuvartate iti bhāvaḥ|
siddheti kimiti| siddhā'prayogaścediti kimarthamityarthaḥ| bhāṣye
ṭhanyathā kṛtvā anayorupapadayoḥ' kṛño ṇamul
syātsiddhā'prayogaścet kṛñiti phalitam| asūyayā prativacanamiti
vigrahaḥ| ṭhkartṛkaraṇe kṛtā bahula'miti samāsaḥ| tadāha--
asūyayeti|

(157) karmaṇi dṛśividoḥ sākalye |3|4|29|

(174) upadaṃśastṛtīyāyām |3|4|47|

pradhānakriyānurodhātparatvācceti bhāvaḥ| nanu mūlakasya bhujikriyāṃ
prati karaṇatve upadaṃśanenā'sāmarthyātsamāsānupapatiriti
śaṅkate-- yadyapīti| upadaṃśinā saha mūlakasya karmatvenānvayaḥ

karaṇatvenānvayasyoktatvādityākṣepaḥ| samādhate-- tathāpīti|
bhujikriyāṃ prati śābdamaryādayā karaṇatvenānvitasyāpi
mūlakasyopadaṃśanaṃ prati ārthikaḥ karmatvānvayayo'styeva|
mūlakasyopadadaṃśanaṃ prati vastutaḥ karmatvasya satvādityarthaḥ|
nanvārthikakarmatvānvayamādāya kathaṃ tṛtīyā, kathaṃ vā ṇamul, kathaṃ
vā samāsa ityata āha-- etāvataiveti| kuta etadityata āha--
tṛtīyāyāmiti| vacanasāmarthyāditi| yadi tṛtīyānte śābdānvaya
evātra vivakṣyeta, tadā karaṇa ityevāvakṣyat ṭhkarame hanaḥ' itivaditi
bhāvaḥ| mūlakasya bhujikriyāṃ prati karaṇatvānvayaḥ śābdaḥ| upadaṃśe
karmatvānvaya ārthika ityetadupapādayati-- tataścāyamartha iti|
ṭhmūlakena bhuṅkte' ityanvayaḥ śābdaḥ, pradhānakriyānurodhātparatvācca
tṛtīyāvibhakteḥ pravṛteriti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ kṛtveti| kiṃ kṛtvā
mūlakena bhuṅkte ityākāṅkṣāyāmupadaśyetyanvetītyarthaḥ|
tadeveti| kimupadasyetyākāṅkṣāyāṃ tadeva mūlakamarthāt
karmatvenānvetītyarthaḥ|
